papers.title: Compact Spin-Charge Separated Neural Quantum States for Valence-Bond States
papers.abstract: Neural-network quantum states (NQS) provide a flexible nonlinear representation of quantum many-body wavefunctions, but their efficiency depends sensitively on whether the architecture reflects the sign structure and constrained Hilbert space of the target state. In this work, we propose a solvable-point-guided strategy: design the architecture at an exactly solvable point where the correct local rules can be read off, then refine to the non-exact regime by enlarging only the kernel size and hidden dimension. The strategy is built from four physics-motivated designs: a stride-matched local-rule convolution, geometric pooling, a sign-resolving $\tanh(x^{2k+1})$ activation, and explicit spin-hole sector separation. We test this approach on quasi-one-dimensional valence-bond-solid (VBS) states and their doped soliton variants (sVBS), the exact ground states of a $t$-$J$-like model with a single mobile hole. In finite-size benchmarks, this architecture reaches high fidelity for the exact sVBS state with substantially fewer parameters than generic fully connected, convolutional, and transformer baselines tested under the same setup. For the spin sector, the learned local rule transfers from small to larger systems without retraining. Away from the solvable point, increasing kernel size and hidden dimension systematically improves accuracy, and the model shows approximately $L^2$ parameter scaling in the gapless regime for system size $L$, compared with approximately $L^4$ for matrix-product states in the same regime. Our work establishes a recipe for compact NQS in sign-structured, constrained Hilbert spaces and paves the pathway to physics-informed architectures for the broader $t$-$J$ and Hubbard families.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“neural-network quantum states (NQS)”、“architecture design”、“parameter scaling”等关键词，属于计算方法与理论建模。；研究对象：准一维价键固体（VBS）态及其掺杂孤子变体（sVBS），即一个类似t-J模型（含单个移动空穴）的精确基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于可解点引导的紧凑型自旋-电荷分离神经量子态架构，能以远少于全连接、卷积和Transformer基线的参数，高保真度地表示sVBS态；在无带隙区域，模型参数规模随系统尺寸L呈约L²标度，远优于矩阵乘积态的约L⁴标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于可解点引导的紧凑型自旋-电荷分离神经量子态架构，能以远少于全连接、卷积和Transformer基线的参数，高保真度地表示sVBS态；在无带隙区域，模型参数规模随系统尺寸L呈约L²标度，远优于矩阵乘积态的约L⁴标度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统NQS架构相比的具体创新点，但核心新意在于：将可解点物理（局域规则）直接嵌入神经网络架构设计，并实现自旋与电荷自由度的显式分离，从而在保持高精度的同时大幅压缩参数规模，并展示出优于矩阵乘积态的标度行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用可解点引导的架构设计策略：在精确可解点处读取正确的局域规则，然后通过仅增大卷积核尺寸和隐藏维度来推广到非精确区域。具体包含四种物理驱动的设计：步长匹配的局域规则卷积、几何池化、符号分辨的tanh(x^{2k+1})激活函数、以及显式的自旋-空穴扇区分离。

papers.title: Milestoning Markov-jump dynamics: Stationary properties, thermodynamic consistency, kinetic hysteresis, and fluctuation symmetries
papers.abstract: We derive an exact coarse graining of generic Markov-jump processes into observable semi-Markov dynamics. Exact results for waiting-time distributions for jumps between observable states are derived and proved that these decompose into conditionally independent dwell and transition times. Dwell times are proved to be a local property of mesostates - they depend on the initial but not final state. Conversely, transition-path times depend on both states, trigger kinetic hysteresis, and, under suitable conditions on the hidden sub-network, are shown to obey a reflection symmetry. We characterize the stationary properties of the milestoned dynamics, prove its thermodynamic consistency, and demonstrate robustness to milestone positioning. Surprisingly, even in the limit of a time-scale separation rendering the observed dynamics approximately Markovian, the effect of kinetic hysteresis on the dissipation persists. A minimal example shows how the results lay the foundation for inferring affinities of hidden dissipative cycles from observations of transition-path times.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“derive an exact coarse graining”“proved”“characterize the stationary properties”等理论推导与证明性表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：马尔可夫跳变过程的粗粒化动力学，具体为可观测的半马尔可夫动力学及其稳态性质、热力学一致性、动力学滞后与涨落对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了可观测态之间的等待时间分布可分解为条件独立的驻留时间和跃迁时间，其中驻留时间是介观态的局域性质，而跃迁时间依赖于初末态并引发动力学滞后；即使在时间尺度分离使观测动力学近似马尔可夫的情况下，动力学滞后对耗散的影响依然存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了可观测态之间的等待时间分布可分解为条件独立的驻留时间和跃迁时间，其中驻留时间是介观态的局域性质，而跃迁时间依赖于初末态并引发动力学滞后；即使在时间尺度分离使观测动力学近似马尔可夫的情况下，动力学滞后对耗散的影响依然存在。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异，但明确提出了milestoning方法下动力学滞后的存在性及其对耗散的影响，并展示了如何从跃迁时间观测推断隐藏耗散循环的亲和力。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于马尔可夫跳变过程的精确粗粒化方法（milestoning），推导等待时间分布、驻留时间与跃迁时间的分解性质，并分析稳态性质、热力学一致性及涨落对称性。

papers.title: Distributed Acoustic Sensing for Urban Monitoring: Coverage Thresholds and Percolation
papers.abstract: Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) enables the repurposing of existing fiber-optic networks as ultra-dense, long-range seismic arrays for urban monitoring. However, constraints imposed by real-world fiber infrastructure topology and components limit its use for city-scale applications. Recent technological developments have paved the way for short-range, on-chip DAS. Assuming their availability, and based on a Graph Theory framework, we show that monitoring applications fall along a coverage spectrum with two critical thresholds that define three distinct regimes. Low coverage (<10%) can, with optimal design, resolve earthquake early warning, groundwater monitoring, geological mapping, and urban activity tracking. A percolation transition occurs at 51.6% coverage, beyond which the city effectively becomes fully covered and statistical traffic monitoring is possible. Only for effectively complete coverage, infrastructure monitoring, individual vehicle tracking, and pedestrian movement analysis become possible. Thus, privacy-related risks remain very low. We show and exemplify how, for metropolises around the world, an optimal sensing network can be designed for earthquake early warning, traffic monitoring, and urban activity tracking. This framework provides a near-future roadmap for deploying urban DAS networks as a backbone of smart city sensing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：基于图论框架（Graph Theory framework）进行理论分析，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：城市监测中的分布式声学传感（Distributed Acoustic Sensing, DAS）网络，特别是其覆盖阈值与渗流（percolation）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 城市DAS监测应用存在两个关键覆盖阈值，将覆盖范围划分为三个不同区域：低于10%的覆盖即可实现地震预警、地下水监测等；当覆盖率达到51.6%时发生渗流转变，城市基本实现全覆盖；仅当覆盖接近完全时，才能实现基础设施监测和个体追踪。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：城市DAS监测应用存在两个关键覆盖阈值，将覆盖范围划分为三个不同区域：低于10%的覆盖即可实现地震预警、地下水监测等；当覆盖率达到51.6%时发生渗流转变，城市基本实现全覆盖；仅当覆盖接近完全时，才能实现基础设施监测和个体追踪。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于图论框架（Graph Theory framework）建立覆盖模型，通过渗流理论（percolation）分析覆盖阈值，并对全球多个大都市进行最优传感网络设计示例。

papers.title: Evolution of Nonlinear Ion Transport in Nanopore Arrays: Ionic Conductance, Current Rectification, and Osmotic Power
papers.abstract: Understanding the ionic transport and scaling behaviors in nanopore arrays is essential for bridging fundamental ion physics and blue energy applications. By fabricating sub-3 nm and sub-20 nm diameter nanopore arrays (NPAs) spanning from few pores to N ~ 10000, we systematically investigate ionic conductance, ion current rectification, and osmotic energy conversion. We report the ionic conductance scaling laws and nonlinearity with nanopore number, with stronger deviations from linearity at lower salt concentrations. Experimental evidence reveals that surface-charge-governed conductance and ion current rectification progressively weaken with increasing N and even vanish as the NPA scales up to N ~ 10000, resulting in an underestimation of surface charge density. In a sub-3 nm densely packed array (separation ~ 25 nm), the conductance exhibits an anomalous power-law dependence on concentration, deviating markedly from the single nanopore characteristics, attributed to the strong pore interactions. Furthermore, osmotic power harvesting measurements reveal a substantial reduction in power density upon scaling, with decreases of up to three orders of magnitude over the same range. To elucidate the underlying mechanism, we developed rigorous 3D modeling showing that the nonlinear behavior originates from concentration polarization at pore entrances and suppressed electric field across NPAs, collectively hindering ion transport. Our work provides insight into nonlinear ion-transport scaling and reveals fundamental differences between transport phenomena in single nanopores and nanopore arrays.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算建模）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“fabricating”“experimental evidence”“measurements”等实验关键词，同时包含“developed rigorous 3D modeling”作为理论支撑。；研究对象：纳米孔阵列（nanopore arrays, NPAs）中的非线性离子输运现象，具体包括离子电导、电流整流和渗透能量转换。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着纳米孔阵列中孔数量N增大至约10000，表面电荷主导的电导和电流整流效应逐渐减弱甚至消失，导致表面电荷密度被低估；在亚3纳米密集排列阵列中，电导对浓度的依赖呈现反常幂律行为，偏离单孔特性，归因于强孔间相互作用。渗透功率密度在相同尺度下可降低三个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着纳米孔阵列中孔数量N增大至约10000，表面电荷主导的电导和电流整流效应逐渐减弱甚至消失，导致表面电荷密度被低估；在亚3纳米密集排列阵列中，电导对浓度的依赖呈现反常幂律行为，偏离单孔特性，归因于强孔间相互作用。渗透功率密度在相同尺度下可降低三个数量级。；创新点：系统揭示了纳米孔阵列从少量孔到大规模阵列（N~10000）的离子输运非线性标度行为，并指出单纳米孔与纳米孔阵列之间输运现象的根本差异。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制备了直径小于3 nm和小于20 nm的纳米孔阵列，孔数从几个到约10000个；测量了离子电导、电流整流和渗透能量转换。理论上开发了严格的三维模型，用于揭示浓度极化和电场抑制等机制。

papers.title: Progress toward a better BOCS: Systematic coarse-graining with local density potentials
papers.abstract: We describe version 5.0 of the Bottom-up Open-source Coarse-graining Software (BOCS) package. BOCS employs the force-matching variational principle to parameterize potentials for coarse-grained (CG) models directly from atomically detailed simulations. BOCS version 5.0 significantly extends previous versions by treating potentials that depend upon the local density (LD) around each particle, as well as potentials that depend upon the square gradient (SG) of this local density. We also describe a new package, PKG-BOCS, for simulating these potentials in LAMMPS. This software treats complex molecular topologies and provides considerable flexibility for defining the local density, as well as the LD and SG potentials. We present numerical calculations that provide physical insight into these potentials and demonstrate the accuracy of our implementation. Finally, we demonstrate that LD potentials can significantly improve the structural fidelity, thermodynamic properties, and transferability of CG models for water.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：force-matching variational principle、coarse-grained (CG) models、numerical calculations、software package。；研究对象：粗粒化（CG）模型中的局域密度（LD）势和局域密度平方梯度（SG）势，并以水分子体系作为具体测试对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局域密度（LD）势能显著提升水粗粒化模型的结构保真度、热力学性质以及可迁移性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局域密度（LD）势能显著提升水粗粒化模型的结构保真度、热力学性质以及可迁移性。；创新点：BOCS 5.0版本首次系统性地支持依赖于局域密度（LD）及其平方梯度（SG）的粗粒化势函数，并提供了相应的LAMMPS模拟接口，同时支持复杂分子拓扑结构和灵活的局域密度定义方式。
papers.method_zh: 采用力匹配变分原理（force-matching variational principle）从全原子模拟数据中参数化粗粒化势；开发了BOCS 5.0软件包用于势函数拟合，以及PKG-BOCS软件包用于在LAMMPS中模拟这些势函数；通过数值计算验证势函数的物理意义和实现精度。

papers.title: Disentangling multi-spin dynamic correlations in the Heisenberg spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ chain
papers.abstract: Higher-order correlations are essential for understanding exotic phases and uncovering universal aspects of quantum dynamics. While inelastic neutron scattering provides well-established access to two-particle correlations, measuring correlations in solids involving more than two particles remains a major challenge. Focusing on magnetic excitations in the Heisenberg spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ chain, we demonstrate that resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) can selectively probe multi-spin dynamical correlations by exciting distinct intermediate states through energy detuning. Through theoretical modeling, we isolate the two- and multi- spin responses, and establish that: (i) The resonant energies of the two- and multi- spin dynamical correlations are separated by $\approx \frac{3}{4}J$; implying that the multi-spin part of the cross-section comes from intermediate states that contain spin flips; (ii) The spectral weight of the two-spin channel exhibits a Lorentzian resonant energy profile consistent with a single dominant electronic configuration, whereas the multi-spin channel response shows a Gaussian-like profile, implying contributions from multiple intermediate spin configurations. These characteristics are reproduced by exact diagonalization of the $t-J$ Hamiltonian, which further reveals that the widths of Lorentzian and Gaussian resonant energy profiles depend primarily on core-hole lifetime ($Γ/2$) and $\frac{2J}Γ$, respectively. Controlled access to multi-spin dynamics, using RIXS energy detuning as a knob, can open new pathways to explore many-body dynamics in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：theoretical modeling、exact diagonalization、摘要未提及实验数据采集。；研究对象：Heisenberg自旋-1/2链中的多自旋动力学关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）的能量失谐（energy detuning）可选择性探测多自旋动力学关联；两自旋与多自旋通道的共振能量间隔约为3J/4，且两自旋通道的共振谱呈洛伦兹型，多自旋通道呈高斯型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）的能量失谐（energy detuning）可选择性探测多自旋动力学关联；两自旋与多自旋通道的共振能量间隔约为3J/4，且两自旋通道的共振谱呈洛伦兹型，多自旋通道呈高斯型。；创新点：提出利用RIXS能量失谐作为调控手段，区分并独立提取两自旋与多自旋动力学关联信号，为实验上直接测量多体量子材料中的高阶自旋关联提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与精确对角化（exact diagonalization of the t-J Hamiltonian），结合RIXS过程模拟，分析不同中间态激发对散射截面的贡献。

papers.title: Electronic Green's function across the pseudogap to stripe transition in the $t$-$t'$-$J$ model
papers.abstract: Superconducting domes in strongly correlated electronic systems are often accompanied by charge density waves and peculiar features in the electronic structure. The appearance of a pseudogap, in particular, and its relation to charge density waves remains insufficiently understood. Here, we investigate the electronic Green's function of the underdoped $t$-$t'$-$J$ model of the cuprate superconductors using tensor network algorithms for finite temperature dynamics on cylinders of width $4$. We find the prominent momentum differentiation, the hallmark of the pseudogap, to be strongly dependent on $t'$, which develops into a momentum-dependent opening of a gap upon decreasing temperature, consistent with the formation of a Fermi arc at intermediate temperatures. The nodal gap around ${\bf k}=(π/2,π/2)$ closes and fills with increasing temperature as coherent stripe order melts into a regime of fluctuating charge clusters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：tensor network algorithms（张量网络算法）、finite temperature dynamics（有限温度动力学）。；研究对象：欠掺杂铜氧化物超导体的 \( t \)-\( t' \)-\( J \) 模型，具体研究赝能隙到条纹相转变过程中的电子格林函数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 赝能隙的标志性特征——动量空间中的显著分化——强烈依赖于次近邻跃迁参数 \( t' \)，且随着温度降低表现为动量依赖的能隙打开，与费米弧的形成一致；节点附近（\( \mathbf{k}=(\pi/2,\pi/2) \)）的能隙随温度升高而闭合，同时相干条纹序熔化为涨落的电荷团簇。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：赝能隙的标志性特征——动量空间中的显著分化——强烈依赖于次近邻跃迁参数 \( t' \)，且随着温度降低表现为动量依赖的能隙打开，与费米弧的形成一致；节点附近（\( \mathbf{k}=(\pi/2,\pi/2) \)）的能隙随温度升高而闭合，同时相干条纹序熔化为涨落的电荷团簇。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用张量网络算法（tensor network algorithms）在宽度为4的圆柱几何上模拟有限温度动力学。

papers.title: Adiabatic realization of anomalous Floquet topological systems
papers.abstract: Topology has emerged as a central concept for classifying phases of matter. The situation is especially rich in periodically driven systems, where anomalous Floquet topological phases break the usual bulk-boundary correspondence between Chern number and edges modes of two-dimensional systems. These phases were so far realized by periodic modulation of the tunneling elements at frequencies near-resonant with respect to the system's bandwidth, a regime where Floquet heating plays a significant role in interacting systems. Here we show that such anomalous Floquet topological phases can also be realized by means of an adiabatic protocol, where the system is always in the instantaneous ground state of the cyclic path in parameter space, like in a Thouless charge pump. We experimentally realize such a state using ultracold atoms in a hexagonal lattice where we adiabatically modulate the lattice geometry, including the sublattice offset. To infer the topology, we use the micromotion area in real-space, which was recently identified as a proxy for the winding number. This way of realizing anomalous phases avoids resonant Floquet heating and imperfect loading into the target state. We demonstrate the robustness of the adiabatic construction by observing the anomalous phase even in the presence of mean-field interactions of magnitude comparable to all other energy scales. These findings are promising for engineering novel topological states in a more robust way.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experimentally realize、ultracold atoms、hexagonal lattice）；研究对象：反常Floquet拓扑相（anomalous Floquet topological phases）在二维六角晶格超冷原子系统中的绝热实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过绝热调控晶格几何参数（包括子晶格偏移），可以在不依赖共振驱动的情况下实现反常Floquet拓扑相，且该相在平均场相互作用下仍保持鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过绝热调控晶格几何参数（包括子晶格偏移），可以在不依赖共振驱动的情况下实现反常Floquet拓扑相，且该相在平均场相互作用下仍保持鲁棒性。；创新点：首次提出并实验验证了通过绝热协议（而非传统的近共振周期调制）实现反常Floquet拓扑相，从而避免了共振Floquet加热以及目标态加载不完美的问题，并在相互作用强度与其他能标可比时仍观察到该拓扑相。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用超冷原子装载于六角晶格，通过绝热调制晶格几何（包括子晶格偏移）使系统始终处于参数空间循环路径的瞬时基态（类似Thouless电荷泵）。拓扑性质通过实空间微运动面积（micromotion area）作为绕数（winding number）的代理量进行推断。

papers.title: Time-of-flight photon spectroscopy for scanning tunneling microscopy luminescence
papers.abstract: We build and commission a time-of-flight photon spectrometer (TOFS) for scanning tunneling microscopy luminescence (STML). We obtain the spectrum by exploiting the wavelength dependent refractive index of a long dispersive optical fiber that converts photon arrival times into wavelength information; blue photons are delayed more than red photons. The setup uses a pulsed excitation source, either laser flashes or voltage pulses, to launch the photons from the junction into a single photon detector. The TOFS calibration can be performed and transferred to the STML setup from a separate benchtop experiment using pulsed light sources with known wavelength. We verify the TOFS during STML operation by simultaneously recording luminescence from the Ag-Ag(111) plasmon using a conventional grating spectrometer. Our experiments show that the TOFS is a straightforward and cost-effective addition to existing STML setups with good performance in the near-infrared range. The TOFS is compatible with a drop-in replacement of the single photon detector such as a superconducting nanowire single photon detector or even bolometers that may expand the useful spectral range beyond the abilities of current STML setups.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：build and commission（搭建与调试）、experiments（实验）、setup（实验装置）。；研究对象：扫描隧道显微镜发光（STML）中的光子能谱测量技术，具体为一种基于飞行时间（time-of-flight）原理的光子光谱仪。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该研究成功搭建并验证了一种基于色散光纤的飞行时间光子光谱仪（TOFS），能够通过光子到达时间差获取波长信息，在近红外波段表现良好，且成本低廉、易于集成到现有STML系统中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该研究成功搭建并验证了一种基于色散光纤的飞行时间光子光谱仪（TOFS），能够通过光子到达时间差获取波长信息，在近红外波段表现良好，且成本低廉、易于集成到现有STML系统中。；创新点：提出了一种简单、低成本且可直接替换现有单光子探测器（如超导纳米线单光子探测器或辐射热计）的飞行时间光谱方案，有望扩展STML的光谱范围至现有技术无法达到的区域。
papers.method_zh: 实验搭建了飞行时间光子光谱仪（TOFS），利用长色散光纤的波长依赖折射率将光子到达时间转换为波长信息（蓝光延迟大于红光）；采用脉冲激发源（激光脉冲或电压脉冲）从隧道结激发光子，并由单光子探测器接收；通过已知波长的脉冲光源在独立实验台上完成校准，并转移至STML装置；在STML运行中，使用传统光栅光谱仪同时记录Ag-Ag(111)等离激元发光进行验证。

papers.title: Dynamical Steering and Unambiguous Signature of Majorana Corner Modes in Altermagnetic Josephson Junctions
papers.abstract: Dynamical manipulation of Majorana zero modes and their unambiguous distinction from topologically trivial states remain paramount challenges in topological quantum computation. Here, we propose a phase-biased altermagnetic Josephson junction as a versatile platform for generating and controlling Majorana corner configurations. Moving beyond conventional global parameter tuning that merely toggles the topological phase in situ, our platform utilizes the macroscopic superconducting phase difference and the Néel-vector orientation as independent control knobs to dynamically reshape the boundary mass. This synergistically enables the deterministic spatial relocation of Majorana corner modes (MCMs) among selected corners of a fixed device geometry. Crucially, this spatial reconfiguration yields a definitive experimental fingerprint: a control-correlated conductance switching. As the MCMs are relocated, the quantized zero-bias peak perfectly emerges at the target corner while simultaneously vanishing at the initial one. This macroscopically phase-locked spatial correlation effectively eliminates false positives from trivial Andreev bound states, establishing a control-correlated diagnostic and a promising route toward future Majorana braiding architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出“propose a phase-biased altermagnetic Josephson junction as a versatile platform”，并基于理论分析讨论控制机制与实验指纹，未提及具体实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：基于交变磁体的约瑟夫森结中的马约拉纳角模（Majorana corner modes, MCMs）。具体体系为相位偏置的交变磁约瑟夫森结，涉及超导相位差和奈尔矢量取向作为控制参数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过独立调控超导相位差和奈尔矢量方向，可动态重构边界质量，从而在固定器件几何中确定性地将马约拉纳角模重新定位到选定的角落，并产生与空间重排相关的电导开关信号，该信号可有效区分马约拉纳零模与平庸的安德烈夫束缚态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过独立调控超导相位差和奈尔矢量方向，可动态重构边界质量，从而在固定器件几何中确定性地将马约拉纳角模重新定位到选定的角落，并产生与空间重排相关的电导开关信号，该信号可有效区分马约拉纳零模与平庸的安德烈夫束缚态。；创新点：超越传统全局参数调谐（仅原位切换拓扑相），提出利用超导相位差和奈尔矢量方向作为独立控制旋钮，实现马约拉纳角模在固定器件几何中的确定性空间重定位，并建立与之关联的宏观相位锁定电导开关作为明确实验诊断信号，有效排除平庸态干扰。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于交变磁体与超导体的约瑟夫森结模型，利用宏观超导相位差和奈尔矢量方向作为独立控制旋钮，分析边界质量的重构与马约拉纳角模的空间迁移。未使用具体数值计算方法（如DFT、DMRG等），摘要未明确说明具体计算手段。

papers.title: Band-minimum degeneracy is not enough: density-of-states control of low-density ferromagnetism
papers.abstract: Recent ultracold-atom experiments have observed ferromagnetic correlations in a geometrically tunable Fermi--Hubbard lattice at intermediate densities. Motivated by subsequent theoretical work that connected the low-density limit of the same model to the Mueller--Hartmann mechanism for itinerant ferromagnetism, we investigate the stability of ferromagnetism across a broad density range using the T-matrix approximation, a controlled approach in the dilute limit. We reproduce the ferromagnetic regime observed experimentally at intermediate densities and systematically compare finite-size and thermodynamic-limit calculations in the dilute regime. We find that the low-density ferromagnetic phase reported for the one-diagonal hopping lattice is strongly suppressed with increasing system size and disappears in the thermodynamic limit, indicating that it originates from finite-size effects. By contrast, low-density ferromagnetism remains robust in the square-lattice Hubbard model with hopping along both diagonal directions. We show that this qualitative difference cannot be explained by the degeneracy of the band minima alone, which occurs in both models. Instead, it is controlled by the singular behavior of the density of states at the band bottom: a weak divergence is insufficient to stabilize ferromagnetism, whereas a much stronger quasi-one-dimensional singularity supports a fully polarized ground state even in the dilute limit. Our results demonstrate that band-minimum degeneracy alone is not sufficient for low-density ferromagnetism and that the nature of the band-bottom density-of-states singularity ultimately controls its stability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：使用T-matrix近似（一种受控的稀极限方法）进行理论分析，并包含有限尺寸与热力学极限的系统比较。；研究对象：几何可调费米-哈伯德晶格中的低密度铁磁性，具体比较了单对角线跳跃晶格与双对角线跳跃（正方形）晶格模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低密度铁磁性的稳定性并非由能带简并度决定，而是由能带底部的态密度奇异性控制：弱发散不足以稳定铁磁性，而准一维强奇异性可在稀极限下支持完全极化基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低密度铁磁性的稳定性并非由能带简并度决定，而是由能带底部的态密度奇异性控制：弱发散不足以稳定铁磁性，而准一维强奇异性可在稀极限下支持完全极化基态。；创新点：明确指出能带简并度不足以解释低密度铁磁性，首次揭示态密度奇异性类型（而非简并度）是控制稀极限下铁磁稳定性的关键因素，并澄清了近期实验与理论中关于有限尺寸效应的混淆。
papers.method_zh: 采用T-matrix近似（稀极限下的受控方法），结合有限尺寸计算与热力学极限计算，系统比较不同晶格几何下的铁磁相稳定性。

papers.title: Distinguishing between Direct and Parametric Driving in Nanomechanics Using a Vibrating Carbon Nanotube
papers.abstract: Parametric driving is a powerful route to amplification and nonlinear control in nanomechanical resonators, but its signatures can be ambiguous because standard dc electrical readout does not directly reveal the frequency of motion. Here we resolve this ambiguity by measuring the motional frequency of a vibrating carbon nanotube independently of the drive frequency. We operate the nanotube as an electromechanical mixer and detect microwave sidebands using a low-noise superconducting amplifier. This frequency-resolved readout distinguishes direct motion of the first overtone from parametric motion of the fundamental, even when the corresponding drive frequencies nearly coincide. The two mechanisms are further separated by their drive-power dependence. Beyond conventional parametric resonance at $2f_0$, we observe responses to driving at $3f_0$ and $4f_0$, consistent with high-order parametric excitation associated with nonlinear stiffness terms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验操作（测量振动频率、使用微波边带检测、低噪声超导放大器）和实验观测（区分直接驱动与参量驱动、观测高阶参量激发）。；研究对象：纳米力学谐振器中的碳纳米管振动系统，具体研究直接驱动与参量驱动的区分机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过独立于驱动频率测量碳纳米管的运动频率，成功区分了第一泛音的直驱运动与基模的参量运动，并观测到与非线性刚度项相关的高阶参量激发（3f₀和4f₀响应）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过独立于驱动频率测量碳纳米管的运动频率，成功区分了第一泛音的直驱运动与基模的参量运动，并观测到与非线性刚度项相关的高阶参量激发（3f₀和4f₀响应）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 将碳纳米管作为机电混频器，利用低噪声超导放大器检测微波边带，实现频率分辨的读出；同时通过驱动功率依赖关系进一步分离两种驱动机制。

papers.title: Spin-orbit-entangled $J_{\rm eff}=\frac{1}{2}$ magnetism and unconventional spin freezing in the bond-disordered pyrochlore antiferromagnet NaCdCo$_2$F$_7$
papers.abstract: Bond disorder in frustrated pyrochlore antiferromagnets can give rise to fundamentally different quantum ground states depending on the nature of the local magnetic moments. Here, we show that the bond-disordered pyrochlore NaCdCo$_2$F$_7$ realizes an unconventional spin-glass-like state with continued dynamics, in stark contrast to its isostructural $S=\frac{1}{2}$ NaCdCu$_2$F$_7$ counterpart. High-field magnetization and Co $L_{2,3}$-edge XAS/XMCD establish spin-orbit-entangled $J_{\rm eff}=\frac{1}{2}$ Co$^{2+}$ moments with a substantial unquenched orbital contribution, consistent with local $XY$ anisotropy seen in the isostructural Na$A''$Co$_2$F$_7$ ($A''$ = Ca, Sr) analogues. $μ$SR and $^{23}$Na NMR measurements reveal progressive slowing of spin fluctuations below $\sim10$ K, culminating in a partially frozen state with persistent low-temperature dynamics that deviates from a canonical spin glass. Comparison with the isostructural bond-disordered pyrochlore NaCdCu$_2$F$_7$, which realizes a random-singlet state, reveals a fundamentally different response of spin-orbit-entangled Co$^{2+}$ moments to bond disorder. These results identify spin-orbit coupling as a key ingredient governing the fate of bond-disordered frustrated pyrochlore magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：XAS/XMCD、μSR、NMR、高场磁化测量。；研究对象：键无序烧绿石反铁磁体 NaCdCo₂F₇，具体研究其自旋-轨道纠缠的 J_eff=1/2 磁性及非常规自旋冻结行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NaCdCo₂F₇ 实现了一种具有持续动力学行为的非常规自旋玻璃态，与同构的 S=1/2 体系 NaCdCu₂F₇ 的随机单态截然不同，表明自旋-轨道耦合是决定键无序阻挫烧绿石磁体基态的关键因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NaCdCo₂F₇ 实现了一种具有持续动力学行为的非常规自旋玻璃态，与同构的 S=1/2 体系 NaCdCu₂F₇ 的随机单态截然不同，表明自旋-轨道耦合是决定键无序阻挫烧绿石磁体基态的关键因素。；创新点：揭示了自旋-轨道纠缠的 Co²⁺ 矩（J_eff=1/2）对键无序的响应与纯自旋 S=1/2 的 Cu²⁺ 体系本质不同，从而将自旋-轨道耦合确立为调控键无序阻挫烧绿石磁体量子基态的关键要素。
papers.method_zh: 高场磁化测量、Co L₂,₃ 边 X 射线吸收谱（XAS）与 X 射线磁圆二色性（XMCD）、μSR（μ子自旋弛豫）、²³Na 核磁共振（NMR）。

papers.title: High-entropy Fe$_2$VAl-based thermoelectric modules with improved conversion efficiency
papers.abstract: Thermoelectric (TE) materials enable the direct conversion of heat into electricity and are attractive for sustainable energy applications. For practical deployment, TE materials must combine high efficiency with low cost, non-toxicity, and scalability. In this work, we optimize the TE performance of low-cost and robust Fe$_2$VAl-based full-Heusler compounds through high-entropy engineering: a synergistic combination of heavy-element doping and controlled off-stoichiometry results in substitutional disorder on all lattice sites, triggering one of the lowest lattice thermal conductivities, $κ_\text{L}\sim2.3$ W m$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$, reported so far for full-Heusler systems. The resulting materials exhibit improved values of the average figure of merit $zT_\text{ave}\approx 0.3$ from $300-500$ K. To demonstrate reproducibility and technological relevance, a full TE module (TEM) based on the optimized alloys was fabricated and characterized. Scaled-up material batches were synthesized by hot pressing, exhibiting TE properties in excellent agreement with laboratory-scale samples, with only slightly increased resistivities in absence of post-annealing treatments. Owing to the excellent mechanical workability of Fe$_2$VAl-based materials, the TEM legs were directly brazed onto copper electrodes, enabling robust module fabrication. A ($6\times 6$)-leg TEM was assembled and systematically characterized. The device exhibits the highest output power and one of the highest conversion efficiencies reported to date for Fe$_2$VAl-based generators over the broad temperature range of $300-673$ K, underscoring the potential of this material system for scalable TE energy harvesting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了材料合成（hot pressing）、模块制备（brazed onto copper electrodes）、性能表征（characterized）等实验过程。；研究对象：高熵Fe₂VAl基全Heusler热电材料及其热电模块（TEM）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高熵工程（重元素掺杂与可控非化学计量比协同）实现了全Heusler体系中极低的晶格热导率（κ_L~2.3 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹），并制备出在300-673 K宽温区内具有最高输出功率和最高转换效率之一的Fe₂VAl基热电模块。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高熵工程（重元素掺杂与可控非化学计量比协同）实现了全Heusler体系中极低的晶格热导率（κ_L~2.3 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹），并制备出在300-673 K宽温区内具有最高输出功率和最高转换效率之一的Fe₂VAl基热电模块。；创新点：首次将高熵工程应用于Fe₂VAl基全Heusler化合物，通过在所有晶格位点引入替代无序，实现了极低晶格热导率，并成功制备出具有实际应用价值的高性能热电模块，验证了该材料体系的可放大性和技术相关性。
papers.method_zh: 高熵工程（重元素掺杂+非化学计量比调控）、热压烧结（hot pressing）制备放大批次材料、直接钎焊（brazing）将热电臂连接到铜电极、模块组装与系统性能表征。

papers.title: Exact solution of the Glauber-Ising model on the finite-length semi-open chain
papers.abstract: The exact time-space correlation function of the $1D$ Glauber-Ising model, quenched to temperature $T=0$ and on a semi-open lattice of finite size $N$, is obtained. This also allows to deduce the exact empty-interval probability of the dual $1D$ coagulation-diffusion process on a periodic finite ring and to reproduce the long-time decay of the particle concentration. These results are consistent with the generic expectations of dynamical finite-size scaling theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact solution（精确解）、correlation function（关联函数）、dual process（对偶过程）。；研究对象：一维 Glauber-Ising 模型在有限长度半开链上的动力学行为，以及其对偶的一维凝聚-扩散过程在周期性有限环上的性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 获得了有限尺寸半开链上 Glauber-Ising 模型淬火至零温后的精确时空关联函数，并由此推导出对偶过程中空区间概率的精确表达式，重现了粒子浓度的长时间衰减行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：获得了有限尺寸半开链上 Glauber-Ising 模型淬火至零温后的精确时空关联函数，并由此推导出对偶过程中空区间概率的精确表达式，重现了粒子浓度的长时间衰减行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过精确求解有限长度半开链上的 Glauber-Ising 模型，利用对偶关系推导出凝聚-扩散过程的空区间概率，并与动力学有限尺寸标度理论的预期结果进行对比验证。

papers.title: Data-Driven Micromechanical Characterization and Mapping of Shale Rocks Using High Speed Nanoindentation
papers.abstract: This study investigates the potential of high-speed nanoindentation in collaboration with data analytics and phase volume fractions to achieve micromechanical characterization of heterogeneous rocks. While micromechanical characterization can be performed using mechanical testing alone, integrating chemical analysis-such as elemental mapping techniques-provides essential phase identification. This enables more accurate interpretation of phase-specific mechanical properties. However, incorporating chemical analysis increases the complexity of the process. Hence, this study proposes data-driven micromechanical characterization and mapping of heterogeneous rocks based primarily on mechanical data and limited dependence on chemical analysis. In this study, Mancos shale rock is analyzed using high-speed nanoindentation to determine the mechanical properties at the microscale. Subsequently, a suite of unsupervised statistical learning techniques, such as Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP) with k-means Clustering, Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), Dirichlet Process Mixture Model (DPMM), and Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN), are applied to the nanoindentation data. Additionally, an automated image processing and segmentation technique was developed and tested. The results from each technique have been systematically compared against the conventional chemo-mechanical approach using two metrics: weighted error and spatial error. Based on the results, UMAP with k-means clustering is the most appropriate technique, while DBSCAN, DPMM, and image segmentation techniques are more suitable as secondary approaches. This study demonstrates the capability of high-speed nanoindentation combined with machine learning techniques for micromechanical characterization with reduced analytical complexity and improved workflow efficiency.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：high-speed nanoindentation、mechanical testing、data analytics、unsupervised statistical learning techniques）；研究对象：Mancos页岩（Mancos shale rock）的微观力学性能表征与映射。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 结合高速纳米压痕与无监督机器学习技术（特别是UMAP结合k-means聚类）能够有效实现页岩的微观力学表征，在降低对化学分析依赖的同时提高工作流程效率，且该方法在加权误差和空间误差指标上优于其他聚类方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：结合高速纳米压痕与无监督机器学习技术（特别是UMAP结合k-means聚类）能够有效实现页岩的微观力学表征，在降低对化学分析依赖的同时提高工作流程效率，且该方法在加权误差和空间误差指标上优于其他聚类方法。；创新点：提出了一种主要基于力学数据、仅需有限化学分析辅助的数据驱动微观力学表征与映射方法，通过系统比较多种无监督学习技术，确定了UMAP结合k-means聚类为最优方案，显著降低了表征过程的复杂性和对化学分析的依赖。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：高速纳米压痕（high-speed nanoindentation）获取微观力学性能数据。数据分析方法：无监督统计学习技术，包括UMAP结合k-means聚类、高斯混合模型（GMM）、狄利克雷过程混合模型（DPMM）、基于密度的噪声应用空间聚类（DBSCAN），以及自主开发的自动图像处理与分割技术。对比基准：传统化学-力学联合方法（chemo-mechanical approach）。

papers.title: Riviera model with egoistical settlers
papers.abstract: The Riviera model mimics a densifying settlement along the coastline. In the lattice version, houses are built sequentially in empty sites with the constraint that every newly built house has at least one empty neighboring site. The distribution of clusters of adjacent houses does not obey a closed set of evolutionary equations, but the void-cluster-void distribution does. We compute the latter and extract the cluster distribution from it. In the jammed state, when all voids have length one and the evolution ceases, the cluster distribution has a neat form and exhibits a factorial decay with the length of the cluster. To investigate finite systems, we employ a static approach directly treating jammed states. If the coastline is a finite segment, we determine the statistics of the number of empty sites in the jammed state (the average, variance, and higher cumulants). We also study a continuum version in which houses are built along the line so that each newly built house is sufficiently separated from at least one neighboring house.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：mimics、lattice version、evolutionary equations、static approach、continuum version。；研究对象：Riviera模型，一种模拟沿海岸线密集化定居过程的统计物理模型，包括格点版本和连续版本。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在格点版本中，空位-团簇-空位的分布满足封闭的演化方程，而房屋团簇的分布不满足；在堵塞态（所有空位长度为1）中，团簇分布呈现简洁形式并随团簇长度呈阶乘衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在格点版本中，空位-团簇-空位的分布满足封闭的演化方程，而房屋团簇的分布不满足；在堵塞态（所有空位长度为1）中，团簇分布呈现简洁形式并随团簇长度呈阶乘衰减。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过建立空位-团簇-空位分布的封闭演化方程，从中提取团簇分布；对于有限系统，采用静态方法直接处理堵塞态，计算空位数量的统计量（平均值、方差、高阶累积量）；还研究了连续版本。

papers.title: Extracting Boundary Conformal Data from Periodic Non-Hermitian Critical Chains
papers.abstract: Boundary conformal field theory (BCFT) contains universal data that are usually accessed microscopically by imposing spatial boundaries on the lattice. Here, we introduce a periodic-chain projected-partition-function spectroscopy that extracts universal boundary quantities directly from non-Hermitian bulk-critical quantum chains, avoiding the need to engineer microscopic open boundaries and circumventing subtle boundary effects in non-Hermitian systems. Using a short-range-entangled boundary preparation and its infrared-compatible left dual, we obtain the Affleck-Ludwig boundary entropy in non-Hermitian systems. We demonstrate this construction for two representative non-Hermitian infrared structures. For a $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric Ising realization of the real nonunitary Yang-Lee CFT, we extract the minimal-boundary projected coefficient and recover a nontrivial negative excited-to-ground ratio. For the genuinely complex fixed points of the non-Hermitian five-state Potts chain, we resolve intrinsically complex boundary coefficients and reproduce the exact relation required by the Kramers-Wannier duality. Our results establish a route to nonunitary BCFT universal data via only knowledge of the bulk critical system, opening a window into non-Hermitian boundary criticality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：boundary conformal field theory (BCFT)、non-Hermitian critical chains、projected-partition-function spectroscopy。；研究对象：非厄米临界量子链中的边界共形场论（BCFT）普适数据，具体包括PT对称Ising链（对应实非幺正Yang-Lee CFT）和非厄米五态Potts链（对应复固定点）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种周期链投影配分函数谱方法，无需在非厄米系统中引入微观开边界，即可直接从体临界量子链中提取边界熵、边界投影系数等边界共形数据，并成功验证了非幺正CFT中的负激发态-基态比以及Kramers-Wannier对偶所要求的精确关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种周期链投影配分函数谱方法，无需在非厄米系统中引入微观开边界，即可直接从体临界量子链中提取边界熵、边界投影系数等边界共形数据，并成功验证了非幺正CFT中的负激发态-基态比以及Kramers-Wannier对偶所要求的精确关系。；创新点：首次提出一种无需在非厄米系统中实际构造开边界即可提取边界共形场论普适数据的方法，有效规避了非厄米系统中微扰开边界带来的复杂边界效应，为非厄米边界临界性研究开辟了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造：利用短程纠缠边界制备及其红外兼容的左对偶态，通过周期链上的投影配分函数谱提取Affleck-Ludwig边界熵；对两种代表性非厄米红外结构（PT对称Ising实现和非厄米五态Potts链）进行解析计算。

papers.title: Refining Unified Colored-Noise Approximation
papers.abstract: Countless biological and physical systems experience fluctuations that exhibit non-trivial temporal correlations. The Unified Colored-Noise Approximation (UCNA) is a framework providing an approximate description of such stochastic dynamics with colored noise, valid in the limits of vanishing and infinite correlation time of the noise. We first pinpoint and address some criticalities in its original derivation, recasting the result through a time-scale separation procedure. By using our approach, we derive the next-to-leading order correction to the dynamics in both limiting regimes, and highlight the relevant physical scalings of these approximations. Our result helps frame the limits of validity of both the original and the refined formulas, especially in comparison with those derived through different approximation procedures. We show our findings in two paradigmatic examples, a quartic potential and a stochastic logistic growth with multiplicative noise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Unified Colored-Noise Approximation (UCNA)、近似描述、推导、修正。；研究对象：受有色噪声（具有非平凡时间关联的涨落）影响的随机动力学系统，具体以四次势和含乘性噪声的随机逻辑斯蒂增长为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 指出了原始统一有色噪声近似（UCNA）推导中的关键问题，并通过时间尺度分离方法重新推导，得到了两种极限（噪声关联时间趋于零和无穷大）下的次领头阶修正，明确了原始公式与修正公式的适用范围。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：指出了原始统一有色噪声近似（UCNA）推导中的关键问题，并通过时间尺度分离方法重新推导，得到了两种极限（噪声关联时间趋于零和无穷大）下的次领头阶修正，明确了原始公式与修正公式的适用范围。；创新点：首次系统性地修正了原始UCNA推导中的关键问题，并给出了两种极限下的次领头阶修正及其物理标度，从而澄清了该近似与其他近似方法相比的适用边界。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：采用时间尺度分离程序重新推导UCNA，并计算次领头阶修正；通过两个范例（四次势、含乘性噪声的随机逻辑斯蒂增长）展示结果。

papers.title: Connectivity and Rigidity in Borosilicate Glasses
papers.abstract: We present a structural analysis of glasses formed by mix of SiO2 and B2O3 glass formers with soda and lime modifiers (Na2O and CaO), which provide a good testing ground for Stochastic Agglomeration Theory. With local structural units properly identified, we can reproduce the one-parameter glass transition temperature T_g (z) curve for the family of (0.75-z) SiO_2 + 0.15 Na_2O + 0.10 CaO + z B_2O_3 glasses studied experimentally by Smedskjaer et al.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Stochastic Agglomeration Theory、structural analysis、reproduce T_g curve）；研究对象：硼硅酸盐玻璃，具体为(0.75-z) SiO₂ + 0.15 Na₂O + 0.10 CaO + z B₂O₃ 系列玻璃体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过正确识别局部结构单元，该理论能够复现实验测得的该系列玻璃的玻璃化转变温度T_g随组分z变化的单参数曲线。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过正确识别局部结构单元，该理论能够复现实验测得的该系列玻璃的玻璃化转变温度T_g随组分z变化的单参数曲线。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 随机聚集理论（Stochastic Agglomeration Theory），结合对局部结构单元的识别与建模。

papers.title: GaN Nucleation Landscape on Patterned Sapphire Shaped by the Growth Temperature of Directly Grown Boron-Compound Masks
papers.abstract: The growth temperature of directly grown boron-compound masks on patterned sapphire can modify the local accessibility of the underlying sapphire surface and thereby alter the subsequent nucleation behavior of GaN. In this work, we investigate how ammonia-borane-derived boron-compound masks grown at different temperatures shape the GaN nucleation landscape within circular SiO$_2$ openings during the initial stage of epitaxial lateral overgrowth. The preferential nucleation position of GaN changes systematically with mask growth temperature: masks grown at 700--750$^\circ$C produce pronounced edge-biased distributions, whereas higher-temperature masks lead to more inward-shifted and spatially sparse GaN domains. Quantitative analysis of the GaN areal fraction, the number of visibly isolated domains, and the radial distribution of domain centers shows that the mask growth temperature affects both the amount of GaN coverage and the spatial arrangement of GaN domains within each opening. The nonmonotonic change in the number of visibly isolated domains is interpreted as a consequence of competition between reduced lateral merging and reduced effective substrate accessibility, rather than as a direct measure of the number of active nucleation sites. Kinetic Monte Carlo simulations reproduce the essential experimental trends by varying the effective density and radial distribution of substrate-accessible sites. These results suggest that the growth temperature of directly formed boron-compound masks provides a practical means of reshaping the intra-opening GaN nucleation landscape by controlling the spatial distribution and effectiveness of local pathways through which GaN precursors can access the underlying sapphire surface.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算模拟）。判断依据：实验研究（investigate how...masks grown at different temperatures shape...）、Kinetic Monte Carlo simulations（动力学蒙特卡洛模拟）。；研究对象：在图案化蓝宝石衬底上，通过直接生长的硼化合物掩模调控GaN的成核行为，具体研究圆形SiO₂开口内GaN的成核分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 掩模生长温度可系统改变GaN在开口内的优先成核位置：低温（700–750°C）掩模导致边缘偏好的成核分布，高温掩模则使GaN域向内偏移且空间分布更稀疏。掩模生长温度通过控制GaN前驱物到达下方蓝宝石表面的局部路径的空间分布和有效性，重塑开口内的GaN成核景观。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：掩模生长温度可系统改变GaN在开口内的优先成核位置：低温（700–750°C）掩模导致边缘偏好的成核分布，高温掩模则使GaN域向内偏移且空间分布更稀疏。掩模生长温度通过控制GaN前驱物到达下方蓝宝石表面的局部路径的空间分布和有效性，重塑开口内的GaN成核景观。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上，在不同温度下生长氨硼烷衍生的硼化合物掩模，随后在圆形SiO₂开口中进行GaN外延横向过生长；通过定量分析GaN面积分数、孤立域数量及域中心径向分布来表征成核行为。计算上，采用动力学蒙特卡洛（Kinetic Monte Carlo）模拟，通过改变衬底可及位点的有效密度和径向分布来复现实验趋势。

papers.title: Field-selected seven-site topological magnons in a classical frustrated triangular-lattice K-$Γ$-$Γ'$ magnet
papers.abstract: Defining magnon topology in strongly frustrated magnets is often hindered by the absence of a simple harmonic magnon vacuum at zero field. Within a classical-spin ground-state search followed by linear spin-wave theory (LSWT), we demonstrate that a representative triangular-lattice K-Gamma-Gamma' model in a dominant-Gamma exchange regime has an in-plane-field-selected compact, noncoplanar seven-site order. This field-selected state provides a controlled classical reference state and hosts magnon bands with field-tunable Chern numbers. Increasing the field drives a Dirac-like band touching that transfers Berry curvature between the fifth and sixth bands, altering the Chern vector from (0, 1, 0, -2, 1, 0, 0) to (0, 1, 0, -2, -1, 2, 0). This topological transition reorganizes the band-resolved thermal Hall conductivity, driving the total $κ_{xy}(T)$ through a near-zero crossing once the upper bands are thermally populated. The dynamical structure factor places roughly half of the coherent spectral weight on the Chern-active branches, offering a spectroscopic route to identify the topological branches. These results define a controlled semiclassical benchmark for magnon topology in this pure nearest-neighbor exchange model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：classical-spin ground-state search, linear spin-wave theory (LSWT), 理论模型计算。；研究对象：经典阻挫三角晶格K-Γ-Γ'模型中的场选拓扑磁振子，具体为在主导Γ交换作用区域、面内磁场下形成的七位非共面磁序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在阻挫三角晶格磁体中，通过面内磁场可稳定一个紧凑的七位非共面经典基态，该基态支持具有场可调陈数的拓扑磁振子能带；磁场增加会引发狄拉克型能带接触，导致陈矢量从(0,1,0,-2,1,0,0)转变为(0,1,0,-2,-1,2,0)，并驱动总热霍尔电导率在高温时接近零交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在阻挫三角晶格磁体中，通过面内磁场可稳定一个紧凑的七位非共面经典基态，该基态支持具有场可调陈数的拓扑磁振子能带；磁场增加会引发狄拉克型能带接触，导致陈矢量从(0,1,0,-2,1,0,0)转变为(0,1,0,-2,-1,2,0)，并驱动总热霍尔电导率在高温时接近零交叉。；创新点：在纯最近邻交换模型中，为阻挫磁体的磁振子拓扑提供了一个可控的半经典基准，并展示了通过磁场选择特定非共面序来实现拓扑相变和调控热输运的途径。摘要未突出说明与具体实验材料的直接对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 经典自旋基态搜索结合线性自旋波理论（LSWT），计算了能带拓扑（陈数）、热霍尔电导率κ_xy(T)以及动力学结构因子。

papers.title: Activated Migration of Localized Ligand-Field Excitons in Atomically Thin CrCl3
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional crystals with densely packed atoms exhibit a range of emerging properties, particularly a wide variety of excitonic behaviors. Thickness-variable layered chromium trihalides with finite surface recombination sites provide an ideal system for understanding how excitons confined in octahedral ligand fields migrate on nanometer length scales, a regime that defies conventional transport probes. In this work, we demonstrate that Cr3+-derived photoluminescence in CrCl3 is spectrally thickness-independent, but its relaxation dynamics are strongly sensitive to thickness and temperature, thereby indicating significant activated migration. A diffusion-coupled surface recombination model reveals an effective out-of-plane diffusivity of 4.5 x 10-6 cm2/s for the ligand-field excitons and a diffusion activation energy of 130 meV. The latter is comparable to the reorganization energy independently estimated from optical Stokes shifts, suggesting that exciton transport is coupled to local lattice relaxation. Furthermore, we show that the relaxation dynamics can be systematically tuned by either enhancing or suppressing surface recombination through controlled surface reactions or encapsulation. This work not only reveals the nanoscopic transport of localized ligand-field excitons but also establishes a spectroscopic transport probe applicable to various 2D materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验观测（光致发光、弛豫动力学）和模型拟合（扩散耦合表面复合模型）。；研究对象：原子级薄层三氯化铬（CrCl₃）中局域配体场激子的迁移行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CrCl₃中源自Cr³⁺的光致发光光谱与厚度无关，但其弛豫动力学对厚度和温度高度敏感，表明存在显著的激活式迁移。通过模型分析，得到了配体场激子的有效面外扩散系数（4.5 x 10⁻⁶ cm²/s）和扩散激活能（130 meV），后者与光学斯托克斯位移估算的重组能相当，表明激子输运与局域晶格弛豫相耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CrCl₃中源自Cr³⁺的光致发光光谱与厚度无关，但其弛豫动力学对厚度和温度高度敏感，表明存在显著的激活式迁移。通过模型分析，得到了配体场激子的有效面外扩散系数（4.5 x 10⁻⁶ cm²/s）和扩散激活能（130 meV），后者与光学斯托克斯位移估算的重组能相当，表明激子输运与局域晶格弛豫相耦合。；创新点：揭示了局域配体场激子在纳米尺度上的迁移行为，并建立了一种适用于多种二维材料的光谱学输运探测方法。摘要未突出说明与以往研究的具体差异点。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用光致发光（PL）光谱测量激子弛豫动力学，并结合一个扩散耦合表面复合模型（diffusion-coupled surface recombination model）来提取有效扩散系数和激活能。通过控制表面反应或封装来调控表面复合，从而系统性地调节弛豫动力学。

papers.title: Optical vortex probe of loop-current chirality in moiré materials
papers.abstract: We propose a symmetry-resolved optical probe of intrinsic loop-current chirality in moiré materials, with twisted bilayer graphene as a representative realization. Interlayer interference generates chiral electronic circulation on triangular plaquettes, giving rise to an intrinsic geometric chirality that enters the second-order response through a $C_3$-selected angular harmonic of the Berry curvature and can be isolated by the orbital-angular-momentum difference $Δ\ell$ of interfering optical vortex beams. When moiré $C_3$ symmetry is preserved, the intrinsic contribution appears in the $Δ\ell=3$ channel of the helicity-dependent dc photocurrent, whereas $C_3$-breaking perturbations activate additional channels. These results establish angular-momentum-resolved nonlinear optics as a route to probing geometric chirality in moiré and other symmetry-engineered quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We propose”、“These results establish”等理论推导和提议性表述，未提及任何实验数据或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：莫尔材料（moire materials）中由环电流（loop-current）产生的手性（chirality），以扭曲双层石墨烯（twisted bilayer graphene）作为代表性体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 莫尔材料中由层间干涉产生的本征几何手性，可以通过光学涡旋光束的轨道角动量差（Δℓ）在非线性光电流中进行对称性分辨探测。当莫尔C₃对称性保持时，该手性贡献出现在Δℓ=3的螺旋度依赖直流光电流通道中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：莫尔材料中由层间干涉产生的本征几何手性，可以通过光学涡旋光束的轨道角动量差（Δℓ）在非线性光电流中进行对称性分辨探测。当莫尔C₃对称性保持时，该手性贡献出现在Δℓ=3的螺旋度依赖直流光电流通道中。；创新点：提出了一种利用光学涡旋光束的轨道角动量（OAM）作为新自由度，来分辨和探测莫尔材料中本征几何手性的方法，将角动量分辨的非线性光学确立为探测此类手性的新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体框架包括：基于对称性分析（C₃对称性）的贝里曲率角谐波展开，以及利用光学涡旋光束的轨道角动量差（Δℓ）作为探测手段的非线性光学响应理论。

papers.title: Possible high temperature superconductivity induced by coupling to proximate hyperbolic photon modes
papers.abstract: The hyperbolic mode (HM) refers to a polariton mode in a polar insulator where the dielectric function is negative in some direction of propagation. Within a frequency window the light occupies a greatly expanded region in momentum space. The HM in hexagonal Boron Nitride (hBN) has been under intense study and we consider placing a metal directly on top hBN and ask whether its physical properties can be strongly affected. While the problem resembles superficially the electron phonon coupling problem, there are important differences. Due to the longitudinal nature of the HM mode the coupling is driven by time dependent charge fluctuations which results in a coupling that strongly increases with the energy difference of the initial and final states. We find a significant modification of the wavefunction and velocity renormalization and we identify the dimensionless coupling constant $λ_0$ that controls this effect. The virtual exchange of HM leads to a repulsive interaction. However, due to its strong energy dependence, pairing is possible by a process analogous to the Anderson-Morel mechanism, but in energy space instead of frequency space. We estimate the effective pairing interaction and find that very high $T_c$ is possible, even for small $λ_0$ where the theory is controlled. We provide estimates using realistic parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中未提及实验或计算模拟，主要基于理论推导（如“identify the dimensionless coupling constant”“estimate the effective pairing interaction”）。；研究对象：金属与六方氮化硼（hBN）构成的异质结构，具体研究金属中电子与hBN中双曲极化激元模式（hyperbolic mode）的耦合效应及其诱导高温超导的可能性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过虚拟交换双曲模式，电子间产生随初末态能量差增强的排斥相互作用，但通过类似Anderson-Morel机制的能量空间配对过程，仍可实现高温超导，即使在耦合常数较小、理论可控的区域内也能获得很高的超导转变温度Tc。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过虚拟交换双曲模式，电子间产生随初末态能量差增强的排斥相互作用，但通过类似Anderson-Morel机制的能量空间配对过程，仍可实现高温超导，即使在耦合常数较小、理论可控的区域内也能获得很高的超导转变温度Tc。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：类比电子-声子耦合但强调双曲模式的纵波特性，推导电子波函数重整化、速度重整化及无量纲耦合常数λ₀；基于能量空间中的Anderson-Morel配对机制估算有效配对相互作用和Tc。

papers.title: Effect of the hyperbolic photon mode on the metal insulator transition in a proximate material
papers.abstract: The hyperbolic mode (HM) refers to a polariton mode where the dielectric function is negative in some direction of propagation. Within a frequency window the light occupies a greatly expanded region in momentum space. We compute the photon density of states and find that the zero point fluctuation in the RMS electric field can reach $MV/cm$, comparable to the largest field used in pump probe experiments in the THz scale. The HM in hexagonal Boron Nitride (hBN) has been under intense study and we consider placing a material that is near the Mott transition directly on top hBN. We find that a substantial shift in the metal-insulator transition is possible, but the effect decays rapidly with distance, so that only a few monolayers are affected. We provide estimates and suggestions for a number of materials of interest.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“计算光子态密度”“提供估计和建议”，未涉及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：研究六方氮化硼（hBN）中的双曲光子模式（HM）对邻近材料中金属-绝缘体相变（Mott相变）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 双曲光子模式可在邻近材料中产生高达MV/cm量级的零点涨落电场，足以显著改变金属-绝缘体相变的位置，但该效应随距离迅速衰减，仅影响几个原子层。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：双曲光子模式可在邻近材料中产生高达MV/cm量级的零点涨落电场，足以显著改变金属-绝缘体相变的位置，但该效应随距离迅速衰减，仅影响几个原子层。；创新点：首次将hBN中的双曲光子模式与邻近材料的Mott相变调控联系起来，揭示了零点涨落电场对相变点的潜在影响，并指出其作用范围仅限于近表面几个单层。
papers.method_zh: 通过计算光子态密度和均方根电场零点涨落，结合Mott相变邻近材料的物理模型，进行理论估计与分析。

papers.title: Intervalley coherence and flavor polarization in three-valley moiré systems
papers.abstract: We investigate interaction-induced symmetry breaking in moiré superlattices created by twisting two identical materials where the electronic low-energy degrees of freedom reside in the vicinity of the $M$ points. Based on general symmetry arguments, we identify and classify the possible candidate instabilities that, besides flavor polarized states, also involve a variety of intervalley-coherent (IVC) orders. This complexity is related primarily to the presence of three valleys, instead of the well-studied scenario of two, e.g., in graphene: IVC states can couple all three valleys identically, with a non-trivial sign structure, or even with different magnitudes. We study the energetics using an analytical strong-coupling framework and unrestricted Hartree-Fock applied to the full continuum model, with very good agreement between the two approaches. Interestingly, depending on stacking, IVC instabilities not only appear due to superexchange at moderate bandwidths, but also deep in the strong-coupling regime as a result of deviations from the flat-metric condition. Our work demonstrates that twisted $M$-point materials provide a rich playground for complex correlated physics and highlights differences and similarities to twisted multilayer graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算）。判断依据：基于对称性论证和强耦合框架分析，并辅以无限制Hartree-Fock计算。；研究对象：由两种相同材料扭转形成的莫尔超晶格，其低能电子自由度位于布里渊区M点附近的三谷体系。具体研究了三谷体系中的相互作用诱导对称性破缺，特别是谷间相干（IVC）序和味极化态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三谷莫尔体系中，除了味极化态，还存在多种谷间相干（IVC）序，这些IVC态可以以相同幅度、非平凡符号结构甚至不同幅度耦合所有三个谷。IVC不稳定性不仅出现在中等带宽下的超交换机制中，在强耦合极限下，由于偏离平带条件也会出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三谷莫尔体系中，除了味极化态，还存在多种谷间相干（IVC）序，这些IVC态可以以相同幅度、非平凡符号结构甚至不同幅度耦合所有三个谷。IVC不稳定性不仅出现在中等带宽下的超交换机制中，在强耦合极限下，由于偏离平带条件也会出现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但相对于已广泛研究的双谷体系（如石墨烯），本工作系统研究了具有三个谷的莫尔体系，揭示了其更丰富的IVC序复杂性，并指出扭转M点材料是研究复杂关联物理的新平台。
papers.method_zh: 1. 基于一般对称性论证对可能的候选不稳定性进行分类和识别。2. 使用解析的强耦合框架进行能量学分析。3. 对完整连续模型进行无限制Hartree-Fock计算，两种方法结果吻合良好。

papers.title: Ultracold atomic lattice systems for simulating topological phases: A review
papers.abstract: Owing to rapid recent progress, ultracold atomic lattice systems for simulating topological phases are now at a pivotal stage, evolving from established paradigms into increasingly versatile and programmable quantum simulators. In this review, we survey recent experimental advances across four major classes of platforms: optical lattices, including optical lattices with laser-assisted tunneling and optical Raman lattices; synthetic lattices in momentum or internal-state space; Floquet-engineered lattices; and optical tweezer arrays, all of which offer distinct capabilities for realizing and probing topological matter. For each class, we highlight representative experimental breakthroughs, the topological models that have been realized, and the advanced detection and characterization techniques employed, emphasizing how these complementary approaches collectively expand the frontier of quantum simulation. We also discuss emerging directions in strongly correlated and nonequilibrium topological phases, and conclude with an outlook on future prospects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（Review）。关键词：review、survey、experimental advances。；研究对象：超冷原子晶格系统，用于模拟拓扑相。具体包括光学晶格、合成晶格、Floquet工程晶格和光镊阵列四类平台。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超冷原子晶格系统已从成熟范式发展为多功能、可编程的量子模拟器，能够实现并探测多种拓扑物质，并正在向强关联和非平衡拓扑相方向拓展。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超冷原子晶格系统已从成熟范式发展为多功能、可编程的量子模拟器，能够实现并探测多种拓扑物质，并正在向强关联和非平衡拓扑相方向拓展。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 综述了四类实验平台：激光辅助隧穿光学晶格、光学拉曼晶格；动量或内态空间合成晶格；Floquet工程晶格；以及光镊阵列。同时介绍了相应的拓扑模型实现和先进探测表征技术。

papers.title: Interfacial Magnetotransport in a NiI_2/Graphene Heterostructure
papers.abstract: We investigate magnetotransport in a van der Waals heterostructure composed of monolayer graphene and the insulating helical antiferromagnet NiI$_2$. While NiI$_2$ is highly resistive and thus poorly suited for direct transport measurements, we demonstrate that magnetotransport in an adjacent graphene layer provides an electrical readout of magnetic-state-dependent interfacial behavior. Most notably, first-harmonic longitudinal magnetoresistance under in-plane magnetic fields exhibits large, anisotropic low-field peaks that are absent from a monolayer graphene/h-BN control device and are suppressed above the multiferroic transition temperature of NiI$_2$. Temperature-dependent harmonic measurements provide complementary evidence: the second-harmonic resistance shows the clearest nonlinear contrast relative to the control device, while the third harmonic contains a larger generic nonlinear and thermal background that is nevertheless modified in the heterostructure. These results demonstrate that graphene-based transport measurements offer a sensitive, non-invasive probe of magnetic phase behavior in electrically insulating van der Waals magnets, opening routes toward spintronic devices based on insulating vdW multiferroics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“We investigate”、“demonstrate”、“measurements”等实验性动词，并描述了具体的实验现象（如磁阻峰、谐波测量）。；研究对象：由单层石墨烯和绝缘螺旋反铁磁体NiI₂构成的范德华异质结，具体研究其界面磁输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在NiI₂/石墨烯异质结中，通过测量石墨烯层的磁输运，可以灵敏地读出下层NiI₂的磁态信息。具体表现为，在面内磁场下，一次谐波纵向磁阻出现大的、各向异性的低场峰，该峰在NiI₂的多铁转变温度以上消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在NiI₂/石墨烯异质结中，通过测量石墨烯层的磁输运，可以灵敏地读出下层NiI₂的磁态信息。具体表现为，在面内磁场下，一次谐波纵向磁阻出现大的、各向异性的低场峰，该峰在NiI₂的多铁转变温度以上消失。；创新点：首次利用石墨烯作为灵敏的电学探针，非侵入式地探测了绝缘性范德华反铁磁体NiI₂的磁相行为，克服了NiI₂本身高电阻、难以直接进行输运测量的困难。这为研究绝缘性范德华多铁材料的自旋电子学应用开辟了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制备了NiI₂/石墨烯范德华异质结，并进行了变温、变磁场的磁输运测量，包括一次谐波（R_ω）和二次、三次谐波（R_2ω, R_3ω）电阻测量。使用单层石墨烯/h-BN器件作为对照实验。

papers.title: Moiré trapping of quadrupolar excitons in van der Waals trilayers
papers.abstract: Quadrupolar excitons in van der Waals heterostructures - quantum superpositions of anti-aligned dipolar excitons - offer a novel platform to explore exotic many-body physics, with applications to quantum sensing and photonic devices. Yet their internal structure, symmetry, and real-space localisation remain largely unknown. Here, we reveal the atomic-scale structure of quadrupolar excitons in twisted WSe2/WS2/WSe2 trilayers by solving the Bethe-Salpeter equation within a large-scale atomistic framework. We discover that large atomic relaxations at small twist angles give rise to two distinct quadrupolar excitons trapped at moiré lattice sites, differing in the in-plane symmetry of the electron density about the hole: one azimuthally symmetric, with the density maximal at the hole, and one threefold symmetric, with a node at the hole. Moiré trapping, neglected in commonly used models of quadrupolar exciton formation, is critical to their many-exciton phases. Without moiré trapping, quadrupolar excitons transition into anti-parallel dipolar excitons on a bipartite square lattice, while with trapping, the same dipoles are confined to a triangular lattice and experience geometric frustration. Our study uncovers the highly non-trivial nature of quadrupolar excitons, with direct implications for simulating frustrated quantum magnetism in a fully tunable excitonic platform.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据关键词：solving the Bethe-Salpeter equation within a large-scale atomistic framework（在大尺度原子框架下求解Bethe-Salpeter方程）。；研究对象：扭曲WSe2/WS2/WSe2三层异质结中的四极激子（quadrupolar excitons），及其在莫尔晶格中的局域化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在小扭转角下，大的原子弛豫导致两种不同对称性的四极激子被束缚在莫尔晶格位点上：一种为电子密度关于空穴呈方位角对称（密度在空穴处最大），另一种为三重对称（电子密度在空穴处有节点）。莫尔束缚对四极激子的多激子相至关重要：无束缚时，四极激子转变为反平行偶极激子并形成二分正方晶格；有束缚时，同一偶极子被限制在三角晶格上并经历几何阻挫。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在小扭转角下，大的原子弛豫导致两种不同对称性的四极激子被束缚在莫尔晶格位点上：一种为电子密度关于空穴呈方位角对称（密度在空穴处最大），另一种为三重对称（电子密度在空穴处有节点）。莫尔束缚对四极激子的多激子相至关重要：无束缚时，四极激子转变为反平行偶极激子并形成二分正方晶格；有束缚时，同一偶极子被限制在三角晶格上并经历几何阻挫。；创新点：首次揭示了四极激子在莫尔晶格中的原子尺度结构，并指出莫尔束缚效应（在常用四极激子模型中常被忽略）对多激子相和模拟阻挫量子磁性具有关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用大尺度原子框架下的Bethe-Salpeter方程求解，结合原子弛豫计算，分析激子波函数的实空间局域化与对称性。

papers.title: Lattice Matching Dictates the Growth Mode and Quality of Deuterium Crystallization in Confined Spherical Shells
papers.abstract: Cryogenic hydrogen isotope fuel layers with high structural integrity and atomic-scale smoothness are prerequisites for symmetric implosion and ignition in inertial confinement fusion (ICF). Using deuterium (D$_2$) as model fuel, we perform large-scale molecular dynamics simulations with a Feynman-Hibbs corrected Silvera-Goldman potential to describe nuclear quantum effects at low temperatures, systematically investigating D$_2$ crystallization inside spherical ablator capsules. By varying substrate lattice constant from 3.1 angstrom to 3.9 angstrom, we demonstrate that lattice matching dictates the transition from coherent epitaxial growth to polycrystalline formation, establishing it as the primary design principle for high-performance targets. When the substrate lattice closely matches the equilibrium hexagonal-close-packed (HCP) spacing of cryogenic D$_2$ (approximately 3.5 angstrom), D$_2$ forms coherent layer-by-layer epitaxial growth consistent with Ostwald's stepwise nucleation theory, yielding HCP-dominated near-single crystals with minimal dislocations and ultra-smooth inner surfaces. In contrast, large lattice mismatch destabilizes coherent growth and causes island-like growth, producing polycrystalline structures with mixed HCP/FCC phases, elevated defects, and greatly increased surface roughness. Radial stress analysis shows that interfacial stress from mismatch localizes within 2-3 molecular layers near the interface, triggering subsequent defect-mediated growth. These findings highlight substrate lattice matching in regulating confined solid growth and crystallization quality, establish it as a key principle for ablator inner-surface engineering in ICF cryogenic targets, and offer atomic guidance for growing high-quality single-crystal deuterium-tritium (DT) fuel layers with optimal smoothness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：采用大规模分子动力学模拟（large-scale molecular dynamics simulations），并使用Feynman-Hibbs修正的Silvera-Goldman势函数。；研究对象：在球形烧蚀壳（spherical ablator capsules）内受限空间中氘（D₂）的结晶过程，具体关注衬底晶格匹配对生长模式和质量的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 衬底晶格常数与低温氘的平衡六方密堆积（HCP）晶格间距（约3.5埃）匹配时，可实现外延层状生长，获得近单晶、低缺陷、超光滑内表面的氘层；晶格失配则导致岛状生长、多晶结构、混合相（HCP/FCC）、高缺陷和表面粗糙度增加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：衬底晶格常数与低温氘的平衡六方密堆积（HCP）晶格间距（约3.5埃）匹配时，可实现外延层状生长，获得近单晶、低缺陷、超光滑内表面的氘层；晶格失配则导致岛状生长、多晶结构、混合相（HCP/FCC）、高缺陷和表面粗糙度增加。；创新点：首次明确将衬底晶格匹配确立为惯性约束聚变（ICF）低温靶中氘（及氘氚）燃料层高质量生长的首要设计原则，并揭示了界面应力局域化（2-3分子层内）触发缺陷介导生长的微观机制。
papers.method_zh: 大规模分子动力学模拟，采用Feynman-Hibbs修正的Silvera-Goldman势函数描述低温下的核量子效应。通过改变衬底晶格常数（3.1埃至3.9埃）系统研究晶格匹配的影响。

papers.title: Vortex-core size and quantum geometry in flat-band superconductors
papers.abstract: We investigate the real-space vortex structure of a flat-band superconductor described by the attractive Hubbard model on the Mielke checkerboard lattice. Using a momentum-space mean-field analysis, we derive a closed-form expression for the coherence length in terms of the quantum metric of the Bloch states and a particle-hole-symmetric pair density. Self-consistent Bogoliubov-de Gennes calculations on a finite disk confirm this prediction across a wide range of fillings and interaction strengths. The coherence length is minimized at half filling, diverges toward both band edges as the pair density vanishes, and depends only logarithmically on the interaction strength. These features differ qualitatively from the conventional BCS picture, which relies on a well-defined Fermi surface and a kinetic mechanism for pair transport. Instead, the vortex-core size is governed by a geometric pair mass arising from virtual interband processes encoded in the quantum metric. Our results establish the vortex core as a direct real-space manifestation of flat-band quantum geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：mean-field analysis、self-consistent Bogoliubov-de Gennes calculations、momentum-space analysis）；研究对象：平带超导体中的涡旋结构，具体为Mielke棋盘晶格上吸引Hubbard模型描述的平带超导体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 平带超导体的涡旋核心尺寸（相干长度）由布洛赫态的量子度规和粒子-空穴对称对密度决定，在半填充时最小，在能带边缘发散，且仅对数依赖于相互作用强度，这与传统BCS图像定性不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：平带超导体的涡旋核心尺寸（相干长度）由布洛赫态的量子度规和粒子-空穴对称对密度决定，在半填充时最小，在能带边缘发散，且仅对数依赖于相互作用强度，这与传统BCS图像定性不同。；创新点：首次将涡旋核心尺寸直接关联到平带的量子几何（量子度规），揭示涡旋核心是平带量子几何在实空间中的直接体现，而非传统BCS理论中的费米面动能机制。
papers.method_zh: 动量空间平均场分析推导相干长度的闭合表达式；在有限圆盘上进行自洽Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BdG）计算以验证预测。

papers.title: Atom Probe Tomography as an Emerging Tool for Understanding Defect-driven Mechanisms in HfO$_{2}$-based Ferroelectrics
papers.abstract: HfO$_{2}$-based ferroelectrics are essential for the next generation of CMOS-compatible memory and logic devices, yet their performance is governed by a complex interplay between oxygen vacancies, dopants, and structural defects that remains an active area of investigation. These defects shape the function-critical dynamic phenomena, such as polar phase stabilization, wake-up, fatigue, and imprint. In this Perspective, we review the limitations of established high-resolution structural characterization techniques and propose atom probe tomography (APT) as a powerful tool for the three-dimensional (3D), atomic-scale mapping of all constituent species in hafnia-based ferroelectric systems. By resolving individual dopants, vacancy clustering, and interfacial segregation, APT can facilitate a quantitative understanding of defect-property relations in hafnia-based ferroelectrics. We discuss current experimental challenges for APT application to ferroelectric oxides, demonstrate a proof-of-concept of atomic-scale reconstruction in a hafnia-based device stack, and highlight the potential of APT to guide the development of ferroelectric structures with enhanced reliability and performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：Atom Probe Tomography、proof-of-concept、atomic-scale reconstruction）；研究对象：HfO₂基铁电体中的缺陷驱动机制，具体涉及氧空位、掺杂剂与结构缺陷的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 原子探针层析技术（APT）能够实现HfO₂基铁电体系中所有组成元素的三维原子尺度成像，从而定量理解缺陷-性能关系，有望指导高可靠性铁电结构的开发。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：原子探针层析技术（APT）能够实现HfO₂基铁电体系中所有组成元素的三维原子尺度成像，从而定量理解缺陷-性能关系，有望指导高可靠性铁电结构的开发。；创新点：首次系统论证APT作为新兴工具在HfO₂基铁电体缺陷研究中的独特优势，并展示了在器件堆叠中的原子尺度重构概念验证。
papers.method_zh: 原子探针层析技术（APT），用于三维原子尺度成分映射；同时对比了现有高分辨结构表征技术的局限性。

papers.title: Geometric decomposition of the $d$-dimensional hard-sphere partition function
papers.abstract: We introduce a geometric decomposition of the hard-sphere partition function. Using a close-packing-inspired geometric bound on the available insertion volume, made rigorous when a corresponding local density certificate is available, we establish a reference upper bound $Q^\ast$ on the configurational integral. Factoring this upper bound out of the statistical geometric partition function of Speedy yields a new form for the $d$-dimensional partition function, $Q(N,V,T)=Q^\ast \exp(-N \mathcal{J})$, where $\mathcal{J}$ depends strictly on the boundary-to-volume ratio of the voids and the close-packing density. Overall, this work deepens our statistical geometric understanding of the hard-sphere system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：几何分解、配分函数、统计几何、上界推导。；研究对象：硬球系统的配分函数，具体为d维硬球体系的统计几何性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过几何分解，将硬球配分函数表示为参考上界Q*与指数因子exp(-N𝒥)的乘积，其中𝒥仅依赖于空隙的边界-体积比和密堆积密度，深化了对硬球系统统计几何的理解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过几何分解，将硬球配分函数表示为参考上界Q*与指数因子exp(-N𝒥)的乘积，其中𝒥仅依赖于空隙的边界-体积比和密堆积密度，深化了对硬球系统统计几何的理解。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于密堆积启发的可用插入体积几何上界（在存在局部密度证书时严格成立），结合Speedy的统计几何配分函数，进行理论推导与分解。

papers.title: Superconducting diode effect via Floquet topological Fulde-Ferrell phase in driven Rashba nanowire
papers.abstract: Much has been studied on Floquet engineering in Rashba nanowire model regarding topological superconductivity hosting Majorana $0$- and anomalous $π$-modes, here we theoretically investigate the possible emergence of finite momentum Fulde-Ferrell (FF) superconducting state in quasi-energy of the above model under the periodic modulation of in-plane and out-of-plane magnetic fields while the static limit does not host a FF ground state. We demonstrate controllable switching between Floquet Majorana $0$- and $π$-modes via reversal of the supercurrent direction, revealing pronounced nonreciprocal supercurrent signatures which is a manifestation of the FF pairing. We validate the onset of FF pairing following a self-consistent mean-field analysis where externally applied supercurrent facilitates nonreciprocal signatures in quasi-energy spectra. The above findings directly indicates to the intriguing phenomenon of superconducting diode effect (SDE). The drive amplitude serves as a parameter to regulate the diode efficiency with chemical potential. Our study thus reveals a rich interplay between Floquet topological superconductivity and finite-momentum FF pairing, providing a tunable way to switch between different Floquet Majorana modes and realize the SDE with high efficiency.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretically investigate、self-consistent mean-field analysis、quasi-energy spectra。；研究对象：受周期性驱动（Floquet工程）的Rashba纳米线模型，具体研究其中可能出现的有限动量Fulde-Ferrell（FF）超导态以及由此产生的超导二极管效应（SDE）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过反转超流方向，可以实现Floquet Majorana 0模与π模之间的可控切换，并观察到显著的非互易超流特征，这直接指向超导二极管效应。驱动振幅可作为调节二极管效率的参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过反转超流方向，可以实现Floquet Majorana 0模与π模之间的可控切换，并观察到显著的非互易超流特征，这直接指向超导二极管效应。驱动振幅可作为调节二极管效率的参数。；创新点：首次在Rashba纳米线的Floquet工程模型中揭示了Floquet拓扑超导性与有限动量FF配对之间的丰富相互作用，并实现了不同Floquet Majorana模式之间的可调切换以及高效超导二极管效应。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合自洽平均场方法。具体包括：在面内和面外磁场的周期性调制下，分析准能谱中的Floquet拓扑超导态；通过自洽平均场分析验证FF配对的出现，并研究外加超流对能谱非互易特征的影响。

papers.title: Persistence Properties of a Phase-ordering System with Competing Dynamics
papers.abstract: We investigate the persistence properties during phase ordering in the two-dimensional ($d=2$) Ising model evolving under competing nonconserved spin-flip and conserved spin-exchange dynamics by means of Monte Carlo simulations at zero temperature. We examine three distinct persistence probabilities: (i) the total persistence probability, defined as the probability that a lattice site has never experienced a change in the sign of the spin residing there; (ii) the spin-flip persistence probability, which exclusively measures the fraction of sites that have never undergone a spin-flip event; and (iii) the composite persistence probability, defined as the fraction of sites that have experienced neither a spin-flip nor a spin-exchange event. In the asymptotic regime, both the total and spin-flip persistence probabilities exhibit identical power-law decay, irrespective of the relative occurrence probability of the spin-flip move $p_r$. The corresponding persistence exponent $θ_i \approx 0.225$, is found to be consistent with the value reported for systems evolving purely under nonconserved dynamics. We further demonstrate that both persistence measures satisfy the scaling relation $d-d_f^i=θ_i/α_i$, where $d_f^i$ is the fractal dimension of the corresponding persistence lattice and $α_i\approx 1/2$ characterizes the asymptotic power-law growth of spatially correlated regions of non-persistent spins. In contrast, although the composite persistence probability also exhibits asymptotic power-law decay, both the corresponding persistence exponent $θ_{\rm c}$ and the fractal dimension $d_f^{\rm c}$ of the persistence lattice show strong dependence on $p_r$. Combined with the presence of a universal growth exponent $α_{\rm c}\approx 1/2$, this leads to the breakdown of the scaling relation among the characteristic exponents for the composite persistence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Monte Carlo simulations）；研究对象：二维伊辛模型在零温下同时受非守恒自旋翻转动力学与守恒自旋交换动力学竞争作用时的相序过程（phase ordering）中的持久性（persistence）性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 总持久概率与自旋翻转持久概率在渐近区域呈现相同的幂律衰减，其持久指数θ_i ≈ 0.225，与纯非守恒动力学系统的结果一致；而复合持久概率的持久指数θ_c和持久格子的分形维数d_f^c强烈依赖于自旋翻转移动的相对发生概率p_r，导致标度关系d-d_f^i=θ_i/α_i对复合持久性失效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：总持久概率与自旋翻转持久概率在渐近区域呈现相同的幂律衰减，其持久指数θ_i ≈ 0.225，与纯非守恒动力学系统的结果一致；而复合持久概率的持久指数θ_c和持久格子的分形维数d_f^c强烈依赖于自旋翻转移动的相对发生概率p_r，导致标度关系d-d_f^i=θ_i/α_i对复合持久性失效。；创新点：首次系统研究了竞争动力学（非守恒与守恒混合）下相序过程中的三种不同持久概率（总持久、自旋翻转持久、复合持久）的渐近行为，并揭示了复合持久性中标度关系的破坏。
papers.method_zh: 采用零温蒙特卡洛模拟，在二维（d=2）伊辛模型中同时引入非守恒自旋翻转动力学与守恒自旋交换动力学，通过改变自旋翻转移动的相对发生概率p_r来调控竞争强度。

papers.title: Real-space spectral functions of three-dimensional billion-size topological non-Hermitian matter with tensor networks
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian systems host a wide range of unconventional topological phenomena while large-scale simulations in finite three dimensional systems remain challenging because of the rapidly growing number of sites. In particular, higher-order topological corner modes are often studied only in small lattices, where strong finite-size effects can mask their intrinsic behavior. Here, we develop a tensor-network framework that combines quantics tensor cross interpolation with the kernel polynomial method, enabling compact representations of large non-Hermitian tight-binding Hamiltonians and direct calculations of real-space spectral functions for systems exceeding one billion lattice sites. Using this approach, we investigate three-dimensional non-Hermitian higher-order topological insulators with with structured real-space geometries. The unprecedented system size enables direct access to the macroscopic regime and allows corner-mode spectral responses to be resolved in genuinely three-dimensional systems.By tuning the loss strength, we identify distinct in-gap corner modes across weak- and strong-loss regimes.Our results establish tensor-network algorithms as a powerful strategy to perform real-space spectral calculations in exceptionally large non-Hermitian systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：tensor-network framework, calculations, simulations。；研究对象：三维非厄米高阶拓扑绝缘体中的拓扑角态，以及其在宏观尺度下的实空间谱函数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合张量网络与核多项式方法，实现了对超过十亿格点数的三维非厄米系统实空间谱函数的直接计算，并成功分辨了弱损耗和强损耗区域中不同的带隙内角态模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合张量网络与核多项式方法，实现了对超过十亿格点数的三维非厄米系统实空间谱函数的直接计算，并成功分辨了弱损耗和强损耗区域中不同的带隙内角态模式。；创新点：实现了对三维非厄米系统前所未有的巨大尺寸（超过十亿格点）的模拟，直接进入了宏观体系，从而能够消除有限尺寸效应，在真正的三维系统中分辨角态模式的谱响应。这为研究非厄米高阶拓扑现象提供了新的计算策略。
papers.method_zh: 张量网络框架，具体结合了量子张量交叉插值（quantics tensor cross interpolation）与核多项式方法（kernel polynomial method）。用于紧凑表示大型非厄米紧束缚哈密顿量并直接计算实空间谱函数。

papers.title: Twistronic control of shift current in multilayer moiré system
papers.abstract: The bulk photovoltaic effect in non-centrosymmetric materials provides an alternative mechanism for the conversion of light into a current response compared to p-n junctions. Among its various contributions, the shift current is particularly attractive because it is governed by the geometric properties of electronic wavefunctions and can generate large photocurrents in low-dimensional materials. Here, we investigate the evolution of the shift current response in mono-, bi-, and trilayer H-MoS2, as well as in twisted moiré bilayers and trilayers. To describe large moiré supercells we develop a Slater-Koster tight-binding model parametrized from first-principles calculations. The resulting electronic structures and shift-current responses are compared with density functional theory calculations and Wannier-interpolated results to verify the accuracy of the approach. The model accurately reproduces the electronic structure near the band edges and captures the main spectral features of the shift current conductivity. We show that twisting breaks the crystal symmetry and activates additional conductivity tensor components that are forbidden in untwisted structures, leading to new tunable in-plane photocurrent components. Analysis of the shift distance reveals a direct connection between the twist-induced modification of the electronic wavefunctions and the increase of the nonlinear response. Our results establish the twist angle as an effective parameter for engineering shift current generation in multilayer transition-metal dichalcogenide base systems and demonstrate that tight-binding approaches provide a practical route for exploring nonlinear optical phenomena in large-scale moiré materials beyond the limits of conventional first-principles calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Slater-Koster tight-binding model parametrized from first-principles calculations、density functional theory calculations、Wannier-interpolated results）；研究对象：单层、双层、三层H-MoS₂，以及扭转双层和三层moiré体系中的位移电流（shift current）响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 扭转破坏了晶体对称性，激活了未扭转结构中禁戒的额外电导率张量分量，从而产生新的可调面内光电流分量；扭转角可作为工程化位移电流产生的有效参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：扭转破坏了晶体对称性，激活了未扭转结构中禁戒的额外电导率张量分量，从而产生新的可调面内光电流分量；扭转角可作为工程化位移电流产生的有效参数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理参数化的Slater-Koster紧束缚模型描述大尺度moiré超胞，并与密度泛函理论（DFT）计算及Wannier插值结果对比验证模型准确性。

papers.title: Direct Nanoscale Pyroelectric Characterization of a CuInP${}_2$S${}_6$ van der Waals Nanogenerator
papers.abstract: Pyroelectric energy conversion offers a route for harvesting time-dependent thermalfluctuations that are abundant in natural and technological environments. Twodimensional ferroelectrics are particularly attractive for this purpose because reduced dimensionality enables ultrathin, mechanically compliant device architectures. Here, we demonstrate direct nanoscale pyroelectric characterization of an out-of-plane van der Waals nanogenerator based on CuInP2S6 (CIPS) encapsulated between few-layer graphene electrodes. A scanning thermal microscopy (SThM) probe is employed as a localized nanoscale heat source while the electrically generated response is measured in situ through the device electrodes. Harmonic detection isolates the pyroelectric signal from parasitic first-harmonic electromechanical contributions, while finite-element thermal modeling combined with probe calibration enables direct determination of the local pyroelectric coefficient from the measured electrical response. Beyond quantitative characterization, the spatially resolved measurements directly identify electrically inactive regions associated with device defects, revealing local performance-limiting features that remain hidden in conventional spatially averaged pyroelectric measurements. The presented approach establishes a versatile platform for quantitative nanoscale pyroelectric characterization and the optimization of van der Waals pyroelectric devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验过程（如“扫描热显微镜探针作为热源”、“原位测量电响应”），并涉及器件制备和表征。；研究对象：基于CuInP₂S₆（CIPS）的范德华纳米发电机，具体研究其纳米尺度的热释电特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功实现了对CIPS范德华纳米发电机局域热释电系数的直接纳米尺度定量表征，并识别出传统空间平均测量中无法发现的、与器件缺陷相关的电学非活性区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功实现了对CIPS范德华纳米发电机局域热释电系数的直接纳米尺度定量表征，并识别出传统空间平均测量中无法发现的、与器件缺陷相关的电学非活性区域。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 扫描热显微镜（SThM）作为局域纳米热源，结合原位电学响应测量；采用谐波检测技术从寄生的一阶谐波机电贡献中分离出热释电信号；结合有限元热模拟与探针校准，从测量的电响应中直接确定局域热释电系数。

papers.title: Non-Equilibrium Model Selection via Finite-Time Thermodynamics
papers.abstract: Information criteria such as WAIC and WBIC extend model selection to singular learning machines, but they are usually derived for equilibrium posteriors. We formulate a finite-time analogue of WBIC by replacing the equilibrium posterior with an effective ensemble generated by learning dynamics under a resource constraint. When this ensemble admits an analytic effective potential, singular learning theory yields a resource-dependent real log canonical threshold. The resulting estimator gives a computable thermodynamic contribution to time-bounded MDL and identifies the finite-time singular complexity relevant to the structural information measured by epiplexity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：formulate、singular learning theory、thermodynamic contribution。；研究对象：非平衡模型选择问题，具体涉及奇异学习机（singular learning machines）在有限时间资源约束下的学习动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将平衡后验替换为资源约束下的有效系综，推导出有限时间版本的WBIC（广泛贝叶斯信息准则），并得到依赖于资源的实对数规范阈值（real log canonical threshold），从而识别出有限时间奇异复杂度（finite-time singular complexity）。
