papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将平衡后验替换为资源约束下的有效系综，推导出有限时间版本的WBIC（广泛贝叶斯信息准则），并得到依赖于资源的实对数规范阈值（real log canonical threshold），从而识别出有限时间奇异复杂度（finite-time singular complexity）。；创新点：将传统平衡后验下的模型选择信息准则（如WBIC）推广到非平衡有限时间情形，建立了资源约束与奇异复杂度之间的热力学联系，为时间受限的MDL（最小描述长度）提供了可计算的热力学贡献。
papers.method_zh: 采用有限时间热力学（finite-time thermodynamics）框架，结合奇异学习理论（singular learning theory）中的实对数规范阈值分析，构建资源依赖的有效势（analytic effective potential），并给出可计算的估计量。

papers.title: Quantum oscillations in proximity to high-angular-momentum band inversion
papers.abstract: Quantum oscillations provide a fundamental probe of electronic structure in magnetic fields, revealing the Fermi surface topology in metals, and/or the quasiparticle properties even in the insulating regimes. Here we study quantum oscillations in minimal models of high-angular-momentum (HAM) band inversion for both a chiral two-band model and a time-reversal-invariant four-band model. In the former case, finite oscillations can appear at the hybridized Chern-insulating regime due to thermal-activated excitations. In the latter case, interference between the two time-reversal-related blocks drives a strong deviation from the Lifshitz-Kosevich form, producing a non-monotonic temperature dependence of the oscillation amplitude and characteristic suppression temperatures whose number follows the angular momentum $l$. These results identify experimentally accessible signatures of HAM band inversion and provide a framework for other discrete-symmetry-related hybridizations and excitonic pairings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study、minimal models、theoretical framework。；研究对象：高角动量（HAM）能带反转体系中的量子振荡现象，具体包括手性两带模型和时间反演对称四带模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在手性两带模型中，杂化陈绝缘体区域因热激活激发可产生有限量子振荡；在时间反演对称四带模型中，两个时间反演相关块之间的干涉导致振荡振幅的温度依赖偏离Lifshitz-Kosevich形式，出现非单调行为，且特征抑制温度的数量与角动量l相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在手性两带模型中，杂化陈绝缘体区域因热激活激发可产生有限量子振荡；在时间反演对称四带模型中，两个时间反演相关块之间的干涉导致振荡振幅的温度依赖偏离Lifshitz-Kosevich形式，出现非单调行为，且特征抑制温度的数量与角动量l相关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于最小模型的理论分析，分别构建手性两带模型和时间反演对称四带模型，研究量子振荡行为，并与Lifshitz-Kosevich公式进行对比。

papers.title: Effect of a Cone Shape on the Motion of Active Janus Colloids
papers.abstract: The propulsion of active colloids is governed by their symmetry and shape, yet a systematic investigation of how small geometric effects influence the locomotion of anisotropic active colloids is lacking. In this paper, we study the effect of a cone shape by combining high-resolution two-photon polymerization 3D printing with AC electric field experiments to study anisotropic Janus micro swimmers. We fabricate a series of Janus colloids with different shapes, ranging from a sphere to a hemisphere with a cone-protrusion, but containing similar hemispherical gold-coatings. Under an applied alternating current (AC) electric field, all particles exhibit active, ballistic motion. We find a shape and size dependence on the propulsion velocity, with the spherical Janus particle moving fastest, followed by a small cone and a large cone protrusion, while surprisingly a printed sphere with a flat side moves slowest. In addition, a reversal in the direction of motion for all shapes was triggered, a phenomenon governed by a transition from induced-charge electrophoresis (ICEP) at low frequencies to self-dielectrophoresis (sDEP) at high frequencies. We reveal a distinct shape influence, with the large cone-protrusion increasing their velocity in the sDEP regime. Our results provide insight into the link between active particle geometry and their propulsion velocity that are important for understanding biological micro swimmers and designing optimized microrobots.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：结合高分辨率双光子聚合3D打印与交流电场实验，研究各向异性Janus微游泳者的运动。；研究对象：不同形状的活性Janus胶体颗粒（从球体到带有锥形突起的半球体），在交流电场作用下的推进运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性Janus胶体的推进速度具有显著的形状和尺寸依赖性：球形Janus颗粒运动最快，带有小锥形突起的次之，带有大锥形突起的再次之，而带有平边的打印球体运动最慢。此外，所有形状的颗粒在低频诱导电荷电泳（ICEP）到高频自介电泳（sDEP）的转变中均出现运动方向反转，且大锥形突起在sDEP区域能提高颗粒速度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性Janus胶体的推进速度具有显著的形状和尺寸依赖性：球形Janus颗粒运动最快，带有小锥形突起的次之，带有大锥形突起的再次之，而带有平边的打印球体运动最慢。此外，所有形状的颗粒在低频诱导电荷电泳（ICEP）到高频自介电泳（sDEP）的转变中均出现运动方向反转，且大锥形突起在sDEP区域能提高颗粒速度。；创新点：系统揭示了微小几何形状（特别是锥形突起）对各向异性活性胶体推进速度的影响，并发现形状在ICEP到sDEP频率转变中对速度调控的独特作用。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨率双光子聚合3D打印制备不同形状的Janus胶体（半球形金涂层），结合交流电场实验观测颗粒的主动弹道运动，分析频率依赖的推进速度与方向变化。

papers.title: Melt-Quench Failures and Practical Solutions for Universal Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials in Amorphous Structure Generation
papers.abstract: Generating experimentally relevant amorphous structures via melt-quench molecular dynamics is prohibitively expensive at the first-principles level. Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) could accelerate such simulations, but their reliability under non-equilibrium conditions remains unclear. Here, we examine eight leading uMLIPs for generating amorphous IrO2, using this electrocatalytically relevant oxide as a diagnostic case. Under the conventional melt-quench protocol, all models yield unphysically expanded structures with densities of 1-4 g/cm3, far below the ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) reference value of 10.04 g/cm3. Comparisons against ab initio references show that accurate energies and forces alone do not ensure stable NPT dynamics; correct energy-volume responses and pressure predictions are also essential. We identify two practical remedies: pressure-targeted fine-tuning and a revised NVT-quench/NPT-equilibration protocol that avoids unphysical volume expansion without additional ab initio training data. Both recover IrO2 densities and local structures consistent with AIMD. Across 30 chemically diverse materials, the volume-expansion failure proves general, and the revised protocol substantially improves density predictions, reducing the AIMD-referenced MAE from 2.46 to 0.35 g/cm3. This work establishes practical validation criteria and simulation strategies for robust uMLIP-driven amorphous structure generation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：machine-learning interatomic potentials、molecular dynamics、ab initio molecular dynamics reference）；研究对象：非晶态IrO₂（作为电催化相关氧化物的诊断案例）及30种化学多样性材料中的非晶结构生成过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 现有通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIPs）在熔融-淬火分子动力学模拟中普遍导致非物理的体积膨胀（密度远低于第一性原理参考值），仅依赖能量和力的准确性不足以保证稳定的NPT动力学；通过压力目标微调或改进的NVT淬火/NPT平衡协议可有效恢复与第一性原理一致的密度和局域结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：现有通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIPs）在熔融-淬火分子动力学模拟中普遍导致非物理的体积膨胀（密度远低于第一性原理参考值），仅依赖能量和力的准确性不足以保证稳定的NPT动力学；通过压力目标微调或改进的NVT淬火/NPT平衡协议可有效恢复与第一性原理一致的密度和局域结构。；创新点：系统揭示了uMLIPs在非平衡条件下生成非晶结构时普遍存在的体积膨胀失效问题，并提出了无需额外第一性原理训练数据的实用修正策略，建立了针对uMLIP驱动非晶结构生成的验证标准与模拟方案。
papers.method_zh: 采用8种领先的通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIPs）进行熔融-淬火分子动力学模拟，对比第一性原理分子动力学（AIMD）参考数据；通过能量-体积响应和压力预测分析失效机制；提出两种修正方案：压力目标微调（pressure-targeted fine-tuning）和NVT淬火/NPT平衡修正协议（revised NVT-quench/NPT-equilibration protocol）。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Uncertainty Relation For a Multi-Phase Alternating Renewal Random Walk
papers.abstract: Thermodynamic Uncertainty Relations (TURs) impose universal bounds linking current precision to entropy production in nonequilibrium systems. While general bounds like the Proesmans--Van den Broeck (PV) relation provide a broad framework, they often remain loose for processes characterized by renewal events. In this work, we derive a generalized entropic bound for current fluctuations in renewal-reward processes. By utilizing a rigorous variance decomposition within the framework of renewal-reward theory, we obtain a model-independent bound that is not only rigorous but tighter than the standard PV relation. Notably, in the linear-response regime, our bound correctly scales with the renewal rate and identifies a precision penalty arising from cycle-length fluctuations. These results provide a physically informative constraint on the precision of run-and-tumble-type dynamics and highlight the universal limits of transport in complex stochastic walkers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“derive a generalized entropic bound”、“within the framework of renewal-reward theory”，属于理论推导与分析。；研究对象：多相交替更新随机游走（multi-phase alternating renewal random walk）中的热力学不确定性关系（TUR），具体涉及更新-奖励过程（renewal-reward processes）中的电流涨落与熵产生之间的普适约束。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出一个比标准Proesmans–Van den Broeck（PV）关系更紧的、模型无关的熵界；在线性响应区域，该界正确标度了更新率，并揭示了由周期长度涨落引起的精度惩罚。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出一个比标准Proesmans–Van den Broeck（PV）关系更紧的、模型无关的熵界；在线性响应区域，该界正确标度了更新率，并揭示了由周期长度涨落引起的精度惩罚。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于更新-奖励理论（renewal-reward theory）进行严格的方差分解，推导出广义的熵界，并与已有的PV关系进行对比分析。

papers.title: Non-stationary longitudinal Josephson effect in electron-hole bilayers
papers.abstract: The non-stationary longitudinal Josephson effect in bilayer systems with pairing of spatially separated electrons and holes is investigated. The tunneling current between two (right and left) weakly coupled electron-hole condensates is analyzed in the presence of an external voltage applied along the layers. Two limiting regimes are considered: the high-density regime, where pairing occurs in momentum space similarly to conventional superconductors, and the low-density regime corresponding to a Bose-Einstein condensate of spatially indirect excitons. Using the tunneling Hamiltonian approach, expressions for the quasiparticle, superconducting and interference contributions to the tunneling current are derived. It is shown that in the high-density limit the quasiparticle and interference currents vanish at zero temperature below a threshold voltage determined by the energy gap, so that only the supercurrent remains. In contrast, in the low-density regime the gapless spectrum of collective excitations leads to finite dissipative contributions even at zero temperature, resulting in damping of Josephson oscillations. For spatially separated tunneling barriers with distance exceeding the coherence length, phase jumps occur at each barrier, resulting in voltage oscillations across the electron and hole barriers and a non-sinusoidal current-phase relation governed by the critical currents of the two barriers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigated, analyzed, using the tunneling Hamiltonian approach, derived。；研究对象：电子-空穴双层系统中的非稳态纵向约瑟夫森效应。具体研究了沿层方向施加外部电压时，两个弱耦合的电子-空穴凝聚体（分别位于左右两侧）之间的隧穿电流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高密度极限下，零温时低于能隙阈值电压的准粒子和干涉电流消失，仅剩超流；而在低密度极限下，集体激发的无能隙谱导致即使在零温也存在有限耗散贡献，从而引起约瑟夫森振荡的阻尼。对于间距超过相干长度的分离隧穿势垒，会发生相位跳变，导致电压振荡和非正弦的电流-相位关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高密度极限下，零温时低于能隙阈值电压的准粒子和干涉电流消失，仅剩超流；而在低密度极限下，集体激发的无能隙谱导致即使在零温也存在有限耗散贡献，从而引起约瑟夫森振荡的阻尼。对于间距超过相干长度的分离隧穿势垒，会发生相位跳变，导致电压振荡和非正弦的电流-相位关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用隧穿哈密顿量方法，推导了隧穿电流中准粒子、超导和干涉贡献的表达式。研究考虑了两种极限情况：高密度极限（动量空间配对，类似传统超导体）和低密度极限（空间间接激子的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚）。

papers.title: Implementation of rotational invariance for first-principles phonons and application to low-dimensional materials
papers.abstract: The acoustic flexural (phonon) modes of low-dimensional materials should show a quadratic dispersion close to the Brillouin zone center. Any departure from this behavior in Density Functional Theory calculations is typically associated with a breaking of the rotational invariance, with few methods available to correct it. In this work, we reexamine this issue based on a reciprocal-space imposition of this condition, with corrections on the zone-center IFCs and their first and second derivatives with respect to the phonon wavevector. We propose two correction schemes for the short-range part of the interatomic force constants, one based on the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse, that we implement in the ABINIT software package, and one based on the straight modification of the on-site antisymmetric part of the first-order derivative of the dynamical matrix with respect to the wavevector. We investigate the impact of imposing rotational invariance for different system dimensionalities and pseudopotentials. Finally, we discuss rotational invariance in the context of long-range electrostatics contribution to the IFCs. We observe that the usual treatment of electrostatics is by construction not rotationally invariant. This is found especially critical when correcting the second derivatives of the IFCs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles phonons、Density Functional Theory calculations、reciprocal-space imposition、ABINIT software package。；研究对象：低维材料中的声学弯曲（flexural）声子模式，以及旋转不变性（rotational invariance）在密度泛函理论（DFT）计算中的实现与修正。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低维材料中声学弯曲声子模式在布里渊区中心附近应呈现二次色散，而DFT计算中偏离此行为通常源于旋转不变性的破坏。本文提出两种基于倒空间的修正方案，并发现长程静电贡献的常规处理在构造上不满足旋转不变性，尤其对力常数二阶导数的修正至关重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低维材料中声学弯曲声子模式在布里渊区中心附近应呈现二次色散，而DFT计算中偏离此行为通常源于旋转不变性的破坏。本文提出两种基于倒空间的修正方案，并发现长程静电贡献的常规处理在构造上不满足旋转不变性，尤其对力常数二阶导数的修正至关重要。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于倒空间施加旋转不变性条件，对布里渊区中心的原子间力常数（IFCs）及其对声子波矢的一阶和二阶导数进行修正。具体提出两种短程IFCs修正方案：一种基于Moore-Penrose伪逆（在ABINIT软件包中实现），另一种直接修改动力学矩阵对波矢一阶导数的原位反对称部分。同时考察了不同维度体系和赝势的影响，并讨论了长程静电贡献下的旋转不变性问题。

papers.title: Endoreversible Carnot machines with long-time reversible limit
papers.abstract: The well-known Curzon-Ahlborn (CA) engine [Am. J. Phys. {\bf 43}, 22 (1975)] runs in finite time and yields a finite power output. In order to recover the standard Carnot cycle from the CA model, the limit of quasi-static operation has to be concurrent with the reversible limit, a condition strangely missing from the CA model. We augment this model by specifying the duration of the isothermal process as a monotonic decreasing function of the temperature difference between the working substance and the reservoir. As an illustration, we analyze the machine's operation in the low-dissipation regime in which the entropy production in each isothermal branch is inversely proportional to the duration of the process. The modified model is able to determine the optimal durations of isothermal processes as well as heat and work per cycle, while retaining the optimal power conditions of the CA model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：模型构建、有限时间热力学、低耗散近似。；研究对象：有限时间运行的不可逆卡诺热机（Curzon-Ahlborn模型）的改进模型，具体研究等温过程持续时间与温度差的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将等温过程持续时间设定为工质与热库温差的单调递减函数，该改进模型在保留Curzon-Ahlborn模型最优功率条件的同时，能够确定等温过程的最优持续时间以及每循环的吸热、放热和做功量，并实现了长时间准静态极限与可逆极限的一致性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将等温过程持续时间设定为工质与热库温差的单调递减函数，该改进模型在保留Curzon-Ahlborn模型最优功率条件的同时，能够确定等温过程的最优持续时间以及每循环的吸热、放热和做功量，并实现了长时间准静态极限与可逆极限的一致性。；创新点：解决了原Curzon-Ahlborn模型中准静态极限与可逆极限不一致的问题，通过引入等温过程持续时间与温差的单调递减函数关系，使模型在长时间极限下能自然恢复为标准卡诺循环。
papers.method_zh: 采用有限时间热力学框架，在低耗散近似下（每个等温分支的熵产生与过程持续时间成反比）对Curzon-Ahlborn模型进行修正，通过数学分析确定最优运行参数。

papers.title: Foundations of entropy in complex systems
papers.abstract: This chapter reviews the foundations of entropy and their extensions to complex systems. We first discuss the relation between Boltzmann's formula, multiplicity, coarse-graining, and Shannon entropy, before introducing generalized entropies such as Rényi, Tsallis, and Burg entropy. We then examine Maxwell--Boltzmann, Bose--Einstein, and Fermi--Dirac statistics, structure-forming systems, sample-space reducing processes, Pólya urns, and nonlinear dynamics. Axiomatic approaches are presented through the Shannon--Khinchin axioms, Tempesta group-composability, Hanel--Thurner asymptotic scaling, Shore--Johnson consistency axioms, and Lieb--Yngvason axioms. Finally, we discuss calibration invariance, Hanel--Thurner--Gell-Mann duality between linear and escort averages, and Kolmogorov--Nagumo averages, showing how the same distribution can arise from different entropies, constraints, or dynamics. These results emphasize that the choice of entropy should be guided by the structure and physical properties of the system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“review”“axiomatic approaches”“theoretical framework”等关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：复杂系统中的熵基础理论。具体包括：熵的统计力学公式（Boltzmann、Shannon）、广义熵（Rényi、Tsallis、Burg）、统计分布（Maxwell–Boltzmann、Bose–Einstein、Fermi–Dirac）、结构形成系统、样本空间缩减过程、Pólya 瓮模型、非线性动力学，以及多种公理化体系（Shannon–Khinchin、Tempesta、Hanel–Thurner、Shore–Johnson、Lieb–Yngvason）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不同熵定义（如Rényi、Tsallis、Burg）与不同约束或动力学可以导出相同的分布，因此熵的选择应基于系统的结构和物理性质，而非任意约定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不同熵定义（如Rényi、Tsallis、Burg）与不同约束或动力学可以导出相同的分布，因此熵的选择应基于系统的结构和物理性质，而非任意约定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该工作主要系统梳理了熵在复杂系统中的多种推广形式及其公理化基础，并强调了熵选择与系统物理结构之间的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论综述与公理化分析。具体包括：Shannon–Khinchin 公理、Tempesta 群可组合性、Hanel–Thurner 渐近标度、Shore–Johnson 一致性公理、Lieb–Yngvason 公理，以及校准不变性、Hanel–Thurner–Gell-Mann 对偶性（线性平均与伴随平均）、Kolmogorov–Nagumo 平均等数学框架。

papers.title: Dynamically suppressed lattice rotations in SrTiO$_3$ as a basis for photo-induced ferroelectricity
papers.abstract: Photo-induced ferroelectricity in the quantum paraelectric SrTiO$_3$ involves the dynamical interplay between a coherently driven Ti-O stretching vibration and multiple structural degrees of freedom, including antiferrodistortive rotations, strain, and the polar mode instability. In the high-temperature cubic phase, in the absence of average antiferrodistortion, time-resolved X-ray diffuse scattering has evidenced a correlation between a photo-induced reduction in antiferrodistortive fluctuations and the emergence of ferroelectric order. Here, we complement these measurements with time-resolved elastic X-ray diffraction in the low-temperature tetragonal phase, in which antiferrodistortive fluctuations are small but a finite average rotation has set in. In this phase, we observe a long-lived reduction of the equilibrium antiferrodistortive rotation angle. A unified theory of the nonlinear lattice dynamics based on first-principles calculations describes the dynamics in both high-temperature cubic and low-temperature tetragonal phases, providing a basis for light-induced ferroelectricity in SrTiO$_3$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论）。判断依据：摘要中同时提及“time-resolved elastic X-ray diffraction”（实验手段）和“unified theory of the nonlinear lattice dynamics based on first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算理论）。；研究对象：量子顺电体 SrTiO₃ 中光致铁电性的机制，特别是反铁畸变转动（antiferrodistortive rotations）与晶格动力学之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低温四方相中，光激发导致平衡态反铁畸变转动角出现长寿命的减小；结合高温立方相的结果，第一性原理非线性晶格动力学理论统一描述了两种相中的动力学行为，为光致铁电性提供了基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低温四方相中，光激发导致平衡态反铁畸变转动角出现长寿命的减小；结合高温立方相的结果，第一性原理非线性晶格动力学理论统一描述了两种相中的动力学行为，为光致铁电性提供了基础。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨弹性X射线衍射（time-resolved elastic X-ray diffraction），用于测量低温四方相中的反铁畸变转动角变化；第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）构建非线性晶格动力学统一理论。

papers.title: Tuning superconductivity and charge density wave order by next-nearest-neighbor hopping integral in honeycomb Holstein model
papers.abstract: By using unbiased determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we investigate the interplay between superconductivity and charge density wave order in the Holstein model on a honeycomb lattice with next-nearest-neighbor hopping \(t^{\prime}\). We find that a finite negative \(t^{\prime}\) enhances \(s\)-wave superconducting pairing susceptibility near the van Hove fillings in the weak electron-phonon coupling regime, while it suppresses superconductivity and promotes charge density wave order at intermediate electron-phonon coupling strengths. The effect of \(t^{\prime}\) on a charge density wave is filling-dependent: It suppresses the charge density wave at half filling but enhances it near the van Hove singularities. A spectral analysis reveals the opening of a gap at low temperatures, highlighting the competitive relationship between superconducting and charge density wave orders mediated by electron-phonon coupling and tuned by \(t^{\prime}\).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations（行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟）。；研究对象：蜂窝晶格Holstein模型中的超导与电荷密度波序，以及次近邻跳跃积分 \(t^{\prime}\) 对二者竞争关系的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱电子-声子耦合下，负的 \(t^{\prime}\) 在范霍夫填充附近增强 \(s\)-波超导配对；在中等耦合强度下，\(t^{\prime}\) 抑制超导并促进电荷密度波序。\(t^{\prime}\) 对电荷密度波的影响依赖于填充：在半满时抑制电荷密度波，在范霍夫奇点附近增强它。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱电子-声子耦合下，负的 \(t^{\prime}\) 在范霍夫填充附近增强 \(s\)-波超导配对；在中等耦合强度下，\(t^{\prime}\) 抑制超导并促进电荷密度波序。\(t^{\prime}\) 对电荷密度波的影响依赖于填充：在半满时抑制电荷密度波，在范霍夫奇点附近增强它。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用无偏的行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟（determinant quantum Monte Carlo, DQMC）。

papers.title: Multiband transport hierarchy and large Nernst effect in EuAuBi: Establishing a Nernst scaling for asymmetric multiband systems
papers.abstract: In correlated materials, coexisting pockets of vastly different carrier densities raise two fundamental questions: which pocket governs the various transport coefficients, and does the conventional Nernst scaling $ν/T \propto μ/E_F$, originally derived for single-band systems, still hold? We address both questions in the polar semimetal EuAuBi, where a dilute electron pocket ($n_e \sim 10^{16}~\mathrm{cm}^{-3}$) coexists with a dense hole pocket ($n_h \sim 10^{21}~\mathrm{cm}^{-3}$). We find a clear hierarchy: the hole pocket dominates the longitudinal resistivity; the Hall effect crosses from electron- to hole-dominance with increasing field; the Seebeck coefficient is dominated by the electron pocket at low temperature and by both pockets at high temperature. Remarkably, the Nernst effect is governed entirely by the ultrahigh-mobility electron pocket, yielding a large low-field signal of $\sim 5~μ\mathrm{V/K}$ near 1~T at 202~K, comparable to anomalous Nernst signals in magnetic Weyl semimetals. By analyzing the two-band thermoelectric conductivity, we show that the Nernst coefficient follows a scaling $ν/T \propto μ_e/{E_{F, tot}}$. This scaling originates from a compensation between the electron-to-hole conductivity ratio and the Fermi-energy ratio, establishing that the large Nernst effect is a semiclassical multiband phenomenon rather than a topological Berry-curvature contribution. This understanding advances the thermoelectric transport physics of multiband electronic systems and offers a guiding principle for low-field transverse thermoelectric design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：transport coefficients, Hall effect, Seebeck coefficient, Nernst effect, two-band analysis）；研究对象：极性半金属EuAuBi，其中存在稀薄电子口袋（载流子浓度~10¹⁶ cm⁻³）与密集空穴口袋（载流子浓度~10²¹ cm⁻³）共存的非对称多带输运体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在EuAuBi中建立了多带输运层级：电子口袋主导Nernst效应，产生与磁性Weyl半金属中反常Nernst信号相当的大信号（~5 μV/K，1 T，202 K）；Nernst系数遵循标度关系ν/T ∝ μ_e/E_{F,tot}，证明该大Nernst效应是半经典多带现象而非拓扑贝里曲率贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在EuAuBi中建立了多带输运层级：电子口袋主导Nernst效应，产生与磁性Weyl半金属中反常Nernst信号相当的大信号（~5 μV/K，1 T，202 K）；Nernst系数遵循标度关系ν/T ∝ μ_e/E_{F,tot}，证明该大Nernst效应是半经典多带现象而非拓扑贝里曲率贡献。；创新点：首次在非对称多带体系中建立Nernst标度ν/T ∝ μ_e/E_{F,tot}，揭示该标度源于电子-空穴电导率比与费米能比之间的补偿机制，为低场横向热电设计提供指导原则。
papers.method_zh: 通过多带输运测量（纵向电阻率、霍尔效应、塞贝克系数、Nernst效应）结合两带热电导率分析，提取各载流子口袋的迁移率、费米能等参数，并验证Nernst标度关系。

papers.title: Orbital-selective band evolution and out-of-plane correlation in the FeGe-family kagome antiferromagnet ScFe$_6$Ge$_6$
papers.abstract: In strongly correlated materials such as high-temperature superconductors, the relation between charge density wave (CDW) order and magnetism remains an important unresolved problem. FeGe is the first kagome metal known to exhibit CDW order deep within an antiferromagnetic state, accompanied by an unconventional evolution of lattice symmetry. To elucidate the general conditions governing such spin-correlated CDW order, we investigate ScFe$_6$Ge$_6$, which lacks CDW order and therefore exhibits reduced involvement of charge degrees of freedom while retaining other properties of FeGe. Instead of a CDW order, ScFe$_6$Ge$_6$ undergoes a magnetic transition at $T^*$ = 195 K. Across this transition, angle-resolved photoemission and Raman spectroscopy reveal orbital-selective behavior confined to a single kagome Dirac band, together with electron-phonon and magnetoelastic coupling to an out-of-plane phonon mode. These results suggest that orbital-selective physics and out-of-plane correlations play enhanced roles in realizing spin-correlated CDW order in magnetic kagome metals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“angle-resolved photoemission and Raman spectroscopy reveal...”，即使用了角分辨光电子能谱和拉曼光谱等实验手段。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是FeGe家族的kagome反铁磁体ScFe₆Ge₆，物理现象包括其磁相变、轨道选择性行为以及面外关联，并与FeGe中的电荷密度波（CDW）序进行对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: ScFe₆Ge₆在195 K发生磁相变，但无CDW序；在该相变中，轨道选择性行为仅局限于单个kagome狄拉克能带，同时存在电子-声子耦合和磁弹耦合到面外声子模。这表明轨道选择性物理和面外关联在磁性kagome金属中实现自旋关联的CDW序中起增强作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：ScFe₆Ge₆在195 K发生磁相变，但无CDW序；在该相变中，轨道选择性行为仅局限于单个kagome狄拉克能带，同时存在电子-声子耦合和磁弹耦合到面外声子模。这表明轨道选择性物理和面外关联在磁性kagome金属中实现自旋关联的CDW序中起增强作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）和拉曼光谱（Raman spectroscopy）。

papers.title: Interfacial control of magnetism and electron transport in nonisostructural SrRuO$_3$/SrCuO$_2$ heterostructure
papers.abstract: Heterointerfaces between structurally dissimilar oxides provide a platform to exploit the interfacial mismatch in the lattice and electronic degrees of freedom to realize emergent functionalities and tunable physical properties with potential applications in oxide electronics. Here, we investigate the magnetic and electronic transport properties of symmetry-mismatched SrRuO$_3$ (SRO)/SrCuO$_2$ (SCO) heterostructure, in which a 4-nm-thick itinerant ferromagnetic metal SRO is interfaced with a planar-type antiferromagnetic insulator SCO, in comparison with a reference SRO (4 nm) film. While both the bare SRO and SRO/SCO bilayer exhibit perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (PMA), the SRO/SCO bilayer shows a pronounced enhancement in the saturation magnetization (M$_S$ $\approx$ 2.7 $μ_B$/Ru) and effective anisotropy constant (K$_{\mathrm{eff}}$ $\approx$ 2.13 $\times$ 10$^6$ erg/cc) relative to the bare SRO film (M$_S$ $\approx$ 1.3 $μ_B$/Ru and K$_{\mathrm{eff}}$ $\approx$ 5.25 $\times$ 10$^5$ erg/cc). Interestingly, the low-temperature resistivity upturn below 5 K arising from disorder-induced quantum corrections in bare SRO is strongly suppressed in SRO/SCO, and it exhibits Fermi-liquid-like transport ($ρ\propto T^2$) down to 2 K. Analysis of the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) reveals dominant intrinsic Berry-curvature driven electron transport in both samples, with enhanced intrinsic and skew-scattering contributions in the SRO/SCO bilayer, indicating the critical role of the interface in modifying the electronic band structure near the Fermi level. Our results demonstrate that the interface acts as an effective control knob, concurrently enhancing the magnetization, PMA, and intrinsic scattering contribution to the AHE in the SRO/SCO heterostructure, while suppressing the disorder-driven quantum corrections to transport behavior observed in the bare SRO film.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“investigate the magnetic and electronic transport properties”（研究磁性和电子输运性质），并对比了实验测量结果（如饱和磁化强度、电阻率、反常霍尔效应）。；研究对象：非等结构氧化物异质结 SrRuO₃ (SRO)/SrCuO₂ (SCO)。具体而言，是研究由4纳米厚的巡游铁磁金属SRO与平面型反铁磁绝缘体SCO构成的对称性失配异质结的界面磁性及电子输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在SRO/SCO异质结中，界面能够同时增强饱和磁化强度（~2.7 μB/Ru）和垂直磁各向异性，并抑制了单层SRO薄膜中由无序引起的低温电阻率回升，使体系在2K以下表现出费米液体行为。同时，界面还增强了反常霍尔效应中本征贝里曲率贡献和斜散射贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在SRO/SCO异质结中，界面能够同时增强饱和磁化强度（~2.7 μB/Ru）和垂直磁各向异性，并抑制了单层SRO薄膜中由无序引起的低温电阻率回升，使体系在2K以下表现出费米液体行为。同时，界面还增强了反常霍尔效应中本征贝里曲率贡献和斜散射贡献。；创新点：该工作揭示了在结构对称性失配的氧化物异质结（SRO/SCO）中，界面可以作为有效调控手段，同时实现磁性和电子输运性能的多重优化（增强磁化强度、垂直各向异性和本征反常霍尔效应，同时抑制无序导致的量子输运修正），展示了利用界面失配自由度实现多功能调控的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：制备SRO/SCO异质结和参考SRO薄膜（可能采用脉冲激光沉积或分子束外延等方法，摘要未明确说明具体生长技术）；测量磁性质（获得饱和磁化强度Ms和有效各向异性常数Keff）；测量电子输运性质（电阻率随温度变化、反常霍尔效应AHE）。分析方法包括：对低温电阻率回升的量子修正分析，以及对反常霍尔效应的标度分析（区分本征贝里曲率贡献和斜散射贡献）。

papers.title: Hidden chirality and half-vortex formation in exciton-polariton condensates
papers.abstract: We show that a radially symmetric, nonresonantly pumped spinor exciton-polariton condensate can acquire chirality without a rotating drive, chiral geometry, or pump orbital angular momentum. Spin relaxation in a two-reservoir system shifts the reservoir-induced blueshift relative to the gain profile, creating an effective non-Hermitian chiral potential. A reduced angular-mode theory reveals tunable exceptional points and non-reciprocal coupling between counter-rotating modes. Full driven-dissipative Gross-Pitaevskii simulations show that this hidden chirality enables all-optical formation of spin-selective half-vortices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：show, theory, simulations）；研究对象：非共振泵浦的自旋激子-极化激元凝聚体中的隐藏手性及半涡旋形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无旋转驱动、手性几何结构或泵浦轨道角动量的条件下，径向对称的自旋激子-极化激元凝聚体可通过自旋弛豫机制自发获得手性，并实现全光学自旋选择性半涡旋的生成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无旋转驱动、手性几何结构或泵浦轨道角动量的条件下，径向对称的自旋激子-极化激元凝聚体可通过自旋弛豫机制自发获得手性，并实现全光学自旋选择性半涡旋的生成。；创新点：揭示了非厄米手性势的起源——储层诱导蓝移与增益谱的相对偏移，并首次提出无需外部手性条件即可在极化激元凝聚体中产生隐藏手性及半涡旋的全光学方案。
papers.method_zh: 双储层系统中的自旋弛豫模型、约化角模理论（用于揭示可调异常点和反向旋转模间的非互易耦合）、全驱动-耗散Gross-Pitaevskii方程数值模拟。

papers.title: The free energy of the square lattice Ising model with interactions alternating in horizontal and vertical directions
papers.abstract: The free energy of the Ising model on the square lattice with alternating interactions in both horizontal and vertical directions is exactly derived. This model is distinct from the checkerboard Ising model. The result includes Onsager's free energy as a special case, and also includes Lee-Yang's free energy with an imaginary field, and relates these two solutions via continuous parameters. It is also derived that each imaginary magnetic field $iπ/2$ applied to a lattice site corresponds to a single frustrated square in its dual lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“exactly derived”（精确推导）、“free energy”（自由能）、“Ising model”（伊辛模型），属于严格解析求解的理论工作。；研究对象：二维正方晶格上水平和垂直方向相互作用交替变化的伊辛模型（Ising model with alternating interactions in horizontal and vertical directions），区别于棋盘格伊辛模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 精确推导了该交替相互作用伊辛模型的自由能解析表达式，该结果将Onsager自由能（均匀相互作用情形）和Lee-Yang自由能（含虚数磁场情形）通过连续参数统一起来；并发现每个格点上的虚数磁场iπ/2对应其对偶晶格中的一个受挫正方形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：精确推导了该交替相互作用伊辛模型的自由能解析表达式，该结果将Onsager自由能（均匀相互作用情形）和Lee-Yang自由能（含虚数磁场情形）通过连续参数统一起来；并发现每个格点上的虚数磁场iπ/2对应其对偶晶格中的一个受挫正方形。；创新点：该模型不同于常见的棋盘格伊辛模型，其自由能解析解将Onsager解和Lee-Yang解通过连续参数联系起来，并揭示了虚数磁场与对偶晶格受挫结构之间的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 严格解析推导（exact derivation），基于统计力学中伊辛模型的转移矩阵或对偶变换等经典解析方法（摘要未明确说明具体技术细节）。

papers.title: symveig: Verified eigenvalue enclosures for symmetry-decomposed Hermitian matrices
papers.abstract: Exact diagonalization of quantum lattice Hamiltonians returns floating-point eigenvalues whose accuracy is not certified: rounding error, eigensolver behaviour, and ill-conditioning can corrupt a result without warning. We present \texttt{symveig}, a pure NumPy/SciPy package that computes rigorous, machine-checkable enclosures of all eigenvalues of a Hermitian matrix, with an optional symmetry-sector decomposition. For a matrix that commutes with an abelian conserved quantity diagonal in the working basis (for example the total magnetization of a spin model), the package verifies each symmetry sector independently. Because each sector block is much smaller than the full matrix, this yields enclosures that are both tighter (by a factor of $3$-$9$ across system sizes $L = 4$-$12$) and dramatically faster (a wall-clock speedup of up to $130\times$ at $L = 12$) than verifying the full matrix, while never forming or diagonalizing it. Every enclosure half-width is a guaranteed upper bound on the distance from a computed eigenvalue to the nearest true eigenvalue under IEEE~754 round-to-nearest arithmetic, obtained by explicit floating-point error analysis with no heuristic slack. The implementation requires neither INTLAB nor MATLAB, bringing rigorously verified eigenvalue enclosure into the standard scientific-Python stack used in computational physics. We validate the package on $1$D Heisenberg (open and periodic), $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg, and $2$D Heisenberg lattices, confirming that every computed eigenvalue is contained in its enclosure across all tested configurations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：exact diagonalization（精确对角化）、floating-point error analysis（浮点误差分析）、verified eigenvalue enclosures（可验证的特征值包围）。；研究对象：量子晶格哈密顿量的特征值计算，具体验证了1D海森堡模型（开边界和周期边界）、J1-J2海森堡模型以及2D海森堡晶格。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了纯NumPy/SciPy软件包symveig，能够为厄米矩阵的所有特征值提供严格、机器可验证的包围区间，并通过对称性分块分解（如总磁化强度）使包围区间更紧（系统尺寸L=4-12时紧致3-9倍）且计算速度更快（L=12时加速高达130倍）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了纯NumPy/SciPy软件包symveig，能够为厄米矩阵的所有特征值提供严格、机器可验证的包围区间，并通过对称性分块分解（如总磁化强度）使包围区间更紧（系统尺寸L=4-12时紧致3-9倍）且计算速度更快（L=12时加速高达130倍）。；创新点：将严格验证的特征值包围计算引入标准科学Python栈（NumPy/SciPy），无需依赖专用数值验证工具箱（如INTLAB），且通过对称性分解同时提高了包围区间的紧致性和计算效率。
papers.method_zh: 基于IEEE 754舍入到最近算术下的显式浮点误差分析，利用NumPy/SciPy实现纯Python包，对与工作基中对角阿贝尔守恒量（如自旋模型的总磁化强度）对易的矩阵进行对称性分块验证，无需形成或对角化全矩阵，也无需INTLAB或MATLAB。

papers.title: Electronic structure trends in La$_{2}R$Ni$_2$O$_7$ ($R=$ Pr, Nd, Sm) from first-principles
papers.abstract: The discovery of superconductivity in bilayer La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ under pressure has sparked tremendous attention on Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) nickelates. Recently, a higher superconducting transition temperature of 96 K was reported in Sm-doped La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ single crystals at $\sim$ 22 GPa. Motivated by this experimental observation, we systematically explore the crystal structure and electronic properties of La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ doped with different rare-earth elements in comparison to the undoped counterpart. As expected due to the effect of chemical pressure, we find that the volume of La$_{2}$$R$Ni$_2$O$_7$ ($R=$ Pr, Nd, Sm) progressively decreases with doping from Pr to Sm. We further find a pressure-induced structural transition to tetragonal symmetry that approximately coincides with the emergence of superconductivity in all cases. This transition is characterized by the emergence of flat $d_{z^2}$ bands at the Fermi level in the electronic structure. Despite subtle distinctions in the electronic structure between undoped and $R$-doped La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$, an increase in the dominant planar hopping is obtained as the $R$ size decreases. In contrast, the out-of-plane hopping decreases (in spite of the $c$ lattice constant compression), due to the decrease in the apical Ni-O$_{\rm rocksalt}$ bond length. Our findings provide further microscopic insights into the effects of $R$-doping in the electronic structure of RP nickelate superconductors in connection to $T_c$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles”（第一性原理）、“systematically explore”、“electronic structure”。；研究对象：稀土元素掺杂的双层Ruddlesden-Popper（RP）相镍氧化物La₂R Ni₂O₇（R = Pr, Nd, Sm），以及其与未掺杂La₃Ni₂O₇的对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在La₂R Ni₂O₇中，随着掺杂元素从Pr到Sm，化学压力导致晶胞体积逐渐减小，并出现与超导态大致同时发生的压力诱导结构相变（转变为四方对称性），该相变伴随费米能级处平坦d_{z²}能带的出现。尽管掺杂与未掺杂体系的电子结构存在细微差异，但面内主导的跃迁积分随R离子半径减小而增大，而面外跃迁积分却因顶端Ni-O岩盐层键长缩短而减小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在La₂R Ni₂O₇中，随着掺杂元素从Pr到Sm，化学压力导致晶胞体积逐渐减小，并出现与超导态大致同时发生的压力诱导结构相变（转变为四方对称性），该相变伴随费米能级处平坦d_{z²}能带的出现。尽管掺杂与未掺杂体系的电子结构存在细微差异，但面内主导的跃迁积分随R离子半径减小而增大，而面外跃迁积分却因顶端Ni-O岩盐层键长缩短而减小。；创新点：系统揭示了不同稀土元素（Pr, Nd, Sm）掺杂对La₃Ni₂O₇晶体结构、电子结构及跃迁积分的影响，特别是面内与面外跃迁积分随掺杂元素变化的相反趋势，为理解R掺杂如何调控超导转变温度（T_c）提供了微观视角。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体方法摘要未明确说明（可能为DFT或DFT+U等，但摘要未提及具体泛函或修正项）。

papers.title: Evaluating the Structural Basis for Polar Altermagnet Candidate Ca$_{3}$(Ru,Ti)$_{2}$O$_{7}$
papers.abstract: The interplay between polar and altermagnetic orders remains largely unexplored in the broader landscape of correlated electron systems. Ca$_{3}$Ru$_{2}$O$_{7}$ has been proposed by density functional theory (DFT) as a polar altermagnet, reliant on the transformation of experimentally reported $Bb2_{1}m$ phase to a lower symmetry $Pn2_{1}a$ structure. Here, we perform a targeted search for the $Pn2_{1}a$ phase using synchrotron X-ray diffraction on single crystals of Ca$_{3}$Ru$_{2}$O$_{7}$ and Ca$_{3}$(Ru$_{0.99}$Ti$_{0.01}$)$_{2}$O$_{7}$. No diffraction signature of the $Pn2_{1}a$ structure is detected down to 20 K within experimental limits of $\sim$60-200 fm atomic displacements, significantly smaller than the DFT prediction of $\sim$1 pm. Combined with recent nonlinear transport measurements, our structural study suggests Ca$_{3}$Ru$_{2}$O$_{7}$ as a unique system where strong electron correlations drive an electronic phase transition without any measurable lattice symmetry change. With Ti substitution exceeding $\sim$3%, a chemically tunable altermagnetic phase with $Bb2_{1}m$ structure emerges. The study highlights the importance of sub-picometer metrology towards de-convolving structural versus electronic origins of altermagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词为“synchrotron X-ray diffraction”（同步辐射X射线衍射）、“single crystals”（单晶）、“structural study”（结构研究）。；研究对象：论文研究的材料是Ca₃Ru₂O₇及其Ti掺杂体系Ca₃(Ru₀.₉₉Ti₀.₀₁)₂O₇。物理现象是极性交变磁体（polar altermagnet）候选材料的结构基础，特别是其是否存在理论预测的低对称性Pn2₁a相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Ca₃Ru₂O₇中，实验未检测到理论预测的Pn2₁a结构相，表明该材料中强电子关联驱动了电子相变，而晶格对称性未发生可测量的变化。当Ti掺杂超过约3%时，会形成具有Bb2₁m结构的化学可调交磁相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Ca₃Ru₂O₇中，实验未检测到理论预测的Pn2₁a结构相，表明该材料中强电子关联驱动了电子相变，而晶格对称性未发生可测量的变化。当Ti掺杂超过约3%时，会形成具有Bb2₁m结构的化学可调交磁相。；创新点：该工作通过高精度结构测量（亚皮米级位移检测），直接检验了密度泛函理论（DFT）关于Ca₃Ru₂O₇是极性交变磁体的结构预测，并否定了该预测。它揭示了强关联电子体系中，电子相变可以不伴随可测量的晶格对称性变化，强调了区分交变磁性的结构起源与电子起源的重要性。
papers.method_zh: 主要实验手段是同步辐射X射线衍射，对Ca₃Ru₂O₇和Ca₃(Ru₀.₉₉Ti₀.₀₁)₂O₇单晶进行低温（低至20K）结构测量。研究还结合了近期非线性输运测量的结果。

papers.title: A Geometrically Exact Treatment of Percolation Through Voids around Faceted Regular and Structurally Disordered Grains
papers.abstract: Fluid and charge flow through interstitial volumes among impermeable randomly placed grains in porous materials ceases to occur at a critical concentration where networks of void volumes are disrupted at macroscopic scales. This critical density for void percolation can be difficult to calculate due to the irregular shape of the void regions. We develop and implement a geometrically exact method, scaling only linearly in the system volume, for identifying the shape and size of contiguous voids. In this manner, we calculate percolation thresholds for both grain cluster percolation (where system spanning networks of overlapping grains begin to appear with increasing density) and void percolation at much higher grain concentrations where networks of interstitial volumes no longer exist on macroscopic scales. For both the former and the latter, we calculate critical concentrations for inclusions in the shape of the Platonic solids (as well as truncated icosahedra) for both aligned and randomly oriented grains. In the case of critical densities for void percolation, the accuracy of our results is significantly improved relative to prior benchmarks. We also incorporate structural disorder of inclusions by considering impermeable grains in the form of cubes subject to a series of randomly placed and oriented fracture planes to mimic aggressively fractured inclusions found in nature. As the number of sustained slices becomes large, we find that the critical porosity for void percolation tends to 5%
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：geometrically exact method、scaling linearly、calculate percolation thresholds。；研究对象：多孔材料中不可渗透颗粒间空隙的渗流现象，具体包括规则多面体（柏拉图立体、截角二十面体）和结构无序（含随机断裂面的立方体）颗粒的堆积体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于规则多面体颗粒，精确计算了颗粒团簇渗流和空隙渗流的临界浓度；对于含随机断裂面的立方体颗粒，当断裂面数量增多时，空隙渗流的临界孔隙率趋近于5%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于规则多面体颗粒，精确计算了颗粒团簇渗流和空隙渗流的临界浓度；对于含随机断裂面的立方体颗粒，当断裂面数量增多时，空隙渗流的临界孔隙率趋近于5%。；创新点：该方法在几何上精确且计算复杂度线性于系统体积，显著提高了空隙渗流临界密度的计算精度（相对于先前基准）；同时首次将结构无序（通过随机断裂面模拟）引入颗粒形状，并揭示了其临界孔隙率的极限行为。
papers.method_zh: 开发并实现了一种几何精确的方法，该方法仅需与系统体积成线性比例的计算量，用于识别连续空隙的形状和尺寸，并据此计算渗流阈值。

papers.title: Phase Behavior of Unilamellar Hybrid Lipid-Diblock Copolymer Membranes
papers.abstract: Hybrid lipid block copolymer membranes are promising for many applications in drug delivery, single molecule detection, in-membrane protein folding, and synthetic cells. However, rational design is difficult due to the many design parameters which determine the nano- and micron-scale morphology and properties. In this work, we propose a physically-informed framework which incorporates chemical immiscibility, hydrophobic thickness mismatch and geometric constraints to predict the morphology of hybrid membranes. For this purpose, we extend existing theory for amphiphilic monolayers to model the thickness of diblock copolymer bilayers, demonstrating that both the hydrophobic and hydrophilic block lengths determine the thickness. We identify and rationalize the four primary membrane morphologies observed: mixed, laterally phase-separated, unzipped (thick-thin coexistence), and polymer-rich. Specifically, chemical immiscibility differentiates mixed membranes from laterally phase separated membranes, and hydrophobic mismatch drives transitions to unzipped or polymer-rich morphologies. Areal density, finally, determines the crossover between unzipped and polymer-rich states. We validate our theoretical predictions using coarse-grained molecular dynamics across a broad parameter space, including multiple lipid species (DOPC, DPPC), polymer species (1,4 PBD-b-PEO, 1,2 PBD-b-PEO, PE-b-PEO), block lengths, temperatures, and compositions. The resulting phase maps unify previously reported experimental and simulation observations and enable a generic and mechanistic understanding for the effect of system parameters on the nanoscale morphology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算验证）。判断依据：提出物理框架（physically-informed framework）、扩展现有理论（extend existing theory）、粗粒化分子动力学模拟（coarse-grained molecular dynamics）。；研究对象：单层杂化脂质-双嵌段共聚物膜（unilamellar hybrid lipid-diblock copolymer membranes）的相行为，包括混合、横向相分离、解拉链（厚-薄共存）和富聚合物四种形态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 化学不混溶性区分混合膜与横向相分离膜，疏水厚度失配驱动向解拉链或富聚合物形态的转变，而面积密度决定解拉链与富聚合物态之间的交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：化学不混溶性区分混合膜与横向相分离膜，疏水厚度失配驱动向解拉链或富聚合物形态的转变，而面积密度决定解拉链与富聚合物态之间的交叉。；创新点：提出了一个整合化学不混溶性、疏水厚度失配和几何约束的物理框架，统一解释了此前实验和模拟中观察到的多种杂化膜形态，并建立了系统参数对纳米尺度形态影响的通用机理理解。
papers.method_zh: 扩展两亲性单层膜理论以描述双嵌段共聚物双层膜厚度（同时考虑疏水和亲水嵌段长度），结合粗粒化分子动力学模拟在宽参数空间（多种脂质种类、聚合物种类、嵌段长度、温度和组成）验证理论预测。

papers.title: Staggered Virtual-Loop-Current Order in Pseudospin-1 Dirac Flat Bands
papers.abstract: Although interactions are known to generate exotic phases in pseudospin-1/2 flat-band Dirac materials, it remains an open question whether the higher-pseudospin systems could realize entirely new types of orders and, if so, how such orders are governed by the nature of the underlying Dirac states. Here, we demonstrate that short-range interactions can drive a staggered virtual-loop-current (SVLC) order together with a $\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}$ charge order in a partially filled pseudospin-1 Dirac flat band of the dice lattice. The virtual loop currents are shown to originate from interaction-driven quantum fluctuations of charge densities and exhibit alternating circulation between the neighboring triangular plaquettes. The resulting spontaneous time-reversal symmetry breaking is found to induce finite intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity and orbital magnetization. The SVLC state is shown to be the lowest energy solution in restricted real-space Hartree-Fock calculations in the weakly interacting regime. The pseudospin-1 Dirac cones enter the SVLC order through the equivalence of their flat-band wavefunctions, and unlike the pseudospin-1/2 Dirac systems, do not rely on the presence of well-defined low-energy valleys in the electronic spectrum. Our study establishes higher-pseudospin Dirac systems as a new platform for investigating exotic emergent orders in flat-band physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“demonstrate”“originate from”“Hartree-Fock calculations”等理论推导与计算关键词，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：dice晶格中部分填充的赝自旋-1狄拉克平带体系，具体研究由短程相互作用驱动的交错虚环流（SVLC）序与√3×√3电荷序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 短程相互作用可在赝自旋-1狄拉克平带中驱动交错虚环流序，该序自发打破时间反演对称性，并诱导出有限的本征反常霍尔电导和轨道磁化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：短程相互作用可在赝自旋-1狄拉克平带中驱动交错虚环流序，该序自发打破时间反演对称性，并诱导出有限的本征反常霍尔电导和轨道磁化。；创新点：首次在赝自旋大于1/2的狄拉克平带体系中预言了交错虚环流序，该序不依赖于电子能谱中明确定义的低能谷结构，与赝自旋-1/2狄拉克体系形成对比，为平带物理中奇异有序态提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用限制实空间Hartree-Fock计算，在弱相互作用区间求解最低能量解，并基于平带波函数的等价性分析赝自旋-1狄拉克锥的序参量行为。

papers.title: InvDesMobility: a reliability-gated first-principles feedback framework for closed-loop materials discovery
papers.abstract: Inverse materials design starts from target functionality and searches for structures that can realize it. Its value in closed-loop discovery depends not only on prediction performance, but also on whether expensive first-principles results are independently validated, provenance-recorded, and admitted as feedback only when evidence is sufficient. This is especially important for composite properties such as carrier mobility, where a final scalar value hides intermediate quantities, fit quality, convergence history, and workflow assumptions. Here we present InvDesMobility, a reliability-gated first-principles feedback framework that integrates multi-agent automated DFT, evidence stratification, generative structure proposal, acquisition ranking, and auditable release. Using 516 2DMatPedia-derived candidates, the workflow produced 280 QC-passed materials and 573 retained carrier-direction seed channels after channel-level reliability gating. These records were split into two feedback objects: relaxed structures updated the generative model, while retained mobility channels trained the acquisition model and set validation priority. Over multiple iterations, InvDesMobility screened 2.4 x 10^6 structures, submitted 102 candidates for DFT validation, and retained 86 reliability-gated generated channels across 41 formulas. Overall, the main contribution is not a fixed list of high-mobility materials, but a transferable feedback contract that makes closed-loop inverse design both useful and auditable when learning from expensive calculated properties. All source data, retained feedback records, and workflows are available at https://github.com/DreamLufei/invDesMobility, with an accompanying evidence website at https://dreamlufei.github.io/invDesMobility/.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles feedback framework、multi-agent automated DFT、generative structure proposal。；研究对象：载流子迁移率（carrier mobility）这一复合物性，以及基于逆设计（inverse materials design）的二维材料发现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个名为InvDesMobility的可靠性门控第一性原理反馈框架，实现了闭环材料发现中昂贵计算结果的独立验证、来源记录与证据分层反馈，而非仅提供高迁移率材料列表。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个名为InvDesMobility的可靠性门控第一性原理反馈框架，实现了闭环材料发现中昂贵计算结果的独立验证、来源记录与证据分层反馈，而非仅提供高迁移率材料列表。；创新点：核心创新在于设计了一个可迁移的反馈契约（transferable feedback contract），使闭环逆设计在利用昂贵计算性质进行学习时既实用又可审计，而非仅输出一个固定的高迁移率材料清单。摘要未突出说明与已有逆设计框架在具体算法或性能上的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 多智能体自动化DFT计算、证据分层（evidence stratification）、生成式结构提议（generative structure proposal）、采集排序（acquisition ranking）、可审计发布（auditable release），以及通道级可靠性门控（channel-level reliability gating）。

papers.title: Collective relaxation eigenmodes and anisotropic magnon thermal transport in $α$-MnTe
papers.abstract: The intrinsic magnon thermal transport in the altermagnet $α$-MnTe is studied by solving the three-dimensional linearized Boltzmann transport equation with the four-magnon collision matrix. Diagonalizing the collision matrix gives direct access to the relaxation eigenmodes beyond the relaxation-time approximation. We show that Umklapp scattering lifts the momentum-related zero modes of the Normal-only collision operator and substantially modifies the low-lying relaxation spectrum. Using the same collision matrix, we compute the magnon thermal conductivity tensor. The full linearized Boltzmann transport equation result exceeds the relaxation-time approximation by more than an order of magnitude at low temperature and reveals a strong transport anisotropy, with the out-of-plane thermal conductivity remaining larger than the in-plane component over the studied temperature range. A mode-resolved analysis shows that the dominant heat-carrying modes retain momentum-like character inherited from the Normal-only zero modes, and that the larger out-of-plane conductivity mainly originates from the stronger out-of-plane group-velocity contribution, rather than from a large difference in relaxation lifetimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：linearized Boltzmann transport equation（线性化玻尔兹曼输运方程）、four-magnon collision matrix（四磁子碰撞矩阵）、diagonalizing the collision matrix（对角化碰撞矩阵）。；研究对象：反铁磁交变磁体（altermagnet）α-MnTe 中的本征磁子热输运现象，特别是磁子热导率及其各向异性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 全线性化玻尔兹曼输运方程计算得到的磁子热导率在低温下比弛豫时间近似结果高出一个数量级以上，并显示出强烈的输运各向异性：在所研究的温度范围内，面外热导率始终大于面内分量。这种各向异性主要源于面外群速度的贡献更强，而非弛豫寿命的显著差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：全线性化玻尔兹曼输运方程计算得到的磁子热导率在低温下比弛豫时间近似结果高出一个数量级以上，并显示出强烈的输运各向异性：在所研究的温度范围内，面外热导率始终大于面内分量。这种各向异性主要源于面外群速度的贡献更强，而非弛豫寿命的显著差异。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过求解三维线性化玻尔兹曼输运方程，并利用四磁子碰撞矩阵进行对角化，直接获得超越弛豫时间近似的弛豫本征模。

papers.title: Luttinger liquid parameters in one-dimensional Rydberg arrays
papers.abstract: We investigate Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) transitions in one-dimensional Rydberg chains, where commensurate critical regimes associated with the melting of crystalline orders with period larger than five and incommensurate floating phases are both described by Luttinger liquid theory. The central quantity is the Luttinger liquid parameter $K$, which characterizes the universal low-energy theory and controls the relevance of perturbations driving BKT transitions. We extract $K$ using Friedel oscillations and the recently developed crosscap method introduced in Phys. Rev. Lett. 134, 076501 (2025). As benchmarks, we first apply the crosscap method to a $\mathbb{Z}_3$ dual hard-core boson chain and a spin-1 XY chain with single-ion anisotropy, obtaining BKT transition points consistent with previous results after finite-size extrapolation. We then compute $K$ in the Rydberg chain along lines with fixed correlation-oscillation period near BKT transitions. Along the commensurate period-five line, the critical values of $K$ predicted by sine-Gordon theory reveal two BKT transitions separating the disordered phase, the critical phase, and the $\mathbb{Z}_5$ crystalline phase. The results from Friedel oscillations and the crosscap method agree with each other and are further supported by energy-gap scaling and Binder-cumulant analysis. To obtain reliable values of $K$ from Friedel oscillations, we use a multi-harmonic fitting scheme throughout the analysis. Along incommensurate lines, the BKT points obtained from Friedel oscillations agree with those extracted from entanglement entropy. Finally, we show that the values of $K$ obtained from the two methods are mutually consistent inside the incommensurate floating phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Luttinger liquid theory、数值提取（crosscap method、Friedel oscillations）、有限尺寸标度分析。；研究对象：一维里德伯原子链中的Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）相变，特别是公度周期大于5的晶格有序熔化过程以及非公度浮游相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过提取Luttinger液体参数K，在一维里德伯链中确定了两个BKT相变点，分别分隔无序相、临界相和Z5晶格相；在非公度浮游相内，两种方法（Friedel振荡与crosscap方法）得到的K值相互一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过提取Luttinger液体参数K，在一维里德伯链中确定了两个BKT相变点，分别分隔无序相、临界相和Z5晶格相；在非公度浮游相内，两种方法（Friedel振荡与crosscap方法）得到的K值相互一致。；创新点：将新发展的crosscap方法首次应用于一维里德伯链系统，并与Friedel振荡方法进行系统对比，验证了两种方法在公度与非公度情形下的一致性。
papers.method_zh: 使用Luttinger液体理论描述低能物理；通过Friedel振荡的多谐波拟合方案以及Phys. Rev. Lett. 134, 076501 (2025) 中发展的crosscap方法提取Luttinger参数K；结合能隙标度和Binder累积量分析进行验证；在非公度线上用纠缠熵提取BKT点作为交叉验证。

papers.title: Optically Active Fractional Wannier-Center Displacement Drives Giant Second-Harmonic Generation
papers.abstract: Electric polarization is a static ground-state Berry-phase property, whereas second-harmonic generation (SHG) and shift current are dynamical optical responses. Their connection is encoded in the shift vector, whose Brillouin-zone average is governed by the band-resolved Berry-phase polarization difference between the optically connected initial and final states. Here we exploit this geometric relation in quantized formal polarization (QFP) crystals, where symmetry-quantized formal-polarization branches correspond to fractional Wannier-center sectors. First-principles screening identifies noncentrosymmetric QFP materials with giant SHG responses, including $\mathrm{InNbBr}_6$ and $\mathrm{InPS}_3$. Band-resolved Berry-phase analysis shows that their dominant optical transitions connect occupied and low-lying unoccupied states whose Wannier centers lie at distinct fractional Wyckoff positions, producing a large transition-resolved Wannier-center displacement. This displacement gives rise to a large shift vector and a dominant shift-vector-related intraband contribution to the static SHG susceptibility. Our results show that symmetry-quantized formal polarization can become optically active through transitions between fractional Wannier-center sectors, providing a symmetry-guided route to giant SHG and shift-current responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合型文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“First-principles screening”（第一性原理筛选）、“Band-resolved Berry-phase analysis”（能带分辨的贝里相位分析）等计算与理论分析方法。；研究对象：具有量子化形式极化（QFP）的非中心对称晶体材料，具体包括 $\mathrm{InNbBr}_6$ 和 $\mathrm{InPS}_3$。研究的核心物理现象是这些材料中的巨大二次谐波产生（SHG）响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在量子化形式极化（QFP）晶体中，光学跃迁发生在占据态和低能未占据态之间，这两个态的Wannier中心位于不同的分数Wyckoff位置，导致巨大的跃迁分辨Wannier中心位移。该位移产生大的位移矢量，进而驱动了巨大的静态SHG响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在量子化形式极化（QFP）晶体中，光学跃迁发生在占据态和低能未占据态之间，这两个态的Wannier中心位于不同的分数Wyckoff位置，导致巨大的跃迁分辨Wannier中心位移。该位移产生大的位移矢量，进而驱动了巨大的静态SHG响应。；创新点：揭示了量子化形式极化（QFP）晶体中，对称性量子化的形式极化分支（对应分数Wannier中心扇区）之间的光学跃迁可以产生巨大的SHG响应。这为寻找具有巨大SHG和位移电流响应的材料提供了一条基于对称性指导的路径。摘要未突出说明与具体实验结果的对比。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用第一性原理计算（First-principles screening）进行高通量材料筛选，并结合能带分辨的贝里相位分析（Band-resolved Berry-phase analysis）来解析光学跃迁的几何起源。具体分析了跃迁分辨的Wannier中心位移（transition-resolved Wannier-center displacement）与位移矢量（shift vector）的关系。

papers.title: Machine learning enables roughness-driven inverse design of milling processes
papers.abstract: Interest in applying data-driven approaches in manufacturing has grown significantly, particularly for mapping complex, high-dimensional relationships. The milling process is one area where predictive models can link influential parameters to surface roughness metrics prior to in situ operations. While this approach offers clear advantages, it faces challenges due to limited datasets and robustness issues in inverse design paradigms. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a machine learning (ML)-based framework for the inverse design of the surface milling process, with a focus on surface roughness as the design objective. The framework employs forward training of two ML models, a deep neural network (DNN) and a random forest (RF) ensemble, both developed using a high-fidelity synthetic dataset generated from a computational simulation framework. These trained models are integrated into a Bayesian optimization (BO) procedure to overcome the multiplicity problem arising from the many-to-one mapping inherent in the dataset. The approach identifies top-performing milling process configurations, considering both process and tool parameters, and presents them from the full solution space. The models achieve average relative errors below 5% when compared to reference results, thereby demonstrating the robustness and reliability of the proposed methodology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：machine learning (ML)-based framework, computational simulation framework, Bayesian optimization (BO)。；研究对象：表面铣削加工过程（milling process），具体关注加工参数与表面粗糙度（surface roughness）之间的映射关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于机器学习的逆向设计框架，能够从全解空间中高效筛选出最优的铣削工艺配置，且预测结果与参考值的平均相对误差低于5%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于机器学习的逆向设计框架，能够从全解空间中高效筛选出最优的铣削工艺配置，且预测结果与参考值的平均相对误差低于5%。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用计算模拟生成高保真合成数据集，分别训练深度神经网络（DNN）和随机森林（RF）集成模型作为正向预测器，并将其集成到贝叶斯优化（BO）流程中，以解决数据集固有的多对一映射带来的多重解问题。

papers.title: Contacts to Low-Dimensional Semiconductors: Physical Theory and Analytical Model
papers.abstract: Metal contacts to low-dimensional semiconductors are critical for nanoelectronics, yet a general physical description has remained elusive. We present an analytical model for metal-induced gap states (MIGS), revealing a universal scaling law governed by semiconductor dimensionality. Linking MIGS to transport observables, we provide a unified formulation of Schottky barrier height, transfer length, and contact resistance. Our model explains recent experiments on carbon nanotubes and 2D materials, clarifying the fundamental criteria for achieving scalable, low-resistance contacts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“analytical model”（解析模型）、“physical theory”（物理理论）、“universal scaling law”（普适标度律）。；研究对象：低维半导体（如碳纳米管、二维材料）与金属接触的物理现象，具体包括金属诱导的能隙态（MIGS）、肖特基势垒高度、传输长度和接触电阻。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了金属诱导能隙态（MIGS）受半导体维度控制的普适标度律，并建立了从MIGS到输运可观测量的统一解析模型，从而阐明了实现可缩放、低电阻接触的基本判据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了金属诱导能隙态（MIGS）受半导体维度控制的普适标度律，并建立了从MIGS到输运可观测量的统一解析模型，从而阐明了实现可缩放、低电阻接触的基本判据。；创新点：提出了一个普适的、基于半导体维度的MIGS标度律，并首次将MIGS与接触电阻等输运特性在统一解析框架下关联，解释了碳纳米管和二维材料的最新实验。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析模型（analytical model）推导金属-低维半导体接触的物理理论，将MIGS与输运可观测量（肖特基势垒高度、传输长度、接触电阻）进行统一公式化。

papers.title: Asymmetric binary Bose mixtures: a Functional Renormalisation Group study
papers.abstract: Zero-temperature binary Bose mixtures with mass and intraspecies couplings imbalances are studied using the functional renormalisation group (FRG) framework. We find that this dual asymmetry induces a spontaneous redistribution of quantum fluctuations between the components. This effect leads to a significant divergence in the quasiparticle residues of the two species, a phenomenon not captured in mean-field treatments. Critically, our FRG analysis predicts a systematic reduction of the density-channel sound velocity with increasing asymmetry -- a result that qualitatively contradicts the behaviour predicted by standard Bogoliubov theory. The ratio of the renormalisation factors is proposed as a robust quantitative probe of many-body correlations and fluctuation transfer. These findings provide a consistent non-perturbative framework for interpreting future experiments on heterogeneous mixtures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：functional renormalisation group (FRG) framework、non-perturbative framework。；研究对象：零温下具有质量不对称和种内耦合不对称的二元玻色混合物（asymmetric binary Bose mixtures）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 质量和种内耦合的双重不对称性会诱导量子涨落在两种组分间自发重新分布，导致两种组分的准粒子权重显著发散，且密度通道声速随不对称性增加而系统性降低，这与平均场理论及标准Bogoliubov理论的预言定性相反。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：质量和种内耦合的双重不对称性会诱导量子涨落在两种组分间自发重新分布，导致两种组分的准粒子权重显著发散，且密度通道声速随不对称性增加而系统性降低，这与平均场理论及标准Bogoliubov理论的预言定性相反。；创新点：揭示了平均场理论无法捕捉的量子涨落重新分布效应，并提出了重整化因子之比作为多体关联和涨落转移的稳健定量探针，为解释未来异质混合物的实验提供了自洽的非微扰框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用泛函重整化群（Functional Renormalisation Group, FRG）框架进行非微扰理论分析。

papers.title: Universality in the target arrival statistics of non-conservative search processes
papers.abstract: Stochastic search processes in which searchers are continuously introduced to and removed from a target search domain are fundamental to a wide class of physical and artificial systems. The theory of such non-conservative search processes is, however, much less developed than for search processes with a fixed number of particles. Here we exploit a natural mapping between non-conservative stochastic search and queueing theory to derive the full time-dependent distribution of target arrivals under minimal assumptions on the underlying search process. Remarkably, we find that the steady-state inter-arrival time distribution is exactly exponential, regardless of the details of the search process, showing a robust universality that emerges directly from the queueing framework. Thus, counterintuitively, the arrival statistics of a non-conservative search process are much simpler than sequential search-and-capture processes involving a fixed number of searchers. This has major implications for target resource accumulation, where the delivery of resources is counter-balanced by their downstream consumption.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“derive the full time-dependent distribution”（推导完整时间依赖分布）、“queueing theory”（排队论）等理论框架，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：非保守搜索过程（non-conservative search processes）中目标到达的统计规律。具体指搜索者不断被引入和移除的随机搜索系统，例如物理或人工系统中粒子持续进出目标区域的场景。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非保守搜索过程中，稳态下目标到达的时间间隔分布严格呈指数形式，与底层搜索过程的细节无关，展现出强普适性。这一结果比固定搜索者数量的顺序搜索-捕获过程更简单。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非保守搜索过程中，稳态下目标到达的时间间隔分布严格呈指数形式，与底层搜索过程的细节无关，展现出强普适性。这一结果比固定搜索者数量的顺序搜索-捕获过程更简单。；创新点：揭示了非保守搜索过程到达统计的普适指数行为，与传统的固定粒子数搜索过程形成鲜明对比，并指出该结果对目标资源积累（如资源输送与下游消耗的平衡）有重要影响。
papers.method_zh: 利用非保守随机搜索与排队论（queueing theory）之间的自然映射，在最小假设下推导出目标到达的完整时间依赖分布。

papers.title: The limits of interpretability in multiple linear regression
papers.abstract: Interpreting machine-learning models has attracted increasing attention, particularly in the physical sciences, where one often seeks to understand the underlying mechanisms rather than merely make predictions. Multiple linear regression is often regarded as an interpretable alternative to more complex models, such as deep neural networks, because its predictions are expressed as explicit weighted sums of input features. However, when input features are strongly correlated, namely in the presence of multicollinearity, the learned weights can exhibit large dataset-to-dataset fluctuations and oscillatory behavior across physically similar features, making their interpretation difficult or even impossible. Although the instability of the weights under multicollinearity is well known in statistics, its consequences for physical interpretation, in particular its connection to oscillatory weights across physically similar features, have not been systematically clarified. Here, we theoretically discuss the mechanism behind this loss of interpretability by analyzing the eigenmodes of the feature correlation matrix. We show that small-eigenvalue modes associated with multicollinearity amplify fluctuations in the weights and generate oscillatory patterns that do not necessarily reflect meaningful contributions. We test this theoretical picture numerically on physics datasets and show that Ridge regularization suppresses these unstable modes, although the resulting weights must still be interpreted with caution. We further confirm the generality of our findings beyond physics by analyzing a diverse collection of publicly available datasets. Our results clarify why, in the presence of multicollinearity, physical interpretation can remain difficult even for linear regression models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值实验）。判断依据：理论分析特征相关矩阵本征模、数值测试物理数据集和公开数据集。；研究对象：多重线性回归模型在特征高度相关（多重共线性）条件下的可解释性问题，特别关注物理科学中特征权重振荡现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多重共线性导致的小本征值模式会放大权重波动并产生振荡模式，使得即使在线性回归模型中，物理解释仍然困难；Ridge正则化虽能抑制不稳定模式，但所得权重仍需谨慎解读。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多重共线性导致的小本征值模式会放大权重波动并产生振荡模式，使得即使在线性回归模型中，物理解释仍然困难；Ridge正则化虽能抑制不稳定模式，但所得权重仍需谨慎解读。；创新点：系统阐明了多重共线性下权重振荡模式与物理解释失效之间的理论联系，并验证了该现象在物理及非物理数据集中的普遍性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析特征相关矩阵的本征模，结合物理数据集和公开数据集的数值测试。

papers.title: Confined Oxygen-Vacancy Migration Drives Ferroelectric Switching
papers.abstract: Conventional ferroelectricity arises from intrinsic lattice distortions, whereas oxygen vacancies are generally regarded as detrimental because their migration induces leakage currents and polarization degradation. However, the recently discovered ultrathin van der Waals ferroelectric Bi2SeO5 exhibits robust out-of-plane polarization switching despite its pristine crystal symmetry forbidding the corresponding displacive ferroelectric instability. Here we show that this apparent contradiction originates from confined oxygen-vacancy migration. We find that oxygen vacancies preferentially form within SeO3 units and undergo reversible low-barrier rearrangements between nearly degenerate configurations. These localized vacancy dynamics generate a large switchable out-of-plane polarization, while long-range vacancy diffusion is suppressed by substantially higher migration barriers. At a representative vacancy concentration of 2.5%, the resulting polarization reaches approximately 16 uC cm^-2, consistent with experiment. Our results identify confined oxygen-vacancy migration as the microscopic origin of ferroelectric switching in Bi2SeO5 and establish defect-enabled ferroelectricity as a general mechanism for layered van der Waals oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：DFT计算、迁移势垒、构型分析）；研究对象：超薄范德瓦尔斯铁电体Bi₂SeO₅中的氧空位迁移与铁电翻转机制
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现Bi₂SeO₅中铁电翻转的微观起源并非传统晶格畸变，而是由受限的氧空位迁移驱动：氧空位在SeO₃单元内形成并发生可逆的低势垒重排，产生可翻转的净极化，而长程扩散被高势垒抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现Bi₂SeO₅中铁电翻转的微观起源并非传统晶格畸变，而是由受限的氧空位迁移驱动：氧空位在SeO₃单元内形成并发生可逆的低势垒重排，产生可翻转的净极化，而长程扩散被高势垒抑制。；创新点：首次提出“缺陷驱动铁电性”机制，将氧空位从传统认为的“有害缺陷”转变为铁电翻转的主动驱动力，为层状范德瓦尔斯氧化物中的铁电性提供了普适性解释。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算，分析氧空位形成能、迁移势垒、构型简并度及极化贡献。

papers.title: Adiabatic preparation of a fractional quantum Hall fluid by coherently pumping atoms from a Bose-Einstein condensate
papers.abstract: We propose a protocol to adiabatically prepare a many-particle fractional quantum Hall fluid of bosonic ultracold atoms exploiting a time-dependent coherent coupling of a strongly interacting atomic state with a large dilute Bose-Einstein condensate. Starting from an empty cloud, atoms with well-defined angular momentum are coherently pumped into the fluid by Raman beams with a Laguerre-Gauss profile. Compared to number-conserving schemes which rely on finite-size-induced topological gaps, we identify an adiabatic path in the Fock space which avoids crossing topological phase transitions and thus maintains a sizable adiabatic gap open at all times. The efficiency of our preparation protocol is numerically assessed for typical experimental parameters up to particle numbers that largely exceed the experimental state-of-the-art. The crucial advantage of including an anharmonic confinement is finally highlighted.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：propose a protocol, numerically assessed, adiabatic path in Fock space）；研究对象：超冷玻色原子体系中的分数量子霍尔流体（fractional quantum Hall fluid of bosonic ultracold atoms）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种通过时间依赖的相干耦合从玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中绝热制备多粒子分数量子霍尔流体的方案，该方案在Fock空间中避免了拓扑相变，从而始终保持可观的绝热能隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种通过时间依赖的相干耦合从玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中绝热制备多粒子分数量子霍尔流体的方案，该方案在Fock空间中避免了拓扑相变，从而始终保持可观的绝热能隙。；创新点：与依赖有限尺寸诱导拓扑能隙的粒子数守恒方案不同，本方案在Fock空间中识别出一条避免穿越拓扑相变的绝热路径，从而在整个过程中保持绝热能隙开放；此外，特别强调了包含非简谐囚禁势的关键优势。
papers.method_zh: 理论方案设计：利用具有拉盖尔-高斯轮廓的拉曼光束将具有确定角动量的原子相干泵浦到强相互作用原子态中；数值评估：针对典型实验参数，对远超当前实验水平的多粒子数进行绝热制备效率的数值模拟。

papers.title: Wavelet Localisation and Local Modulation Freezing in MRW Unwrapping
papers.abstract: We develop a localised wavelet formulation of multifractal random walk unwrapping based on the local multiplicative modulation freezing. The framework is motivated by the observation that finite-support wavelet localisation may induce approximate local factorisation of multiplicatively modulated stochastic fields, allowing the modulation component to become effectively frozen within sufficiently localised probing domains. Within this regime, logarithmic wavelet amplitudes admit an approximate additive decomposition linking local wavelet statistics directly to the underlying modulation field. This viewpoint reformulates covariance-based MRW unwrapping as a localised multiscale operator problem in which wavelet coefficients act as finite-support probes of multiplicative organisation. The validity of the approximation depends explicitly on support geometry, scale-dependent overlap, and residual multiscale mixing generated by internal modulation variability. We show that these effects naturally produce finite-scale deviations from ideal logarithmic covariance scaling and lead to structured covariance distortions whose form depends on the interaction between the modulation field and the geometry of the wavelet representation. In the resulting framework, localisation itself becomes the operational mechanism enabling multiscale probing of local stochastic organisation. Numerical investigations using orthonormal wavelet decompositions support the proposed interpretation and demonstrate the emergence of scale-dependent freezing regimes, residual covariance mixing, and finite-support breakdown effects consistent with the theory. The proposed framework suggests a broader connection between wavelet localisation, local regularity organisation, and finite-support multiscale stochastic operators. Wavelet localisation becomes an operational mechanism for probing localised multiscale structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：wavelet formulation、theoretical framework、numerical investigations）；研究对象：多重分形随机游走（MRW）的展开问题，具体涉及小波局域化与局域调制冻结效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限支撑小波局域化可诱导乘性调制随机场的近似局域分解，使调制分量在足够局域的探测域内“冻结”，从而将基于协方差的MRW展开重构为局域化多尺度算子问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限支撑小波局域化可诱导乘性调制随机场的近似局域分解，使调制分量在足够局域的探测域内“冻结”，从而将基于协方差的MRW展开重构为局域化多尺度算子问题。；创新点：提出小波局域化本身作为探测局域随机组织结构的操作机制，揭示了有限支撑几何、尺度依赖重叠及内部调制变异性导致的有限尺度偏差与协方差畸变结构。
papers.method_zh: 基于小波变换的理论框架，采用局域乘性调制冻结近似，结合正交小波分解进行数值验证。

papers.title: Quantum Information Geometry of Multicomponent Superconducting Fluctuation Transport
papers.abstract: Quantum geometry underlies many electronic responses, but its transport signatures have so far been established mainly for pure single-particle Bloch states. Whether collective many-body fluctuations possess a measurable quantum geometry remains largely unexplored. Here we show that superconducting fluctuation transport provides a direct probe of quantum information geometry in collective many-body matter. Starting from a multicomponent time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau theory in the Gaussian fluctuation regime, we identify the equilibrium density matrix of fluctuating Cooper pairs as the static pair propagator, which defines a positive mixed-state manifold in momentum space. The geometry of this manifold is directly measurable through paraconductivity: the longitudinal paraconductivity is governed by the quantum Fisher information of superconducting fluctuation modes, while the fluctuational anomalous Hall effect is governed by the mean Uhlmann curvature, the mixed-state counterpart of Berry curvature. This correspondence further yields geometric bounds between these two transport components, with no direct analogue in normal electronic transport. Applied to chiral superconducting fluctuations in quarter-metal systems motivated by rhombohedral multilayer graphene, a symmetry-allowed Lifshitz invariant generates finite mean Uhlmann curvature and logarithmically enhances the anomalous Hall conductivity above the critical temperature. Our results establish collective superconducting fluctuations as an experimentally accessible transport probe of mixed-state quantum information geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Starting from a multicomponent time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau theory”、“identify the equilibrium density matrix”、“establish geometric bounds”等理论推导和模型构建关键词。；研究对象：多组分超导体的涨落输运现象，特别是超导涨落中的量子信息几何（量子Fisher信息与平均Uhlmann曲率）与输运响应（纵向电导率与反常霍尔效应）之间的对应关系。具体应用体系为菱方多层石墨烯启发的四分之一金属中的手性超导涨落。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超导涨落输运可直接探测集体多体物质中的混合态量子信息几何：纵向涨落电导率由超导涨落模的量子Fisher信息决定，而涨落反常霍尔效应由平均Uhlmann曲率（Berry曲率的混合态对应物）决定，两者之间存在几何约束关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超导涨落输运可直接探测集体多体物质中的混合态量子信息几何：纵向涨落电导率由超导涨落模的量子Fisher信息决定，而涨落反常霍尔效应由平均Uhlmann曲率（Berry曲率的混合态对应物）决定，两者之间存在几何约束关系。；创新点：首次将量子信息几何（量子Fisher信息与平均Uhlmann曲率）与集体多体涨落（超导涨落）的输运响应直接关联，并推导出纵向与霍尔输运之间的几何界限，这在正常电子输运中无直接类比。
papers.method_zh: 采用多组分含时金兹堡-朗道理论（Gaussian涨落区），将平衡态密度矩阵识别为静态对传播子，从而在动量空间定义正定混合态流形；通过计算涨落电导率（paraconductivity）和反常霍尔电导率，建立输运系数与量子信息几何量之间的解析对应。

papers.title: Probing Interfacial Magnetic Anisotropy in \texorpdfstring{CoV$_{2}$O$_{4}$}{CoV2O4} using Spin Hall Magnetoresistance
papers.abstract: Spin Hall magnetoresistance (SMR) has emerged as a powerful probe for investigating interfacial spin transport and magnetic anisotropy in complex oxide heterostructures. In this work, we investigate the interfacial magnetic anisotropy in Pt/CVO through angle-dependent magnetotransport measurements. Unlike the bulk-sensitive magnetic measurements on both strained CVO and Pt/CVO films, which exhibit a ferrimagnetic transition at $T_{C} \approx 150$ K accompanied by out-of-plane anisotropy that reorients toward in-plane anisotropy below 90 K, SMR reveals a distinct interfacial magnetic anisotropy. The rotational scans of the in-plane transverse SMR at 20 K exhibit substantial hysteresis about [100], while no hysteresis is observed along [110] and [1$\bar{1}$0], indicating a biaxial anisotropy with easy axes along [110] and [1$\bar{1}$0]. Furthermore, the absence of sharp discontinuities in both the in-plane longitudinal and transverse SMR, together with pronounced discontinuities near the in-plane [010] direction during out-of-plane rotation, strongly indicates the presence of in-plane anisotropy. This behavior persists up to 120 K. The discrepancy between the bulk-sensitive magnetic measurements and the SMR response suggests that the Pt/CVO interface retains a magnetic anisotropy distinct from the bulk, highlighting the interfacial sensitivity of SMR. Additionally, the spin mixing conductance is found to be of the order of $10^{14}$ $Ω^{-1}\mathrm{m}^{-2}$, comparable to other oxide-based spintronic systems. These findings highlight the crucial role of interfacial effects in spin transport and establish Pt/CVO as a promising platform for spintronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：angle-dependent magnetotransport measurements、rotational scans、SMR响应测量。；研究对象：Pt/CoV₂O₄（Pt/CVO）异质结中的界面磁各向异性，以及自旋霍尔磁电阻（SMR）在该体系中的表现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SMR测量揭示Pt/CVO界面在20 K下具有沿[110]和[1\(\bar{1}\)0]方向的双轴易磁化轴，与体磁测量显示的从面外到面内的各向异性重取向行为截然不同，表明界面磁各向异性与体相存在显著差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SMR测量揭示Pt/CVO界面在20 K下具有沿[110]和[1\(\bar{1}\)0]方向的双轴易磁化轴，与体磁测量显示的从面外到面内的各向异性重取向行为截然不同，表明界面磁各向异性与体相存在显著差异。；创新点：利用SMR的界面敏感性，首次揭示了Pt/CVO异质结中界面磁各向异性与体相磁各向异性之间的显著差异，并定量提取了自旋混合电导（约10¹⁴ Ω⁻¹m⁻²），为理解氧化物自旋电子学中的界面效应提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 角度依赖的磁输运测量（包括面内横向SMR旋转扫描、面内纵向SMR及面外旋转测量），并结合体敏感的磁性测量（对应变CVO和Pt/CVO薄膜）进行对比分析。

papers.title: Surface-Sensitive Mapping of Anisotropic Phonon Cascades in T$_{d}$-WTe$_{2}$
papers.abstract: Understanding how energy flows from photoexcited carriers into the lattice is essential for describing nonequilibrium phenomena in low-symmetry quantum materials. Here, we use ultrafast low-energy electron diffraction and diffuse scattering to probe momentum-resolved phonon dynamics at the surface of T$_{d}$-WTe$_{2}$, a strongly anisotropic semimetal. Following optical excitation, the Debye-Waller suppression of Bragg peaks reveals a biexponential increase of the mean-squared atomic displacement, indicating sequential lattice relaxation. Analysis of the diffuse background reveals a preferential intensity build-up parallel to the tungsten-chain axis in the material, attributed to anisotropic electron-phonon coupling during electronic cooling. Diffuse intensity subsequently redistributes across the surface Brillouin zone and finally accumulates near the zone centre, consistent with anharmonic phonon-phonon scattering and the gradual population of low-frequency acoustic modes on a 30--100 ps timescale. The results reveal a hierarchical relaxation pathway in which energy is first deposited into selected finite-momentum phonons before spreading through the broader lattice bath. Our work highlights the importance of momentum-resolved diffuse scattering for disentangling electron-phonon and phonon-phonon relaxation in anisotropic topological semimetals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：ultrafast low-energy electron diffraction and diffuse scattering（超快低能电子衍射与漫散射）、probe、analysis。；研究对象：T$_{d}$-WTe$_{2}$（一种强各向异性半金属）的表面，具体研究光激发后声子级联动力学（phonon cascades）的动量分辨演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光激发后能量首先沉积到特定有限动量的声子模式（沿钨链方向），随后通过非谐声子-声子散射在30–100皮秒时间尺度上逐渐向低频声学模和整个晶格热浴扩散，揭示了各向异性半金属中分层次的晶格弛豫路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光激发后能量首先沉积到特定有限动量的声子模式（沿钨链方向），随后通过非谐声子-声子散射在30–100皮秒时间尺度上逐渐向低频声学模和整个晶格热浴扩散，揭示了各向异性半金属中分层次的晶格弛豫路径。；创新点：首次利用动量分辨的漫散射技术，在表面敏感尺度上直接区分了各向异性电子-声子耦合导致的有限动量声子优先激发与后续非谐声子-声子散射导致的能量重新分布过程，揭示了拓扑半金属中分层次的晶格弛豫途径。
papers.method_zh: 超快低能电子衍射（ultrafast low-energy electron diffraction, ULEED）结合漫散射（diffuse scattering）技术，用于动量分辨地探测表面声子动力学；通过Debye-Waller效应对布拉格峰强度的衰减分析提取均方位移的双指数增长行为，并通过漫散射背景的强度分布追踪声子在各向异性布里渊区中的演化。

papers.title: Intrinsic linewidths of confined phonons in few-layer hBN
papers.abstract: Understanding lattice vibrations in two-dimensional (2D) materials is essential for controlling thermal transport, mechanical response, and energy dissipation in nanoscale devices. However, the intrinsic lifetimes of low-energy phonon modes, particularly those that are optically silent, remain largely unexplored. Here we use helium-3 spin-echo spectroscopy to resolve low-energy phonons at the surface of hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) and measure their intrinsic linewidths. We observe the flexural and Rayleigh wave modes and extract the bending rigidity of a quasi-freestanding hBN monolayer. We further report the simultaneous observation of multiple surface-confined interlayer shear modes whose energies agree closely with linear-chain model predictions. By resolving their intrinsic linewidths, we demonstrate a strong confinement-induced reduction in phonon lifetimes, with a near order of magnitude increase in linewidth between the four- and two-layer modes. The temperature dependence of the linewidths indicates that phonon-phonon scattering dominates between 160-360K, while the systematic broadening with decreasing layer number reveals the impact of confinement on phonon decay. These results reveal how reduced dimensionality affects the decay of interlayer shearing modes in hBN, providing direct insight into the phonon lifetimes, confinement effects, and dissipation pathways that govern the dynamical behaviour of two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：helium-3 spin-echo spectroscopy（氦-3自旋回波谱学）、测量（measure）、观察（observe）。；研究对象：少层六方氮化硼（few-layer hBN）中受限声子的本征线宽，特别是低能声子模式（包括弯曲波、瑞利波和层间剪切模）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过测量少层hBN中受限声子的本征线宽，发现层数减少会导致声子寿命显著降低（四层模式与两层模式之间线宽增加近一个数量级），揭示了维度降低对层间剪切模衰变的影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过测量少层hBN中受限声子的本征线宽，发现层数减少会导致声子寿命显著降低（四层模式与两层模式之间线宽增加近一个数量级），揭示了维度降低对层间剪切模衰变的影响。；创新点：首次通过实验直接测量了少层hBN中光学非活性低能声子模式的本征线宽，并定量揭示了声子寿命随层数减少而显著缩短的受限效应，以及160-360K温度范围内声子-声子散射的主导作用。
papers.method_zh: 氦-3自旋回波谱学（³He spin-echo spectroscopy），用于分辨hBN表面的低能声子并测量其本征线宽；结合线性链模型（linear-chain model）预测层间剪切模的能量。

papers.title: Machine Learning Topological Order from Defect Partition Functions
papers.abstract: We introduce a machine learning framework for extracting Ising topological order from defect partition functions of the two-dimensional Ising model on a torus. Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs) are trained on Ising model data sampled at criticality across topological sectors. We take a component-wise square-root map of the learned distributions which naturally produces candidate wavefunctions for the (2+1)-dimensional Ising TQFT. As a nontrivial consistency check, we extract the modular S-matrix from overlaps of the resulting states and recover the expected Ising modular data. Our results demonstrate that neural network representations can capture both critical fluctuations and emergent topological structure, providing a data-driven route from lattice statistical mechanics to topological quantum field theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据关键词：machine learning framework、Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs)、extract、candidate wavefunctions、data-driven route。；研究对象：二维环面上伊辛模型的拓扑序，具体为伊辛拓扑量子场论（Ising TQFT）及其与统计力学临界涨落的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过训练受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）学习伊辛模型在临界点不同拓扑扇区的配分函数，并对其分布进行分量平方根映射，可自然得到（2+1）维伊辛拓扑量子场论的候选波函数；进一步从这些波函数的重叠中提取出模S矩阵，验证了其与伊辛模数据的预期一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过训练受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）学习伊辛模型在临界点不同拓扑扇区的配分函数，并对其分布进行分量平方根映射，可自然得到（2+1）维伊辛拓扑量子场论的候选波函数；进一步从这些波函数的重叠中提取出模S矩阵，验证了其与伊辛模数据的预期一致。；创新点：提出了一种数据驱动的方法，直接从晶格统计力学模型（伊辛模型）的配分函数出发，利用机器学习自动提取拓扑序和拓扑量子场论的结构，无需预先假设拓扑场论形式。
papers.method_zh: 使用受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）对二维伊辛模型在环面上临界点的数据进行训练，学习不同拓扑扇区的分布；然后对学习到的分布进行分量平方根映射，构造候选波函数；最后通过计算波函数重叠提取模S矩阵。

papers.title: Spin-dependent electron transfer through a ring-wire coupled junction: Role of in-plane electric field
papers.abstract: We study spin-dependent transport in a hybrid magnetic system, where a non-magnetic (NM) wire is coupled to a side-attached antiferromagnetic (AFM) mesoscopic ring, placed between two non-magnetic electrodes subject to an in-plane electric field oriented perpendicular to the NM wire.
