The system is described within a tight-binding (TB) framework, and transport properties are computed using the non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) formalism. We consider two junction configurations distinguished by the wire-ring coupling: a single-coupled junction and a double-coupled junction. In the single-coupled configuration, the coupling geometry alone breaks the spin symmetry, yielding a finite spin polarization (SP) even without any external field. The in-plane electric field further enhances the symmetry breaking in both configurations, serving as an efficient tuning parameter that drives the SP nearly $100\%$ in the low-bias region. In the double-coupled configuration, spin symmetry is preserved in the absence of the external field, and the electric field acts as a sole source of symmetry breaking, producing a large SP. Finite temperature effects and different system sizes are examined, confirming the robustness of the observed features. To validate the findings over a wide parameter space, we considered different sets of parameters and found that the key signatures remain unchanged. Our results demonstrate that such hybrid structures are promising candidates for realizing an externally controllable spintronic device in low-dimensional systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“tight-binding (TB) framework”和“non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) formalism”，属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：论文研究一种混合磁体系中的自旋相关电子输运现象，具体体系为：一个非磁性（NM）导线与一个侧向耦合的反铁磁（AFM）介观环构成的结，置于两个非磁性电极之间，并施加垂直于NM导线的面内电场。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单耦合结中，仅靠耦合几何结构即可打破自旋对称性，产生有限的自旋极化（SP）；面内电场可进一步增强对称性破缺，在低偏压区使SP接近100%。在双耦合结中，电场是唯一的对称性破缺源，也能产生大的自旋极化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单耦合结中，仅靠耦合几何结构即可打破自旋对称性，产生有限的自旋极化（SP）；面内电场可进一步增强对称性破缺，在低偏压区使SP接近100%。在双耦合结中，电场是唯一的对称性破缺源，也能产生大的自旋极化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用紧束缚（TB）模型描述体系，并使用非平衡格林函数（NEGF）方法计算输运性质。考虑了两种结构型（单耦合与双耦合），并考察了有限温度效应和不同系统尺寸。

papers.title: Stabilizing Itinerant Electrons in a Corner-Sharing Kagomé Oxide Nd4Os3ZnO14
papers.abstract: Kagome oxides provide a fertile platform for exploring exotic electronic states arising from geometrical frustration and characteristic band topology. Here, we report the synthesis of a 5d transition-metal kagome oxide, Nd4Os3ZnO14, obtained via high-temperature, high-pressure hydrothermal synthesis. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction reveals a two-dimensional kagome network formed by corner-sharing OsO6 octahedra, with a nominal osmium valence of +4.67. In-plane resistivity and hard X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy measurements indicate that the semimetallic electronic structure at room temperature evolves into a semiconducting ground state upon cooling, accompanied by a pronounced enhancement of hole mobility. Magnetic susceptibility measurements demonstrate localized Nd3+ moments without long-range magnetic order down to 2 K. The coexistence of a metallic kagome plane, strong spin-orbit coupling inherent to 5d electrons, and rare-earth magnetism establishes Nd4Os3ZnO14 as a promising platform for investigating correlated electron phenomena in kagome oxides within the itinerant regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“synthesis”、“Single-crystal X-ray diffraction”、“In-plane resistivity”、“hard X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy”、“Magnetic susceptibility measurements”。；研究对象：一种5d过渡金属角共享Kagomé氧化物Nd4Os3ZnO14，具体研究其晶体结构、电子输运性质、磁性质及强自旋-轨道耦合与稀土磁性的共存现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料在室温下呈现半金属电子结构，冷却后转变为半导体基态，同时伴随空穴迁移率的显著增强；Nd3+局域磁矩在2 K以上未出现长程磁有序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料在室温下呈现半金属电子结构，冷却后转变为半导体基态，同时伴随空穴迁移率的显著增强；Nd3+局域磁矩在2 K以上未出现长程磁有序。；创新点：首次合成并表征了具有角共享OsO6八面体构成的二维Kagomé网络的5d过渡金属氧化物，实现了金属性Kagomé平面、5d电子强自旋-轨道耦合与稀土磁性的共存，为研究巡游电子态下的Kagomé氧化物关联电子现象提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 高温高压水热合成法；单晶X射线衍射确定晶体结构；面内电阻率测量和硬X射线光电子能谱表征电子结构；磁化率测量研究磁性质。

papers.title: Self-Consistent Closure of Fractal Dimension, Nonextensive Statistics, and Non-Markovian Dynamics in Critical Systems
papers.abstract: Self-organized critical systems often exhibit three macroscopic features simultaneously: nonextensive thermodynamics (quantified by the Tsallis index $q$), structural fractality (measured by the Hausdorff dimension $D$), and non-Markovian dynamics (characterized by the memory exponent $α$). Historically, these parameters have been treated as independent, to be empirically fitted case by case. Here we demonstrate that phase-space self-consistency imposes a unique algebraic closure: $α=D/(2D-1)$. This relation, together with $q=1+1/D$ derived from the extensivity of Tsallis entropy on fractal supports, yields the known result $α=1/(3-q)$ as a consequence, not as an independent assumption. The closure contains no free parameters and satisfies the physical boundary conditions $α(1)=1$ (ballistic transport in Euclidean spaces) and $α\to1/2$ as $D\to\infty$ (maximally subdiffusive regime). We validate the Troika relation across eight independent experimental systems, including seismicity, electromagnetic precursors, EEG, urban networks, botanical architectures, and space plasma. All measured values fall within error bars of the theoretical prediction, establishing the universality of the closure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验验证）。判断依据：推导代数闭包关系、理论边界条件分析，并引用八个独立实验系统的数据验证。；研究对象：自组织临界系统中同时出现的三个宏观特征：非广延热力学（Tsallis指数 q）、结构分形（Hausdorff维数 D）和非马尔可夫动力学（记忆指数 α）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 相空间自洽性要求三个参数满足唯一代数闭包关系 α = D/(2D-1)，结合分形支撑上Tsallis熵广延性导出的 q = 1 + 1/D，可推出 α = 1/(3-q)，该关系无自由参数，并在八个独立实验系统中得到验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：相空间自洽性要求三个参数满足唯一代数闭包关系 α = D/(2D-1)，结合分形支撑上Tsallis熵广延性导出的 q = 1 + 1/D，可推出 α = 1/(3-q)，该关系无自由参数，并在八个独立实验系统中得到验证。；创新点：首次证明自组织临界系统中三个宏观参数（D、q、α）并非独立，而是由相空间自洽性唯一确定，无需经验拟合。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于相空间自洽性建立分形维数、非广延统计与非马尔可夫动力学之间的代数闭包；实验验证：引用地震活动、电磁前兆、脑电图、城市网络、植物结构、空间等离子体等八个独立系统的实测数据。

papers.title: Ground States and Excitations of Magnetic Impurities in Pseudogap Superconducting Systems
papers.abstract: Combining effective field theory and numerical renormalization-group (NRG), we study the ground-state phase diagram and single-particle excitations of a spin-$\tfrac{1}{2}$ impurity in a superconducting system with a tunneling density of states behaving as $ρ(ε) \sim |ε|^{r}$, for $|ε|\gg Δ$ ($Δ$ being the $s$-wave pairing potential). We focus on the properties of the doublet-singlet transition at large Kondo coupling. The effective field theory for the singlet phase is inferred from a strong coupling expansion in the Kondo coupling. For $Δ\neq 0$, it contains a local pairing term which drives the system into a spin-singlet phase with enhanced paring correlations. We study how the singet-doublet phase boundary is affected by particle-hole symmetry breaking perturbations such as a scattering potential and/or the chemical potential. Results for the $T$-matrix spectral function are also reported near the transition both at particle-hole symmetry and away from it. It is shown that the singlet-doublet transition can be induced by the chemical potential rather than the Kondo coupling strength. At particle-hole symmetry, a resonance-like feature is observed for $r= 1$ and related to a two-quasiparticle excitation using a single-site model which is derived from effective field theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：effective field theory（有效场理论）、numerical renormalization-group (NRG)（数值重整化群）。；研究对象：赝能隙超导系统中的自旋-1/2磁性杂质，具体研究其基态相图与单粒子激发，重点关注隧道态密度在能量远大于超导能隙时呈幂律行为（ρ(ε) ~ |ε|^r）的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强Kondo耦合下，杂质系统存在双态-单态相变；单态相中存在局域配对项，可增强配对关联；该相变不仅可由Kondo耦合强度驱动，也可由化学势诱导。在粒子-空穴对称点且r=1时，观察到类似共振的特征，该特征与有效场论导出的单格点模型中的双准粒子激发有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强Kondo耦合下，杂质系统存在双态-单态相变；单态相中存在局域配对项，可增强配对关联；该相变不仅可由Kondo耦合强度驱动，也可由化学势诱导。在粒子-空穴对称点且r=1时，观察到类似共振的特征，该特征与有效场论导出的单格点模型中的双准粒子激发有关。；创新点：系统研究了粒子-空穴对称性破缺（如散射势和化学势）对单态-双态相边界的影响；发现化学势可独立于Kondo耦合强度诱导相变；在粒子-空穴对称点且r=1时，将共振特征与双准粒子激发建立联系。
papers.method_zh: 结合有效场理论（从强耦合展开推导单态相的有效理论）与数值重整化群（NRG）方法，计算了基态相图、单粒子激发谱以及T-矩阵谱函数。

papers.title: Mapping the Stability of Spin Qubits in Superconducting Pseudogap Systems
papers.abstract: Superconducting spin qubits, realized as Yu-Shiba-Rusinov spin-doublet states in quantum-dot-superconductor systems, represent a cornerstone of current research in quantum technologies. We analyze these ground states of quantum impurities in superconducting pseudogap systems, namely systems with a pseudogap tunneling density of states $ρ(ε) \sim |ε|^r$ for energies $|ε|\gg Δ$ ($Δ$ being a $s$-wave pairing potential). For $r=1$, these hosts are realized as Dirac materials (graphene or 3D topological insulator surfaces) in proximity to conventional superconductors, or as $d+i s$ superconductors. Using effective field theory and numerical renormalization group, we map the phase diagram against the pseudogap exponent $r > 0$ and particle-hole symmetry-breaking perturbations. At particle-hole symmetry, increasing $r$ also increases the critical value, $J_c$, of the Kondo coupling that triggers the transition from spin doublet to singlet. Unlike the gapless pseudogap Kondo systems, numerical and analytical evidence suggest that Andreev reflection stabilizes a singlet ground state at $J$ for all $r > 0$. Breaking particle-hole symmetry -- by potential scattering or chemical potential -- eventually restores the transition at lower $J_c$. Our results indicate that coupling to superconducting hosts with large pseudogap exponents enhances the stability of spin qubits at large Kondo coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：effective field theory, numerical renormalization group（有效场论、数值重整化群）。；研究对象：超导赝能隙系统中的自旋量子比特，具体为量子点-超导体系统中由Yu-Shiba-Rusinov自旋二重态实现的超导自旋量子比特，以及赝能隙隧穿态密度ρ(ε) ~ |ε|^r（r>0）的量子杂质基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在粒子-空穴对称点，增大赝能隙指数r会提高触发自旋二重态到单重态转变的Kondo耦合临界值J_c；与无隙赝能隙Kondo系统不同，Andreev反射在所有r>0下都能稳定单重态基态，而打破粒子-空穴对称性会恢复较低J_c下的转变。这表明耦合到大赝能隙指数的超导宿主能增强自旋量子比特在大Kondo耦合下的稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在粒子-空穴对称点，增大赝能隙指数r会提高触发自旋二重态到单重态转变的Kondo耦合临界值J_c；与无隙赝能隙Kondo系统不同，Andreev反射在所有r>0下都能稳定单重态基态，而打破粒子-空穴对称性会恢复较低J_c下的转变。这表明耦合到大赝能隙指数的超导宿主能增强自旋量子比特在大Kondo耦合下的稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用有效场论（effective field theory）和数值重整化群（numerical renormalization group）方法，分析赝能隙指数r>0及粒子-空穴对称性破缺微扰下的相图。

papers.title: Coupled-cluster study of dynamic Jahn-Teller effect in a $5d^2$ W antifluorite
papers.abstract: In correlated insulators, the interplay among coexisting charge, spin, orbital, and lattice degrees of freedom gives rise to rich quantum phenomena, while unraveling the interplay is not straightforward. In the family of cubic $5d^2$ double perovskites, the ground spin-orbit coupled electronic states of $5d$ metal sites are degenerate and couple to the Jahn-Teller active vibrations, whereas no experimental evidence of the symmetry-lowering in the low-temperature ordered phases has been reported. To quantitatively unravel the nature of $5d^2$ centers, we apply equation-of-motion coupled cluster (EOM-CC) theory to analyze the vibronic and magnetic properties of $5d^2$ W sites of Cs$_2$WCl$_6$. We derive the electronic and vibronic model Hamiltonians, calculate the W $L_3$ edge resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS) spectra, and determine the effective magnetic moment. The simulated RIXS spectra show that vibronic coupling makes several peaks asymmetric. The effective magnetic moments exhibit a temperature dependence similar to that observed experimentally, confirming the validity of the calculated distribution of low-energy levels. Our calculations indicate that the Jahn-Teller effect in Cs$_2$WCl$_6$ is in a weak regime, and noticeable deformation would not occur, whereas the dynamic Jahn-Teller effect modulates the shapes of the RIXS spectra and affects the magnetic moment. This work demonstrates the usefulness of the EOM-CC method for predicting physical phenomena on metal sites in correlated insulating materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“equation-of-motion coupled cluster (EOM-CC) theory”、“derive the electronic and vibronic model Hamiltonians”、“calculate the RIXS spectra”。；研究对象：Cs₂WCl₆中5d² W位点的动态Jahn-Teller效应及其对振动耦合、磁性和光谱性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cs₂WCl₆中的Jahn-Teller效应处于弱耦合区域，不会导致显著的晶格畸变，但动态Jahn-Teller效应会调制RIXS谱峰形状并影响有效磁矩的温度依赖性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cs₂WCl₆中的Jahn-Teller效应处于弱耦合区域，不会导致显著的晶格畸变，但动态Jahn-Teller效应会调制RIXS谱峰形状并影响有效磁矩的温度依赖性。；创新点：首次将EOM-CC方法应用于定量分析5d²金属中心的振动耦合与磁性，并成功模拟了RIXS谱的非对称特征和磁矩的温度依赖性，验证了该方法在关联绝缘体材料中预测物理现象的实用性。
papers.method_zh: 采用运动方程耦合簇（EOM-CC）理论，推导电子和振动耦合模型哈密顿量，计算W L₃边共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）谱和有效磁矩。

papers.title: Van der waals engineering of valley polarization in WSe2 via kagome V2O3 monolayer heterostructure through magnetic proximity effect
papers.abstract: To achieve a robust valley splitting in transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) at zero magnetic field is a challenging and elusive goal for valleytronic and spintronic devices. Therefore, in the current study, using the first principles calculations, we introduce an oxide-driven valleytronic platform by employing a two-dimensional ferromagnetic oxide (V2O3) as a magnetic proximity partner for WSe2. We found that the intrinsic ferromagnetism of V2O3 induces a prominent and spontaneous valley splitting of ~ 10.41 meV in WSe2. This pronounced valley polarization mainly originates from the strong interfacial exchange coupling interaction and charge redistribution mediated by V 3d electrons, coupled with the intrinsic spin-orbit coupling of WSe2. Interestingly, this value is significantly greater than the previously reported value for CrI3/WSe2, which corresponds to an effective magnetic field of ~ 10 T. Besides, we also have a high Curie temperature of 500 K, and an out-of-plane magnetic anisotropy energy (MAE) of 0.31 meV, indicating that this oxide-based heterostructure can also be used for near-room temperature operation. Importantly, under the external electric field with a step of 0.1 eV/Å, the ferromagnetism is preserved and an enhancement in Curie temperature and MAE makes this oxide-based heterostructure more valuable for the next generation valleytronic devices. Therefore, these findings establish a new paradigm for realizing tunable, robust, and magnetic field-free valleytronic and spintronic devices for this oxide-based heterostructure. Moreover, this concept can be generalized to other correlated oxide-based TMD systems, providing a versatile strategy for next-generation quantum and functional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first principles calculations（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：WSe₂单层与kagome V₂O₃单层构成的范德华异质结，研究其通过磁邻近效应实现的谷极化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零磁场下，V₂O₃的固有铁磁性通过界面交换耦合和电荷重分布，在WSe₂中诱导出约10.41 meV的自发谷劈裂，该值显著大于此前报道的CrI₃/WSe₂体系，等效于约10 T的有效磁场。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零磁场下，V₂O₃的固有铁磁性通过界面交换耦合和电荷重分布，在WSe₂中诱导出约10.41 meV的自发谷劈裂，该值显著大于此前报道的CrI₃/WSe₂体系，等效于约10 T的有效磁场。；创新点：首次提出利用二维铁磁性氧化物（V₂O₃）作为磁邻近衬底，在过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）中实现无需外磁场的强谷极化，且该氧化物基异质结构具有高居里温度和电场可调性，为下一代谷电子学器件提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first principles calculations），具体包括：密度泛函理论（DFT）计算界面交换耦合、电荷重分布、自旋轨道耦合效应，以及计算居里温度（~500 K）和面外磁各向异性能（0.31 meV），并模拟外加电场（步长0.1 eV/Å）对铁磁性和谷极化的调控。

papers.title: Carbon Layer Orientation and Closed-Pore Construction Achieving Ultra-Low Specific Surface Area Hard Carbon for High-Performance Na-ion Storage
papers.abstract: Addressing the critical trade-off between initial Coulombic efficiency (ICE) and reversible capacity in hard carbon anodes for Na-ion batteries (NIBs), we introduce a novel coupling strategy that combines carbon layer orientation reconstruction with closed-pore construction to produce hard carbon with an ultra-low specific surface area. We demonstrate that the nanographite domains within the hard carbon precursor undergo entropy-driven orientation reconstruction through the synergistic regulation of heteroatom doping and medium-temperature carbonization. This process not only increases interlayer spacing and promotes structural disorder but also enables the formation of dense, closed pores and ultramicropores at domain boundaries via confined atomic migration, while simultaneously encapsulating surface open pores within internal closed ones. Due to this unique pore architecture, our hard carbon exhibits an ultra-low specific surface area of 1.89 m2 g-1 with a markedly higher proportion of closed pores. As a result, our hard carbon achieves a remarkable reversible capacity of 342.3 mAh g-1 at 20 mA g-1, with an exceptional ICE of 90.4% and a dominant plateau capacity of 262.3 mAh g-1 (76.6%) for NIBs. We believe this coupling strategy provides a new paradigm for the structural engineering of high-ICE anode materials in advanced NIBs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了材料的制备过程（“medium-temperature carbonization”）、结构表征（“specific surface area”、“closed pores”）和电化学性能测试（“reversible capacity”、“ICE”）。；研究对象：用于钠离子电池（NIBs）的硬碳负极材料。具体研究了通过碳层取向重构和闭孔构建协同策略制备的超低比表面积硬碳。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过杂原子掺杂与中温碳化的协同调控，实现了硬碳前驱体中纳米石墨畴的熵驱动取向重构，从而构建了致密的闭孔和超微孔结构，显著降低了比表面积。该硬碳负极在20 mA g⁻¹电流密度下实现了342.3 mAh g⁻¹的可逆容量和90.4%的首次库仑效率（ICE），其中平台容量占比高达76.6%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过杂原子掺杂与中温碳化的协同调控，实现了硬碳前驱体中纳米石墨畴的熵驱动取向重构，从而构建了致密的闭孔和超微孔结构，显著降低了比表面积。该硬碳负极在20 mA g⁻¹电流密度下实现了342.3 mAh g⁻¹的可逆容量和90.4%的首次库仑效率（ICE），其中平台容量占比高达76.6%。；创新点：提出了一种“碳层取向重构”与“闭孔构建”的耦合策略，通过熵驱动的原子迁移，将表面开孔封装于内部闭孔中，从而同时实现超低比表面积（1.89 m² g⁻¹）和高闭孔比例，有效解决了硬碳负极中首次库仑效率与可逆容量之间的权衡问题。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：杂原子掺杂与中温碳化协同调控（具体掺杂元素和碳化温度摘要未明确说明）；结构表征：比表面积测试（SSA）、孔结构分析（闭孔/开孔比例）；电化学测试：恒流充放电测试（20 mA g⁻¹）。

papers.title: Dimensional Crossover of Mass Anisotropy in Ta-doped WTe2
papers.abstract: The observation of extremely large magnetoresistance in WTe2 has attracted considerable attention towards understanding its underlying origin. With its layered van der Waals structure, the question that remains largely unexplored is whether the three-dimensional anisotropic transport characteristics of WTe2 persists under chemical substitution. Here, we present a systematic angle-dependent magneto-transport study of single-crystalline TaxW1-xTe2 (x = 0, 0.05, 0.1). The results are analysed within a mass anisotropy scaling framework to extract the mass anisotropy parameter γ as a function of temperature and doping. It is observed that Ta substitution leads to monotonic increase of γ across all temperatures, indicating a progressive deepening of quasi-two-dimensional Fermi surface character. Ta doping also leads to a substantial improvement in crystalline quality, reflected in a pronounced increase in the residual resistivity ratio. Despite weakening electron-hole compensation, the magnetoresistance rises sharply to ~58,211% at x = 0.1, which is assigned to a substantial enhancement in carrier mobility. Rietveld refinement confirms a systematic c-axis contraction with Ta content, identifying the structural origin of the enhanced anisotropy. The mass anisotropy scaling that holds for x = 0 and x = 0.05 breaks down for x = 0.1, where the angular magneto-resistance anisotropy substantially exceeds single-ellipsoid predictions, pointing to a multi-pocket Fermi surface with distinct anisotropies. Nonlinear Hall resistivity provides independent evidence for the underlying multiband character of transport in this system. These findings demonstrate that Fermi surface anisotropy, carrier compensation, and mobility are independent parameters that can lead to tuneable control of large magnetoresistance in topological semimetal WTe2.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“present a systematic angle-dependent magneto-transport study”（系统性的角度依赖磁输运研究）、“Rietveld refinement”（Rietveld精修）等具体实验手段。；研究对象：Ta掺杂的WTe₂单晶（化学式TaxW1-xTe₂，x = 0, 0.05, 0.1）。研究其准二维费米面特性、质量各向异性、以及超大磁电阻效应的起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ta掺杂导致WTe₂的质量各向异性参数γ单调增加，费米面准二维特征加深；尽管电子-空穴补偿减弱，但由于载流子迁移率大幅提升，磁电阻在x=0.1时仍急剧增大至约58,211%。此外，x=0.1时角度磁电阻各向异性超出单椭球模型预测，表明存在多口袋费米面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ta掺杂导致WTe₂的质量各向异性参数γ单调增加，费米面准二维特征加深；尽管电子-空穴补偿减弱，但由于载流子迁移率大幅提升，磁电阻在x=0.1时仍急剧增大至约58,211%。此外，x=0.1时角度磁电阻各向异性超出单椭球模型预测，表明存在多口袋费米面。；创新点：系统揭示了化学掺杂（Ta替代W）对WTe₂三维各向异性输运特性的影响，发现质量各向异性标度在x=0.1时失效，并指出费米面各向异性、载流子补偿和迁移率是独立可调参数，共同控制超大磁电阻效应。
papers.method_zh: 角度依赖的磁输运测量（angle-dependent magneto-transport）；质量各向异性标度框架（mass anisotropy scaling framework）分析；Rietveld精修确定晶体结构变化；非线性霍尔电阻测量。

papers.title: Unveiling AlSb as a Promising Zincblende Semiconductor for Visible-Light Shift-Current Generation
papers.abstract: We use density functional theory to investigate the shift-current response in zincblende III--V (AlP, AlAs, AlSb, GaP, GaAs, InP, InAs, and InSb) and II--VI (ZnS, ZnSe, ZnTe, CdS, CdSe, and CdTe) semiconductors. Our main goal is to identify which material generates the largest shift-current under illumination and to examine the factors influencing this response. We find that aluminum-containing semiconductors, particularly AlSb, exhibit the highest shift-current responses, while CdSe shows the lowest. We analyze the contributions of specific band-to-band transitions to the shift-current in AlSb by selectively summing valence and conduction bands. Additionally, we calculate delocalization indices to investigate the electron delocalization, which correlates with the shift current. Hydrostatic pressure does not enhance the shift current in these materials. These findings have potential applications in optoelectronics and identify the most promising zincblende semiconductors for efficient shift-current generation under visible-light illumination
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory（密度泛函理论）、investigate（研究）、calculate（计算）。；研究对象：锌闪锌矿结构的III-V族（AlP、AlAs、AlSb、GaP、GaAs、InP、InAs、InSb）和II-VI族（ZnS、ZnSe、ZnTe、CdS、CdSe、CdTe）半导体材料，重点研究其在可见光照射下的位移电流（shift-current）响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 含铝的半导体（尤其是AlSb）在可见光照射下表现出最高的位移电流响应，而CdSe的响应最低；静水压不能增强这些材料的位移电流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：含铝的半导体（尤其是AlSb）在可见光照射下表现出最高的位移电流响应，而CdSe的响应最低；静水压不能增强这些材料的位移电流。；创新点：系统比较了多种锌闪锌矿半导体在可见光下的位移电流性能，首次明确指出AlSb是最有前景的候选材料，并揭示了电子离域与位移电流的相关性。摘要未突出说明与以往理论工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）进行计算，通过选择性求和价带和导带分析特定带间跃迁对位移电流的贡献，并计算离域指数（delocalization indices）来研究电子离域与位移电流的关联。

papers.title: Dressed Floquet scars from protected zero modes in a Rydberg chain
papers.abstract: In this Letter, we present an approximate analytic construction of two zero quasienergy quantum many-body scars in a periodically driven model of Rydberg atoms on a ring, which persist over a range of driving amplitudes and frequencies for finite sizes. An index theorem protects an exponentially large number (in system size) of exact zero energy modes of the Floquet Hamiltonian in this setting. Unlike most of these zero modes which continuously change with drive parameters, these two quantum many-body scars retain the memory of particular states. They can be expressed as {\it dressed versions} of two contrasting states, the Rydberg vacuum and a unitarily rotated variant of a volume-law scar [Ivanov and Motrunich, Phys. Rev. Lett. {\bf 134}, 050403 (2025)], respectively. We provide an analytic understanding of their existence using a Floquet perturbation theory and show their resilience beyond the perturbative regime using exact diagonalization in finite systems. Our study provides insight into the structure of protected zero modes in interacting Floquet settings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“analytic construction”、“index theorem”、“Floquet perturbation theory”、“exact diagonalization”等理论分析和数值计算关键词，未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：一个由里德伯原子（Rydberg atoms）构成的环状（ring）周期性驱动（periodically driven）量子多体系统。具体研究该系统中受保护的零准能量量子多体疤痕态（quantum many-body scars）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在周期性驱动的里德伯原子环中，存在两个近似解析构造的零准能量量子多体疤痕态。这两个疤痕态在有限尺寸下，对一定范围内的驱动振幅和频率保持稳定，并且它们分别对应于里德伯真空态和一种体积律疤痕态的“ dressed version ”（ dressed 版本）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在周期性驱动的里德伯原子环中，存在两个近似解析构造的零准能量量子多体疤痕态。这两个疤痕态在有限尺寸下，对一定范围内的驱动振幅和频率保持稳定，并且它们分别对应于里德伯真空态和一种体积律疤痕态的“ dressed version ”（ dressed 版本）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：在周期性驱动的相互作用系统中，首次近似解析构造了受保护的零准能量疤痕态，并揭示了它们与特定零能量模式（如里德伯真空态和体积律疤痕态）之间的“ dressed ”关系，为理解相互作用Floquet系统中的受保护零模结构提供了新见解。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用解析与数值相结合的方法：

papers.title: Topological Tricritical Ising Universality Class in One Dimension
papers.abstract: Recent advances have revealed that quantum critical universality can be enriched by nontrivial topology. Here we study the tricritical point of the one-dimensional cluster O Brien-Fendley model and show that it realizes a topologically nontrivial tricritical Ising ($\text{TCI}^*$) universality class. The transition shares the local bulk conformal data of ordinary TCI criticality, while realizing a distinct symmetry-enriched topological sector, manifested through a protected twofold degeneracy under open boundary conditions. We further show that TCI criticality admits two spontaneously fixed boundary conditions, realized respectively through symmetry enrichment and boundary renormalization-group flow, which are distinguished by the $\mathbb{Z}_2^T$ charge of the disorder field. Remarkably, we find that the topological twofold degeneracy at the $\text{TCI}^*$ critical point exhibits an exponential energy splitting, in stark contrast to the algebraic splitting at the $\text{Ising}^*$ critical point. These results reveal a symmetry-enriched form of TCI criticality and uncover topologically distinct boundary structures beyond those of the ordinary TCI theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：研究、揭示、实现、分析（无实验或计算手段描述）。；研究对象：一维cluster O’Brien-Fendley模型的三临界点，以及该点所实现的拓扑非平凡三临界伊辛（TCI*）普适类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该三临界点具有与普通三临界伊辛（TCI）临界性相同的局域体共形数据，但实现了不同的对称性富集拓扑扇区，表现为开边界条件下的受保护二重简并；该拓扑二重简并的能量分裂呈指数形式，与Ising*临界点的代数分裂形成鲜明对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该三临界点具有与普通三临界伊辛（TCI）临界性相同的局域体共形数据，但实现了不同的对称性富集拓扑扇区，表现为开边界条件下的受保护二重简并；该拓扑二重简并的能量分裂呈指数形式，与Ising*临界点的代数分裂形成鲜明对比。；创新点：揭示了一种对称性富集的三临界伊辛临界性，并发现了超越普通TCI理论的拓扑上不同的边界结构。摘要未突出说明与已有TCI*或Ising*工作的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体包括共形场论、对称性富集拓扑扇区分析、边界重整化群流分析。

papers.title: End-Functionalized Ions Promote Stability of Highly Frustrated Phases in Diblock Copolymers
papers.abstract: Block copolymers self-assemble into ordered nanostructures whose geometry is governed by a competition between interfacial energy and chain conformational entropy. While this competition produces a rich sequence of morphologies, topologically complex ``frustrated'' phases such as the primitive cubic ($Im\bar{3}m$) network incur severe packing penalties and are difficult to access in neutral systems. Here we show that ions functionalized at the termini of one block in an AB diblock copolymer melt introduce a qualitatively new stabilization mechanism. Strong ion correlations drive chain-end association and generate a curvature preference toward the charged domain; the resulting tendency of end-localized ion clusters to adopt compact, curved geometries selectively favors the highly frustrated $Im\bar{3}m$ single-network over the classical phases, in a region of parameter space lying below the order-disorder transition of the neutral system. Free energy decomposition reveals that the electrostatic energy, arising almost entirely from beyond-mean-field ion correlations, becomes increasingly negative with increasing interfacial curvature. In the primitive cubic network, pronounced local segregation of ions into the cylindrical struts generates compact curved clusters whose correlation energy gain more than offsets the enhanced packing frustration, so the very geometry that is the source of packing frustration in neutral systems becomes the source of its stability here. Increasing ion size weakens correlations and suppresses the $Im\bar{3}m$ phase, consistent with experimental observations. Our results establish curvature-selective end-group association as a general principle for accessing frustrated topologies in block copolymer systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“Free energy decomposition reveals”、“beyond-mean-field ion correlations”等理论计算与分析手段，未提及具体实验操作。；研究对象：AB型双嵌段共聚物熔体，特别是其中由末端功能化离子诱导形成的拓扑复杂“受挫相”（如立方相 \(Im\bar{3}m\) 单网络结构）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在AB双嵌段共聚物中，将离子功能化于其中一嵌段的末端，可以通过强离子关联驱动链端聚集，产生朝向带电域的曲率偏好，从而选择性地稳定高度受挫的 \(Im\bar{3}m\) 单网络相。该相在无离子体系中通常难以获得。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在AB双嵌段共聚物中，将离子功能化于其中一嵌段的末端，可以通过强离子关联驱动链端聚集，产生朝向带电域的曲率偏好，从而选择性地稳定高度受挫的 \(Im\bar{3}m\) 单网络相。该相在无离子体系中通常难以获得。；创新点：提出了“曲率选择性的端基缔合”作为稳定嵌段共聚物中受挫拓扑结构的一般性原理。揭示了在高度弯曲的界面（如 \(Im\bar{3}m\) 相的圆柱状支柱）中，离子局域聚集带来的关联能增益可以抵消甚至超过链堆积受挫的代价，从而将原本导致受挫的几何结构转变为稳定性的来源。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与自由能分解。具体包括：考虑超越平均场（beyond-mean-field）的离子关联效应，计算静电能量贡献；分析不同相（如经典相与 \(Im\bar{3}m\) 相）中离子的局域分布与曲率关系；通过改变离子尺寸等参数进行相稳定性分析。

papers.title: Entropic Necks, Dynamic Crossovers, and Fragility in Supercooled Liquids
papers.abstract: The dramatic slowdown of dynamics in supercooled liquids is accompanied by a sequence of dynamical crossovers, most notably the transition from high-temperature collision-dominated transport to low-temperature activated structural relaxation. A particularly striking manifestation of this change is the crossover from Rosenfeld excess-entropy scaling to the Adam--Gibbs relation. In this work we develop a theoretical framework based on a configuration-space extension of Zwanzig's entropic-neck picture and combine it with a Mori--Zwanzig memory-function formalism to address anomalies of supercooled liquids. The central idea is that structural relaxation is controlled by the narrowing of configurational pathways connecting metastable basins of the inherent-structure landscape. Starting from coupled slow variables describing intrabasin motion and neck fluctuations, we derive a reduced generalized Langevin description in which elimination of the neck coordinate generates a long-lived memory kernel and naturally leads to entropy-controlled activated dynamics. At high temperatures the neck is broad and readily accessible, yielding Rosenfeld-type transport governed primarily by local structural entropy. Upon cooling, progressive neck constriction produces an increasing entropy deficit, leading to Adam--Gibbs behavior and activated relaxation. Within this picture, fragility acquires a simple geometric interpretation: fragile liquids are characterized by a rapid collapse of the effective configurational neck with decreasing temperature, whereas strong liquids exhibit a much slower evolution of accessible pathways. The framework does not by itself compute the configurational entropy, mismatch penalty, or cooperative length from microscopic interactions; its aim is to provide a dynamical and geometrical interpretation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical framework、configuration-space extension、Mori–Zwanzig memory-function formalism、derived a reduced generalized Langevin description。；研究对象：过冷液体（supercooled liquids）中的动力学减速现象，特别是从高温碰撞主导输运到低温活化结构弛豫的动力学交叉，以及脆性（fragility）的几何解释。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 过冷液体的结构弛豫受限于构型空间中连接亚稳态盆地的“熵颈”（entropic neck）的收缩；高温下颈宽大，输运由局部结构熵主导（Rosenfeld标度），低温下颈收缩导致熵亏，产生Adam–Gibbs行为和活化弛豫；脆性对应有效构型颈随温度降低而快速塌缩，强液体则颈演化缓慢。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：过冷液体的结构弛豫受限于构型空间中连接亚稳态盆地的“熵颈”（entropic neck）的收缩；高温下颈宽大，输运由局部结构熵主导（Rosenfeld标度），低温下颈收缩导致熵亏，产生Adam–Gibbs行为和活化弛豫；脆性对应有效构型颈随温度降低而快速塌缩，强液体则颈演化缓慢。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有理论（如Adam–Gibbs、Rosenfeld标度）的具体对比，但核心新意在于将脆性赋予简单的几何解释——即构型颈随温度收缩的速率，并提供了一个动力学与几何统一的框架，而非仅依赖构型熵或协同长度的微观计算。
papers.method_zh: 基于Zwanzig熵颈图像的构型空间扩展，结合Mori–Zwanzig记忆函数形式论，从描述盆内运动和颈涨落的耦合慢变量出发，推导出约化的广义朗之万描述，其中消除颈坐标后产生长寿命记忆核，自然导出熵控制的活化动力学。

papers.title: Switching Chern number by sliding and gating in alternately twisted tetralayer MoTe2
papers.abstract: Switching the bulk Chern number in topological materials is of central importance for the design of topological electronic devices. Motivated by recent observations of integer and fractional quantum anomalous Hall effects in twisted transition metal dichalcogenides (tTMDs), we realize the switching of valley Chern number through sliding and gating in alternately twisted tetralayer (ATT) MoTe$_{2}$. Using large-scale density functional theory (DFT) calculations, we show that the Chern number of the first $K$-valley moiré band evolves from $+1$ to $-1$ under the interlayer sliding. Furthermore, an applied electric field can switch the valley Chern number from $-1$ to $+1$. Based on the developed continuum model, we reveal that these switching behaviors are caused by the sliding- and gate-dependent intralayer moiré potential distributions across the layers. Our results establish ATT MoTe$_{2}$ as a promising platform for engineering moiré band topologies through the design of moiré potentials with sliding in multilayer moiré systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“large-scale density functional theory (DFT) calculations”、“continuum model”。；研究对象：交替扭转四层二碲化钼（alternately twisted tetralayer MoTe₂，简称 ATT MoTe₂）中的谷陈数（valley Chern number）切换现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过层间滑动和施加电场，可以实现 ATT MoTe₂ 中第一个 K 谷莫尔能带的谷陈数在 +1 与 -1 之间的切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过层间滑动和施加电场，可以实现 ATT MoTe₂ 中第一个 K 谷莫尔能带的谷陈数在 +1 与 -1 之间的切换。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用大规模密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，并结合所发展的连续模型（continuum model）进行分析。

papers.title: NIMO: A Software Platform for Closed-Loop Materials Exploration with Diverse AI Algorithms
papers.abstract: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs), where artificial intelligence proposes subsequent experiments and robotic systems execute them, are rapidly becoming the vanguard of materials discovery. A critical bottleneck, however, lies in seamlessly bridging diverse AI algorithms tailored for specific exploration goals with the heterogeneous robotic hardware found across different laboratories. Here, we present NIMO, an open-source software platform designed to dissolve this barrier through three core paradigms: a modular AI-robot decoupling mediated via simple CSV file exchange, a discrete candidate-pool architecture that seamlessly absorbs domain knowledge, and a unified Python interface pre-loaded with twelve distinct AI algorithms. In this Perspective, we review the operational principles of each algorithm alongside six diverse SDL implementations driven by NIMO, covering electrolyte discovery, organic synthesis, thin-film exploration, fuel-cell process informatics, coffee-ring phase exploration, and legacy liquid-handling automation. One of these also demonstrates NIMO's seamless interoperability with the IvoryOS orchestration framework. To democratize autonomous science, we also introduce a no-code desktop application that enables intuitive, human-in-the-loop exploration for non-programmers. NIMO is freely available at https://github.com/NIMS-DA/nimo, offering a versatile, plug-and-play foundation to accelerate autonomous materials exploration across diverse experimental landscapes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（软件平台开发+实验应用展示）。判断依据：论文描述了一个开源软件平台（NIMO），并回顾了其驱动的六种不同自驱动实验室（SDL）实现，涵盖实验探索（如电解质发现、有机合成、薄膜探索等），属于软件工具与实验应用的结合。；研究对象：论文研究的是自驱动实验室（SDL）中的材料探索流程，具体涉及电解质、有机合成、薄膜、燃料电池过程信息学、咖啡环相探索以及液体处理自动化等多样化的实验体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NIMO平台通过模块化AI-机器人解耦、离散候选池架构和统一Python接口，成功弥合了不同AI算法与异构机器人硬件之间的鸿沟，实现了闭环材料探索的通用化与易用性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NIMO平台通过模块化AI-机器人解耦、离散候选池架构和统一Python接口，成功弥合了不同AI算法与异构机器人硬件之间的鸿沟，实现了闭环材料探索的通用化与易用性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但可归纳为：首次提出通过简单CSV文件交换实现AI与机器人硬件的解耦，并预装多种AI算法，同时提供无代码界面，从而大幅降低自驱动实验室的部署门槛，促进自主材料探索的民主化。
papers.method_zh: 主要方法是软件平台开发，具体包括：基于CSV文件交换的模块化AI-机器人解耦、离散候选池架构（可吸收领域知识）、预装12种不同AI算法的统一Python接口，以及一个无代码桌面应用程序（支持非编程人员的人机交互探索）。实验部分涉及六种不同的SDL实现，其中一种展示了与IvoryOS编排框架的互操作性。

papers.title: Underscreening and related phenomena in strong electrolytes
papers.abstract: We propose a heuristic model of underscreening phenomenon in high density Coulomb systems, such as strong electrolytes and electron hole conglomerates under ultra high dose rate (UHDR) radiation in biological tissues. It explains the data on screening length $L$ increasing with charge particle concentration and offers additional insights in understanding the conductivity and reduction potential of concentrated electrolytes. Also, it validates our current understanding of the FLASH radiation treatment of tumors (FLASH-RT) perceived as an analogous system. The underlying physics is that mutual binding creates diffusion barriers which suppress the concentration of mobile particles thus increasing the screening length. Also, they slow down the rates of chemical reactions responsible for generation of biologically active radicals which explains the sparing effect observed under UHDR.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：提出启发式模型（heuristic model）、解释数据、提供见解（offers insights）、验证理解（validates understanding）。；研究对象：强电解质（strong electrolytes）以及超高剂量率（UHDR）辐射下生物组织中的电子-空穴聚集体（electron hole conglomerates）中的欠屏蔽（underscreening）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高密度库仑体系中，粒子间的相互结合会形成扩散势垒，抑制可移动粒子的浓度，从而导致屏蔽长度随带电粒子浓度增加而增大；同时，这一机制也减缓了生物活性自由基的生成速率，解释了超高剂量率辐射下的“保护效应”（sparing effect）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高密度库仑体系中，粒子间的相互结合会形成扩散势垒，抑制可移动粒子的浓度，从而导致屏蔽长度随带电粒子浓度增加而增大；同时，这一机制也减缓了生物活性自由基的生成速率，解释了超高剂量率辐射下的“保护效应”（sparing effect）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 提出启发式模型（heuristic model），基于扩散势垒和移动粒子浓度抑制的物理图像，分析屏蔽长度、电导率和还原电位等性质，并将FLASH放射治疗视为类比系统进行验证。

papers.title: Kinetic Criticality in Linker-Mediated Colloidal Aggregation
papers.abstract: Linker-mediated aggregation plays an important role in modern nanoscience. We demonstrate that it departs sharply from classical Smoluchowski kinetics because cluster reactivity evolves during growth. Combining theory with DNA-linked gold-nanoparticle experiments, we establish kinetic critical point controlled by linker abundance. Below threshold, active linkers are depleted and growth arrests; above threshold, clusters accumulate reactive sites, self-accelerate, and cross over to diffusion-limited coarsening. Experiments verify the predicted arrest, accelerated growth, and scaling collapse.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+实验）。依据：摘要中明确提到“Combining theory with DNA-linked gold-nanoparticle experiments”。；研究对象：连接子介导的胶体聚集过程，具体为DNA连接的金纳米颗粒体系中的聚集动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 连接子介导的胶体聚集存在动力学临界点，由连接子丰度控制：低于阈值时聚集停滞，高于阈值时聚集自加速并过渡到扩散限制粗化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：连接子介导的胶体聚集存在动力学临界点，由连接子丰度控制：低于阈值时聚集停滞，高于阈值时聚集自加速并过渡到扩散限制粗化。；创新点：揭示了连接子介导聚集与经典Smoluchowski动力学的显著偏离，即团簇反应性在生长过程中演化，并首次建立了由连接子丰度控制的动力学临界点。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模（结合经典Smoluchowski动力学修正）与DNA-金纳米颗粒实验相结合，通过实验验证了预测的聚集停滞、加速生长以及标度塌缩。

papers.title: Cluster-based Message-Passing (CluMP) Optimization for Complex QUBO Problems
papers.abstract: Quadratic Unconstrained Boolean Optimization (QUBO) problems are widespread in both industrial applications and scientific studies. A QUBO problem corresponds to the optimization of a system of Ising spins defined on a generally sparse and heterogeneous graph. When the QUBO problem contains conflicting requests, the corresponding Ising system is frustrated, generating a complex energy landscape, which is hard to explore and optimize. Despite extensive algorithmic and hardware developments, finding low-energy configurations in these systems remains challenging (e.g., local-update heuristics typically become trapped in metastable states), especially when the (possibly frustrated) interactions generate extended correlated domains. We introduce CluMP (Cluster-based Message-Passing), an algorithm that performs collective updates on connected clusters of spins using information from Belief Propagation (BP). By controlling the amount of frustration within clusters, CluMP enables BP convergence on large subgraphs and proposes nonlocal rearrangements involving up to hundreds of spins in a single move. We benchmark CluMP against state-of-the-art local-update heuristics on spin-glass models defined on several graph topologies, including random regular graphs and lattice regular graphs in two and three dimensions. Cluster moves consistently bypass local trapping and reach lower energies with fewer effective operations than single-spin dynamics. These results demonstrate that frustration-tolerant cluster updates can be implemented efficiently on sparse graphs. The CluMP framework provides a scalable strategy for large-scale combinatorial optimization and inference problems, where exploiting medium- and long-range correlations is key to navigating complex energy landscapes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/算法文章。判断依据：关键词“algorithm”、“benchmark”、“spin-glass models”、“Belief Propagation”。；研究对象：论文研究的是二次无约束布尔优化（QUBO）问题，对应一般稀疏且异质图上的伊辛自旋系统，特别是存在阻挫（frustration）的复杂能量景观中的低能构型搜索问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于簇的消息传递算法（CluMP），通过控制簇内阻挫程度，使置信传播（BP）在大子图上收敛，并实现单次移动中涉及数百个自旋的非局域更新，在多种自旋玻璃模型上比单自旋动力学更有效地达到更低能量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于簇的消息传递算法（CluMP），通过控制簇内阻挫程度，使置信传播（BP）在大子图上收敛，并实现单次移动中涉及数百个自旋的非局域更新，在多种自旋玻璃模型上比单自旋动力学更有效地达到更低能量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 具体算法框架为：基于簇的消息传递（CluMP），利用置信传播（Belief Propagation）的信息对自旋的连通簇进行集体更新。基准测试在随机正则图和二维、三维晶格正则图上的自旋玻璃模型上进行，与最先进的局域更新启发式算法对比。

papers.title: Cobalt-Catalysed Chain Transfer Polymerisation Enables Soft Methacrylate Nematic Elastomers for Switchable Pressure-Sensitive Adhesion
papers.abstract: Liquid crystal elastomers (LCEs) exhibit unique viscoelastic behavior arising from reversible liquid-crystalline ordering, making them attractive candidates for switchable pressure-sensitive adhesives (PSAs). However, methacrylate-based LCEs are typically highly crosslinked, leading to elevated glass-transition temperatures ($T_g$) and storage moduli ($E'$) that limit adhesive performance. Here, we demonstrate that catalytic chain-transfer polymerization provides an effective strategy for engineering soft methacrylate nematic elastomers through systematic control of network architecture. Incorporation of parts-per-million concentrations of bis(boron difluorodimethylglyoximate)cobalt(II) (CoBF) during photopolymerization reduced the effective crosslink density and increased the molecular weight between crosslinks, producing substantial decreases in $T_g$ and $E'$ while preserving nematic order. Dynamic mechanical analysis revealed that increasing CoBF concentration enhanced viscoelastic dissipation and broadened the accessible nematic temperature window. To further optimize rheological properties for pressure-sensitive adhesion, monofunctional methacrylates and flexible poly(ethylene glycol) dimethacrylate (PEGDMA) were incorporated into the network. The optimized formulation exhibited a $T_g$ near 0~$^\circ$C, a room-temperature storage modulus of approximately 0.3 MPa, and high damping behavior, approaching the Dahlquist criterion for pressure-sensitive adhesion. As a result, the resulting nematic elastomers displayed strong tack, peel, and lap-shear adhesion in the nematic state, together with rapid, reversible, and residue-free debonding upon heating above the nematic-to-isotropic transition temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrate、photopolymerization、Dynamic mechanical analysis、optimized formulation。；研究对象：软性甲基丙烯酸酯型向列液晶弹性体（LCE），用于可切换压敏胶（PSA）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过催化链转移聚合引入百万分之一浓度的钴催化剂（CoBF），可有效降低交联密度、提高交联间分子量，从而显著降低玻璃化转变温度（Tg）和储能模量（E'），同时保持向列有序性，最终获得在向列态具有强粘附力、在加热至清亮点以上时可快速可逆无残留脱粘的压敏胶。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过催化链转移聚合引入百万分之一浓度的钴催化剂（CoBF），可有效降低交联密度、提高交联间分子量，从而显著降低玻璃化转变温度（Tg）和储能模量（E'），同时保持向列有序性，最终获得在向列态具有强粘附力、在加热至清亮点以上时可快速可逆无残留脱粘的压敏胶。；创新点：首次将催化链转移聚合策略应用于甲基丙烯酸酯基液晶弹性体，通过精确控制网络结构实现软性化，从而满足压敏胶的Dahlquist判据，并实现热可切换的粘附/脱粘行为。
papers.method_zh: 催化链转移聚合（使用CoBF催化剂）、光聚合、动态力学分析（DMA）、粘附性能测试（包括初粘力、剥离强度、搭接剪切强度）。

papers.title: Topological Surface Charge Detection via Terahertz Time-domain Spectroscopy
papers.abstract: The topological magnetoelectric effect (TME) in three-dimensional topological insulators manifests as a quantized surface charge accumulation proportional to an applied magnetic field. Here we demonstrate an optical method using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) to detect surface charge accumulation in a chromium-doped (Bi,Sb)$_2$Te$_3$ thin film under oblique incidence, achieving sub-milliradian Faraday rotation precision. Unlike transport probes that require ultralow longitudinal conductivity, this optical technique is robust against finite $σ_L$, degrading by less than $0.3\%$ even when $σ_L \sim σ_T$. We extract the charge accumulation $η/B_z$ from the measured Faraday rotation and show results at $45^\circ$ and $60^\circ$ coincide within experimental uncertainty. Extending this to axion insulators, we predict that the TME produces an imaginary Faraday rotation linear in frequency, whose slope directly reflects the single-surface charge density. With improved sample thickness and precision, this optical scheme provides a viable pathway toward direct verification of the TME and four-dimensional quantum Hall effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate、optical method、terahertz time-domain spectroscopy、measurement、extract、show results）；研究对象：三维拓扑绝缘体中的拓扑磁电效应（TME）导致的表面电荷积累，具体材料为铬掺杂的(Bi,Sb)₂Te₃薄膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS）在斜入射条件下实现了对拓扑绝缘体表面电荷积累的光学检测，该方法对有限纵向电导率具有鲁棒性；并预测在轴子绝缘体中，TME会产生与频率成线性关系的虚法拉第旋转，其斜率直接反映单表面电荷密度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS）在斜入射条件下实现了对拓扑绝缘体表面电荷积累的光学检测，该方法对有限纵向电导率具有鲁棒性；并预测在轴子绝缘体中，TME会产生与频率成线性关系的虚法拉第旋转，其斜率直接反映单表面电荷密度。；创新点：提出了一种光学方法替代传统的输运探测手段来检测拓扑磁电效应，该方法不受超低纵向电导率的限制，即使σ_L ~ σ_T时退化程度也低于0.3%，为直接验证TME和四维量子霍尔效应提供了可行路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS）技术，在斜入射条件下测量铬掺杂(Bi,Sb)₂Te₃薄膜的法拉第旋转，达到亚毫弧度精度；通过法拉第旋转提取电荷积累量η/B_z，并比较45°和60°入射角下的结果；对轴子绝缘体进行了理论预测。

papers.title: Generative modelling powered by room-temperature polariton condensates
papers.abstract: Generative modelling requires efficient stochastic nonlinear transformations and physical platforms that can naturally realise them. We experimentally demonstrate that nonlinear optical systems operating in the strong light-matter coupling regime can serve as physical transformation layers for conditional generative modelling. Specifically, we develop a workflow in which room-temperature exciton-polariton condensates formed in organic dye microcavities act as a physical stochastic transform within a generative adversarial network and enable conditional digit-to-image translation. By using the nonlinear many-body dynamics and intrinsic stochasticity of polariton condensates, the workflow outperforms baseline approaches based on digitally injected perturbations. We find that polariton-enabled sampling via generative adversarial network (Polariton GAN) yields improved inception score, digit preservation accuracy and structural similarity compared with both digital sampling and laser-based systems. We further show that spatially correlated output variations can naturally regularise adversarial training and enhance output diversity. Our results establish polariton condensation as a new computational resource for generative modelling, opening a pathway towards physics-enhanced machine learning systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we experimentally demonstrate”、“we develop a workflow”以及实验测量结果（如inception score等）。；研究对象：室温激子-极化激元凝聚体（exciton-polariton condensates），具体形成于有机染料微腔（organic dye microcavities）中，用于生成式建模（generative modelling）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用室温极化激元凝聚体的非线性多体动力学和内在随机性，作为生成对抗网络（GAN）中的物理随机变换层，实现了条件数字到图像的翻译，并在inception score、数字保留准确度和结构相似性上优于数字采样和激光系统。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用室温极化激元凝聚体的非线性多体动力学和内在随机性，作为生成对抗网络（GAN）中的物理随机变换层，实现了条件数字到图像的翻译，并在inception score、数字保留准确度和结构相似性上优于数字采样和激光系统。；创新点：首次将极化激元凝聚体作为物理计算资源用于生成式建模，利用其固有的空间关联输出变化自然正则化对抗训练并增强输出多样性，实现了物理增强的机器学习系统。
papers.method_zh: 实验上构建有机染料微腔中的激子-极化激元凝聚体，将其作为生成对抗网络（Polariton GAN）中的物理随机变换层，进行条件图像生成任务；对比基线方法包括数字注入扰动和基于激光的系统。

papers.title: A Unified Dielectric-Dependent Hybrid Functional for Accurate Band Gaps across Dimensions
papers.abstract: Predicting fundamental band gaps across material classes and dimensionalities remains a central challenge in electronic-structure theory. Here, we show that intrinsic dielectric screening provides a unified control parameter for nonlocal exchange from bulk to low-dimensional and heterogeneous materials. We introduce a geometry-independent dielectric response and incorporate it self-consistently into a nonempirical screened-dielectric-dependent hybrid functional. Benchmarks for 100 materials spanning bulk, two-dimensional, one-dimensional, and mixed-dimensional systems show near-GW accuracy at the computational cost of generalized Kohn-Sham theory. These results reveal a screening-exchange-gap relation in which reduced dimensionality weakens intrinsic dielectric screening, strengthens nonlocal exchange, and drives the opening of fundamental gaps.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：nonempirical screened-dielectric-dependent hybrid functional、generalized Kohn-Sham theory、benchmarks。；研究对象：从块体到低维（二维、一维）及混合维度体系的100种材料，重点研究其基本带隙。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 本征介电屏蔽可作为从块体到低维及异质材料的非局域交换作用的统一控制参数；降低维度会削弱本征介电屏蔽、增强非局域交换作用，从而驱动基本带隙的打开。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：本征介电屏蔽可作为从块体到低维及异质材料的非局域交换作用的统一控制参数；降低维度会削弱本征介电屏蔽、增强非局域交换作用，从而驱动基本带隙的打开。；创新点：引入几何无关的介电响应作为统一参数，实现了从块体到低维及混合维度体系带隙的接近GW精度的预测，同时保持广义Kohn-Sham理论的计算成本。摘要未突出说明与已有杂化泛函方法的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种与几何无关的介电响应函数，并将其自洽地纳入非经验的屏蔽介电依赖杂化泛函中，在广义Kohn-Sham理论框架下进行计算。

papers.title: Nonlocal Orbital-Free Kinetic Energy Functional from the Jellium-with-Gap Model for Finite Systems
papers.abstract: The quasi-linear scaling of orbital-free density functional theory (OF-DFT) with system size makes it a computationally efficient alternative to conventional Kohn--Sham density functional theory for many condensed-matter applications. However, its applicability remains limited, particularly for finite systems such as molecular clusters, due to the lack of accurate kinetic energy density functionals. In this context, the development of nonlocal kinetic energy density functionals (NL-KEDFs) has significantly advanced the practical utility of OF-DFT. Here, following an alternative formulation based on the linear-response kernel derived from the jellium-with-gap model (JGM), we develop an NL-KEDF capable of accurately describing the diverse density regimes characteristic of finite systems, including molecular clusters. Benchmark calculations, together with an analysis of the corresponding Pauli potentials, demonstrate that the proposed functional achieves higher accuracy than state-of-the-art orbital-free approaches for finite systems. Furthermore, the optical properties computed using the present method show good agreement with reference results, highlighting its reliability. These results indicate that the proposed NL-KEDF provides a robust and efficient framework for extending OF-DFT to finite systems, with potential implications for nanomaterial design and a deeper understanding of nanoscale phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：orbital-free density functional theory (OF-DFT)、linear-response kernel、benchmark calculations。；研究对象：有限体系，特别是分子团簇（molecular clusters）等具有多样密度分布特征的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于“含能隙凝胶模型”（Jellium-with-Gap Model, JGM）推导出的非局域动能密度泛函（NL-KEDF），能够比现有最先进的无轨道方法更准确地描述有限体系的电子密度和光学性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于“含能隙凝胶模型”（Jellium-with-Gap Model, JGM）推导出的非局域动能密度泛函（NL-KEDF），能够比现有最先进的无轨道方法更准确地描述有限体系的电子密度和光学性质。；创新点：提出了一种基于JGM模型线性响应核的替代性公式来构建NL-KEDF，该泛函专门针对有限体系中存在的不同密度区域（如分子团簇内部和外部）进行了优化，从而显著提高了OF-DFT在有限体系中的适用性和精度。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与基准计算。具体而言，基于JGM模型推导出线性响应核（linear-response kernel），并以此为基础构建了一个新的非局域动能密度泛函（NL-KEDF）。通过基准测试和对应的Pauli势分析来评估其准确性，并计算了光学性质与参考结果进行对比。

papers.title: Symmetry-aware generative design of flat-band materials beyond known crystal-net prototypes
papers.abstract: Flat electronic bands underlie a range of strongly correlated and topological phenomena, whose design in real materials has so far relied on a small catalogue of named geometric motifs such as kagome, Lieb, and pyrochlore nets. This discrete catalogue is by no means to exhaust the geometries that support flat bands in real compounds, as band flatness is a property of network connectivity. Here we combine a continuous geometric representation of crystal sublattices, with a symmetry-constrained generative model, to access a broader design space for materials hosting flat bands. The key step is to choose sublattice motifs that are outside the known geometric clusters, ensuring the novelty of the generated structures. We then introduce SkeleGen, which pins these unconventional skeletons to symmetry-compatible Wyckoff positions while denoising the surrounding chemistry, resulting in 9,352 crystal candidates that survive stability and flatnessscreening. Band flatness is confirmed using high throughput full DFT calculations, which agree well also with the tight-binding spectra of the isolated skeletons, supporting a geometric origin of the band flatness. We demonstrate "out-of-distribution" motifs as a new design principle to dramatically expand geometric repertoire for materials discovery, potentially beyond flat bands.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：generative model、DFT calculations、tight-binding spectra、high throughput screening）；研究对象：平带材料，具体为通过晶体子晶格几何结构设计实现平带的材料体系，超越已知的kagome、Lieb、pyrochlore等几何原型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将晶体子晶格的连续几何表示与对称性约束的生成模型相结合，可以系统性地发现大量具有平带的新晶体候选材料（9,352个），且平带源于几何结构而非化学细节。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将晶体子晶格的连续几何表示与对称性约束的生成模型相结合，可以系统性地发现大量具有平带的新晶体候选材料（9,352个），且平带源于几何结构而非化学细节。；创新点：提出“分布外”（out-of-distribution）子晶格几何基元作为设计原则，突破了传统依赖少数已知几何原型（如kagome、Lieb、pyrochlore）的局限，极大扩展了平带材料的几何设计空间。
papers.method_zh: 对称性约束的生成模型（SkeleGen）、高通量密度泛函理论（DFT）计算、紧束缚模型（tight-binding）谱分析、Wyckoff位置约束、稳定性与平带筛选。

papers.title: Intrinsic decay length in elastic localization
papers.abstract: Localization in finite elastic structures is often studied using infinite-domain solutions, which avoid the explicit treatment of boundaries and admit simpler analytical descriptions. Yet it remains poorly understood when finite-domain localized states can be accurately approximated by their infinite-domain counterparts. In this work, we show that the accuracy is controlled by an intrinsic decay length. Using a prototypical localization model, we show that finite-domain localized solutions converge exponentially to the corresponding infinite-domain localized solution once the structural length exceeds the intrinsic decay length. The intrinsic decay length also explains the markedly different validity regimes of finite- and infinite-domain weakly nonlinear approximations. It further has important implications for numerical computation, since once the structural length exceeds the intrinsic decay length, localized solutions corresponding to different domain lengths differ only by exponentially small quantities, making them increasingly difficult to distinguish numerically. The theoretical predictions are validated using two representative localization problems: bulging in membrane tubes and localized helical buckling in twisted rods. The present work provides a unified geometric framework for understanding localization transition, asymptotic validity, and numerical computation in elastic localization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：infinite-domain solutions、analytical descriptions、theoretical predictions、unified geometric framework）；研究对象：弹性局域化现象中的有限结构与无限结构之间的局域态对应关系，具体以膜管鼓胀和扭杆局域螺旋屈曲为代表性验证问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限弹性结构中局域态能否被无限域解准确近似，取决于一个内在衰减长度；当结构尺寸超过该长度时，有限域局域解以指数速度收敛于无限域局域解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限弹性结构中局域态能否被无限域解准确近似，取决于一个内在衰减长度；当结构尺寸超过该长度时，有限域局域解以指数速度收敛于无限域局域解。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用原型局域化模型进行解析分析，结合弱非线性近似理论，并通过两个代表性弹性局域化问题（膜管鼓胀、扭杆局域螺旋屈曲）进行数值验证。

papers.title: Interlayer pairing mechanism for bilayer nickelate superconductors
papers.abstract: The discovery of superconductivity in Ruddlesden-Popper bilayer nickelates under both high pressure and ambient conditions has opened a new paradigm for exploring unconventional superconductivity. This review provides a brief survey of theoretical progress on bilayer nickelate superconductors. Drawing from the key experimental observations, we summarize essential physical ingredients including the hybridized Ni-3$d_{x^2-y^2}$ and 3$d_{z^2}$ electronic structure, orbital-dependent electronic correlation, Hund's coupling, and strong interlayer magnetic coupling. The fundamental theoretical models including the bilayer two-orbital Hubbard model and its minimal $t$-$J$ variants are introduced. Starting from the atomic-limit interlayer valence bond picture of the half-filled $d_{z^2}$ orbital, we elaborate on strong correlation interlayer pairing mechanisms based on different limiting considerations. Specific emphasis is placed on the hybridization mechanism, where the $d_{z^2}$ local singlet pairs provide the pairing energy and their hybridization with itinerant $d_{x^2-y^2}$ promotes superconducting phase coherence. We further analyze the pairing symmetry, the dependence of $T_c$ on various internal and external parameters, the nontrivial normal state properties including the Fermi liquid, non-Fermi liquid, weakly insulating and pseudogap behaviors. Effects of pressure tuning, oxygen content, and Kondo scattering induced by oxygen vacancies are also discussed. Finally, weak correlation theories based on spin fluctuations associated with Fermi surface nesting are briefly covered.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（综述）。判断依据：摘要明确说明是“theoretical progress”的综述，并介绍了多种理论模型和机制。；研究对象：Ruddlesden-Popper 双层镍酸盐超导体（bilayer nickelate superconductors），具体研究其非常规超导的配对机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该综述系统阐述了双层镍酸盐超导体的强关联层间配对机制，特别是基于半填充 \(d_{z^2}\) 轨道的原子极限层间价键图像，以及 \(d_{z^2}\) 局域单态与巡游 \(d_{x^2-y^2}\) 轨道杂化促进超导相位相干的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该综述系统阐述了双层镍酸盐超导体的强关联层间配对机制，特别是基于半填充 \(d_{z^2}\) 轨道的原子极限层间价键图像，以及 \(d_{z^2}\) 局域单态与巡游 \(d_{x^2-y^2}\) 轨道杂化促进超导相位相干的机制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明该综述相对于已有综述的独特创新点，但其核心贡献在于系统性地阐述了基于 \(d_{z^2}\) 轨道层间价键和轨道杂化的强关联配对机制，并分析了该机制对配对对称性、超导转变温度 \(T_c\) 及正常态性质（如费米液体、非费米液体、赝能隙等）的影响。
papers.method_zh: 理论模型分析。具体包括：双层两轨道Hubbard模型（bilayer two-orbital Hubbard model）及其最小化 \(t\)-\(J\) 变体模型；基于不同极限考虑的强关联层间配对机制分析；以及基于费米面嵌套的自旋涨落的弱关联理论。

papers.title: Identifying Mobility Edge from Finite Temperature Spectral Form Factor
papers.abstract: The spectral form factor (SFF) is a measure of energy correlations and has been widely used to identify the transition from the ergodic to the localized phase in interacting many-body quantum systems. In this work, we show that in a disordered Heisenberg spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ model, the finite temperature SFF can be used to generate a canonical phase diagram exhibiting a critical temperature $T_\mathrm{MBL}$. Using simple ideas of statistical mechanics, we obtain the critical energy density $ε_\mathrm{MBL}$ dual to $T_\mathrm{MBL}$. We show that the mobility edge (ME), numerically estimated from the spread of local perturbations and the optical conductivity, indeed coincides with $ε_\mathrm{MBL}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：spectral form factor (SFF)、finite temperature、phase diagram、numerically estimated。；研究对象：无序海森堡自旋-1/2模型（disordered Heisenberg spin-1/2 model）中的多体局域化（MBL）相变及迁移率边（mobility edge）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限温度下的谱形因子（SFF）可用于生成包含临界温度T_MBL的相图，且通过统计力学得到的临界能量密度ε_MBL与数值估计的迁移率边（ME）一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限温度下的谱形因子（SFF）可用于生成包含临界温度T_MBL的相图，且通过统计力学得到的临界能量密度ε_MBL与数值估计的迁移率边（ME）一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用谱形因子（SFF）分析有限温度下的能级关联；结合统计力学思想推导临界能量密度；通过局域扰动传播和光导率（optical conductivity）的数值估计来标定迁移率边。

papers.title: Floquet-Sambe Bottleneck and Frequency-Selective Localization in a Driven Synthetic Spin Chain
papers.abstract: We study a finite Floquet chain in which a uniform nearest-neighbor hopping coexists with a periodically rotating, \textrm{SU(2)}-dictated spin-assisted hopping profile. The resulting coupling is spatially inhomogeneous -- weakest at the chain boundaries and strongest in the bulk -- and produces a frequency-dependent Floquet-Sambe bottleneck. In the closed system, the mean inverse participation ratio (\textrm{MIPR}) of the Floquet eigenstates exhibits a striking nonmonotonic dependence on the driving frequency $ω$: the states remain extended at both low and high frequencies, but become maximally localized at an intermediate frequency. We demonstrate that this localization maximum occurs at $ω_{\mathrm{peak}}\sim μ_{-s}=\sqrt{% 2s}$, a scale controlled by the first boundary bottleneck. To connect these spectral properties to measurable transport, we construct an open-system Floquet-Sambe Green-function inverse participation ratio from the spatial density of the injected scattering state. This open-system diagnostic recovers the same nonmonotonic localization trend as its closed-system counterpart, with the peak shifted to higher frequencies by the static bandwidth and the lead self-energy. These findings establish the driven synthetic spin chain as a directly realizable, frequency-tunable platform for coherent information storage and retrieval, rooted in the interplay of Floquet-Sambe virtual channels, boundary-controlled localization, and frequency-selective transport in emerging multi-level superconducting circuit architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study（理论研究）、construct（构建理论模型）、demonstrate（理论论证）。；研究对象：驱动合成自旋链（driven synthetic spin chain）中的Floquet-Sambe瓶颈效应与频率选择性局域化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限Floquet链中，Floquet本征态的平均逆参与率（MIPR）随驱动频率呈现非单调依赖：低频率和高频率下态保持扩展，而在中间频率达到最大局域化。该局域化峰值出现在由第一个边界瓶颈控制的频率尺度ω_peak~μ_{-s}=√(2s)处。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限Floquet链中，Floquet本征态的平均逆参与率（MIPR）随驱动频率呈现非单调依赖：低频率和高频率下态保持扩展，而在中间频率达到最大局域化。该局域化峰值出现在由第一个边界瓶颈控制的频率尺度ω_peak~μ_{-s}=√(2s)处。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：构建具有均匀最近邻跳跃与周期性旋转SU(2)自旋辅助跳跃的有限Floquet链模型；计算闭系统中Floquet本征态的MIPR；构建开系统Floquet-Sambe格林函数逆参与率，通过注入散射态的空间密度分析输运性质。

papers.title: Impedance Matching and Absorption Enhancement in Helical Carbon Coil Microwave Absorbers via Tunable Anchoring Layer Thickness
papers.abstract: Helical carbon coils exhibit unique three dimensional chiral architectures that can effectively interact with microwaves in the 2 to 18 GHz range. Inspired by recent experimental studies, we develop a coarse grained electrodynamic model for helical carbon coil arrays supported on quartz substrates, and examine their potential as microwave absorbers. Guided by the heuristic relation $f_{\mathrm{res}} = c / (n_{\mathrm{eff}} p)$, we compute absorption and reflection fractions for both bare helical carbon coil on substrate and helical carbon coil with anchoring layer on substrate configurations. The anchoring layer thickness is treated as a tunable parameter to improve absorption at selected frequencies. We find that the introduction of a carbon based anchoring layer of optimized thickness enhances impedance matching absorption. The parameters are chosen as representative values for demonstration purposes, and may vary within a certain range depending on preparation conditions. Our results serve to illustrate the potential of helical carbon coils as microwave absorbing devices, and to identify possible active tuning strategies. In the discussion section, we consider extensions of the present model to account for circular dichroism absorption, and examine the influence of actual interfacial reflection on microwave absorption and reflection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：develop a coarse grained electrodynamic model, compute absorption and reflection fractions）；研究对象：石英衬底上支撑的螺旋碳线圈阵列，及其作为微波吸收体的性能。具体研究了有无碳基锚定层（anchoring layer）的两种构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过优化碳基锚定层的厚度，可以改善螺旋碳线圈微波吸收体的阻抗匹配，从而增强特定频率下的微波吸收。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过优化碳基锚定层的厚度，可以改善螺旋碳线圈微波吸收体的阻抗匹配，从而增强特定频率下的微波吸收。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该工作主要创新在于将锚定层厚度作为可调参数，系统研究了其对螺旋碳线圈微波吸收性能的影响，并提出了通过优化锚定层厚度实现阻抗匹配吸收的策略。
papers.method_zh: 采用粗粒化电动力学模型（coarse grained electrodynamic model）进行数值计算。利用启发式关系式 \( f_{\mathrm{res}} = c / (n_{\mathrm{eff}} p) \) 指导分析，计算了吸收和反射分数。

papers.title: On the flow of electrically charged particles in an elastic solid
papers.abstract: This paper is a specialization of a broad and complicated continuum theory [arXiv:2403.07582] to a relatively simple and useful case so that it is more reader friendly. A continuum theory of the flow of charged particles in an elastic solid is presented. It can describe the behavior of soft solid electrolytes and elastic semiconductors. It is nonlinear and is valid for large deformation and strong fields. The theory is derived from a three-continuum mixture model including a charged lattice continuum, a bound charge continuum for electric polarization, and an ideal fluid for the flow of mobile charges. The basic electromechanical laws are applied systematically to the model. The electric fields are quasistatic and are in SI units.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：continuum theory（连续介质理论）、derived from a three-continuum mixture model（从三连续混合物模型推导）。；研究对象：带电粒子在弹性固体中的流动，具体涉及软固体电解质和弹性半导体中的电-力耦合行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要贡献是提出一个适用于大变形和强场的非线性连续介质理论。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要贡献是提出一个适用于大变形和强场的非线性连续介质理论。；创新点：将此前复杂的连续介质理论特化到带电粒子在弹性固体中流动这一相对简单且实用的情形，使其更易于读者理解和使用。
papers.method_zh: 基于三连续混合物模型（包括带电晶格连续体、用于电极化的束缚电荷连续体、以及用于可移动电荷流动的理想流体），系统应用基本电-力学定律，采用准静态电场假设，并使用SI单位制。该理论是作者此前更广泛复杂理论（arXiv:2403.07582）的特化简化版本。

papers.title: Interaction and non-Hermiticity controlled transmission in extended Su-Schrieffer-Heeger models
papers.abstract: We study the transport characteristics of an extended version of the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model with next-nearest-neighbor (NNN) interactions and non-Hermitian onsite energies. We observed that transport in such a system is significantly modified by the NNN interaction and the non-Hermitian terms. The transmission coefficient exhibits oscillatory behavior as the strength of the NNN interaction varies in a fixed-length chain. Moreover, the transmission coefficient also shows oscillation with system size for a fixed strength of the NNN interaction. We find that novel oscillatory behavior of the transmission coefficient, arising form the NNN interaction, is a unique feature of such a model and has not been reported previously. The presence of the non-Hermitian terms also enhances/reduces the transmission coefficient depending on the values of the other system parameters like intra-, inter- and NNN hopping. It appears from our study that both the NNN interaction and the non-Hermiticity introduce significant changes in the transport properties of the extended SSH chain, which are not observed in the standard Hermitian nearest-neighbour variant of the SSH model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study the transport characteristics、model、transmission coefficient。；研究对象：扩展的Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型，包含次近邻（NNN）相互作用和非厄米在位能，研究其输运特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 次近邻相互作用导致传输系数随相互作用强度或系统尺寸呈现新颖的振荡行为，且非厄米项可增强或抑制传输系数，这些效应在标准厄米最近邻SSH模型中未观察到。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：次近邻相互作用导致传输系数随相互作用强度或系统尺寸呈现新颖的振荡行为，且非厄米项可增强或抑制传输系数，这些效应在标准厄米最近邻SSH模型中未观察到。；创新点：首次报道了由次近邻相互作用引起的传输系数新颖振荡行为，并揭示了非厄米项与次近邻相互作用共同对输运性质的显著调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与分析：通过构建包含次近邻相互作用和非厄米在位能的扩展SSH模型，计算固定长度链中传输系数随次近邻相互作用强度的变化，以及固定相互作用强度下传输系数随系统尺寸的变化。

papers.title: Creation and motion of antiferromagnetic skyrmions by edge manipulation
papers.abstract: Magnetic racetrack architectures that use topological magnetic particles to store information are one of the most promising concepts for future storage applications. Antiferromagnetic racetracks are particularly appealing as they are not susceptible to external magnetic fields. State-of-the-art racetracks use magnetic fields, spin-transfer and spin-orbit torques caused by electric currents to move the bits across the entire circuit. However, the application of currents in many antiferromagnetic racetracks is limited because many of them are insulating. Recently, however, a concept for ferromagnetic racetrack memories that are free of global driving forces has been proposed. It has been demonstrated that various topological entities can be generated and transported over long distances solely through local magnetization rotation at the sample boundaries, independent of global driving forces. Here, we demonstrate that the local rotation of magnetization at the boundary of an antiferromagnetic sample can be exploited in racetracks to efficiently generate and transmit antiferromagnetic skyrmions. Additionally, we demonstrate that local switching of staggered magnetization at the edge of an antiferromagnetic racetrack can be even more successful than the rotational procedure. A comparison of ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic processing of skyrmionic bits, together with energy considerations, shows that this procedure is fairly efficient in antiferromagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：demonstrate, concept, energy considerations，无实验或计算细节描述）；研究对象：反铁磁赛道中的斯格明子（antiferromagnetic skyrmions），具体为通过边界操控实现其产生与运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过反铁磁样品边界处的局域磁化旋转或交错磁化翻转，可高效产生并传输反铁磁斯格明子，且边界翻转方法比旋转方法更有效；与铁磁体系相比，该过程在反铁磁中具有较高效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过反铁磁样品边界处的局域磁化旋转或交错磁化翻转，可高效产生并传输反铁磁斯格明子，且边界翻转方法比旋转方法更有效；与铁磁体系相比，该过程在反铁磁中具有较高效率。；创新点：将原本用于铁磁赛道中无全局驱动力操控拓扑磁结构的边界局域旋转方法，拓展至反铁磁体系，并进一步提出边界局域交错磁化翻转这一更高效的新方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与能量考量（energy considerations），对比铁磁与反铁磁体系中斯格明子比特的操控过程。

papers.title: Quasiparticle Diffusion for the Toda Fluid in Equilibrium
papers.abstract: Many-body integrable systems can be understood as a gas of quasiparticles. They propagate ballistically and drive large-scale transport. However, with the exception of the hard rods system, no tools have been available to numerically track such quasiparticles. Focusing on the Toda fluid, whose integrability relies on the availability of a Lax pair, we present a numerical scheme to track quasiparticle trajectories as determined by the time-dependent eigenvectors of the Lax matrix. Simulating the Toda fluid in thermal equilibrium, this tracking scheme is used to numerical confirm Brownian motion of a quasiparticle. Simulated is also the motion of a tagged particle. Our numerical results for the diffusion constant matches with a novel TBA prediction. We believe our numerical scheme can be extended to other classical many-particle models possessing a Lax matrix.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“numerical scheme”（数值方案）、“simulating”（模拟）、“TBA prediction”（热力学贝特假设预言）。；研究对象：Toda流体（Toda fluid）在热平衡状态下的准粒子扩散行为，具体关注准粒子（quasiparticle）的布朗运动以及标记粒子（tagged particle）的运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过数值追踪Lax矩阵时间依赖本征向量确定的准粒子轨迹，首次在Toda流体中数值证实了准粒子的布朗运动，并发现标记粒子的扩散常数与一种新的热力学贝特假设（TBA）预言相匹配。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过数值追踪Lax矩阵时间依赖本征向量确定的准粒子轨迹，首次在Toda流体中数值证实了准粒子的布朗运动，并发现标记粒子的扩散常数与一种新的热力学贝特假设（TBA）预言相匹配。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断：此前除硬杆系统（hard rods）外，缺乏数值追踪可积系统中准粒子的工具，该工作首次为拥有Lax矩阵的经典多粒子模型提供了通用的准粒子追踪数值方案。
papers.method_zh: 基于Lax对（Lax pair）的数值追踪方案：利用Toda流体可积性所依赖的Lax矩阵，通过计算其随时间演化的本征向量来追踪准粒子轨迹，并在热平衡条件下进行分子动力学模拟。

papers.title: Oxidation-induced ultrafast spin-to-orbital conversion at heavy-metal interfaces
papers.abstract: Oxidation engineering provides a route to control orbital degrees of freedom, yet its role in spin-to-orbital conversion remains largely unexplored. Here, we report an efficient spin-to-orbital conversion mechanism driven by interfacial oxidation at heavy-metal interfaces. In W/Co/SiO2 heterostructures, terahertz emission exhibits a time delay that scales linearly with the W thickness, identifying orbital-current transport as the dominant origin. The emission amplitude is approximately three times larger than that of Co/Pt bilayers, indicating highly efficient conversion from spin to orbital angular momentum. Systematic variation of Co thickness, stoichiometry, and interface configuration reveals that the effect originates from oxidation of the W layer at the W/Co interface, which modulates the interfacial orbital texture. We further show that this mechanism is generic across different heavy metals and scales with their spin-orbit coupling strength. These results establish oxidation as an effective handle to engineer spin-to-orbital conversion and provide a general route toward orbitronic terahertz emitters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了在W/Co/SiO2异质结中进行太赫兹发射实验，并系统变化了Co厚度、化学计量比和界面构型。；研究对象：重/铁磁金属异质结（W/Co/SiO2）中的界面氧化诱导的超快自旋-轨道转换现象，以及由此产生的轨道电流输运和太赫兹辐射。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在重/金属界面处，通过氧化工程可以诱导出一种高效的自旋-轨道转换机制，其效率约为传统Co/Pt双层结构的三倍，且该机制具有普适性，其强度与重金属的自旋-轨道耦合强度成正比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在重/金属界面处，通过氧化工程可以诱导出一种高效的自旋-轨道转换机制，其效率约为传统Co/Pt双层结构的三倍，且该机制具有普适性，其强度与重金属的自旋-轨道耦合强度成正比。；创新点：首次揭示了界面氧化是调控自旋-轨道转换的有效手段，并证明由此产生的轨道电流可以用于构建高效的轨道电子学太赫兹发射器。摘要未突出说明与现有理论模型的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹发射光谱（Terahertz emission spectroscopy）。通过测量太赫兹辐射的时域延迟与W层厚度的线性关系来识别轨道电流输运；通过系统改变Co层厚度、化学计量比和界面构型来研究氧化效应的影响。

papers.title: Interaction-enabled topological pumping of Rydberg electrons
papers.abstract: Topological pumping is a paradigmatic realization of quantized transport in band systems, yet its fate in strongly correlated regimes, especially with long-range interactions, remains largely unexplored. Here we report the experimental observation of interaction-enabled topological pumping of correlated Rydberg electrons in a synthetic lattice. We show that dipolar exchange interactions induce a controllable shift of the underlying topological singularity in parameter space, such that a fixed pumping trajectory can be driven through successive topological transitions by tuning the interaction strength alone. This leads to the emergence and breakdown of quantized transport. The observations are consistent with an effective Rice-Mele description with interaction-renormalized onsite potentials and are supported by characterizing the adiabaticity and robustness to control trajectory imperfections. Our results establish a platform for exploring interaction-controlled topological transport beyond perturbative regimes and open a route toward engineering correlated topological matter in synthetic quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experimental observation、synthetic lattice、dipolar exchange interactions）；研究对象：里德伯电子在合成晶格中的相互作用增强拓扑泵浦现象，具体涉及强关联长程相互作用下的拓扑输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控偶极交换相互作用强度，可诱导参数空间中拓扑奇点的可控移动，使固定泵浦轨迹经历连续拓扑相变，从而产生或破坏量子化输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控偶极交换相互作用强度，可诱导参数空间中拓扑奇点的可控移动，使固定泵浦轨迹经历连续拓扑相变，从而产生或破坏量子化输运。；创新点：首次实验观测到长程相互作用（而非传统单粒子能带拓扑）驱动的拓扑泵浦，实现了超越微扰区域的相互作用控制拓扑输运。
papers.method_zh: 利用里德伯原子合成晶格实验平台，通过偶极交换相互作用实现相互作用强度可调，结合有效Rice-Mele模型描述（含相互作用重整化的局域势），并表征绝热性及对控制轨迹缺陷的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Programmable Gauge-Field Textures with Ultracold Atoms in Momentum Space
papers.abstract: Synthetic gauge fields with ultracold atoms offer a route to quantum matter in which electromagnetic environments can be designed rather than merely imposed. While the Harper-Hofstadter model has been realized in several cold-atom systems, existing implementations are largely limited to spatially uniform magnetic fluxes. Here we experimentally realize a highly programmable two-dimensional momentum-state lattice of ultracold atoms with local control over the Peierls phase pattern, enabling direct implementation of Harper-Hofstadter Hamiltonians with tunable and spatially structured synthetic gauge fields. We observe a crossover from ballistic to strongly flux-modified bulk dynamics with suppressed transport. By introducing a synthetic electric field through site-dependent energy gradients, we further demonstrate Hall-type transverse drift arising from the interplay between electric and magnetic fields. In addition, we engineer a synthetic flux domain wall separating regions with opposite magnetic fluxes and observe anisotropic propagation guided along the interface. These results move cold-atom gauge-field engineering from uniform magnetic backgrounds toward designer gauge textures, providing an experimental setting for transport across programmable topological interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：experimentally realize、observe、demonstrate、engineer。；研究对象：超冷原子在动量空间中构建的可编程规范场纹理，具体为Harper-Hofstadter模型中的合成规范场（包括可调磁通、合成电场及磁通畴壁）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验实现了对Peierls相位图案的局域控制，从而在超冷原子动量态晶格中构建了具有空间结构可调的合成规范场；观察到了从弹道输运到磁通抑制的体动力学转变，以及由合成电场与磁场相互作用导致的霍尔型横向漂移；并展示了沿磁通畴壁的各向异性传播。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验实现了对Peierls相位图案的局域控制，从而在超冷原子动量态晶格中构建了具有空间结构可调的合成规范场；观察到了从弹道输运到磁通抑制的体动力学转变，以及由合成电场与磁场相互作用导致的霍尔型横向漂移；并展示了沿磁通畴壁的各向异性传播。；创新点：将超冷原子合成规范场从均匀磁通背景推进到可设计的规范场纹理（如磁通畴壁），实现了对空间结构化的合成规范场的直接编程与实验观测。
papers.method_zh: 利用超冷原子构建高度可编程的二维动量态晶格，通过局域控制Peierls相位图案直接实现Harper-Hofstadter哈密顿量；引入依赖于格点位置的能量梯度来产生合成电场。

papers.title: Universal scaling in the rheology of dense cellular systems
papers.abstract: Biological tissues must dynamically transition between rigid and fluid-like states during processes like morphogenesis and collective migration, often while simultaneously resisting physiological shear stresses. It remains unclear whether these tissue dynamics are governed by the same non-equilibrium critical phenomena that control conventional disordered matter. Here we show that model cell monolayers under constant stress display a rich phase diagram of nonlinear rheology. In rigid regimes, small internal fluctuations maintain a solid-like state up to a finite yield stress, above which the tissue shear-thins; conversely, fluid-like regimes exhibit robust continuous and discontinuous shear thickening, culminating in structural arrest via shear jamming. This space-filling shear-jamming transition is accompanied by structural changes including the formation of system-spanning force chains and the emergence of orientational ordering. We demonstrate that the macroscopic viscosity across these disparate regimes is described by universal scaling behavior controlled by the same underlying physical parameters. These results establish confluent tissues as a distinct class of disordered matter, demonstrating that universal jamming phenomena can emerge entirely through shape-driven topological constraints to regulate biological mechanics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（关键词：model cell monolayers、phase diagram、scaling behavior）；研究对象：密集细胞单层（confluent cell monolayers）在恒定应力下的非线性流变行为，属于生物组织力学与无序物质物理的交叉体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 密集细胞组织在不同应力下表现出丰富的非线性流变相图，包括固态屈服、剪切变稀、连续/不连续剪切增稠以及剪切堵塞转变，且所有流变区域的宏观粘度遵循由相同物理参数控制的普适标度行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：密集细胞组织在不同应力下表现出丰富的非线性流变相图，包括固态屈服、剪切变稀、连续/不连续剪切增稠以及剪切堵塞转变，且所有流变区域的宏观粘度遵循由相同物理参数控制的普适标度行为。；创新点：证明密集细胞组织是一类独特的无序物质，其堵塞现象完全由形状驱动的拓扑约束（而非传统颗粒物质的体积分数控制）所主导，并揭示了生物组织力学与经典非平衡临界现象之间的普适联系。
papers.method_zh: 基于模型细胞单层的理论模拟（摘要未明确说明具体计算方法，如是否采用顶点模型或自推进粒子模型），通过分析恒定应力下的流变响应、结构变化（力链、取向序）来建立标度关系。

papers.title: Ternary-composition tuning of the anomalous Nernst effect in amorphous-like Gd-Co-Pt films
papers.abstract: We report composition tuning of the anomalous Nernst effect in amorphous-like Gd-Co-Pt ternary films. Pt incorporation into Gd-Co films modifies the anomalous Nernst coefficient and induces a sign reversal of S_ANE, whereas Gd incorporation into Co-Pt films suppresses S_ANE but reduces thermal conductivity. Owing to the balance between transverse thermoelectric response and thermal transport, the heat-flux sensitivity reaches approximately 0.24 μm/A. Composition maps reveal that the magnitude and heat-flux sensitivity of the anomalous Nernst effect can be systematically tuned in the Gd-Co-Pt ternary composition space. This work extends ANE material design from binary-alloy optimization to ternary-composition engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：report、composition tuning、measurements（如热导率、Nernst系数等实验表征）。；研究对象：非晶态Gd-Co-Pt三元合金薄膜中的反常能斯特效应（anomalous Nernst effect, ANE）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节Gd-Co-Pt三元薄膜的组分，可以实现反常能斯特系数的大小和符号反转，并优化热流灵敏度（约0.24 μm/A），将ANE材料设计从二元合金拓展到三元组分工程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节Gd-Co-Pt三元薄膜的组分，可以实现反常能斯特系数的大小和符号反转，并优化热流灵敏度（约0.24 μm/A），将ANE材料设计从二元合金拓展到三元组分工程。；创新点：首次在非晶态三元合金体系中系统展示反常能斯特效应的组分调控能力，实现了从二元合金优化到三元组分工程的拓展。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备非晶态Gd-Co-Pt薄膜，通过组分调控（Pt掺入Gd-Co、Gd掺入Co-Pt）测量反常能斯特系数、热导率及热流灵敏度，并构建组分-性能映射图。

papers.title: Optical Creation of Synthetic Microgravity for Quantum Degenerate Gases
papers.abstract: Microgravity environments provide unique opportunities for ultracold-atom experiments by enabling long interrogation times and reduced acceleration-induced dynamics. However, their realization has largely been restricted to specialized facilities such as drop towers, sounding rockets, and space-based laboratories. Here we realize synthetic microgravity for quantum degenerate gases using optically engineered force landscapes that compensate Earth's gravity to the milli-g level while maintaining continuous confinement of the atomic ensemble.
