These force landscapes are generated by dynamically painted optical dipole potentials and calibrated in situ through Bloch oscillations in a vertical optical lattice, enabling precise control of the residual acceleration. We use this capability to demonstrate matter-wave beam splitting with arm separations of several hundred microns. We further implement a Bloch-band atom interferometer in which interaction-induced dephasing is strongly suppressed through controlled three-dimensional expansion in the synthetic microgravity potential. This reduction of mean-field effects restores near-$\sqrt{N}$ scaling of interferometric sensitivity for large quantum degenerate ensembles. Our results establish a versatile platform for realizing synthetic microgravity with trapped quantum gases in terrestrial laboratories, bringing the advantages of microgravity experiments to continuously operating systems and opening new opportunities for quantum sensing, matter-wave interferometry, and precision measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：realize、demonstrate、implement、experiments。；研究对象：量子简并气体（超冷原子）在合成微重力环境中的行为，具体涉及物质波分束和布洛赫带原子干涉仪。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过光学设计的力场实现了对量子简并气体的合成微重力（残余加速度降至毫g水平），并利用该环境显著抑制了相互作用诱导的退相干，恢复了近√N的干涉灵敏度标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过光学设计的力场实现了对量子简并气体的合成微重力（残余加速度降至毫g水平），并利用该环境显著抑制了相互作用诱导的退相干，恢复了近√N的干涉灵敏度标度。；创新点：首次在普通地面实验室中，利用光学手段为囚禁的量子简并气体创建合成微重力环境，替代了落塔、探空火箭或空间站等专用设施，实现了连续运行且可精确调控的微重力条件。
papers.method_zh: 使用动态绘制的光学偶极势（dynamically painted optical dipole potentials）产生力场，通过垂直光学晶格中的布洛赫振荡（Bloch oscillations）进行原位校准，实现残余加速度的精确控制。在此基础上实现了物质波分束和布洛赫带原子干涉仪，并在合成微重力势中控制三维膨胀以抑制平均场效应。

papers.title: Complementary Thermodynamic Mechanisms of Boron and Carbon Segregation at Grain Boundaries in Nickel Alloys
papers.abstract: Grain boundary stabilization by light interstitials is central to the performance of Ni-based superalloys, yet the thermodynamic mechanisms governing their interactions with substitutional chemistry remain poorly resolved. Here, we use hybrid Monte Carlo molecular dynamics simulations to quantify how boron and carbon modify the thermodynamic, structural, and chemical ordering of grain boundaries in Ni--Cr alloys. By analyzing interfacial state variables, site-resolved segregation spectra, local chemical ordering, and structural evolution, we show that boron and carbon stabilize grain boundaries through complementary pathways. Carbon drives saturation-controlled stabilization by recruiting Cr and conditioning boundary chemistry, while suppressing temperature-driven structural transformations of the boundary. In contrast, boron stabilizes grain boundaries through a selective mechanism that lowers the interfacial grand potential via localized ordering while permitting gradual structural evolution. These effects arise from coupled interactions between interstitial segregation and Cr redistribution, which together regulate site accessibility, chemical competition, and the range of accessible interfacial states. This work provides a thermodynamic framework for grain boundary engineering and suggests design principles for leveraging interstitial-substitutional interactions in alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：hybrid Monte Carlo molecular dynamics simulations（混合蒙特卡罗分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：镍基合金（Ni-Cr合金）中硼和碳在晶界处的偏析行为及其热力学机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硼和碳通过互补的热力学路径稳定晶界：碳通过招募铬并抑制温度驱动的结构转变实现饱和控制型稳定；硼则通过局部有序化降低界面巨势，同时允许渐进的结构演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硼和碳通过互补的热力学路径稳定晶界：碳通过招募铬并抑制温度驱动的结构转变实现饱和控制型稳定；硼则通过局部有序化降低界面巨势，同时允许渐进的结构演化。；创新点：揭示了间隙原子（硼、碳）与替代原子（铬）在晶界处的耦合相互作用，提出了基于热力学框架的晶界工程设计原理，并区分了两种不同的稳定化机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合蒙特卡罗分子动力学模拟，分析界面状态变量、位点分辨偏析谱、局部化学有序性及结构演化。

papers.title: Fermi-Level-Dependent Defect Chemistry and Oxygen Evolution Reaction Activity of Fe-Doped and Oxygen-Deficient \ce{SrTiO3}(001)
papers.abstract: The oxygen evolution reaction (OER) on perovskite oxides is controlled by the interplay of dopant chemistry, defect charge states, and surface segregation, yet these factors are rarely treated on equal footing. Using first-principles density functional theory, we investigate how Fe dopants (\FeTi{}) and oxygen vacancies (\VO{}) in different charge states affect the OER on TiO$_2$-terminated \ce{SrTiO3}(001). We combine charge-dependent defect formation energies, segregation energies, and charge transition levels with OER free-energy profiles obtained in the computational hydrogen electrode framework. Neutral \FeTix{} preserves near-pristine activity, with overpotentials of $0.43$--$0.48$~V compared to $0.45$~V for the pristine surface, whereas the reduced states \FeTip{} and \FeTipp{} raise the overpotential to as much as $1.35$~V when intermediates bind to Ti sites adjacent to surface Fe. Oxygen vacancies segregate to the surface across the entire band gap ($ΔE_\mathrm{seg} = -0.50$ to $-0.80$~eV) but do not improve the activity: \VOx{} and \VOp{} overstabilize oxygenated intermediates ($η$ up to $2.13$~V), and only \VOpp{} retains a balanced pathway ($η= 0.45$~V in the bulk-like region). Because the stable charge state and the segregation tendency of each defect are set by the Fermi level, the OER overpotential itself becomes a Fermi-level-dependent quantity. These results establish Fermi-level engineering as a framework for assessing and tuning defect-mediated OER activity in perovskite oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles density functional theory”（第一性原理密度泛函理论）、“computational hydrogen electrode framework”（计算氢电极框架）。；研究对象：Fe掺杂且含氧空位的钛酸锶（\ce{SrTiO3}(001)）表面，具体为TiO₂终止的(001)面，以及其上的析氧反应（OER）活性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Fe掺杂和氧空位在不同电荷态下对OER活性有显著不同的影响：中性Fe掺杂几乎不改变活性，而还原态Fe掺杂会大幅提高过电位；氧空位会向表面偏析但不会改善活性，反而可能过度稳定中间体。OER过电位本身成为费米能级的函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Fe掺杂和氧空位在不同电荷态下对OER活性有显著不同的影响：中性Fe掺杂几乎不改变活性，而还原态Fe掺杂会大幅提高过电位；氧空位会向表面偏析但不会改善活性，反而可能过度稳定中间体。OER过电位本身成为费米能级的函数。；创新点：将掺杂化学、缺陷电荷态和表面偏析这三个因素放在同等地位上统一处理，并揭示了费米能级通过调控缺陷的稳定电荷态和偏析倾向，从而决定OER过电位的机制，提出了“费米能级工程”作为评估和调控钙钛矿氧化物缺陷介导OER活性的框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，结合电荷依赖的缺陷形成能、偏析能、电荷跃迁能级，以及基于计算氢电极框架的OER自由能剖面分析。

papers.title: Controlling Porosity in Supraparticles Composed of Colloidal Rods and Spheres
papers.abstract: Supraparticles (SPs) are assemblies of colloidal particles whose properties can be tuned by modifying the chemistry, shape, and size of the colloidal particles as well as their arrangement in the SP. SPs with internal porosity are of particular interest for catalysis, photonics, and adsorption applications because of their high surface area and tunable pore size distribution. SPs are often fabricated by droplet drying, and the nonequilibrium nature of drying processes may provide an additional handle to control particle arrangement within the SP. Here, we use mesoscale particle-based simulations to explore the drying-induced assembly of SPs made from rod-shaped and spherical colloidal particles. We selectively remove one type of particle after drying and characterize the structure of the resulting porous SP. We find that the remaining particles form connected networks for most compositions, with rods percolating at lower volume fractions than spheres. Most of the resulting void volume forms a single contiguous space whose surface area closely follows the total surface area of the remaining component. The pore-size distribution, however, depends strongly on sphere size and on the removed component, reflecting differences in sphere-clustering and rod-bundling before removal. This work provides new insight into how particle size and shape, as well as processing conditions, might be used to manipulate porosity in SPs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：mesoscale particle-based simulations、模拟）；研究对象：由棒状和球形胶体颗粒组成的超粒子（supraparticles, SPs）的内部孔隙结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过选择性去除干燥后超粒子中的一种组分（棒或球），剩余颗粒可形成连通网络，其中棒状颗粒在更低体积分数下即可形成逾渗网络；孔隙尺寸分布强烈依赖于球体尺寸和被去除的组分类型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过选择性去除干燥后超粒子中的一种组分（棒或球），剩余颗粒可形成连通网络，其中棒状颗粒在更低体积分数下即可形成逾渗网络；孔隙尺寸分布强烈依赖于球体尺寸和被去除的组分类型。；创新点：系统研究了颗粒形状（棒 vs 球）和尺寸对超粒子内部孔隙结构（如孔隙连通性、表面积、孔径分布）的影响，揭示了通过调控颗粒形状和加工条件（如干燥）来设计超粒子孔隙率的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 采用介观尺度基于粒子的模拟方法，模拟液滴干燥诱导的胶体棒与球混合组装过程，并在干燥后选择性移除一种颗粒，随后表征所得多孔超粒子的结构。

papers.title: Many-body activity emerging in a monolayer of air-fluidized hollow pentagons
papers.abstract: Particles governed by many-body interactions exhibit remarkably complex structures and dynamics. We experimentally investigate a monolayer of pentagon particles subjected to an up-lifting air flow which induces many-body aerodynamic interactions and stochastic motion akin to a thermal bath. To minimize air flow resistance, particles move collectively with interactions dictated by their geometry: hollow particles exhibit effective attraction, whereas solid particles repel each other. Under sufficiently large air flow, sparsely packed hollow pentagons overcome substrate friction and undergo long-time diffusive motion. Under lower air flow, we see a coexistence of isolated, static pentagons and densely packed, "active" clusters, whose particles display super-diffusivity. This "emergent activity" arises collectively when locally disordered structures interact with the air flow, resulting in correlated motion across broad temporal and spatial scales. Using Langevin dynamics simulations of two-dimensional attractive active pentagons, whose activity is an effective result of the local packing density, we further unravel the basic features of this emergent activity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimentally investigate”，并进行了“Langevin dynamics simulations”。；研究对象：空气流化床中单层空心五边形颗粒（hollow pentagons）构成的体系，研究其由多体空气动力学相互作用诱导的涌现集体运动与类活性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在足够大的气流下，稀疏排列的空心五边形颗粒克服基底摩擦并发生长时扩散运动；在较低气流下，体系出现孤立静态颗粒与密集“活性”团簇共存，团簇内颗粒呈现超扩散行为，这种涌现活性源于局域无序结构与气流的集体相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在足够大的气流下，稀疏排列的空心五边形颗粒克服基底摩擦并发生长时扩散运动；在较低气流下，体系出现孤立静态颗粒与密集“活性”团簇共存，团簇内颗粒呈现超扩散行为，这种涌现活性源于局域无序结构与气流的集体相互作用。；创新点：揭示了在无内置驱动力（如自推进）的被动颗粒体系中，通过几何形状（空心结构）与多体空气动力学耦合，可涌现出类似活性物质的超扩散集体运动。摘要未突出说明与已有活性物质实验的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用向上气流流化单层五边形颗粒，通过调节气流强度观察颗粒运动；计算上采用二维吸引性活性五边形的朗之万动力学模拟，其中活性由局域堆积密度有效决定。

papers.title: Precipitation strengthening: a collective multi-dislocation phenomenon
papers.abstract: Precipitation strengthening is a cornerstone of physical metallurgy, delivering otherwise unattainable combinations of strength and ductility. The approach relies on nanoscale precipitates that impede the motion of dislocations, the primary carriers of plastic deformation. Historically, precipitation strengthening has been rationalized via two idealized, limiting mechanisms: dislocations either cut through or bow around precipitates. However, in situ experiments cannot yet resolve the coupled, real-time evolution of dislocation networks and nanoprecipitates, leaving these atomic-scale dynamics inaccessible to direct observation. Here, using large-scale atomistic simulations that fully capture these dynamics, we demonstrate that the classical cutting-versus-bowing dichotomy is incomplete. Instead, strengthening arises as an emergent collective phenomenon driven by concurrent, multi-dislocation interactions. These interactions simultaneously induce dislocation accumulation at interfaces, storage within precipitates, and precipitate-mediated multiplication inside the matrix. These findings establish a mechanistic framework that transcends traditional models and provides a new foundation for predicting strengthening behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“large-scale atomistic simulations”（大规模原子模拟）。；研究对象：沉淀强化（precipitation strengthening）这一物理冶金现象，具体涉及纳米析出相与位错网络的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典理论中位错“切割”或“绕过”析出相的二分法是不完整的；沉淀强化实际上是一种由多位错同时相互作用引发的集体涌现现象，包括位错在界面累积、在析出相内部存储以及通过析出相在基体中增殖。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典理论中位错“切割”或“绕过”析出相的二分法是不完整的；沉淀强化实际上是一种由多位错同时相互作用引发的集体涌现现象，包括位错在界面累积、在析出相内部存储以及通过析出相在基体中增殖。；创新点：超越了传统切割-绕过二分法模型，建立了基于多位错集体相互作用的机制框架，为预测沉淀强化行为提供了新基础。
papers.method_zh: 大规模原子模拟（large-scale atomistic simulations），能够完全捕捉位错网络与纳米析出相的耦合实时演化动力学。

papers.title: Atomistic insights into the structural, thermal, and mechanical evolution of $Zr_{47.5}Cu_{47.5}Ag_{5}$ bulk metallic glass
papers.abstract: Bulk metallic glasses (BMGs) are distinguished by amorphous atomic structures that confer superior mechanical performance; however, the evolution of these properties in ternary bulk configurations remains insufficiently explored. In this study, we employed large-scale molecular dynamics simulations to investigate the structural, thermal, and mechanical properties of $Zr_{47.5}Cu_{47.5}Ag_{5}$ BMGs. Our thermodynamic and topological analyses, utilizing potential energy regression and the Modified Wendt-Abraham parameter, identified a glass transition temperature ($T_g$) of approximately $692\text{ K}$. Structural characterization via Voronoi tessellation and partial radial distribution functions reveals that the amorphous matrix is stabilized by icosahedral clusters, with Ag atoms inducing significant chemical heterogeneity through localized nano-clustering. Thermal transport properties, computed via the Green-Kubo formalism, demonstrate a monotonic decrease in conductivity with temperature, consistent with structural scattering saturation in disordered lattices. Mechanical tensile testing reveals that the material exhibits robust rate- and temperature-dependent behavior, with yield strengths reaching $\approx 2.3\text{ GPa}$ at room temperature. We show that macroscopic strain-softening is intrinsically linked to the thermally induced collapse of rigid icosahedral motifs, which facilitates shear band percolation. These findings provide a structural rationale for the beneficial role of Ag dopants in enhancing the resilience of multicomponent metallic glasses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“large-scale molecular dynamics simulations”（大规模分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：三元块体金属玻璃（BMG）$Zr_{47.5}Cu_{47.5}Ag_{5}$ 的结构、热学与力学性能演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ag原子的引入通过局域纳米团簇化诱导显著的化学异质性，并稳定二十面体团簇；宏观应变软化与刚性二十面体结构的热诱导坍塌直接相关，从而促进剪切带的渗透。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ag原子的引入通过局域纳米团簇化诱导显著的化学异质性，并稳定二十面体团簇；宏观应变软化与刚性二十面体结构的热诱导坍塌直接相关，从而促进剪切带的渗透。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用大规模分子动力学模拟，结合势能回归与修正的Wendt-Abraham参数进行热力学与拓扑分析；利用Voronoi镶嵌与部分径向分布函数进行结构表征；通过Green-Kubo公式计算热输运性质；进行力学拉伸测试以研究速率与温度依赖性行为。

papers.title: Valley Valves at Domain Walls in Symmetry-Broken Rhombohedral Graphene
papers.abstract: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene polarized by a moderate perpendicular displacement field hosts a time-reversal-symmetry-breaking valley-and-spin-polarized metallic phase that may condense into a chiral superconductor. Recent magnetic imaging and transport measurements in this unconventional system suggest the presence of domain walls both in the metallic and superconducting phases. In this work, we show that valley domain walls are impenetrable barriers to transport in the metallic regime. Transmission through such a domain wall must therefore be mediated by intervalley interactions. We derive the symmetry-allowed terms and show via microscopic numerical simulations that they enable the transmission of electrons across the domain wall. In the superconducting phase, we find that intervalley mixing is crucial for supporting an appreciable supercurrent through a SNS' Josephson junction that connects opposite-chirality superconducting regions. Taken together, our work elucidates the nature of domain walls in these experimentally relevant multilayer systems and emphasizes the critical role of intervalley hybridization plays in governing their transport properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：show、derive、microscopic numerical simulations、find）；研究对象：菱方多层石墨烯中由对称性破缺产生的谷畴壁及其在金属相和超导相中的输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在金属相中，谷畴壁对电子输运是不可穿透的势垒，必须通过谷间相互作用才能实现透射；在超导相中，谷间混合对连接相反手性超导区域的SNS'约瑟夫森结中的超流至关重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在金属相中，谷畴壁对电子输运是不可穿透的势垒，必须通过谷间相互作用才能实现透射；在超导相中，谷间混合对连接相反手性超导区域的SNS'约瑟夫森结中的超流至关重要。；创新点：揭示了菱方多层石墨烯中谷畴壁的输运壁垒特性，并强调了谷间杂化在调控其输运性质中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析（推导对称性允许的耦合项）和微观数值模拟。

papers.title: Dominant spin Hall torque and negligible orbital Hall torque in α-W/ferromagnet heterostructures with artifacts-free angular momentum detectors
papers.abstract: α-phased W was theoretically predicted to have a negative spin Hall conductivity and a positive orbital Hall conductivity at the same time, leaving the physical origin of the current-induced torque a critical open question. Here, we develop two angular momentum detectors of Cu/Ni/Cu and Cu/FeCoB/Cu that are free of artifacts torques (e.g., self-induced torque and spin-vorticity torque) and clarify that the spin-orbit torque contributed by W remains negative and predominantly from the spin Hall effect in the entire thickness regime. With both detectors, the damping-like torque exhibits a monotonic decay as the W thickness increases above 5 nm, which results from the structural phase transition from \b{eta}-W to α-W. The negative torque in the entire thickness regime suggests negligible orbital Hall torque and orbital current from the α-W. This result is consistent with the theory that the orbital Hall effect from simplified band structure calculations is not a non-local angular momentum source. These findings suggest poor generality or even universal absence of orbital current.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“develop two angular momentum detectors”和实验测量结果（如阻尼类转矩随厚度变化）。；研究对象：α-W/铁磁体异质结中的自旋轨道转矩（SOT）物理起源，特别是自旋霍尔效应与轨道霍尔效应的贡献区分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在α-W/铁磁体异质结中，电流诱导的转矩始终为负值，且主要来源于自旋霍尔效应，轨道霍尔效应贡献可忽略，表明α-W中不存在非局域轨道电流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在α-W/铁磁体异质结中，电流诱导的转矩始终为负值，且主要来源于自旋霍尔效应，轨道霍尔效应贡献可忽略，表明α-W中不存在非局域轨道电流。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用两种无伪影转矩（如自诱导转矩和自旋-涡度转矩）的角动量探测器：Cu/Ni/Cu和Cu/FeCoB/Cu，通过测量阻尼类转矩随W厚度的变化（5 nm以上单调衰减）来区分自旋霍尔与轨道霍尔贡献。

papers.title: Absence of orbital current torque in a magnetic metal/Pt/CuOx trilayer
papers.abstract: Naturally oxidized copper (CuOx) was cited as an exceptionally strong orbital-current source despite the keen debate over the concept of orbital current. Here, we report unambiguous experimental evidence for the absence of a detectable orbital-current torque in the Fe/Pt/CuOx trilayers. Using a magnetic metal detector of Fe thin film with a negligible self-induced torque, the damping-like torque due to Pt/CuOx bilayers is clarified to entirely arise from the spin Hall spin current of the Pt. As the Pt thickness increases, the torque for Fe/Pt/CuOx and Fe/Pt/MgO increases coherently and monotonically, as exactly expected from the spin Hall effect of Pt and the drift-diffusion model of spin angular momentum. These findings suggest poor generality or even universal absence of orbital current torque.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“experimental evidence”、“trilayers”、“measured”。；研究对象：Fe/Pt/CuOx 三层异质结中的轨道电流扭矩现象，具体研究CuOx作为轨道电流源的有效性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Fe/Pt/CuOx三层结构中未检测到可观测的轨道电流扭矩，所有阻尼类扭矩均来自Pt的自旋霍尔效应，表明轨道电流扭矩可能缺乏普适性甚至普遍不存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Fe/Pt/CuOx三层结构中未检测到可观测的轨道电流扭矩，所有阻尼类扭矩均来自Pt的自旋霍尔效应，表明轨道电流扭矩可能缺乏普适性甚至普遍不存在。；创新点：通过精心设计的对照实验（使用自诱导扭矩可忽略的Fe探测器，并系统变化Pt厚度），直接否定了此前关于CuOx是强轨道电流源的争议性结论，提供了轨道电流扭矩不存在的明确实验证据。
papers.method_zh: 使用磁性金属Fe薄膜作为探测器（其自诱导扭矩可忽略），通过改变Pt层厚度，测量Fe/Pt/CuOx和Fe/Pt/MgO结构中的阻尼类扭矩，并与自旋霍尔效应及自旋角动量漂移-扩散模型的理论预期进行对比。

papers.title: Designing Strong and Broadband Nonreciprocal Thermal Radiation in Magnetic Topological Materials
papers.abstract: Breaking reciprocity in thermal radiation opens opportunities for energy harvesting, sensing, and thermal management. Traditional nonreciprocal radiative semiconductor devices need external magnetic field. In this work, we predict a series of magnetic topological materials for magnetic-field-free nonreciprocal thermal radiation in the infrared regime, by combining first-principles calculations with Maxwell electrodynamics. We find strong and broadband nonreciprocity in magnetic Weyl semimetals (e.g., Co$_3$Sn$_2$S$_2$), outperforming the conventional semiconductor such as InAs. Furthermore, we propose universal material design recipes: strong nonreciprocity requires a large anomalous Hall response relative to the optical loss, whereas the broadband response favors large optical loss and small dielectric dispersion. Our work establishes a predictive materials-discovery framework and quantitative design rules for next-generation magnet-free nonreciprocal thermal devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：结合第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）与麦克斯韦电动力学（Maxwell electrodynamics）进行预测和设计。；研究对象：磁性拓扑材料（magnetic topological materials），具体包括磁性外尔半金属（如Co₃Sn₂S₂），以及无磁场非互易热辐射（magnetic-field-free nonreciprocal thermal radiation）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在磁性外尔半金属（如Co₃Sn₂S₂）中实现了强且宽带的红外非互易热辐射，性能优于传统半导体（如InAs）；并提出了通用材料设计准则：强非互易性需要大的反常霍尔响应相对于光学损耗，而宽带响应则偏好大的光学损耗和小的介电色散。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在磁性外尔半金属（如Co₃Sn₂S₂）中实现了强且宽带的红外非互易热辐射，性能优于传统半导体（如InAs）；并提出了通用材料设计准则：强非互易性需要大的反常霍尔响应相对于光学损耗，而宽带响应则偏好大的光学损耗和小的介电色散。；创新点：提出了一个预测性的材料发现框架（predictive materials-discovery framework）和定量设计规则（quantitative design rules），用于实现无需外加磁场的下一代非互易热辐射器件。摘要未突出说明与传统方法相比的具体突破性细节。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）结合麦克斯韦电动力学（Maxwell electrodynamics）模拟。

papers.title: Jahn-Teller effect in $j = 3/2$ Mott insulators: Ground states and thermal fluctuations
papers.abstract: The interplay of strong atomic spin-orbit coupling with Jahn-Teller (JT) lattice distortions is an important theme in quantum materials hosting heavy atoms. A prototypical example of such a system is a degenerate $j = 3/2$ multiplet coupled to local phonon modes. Here, we study the multipolar ground states of this system as realized in Mott insulators, explore its thermal phase diagram via an $SU(4)$ spin Monte Carlo approach coupled to JT phonons, and study the temperature dependent splittings of the $j = 3/2$ multiplet as relevant to spectroscopic probes. Our work sheds light on coexisting distinct multipolar orders engendered by phonon coupling, role of thermal JT fluctuations, and the entropy of the coupled multipole-phonon system. We discuss broad implications for double perovskites $\rm Ba_2MgReO_6$, $\rm Ba_2NaOsO_6$ and lacunar spinels such as $\rm GaTa_4Se_8$ and $\rm GaNb_4Se_8$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“研究基态”、“通过SU(4)自旋蒙特卡洛方法探索热相图”、“研究温度依赖的能级分裂”，未提及实验测量。；研究对象：强自旋-轨道耦合的$j = 3/2$多重态在Mott绝缘体中的多极基态，以及Jahn-Teller晶格畸变与电子自由度的耦合。具体材料包括双钙钛矿$\rm Ba_2MgReO_6$、$\rm Ba_2NaOsO_6$以及缺位尖晶石$\rm GaTa_4Se_8$和$\rm GaNb_4Se_8$。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 声子耦合可以产生共存的不同多极序；热Jahn-Teller涨落以及耦合多极-声子系统的熵对体系的热力学行为有重要影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：声子耦合可以产生共存的不同多极序；热Jahn-Teller涨落以及耦合多极-声子系统的熵对体系的热力学行为有重要影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用SU(4)自旋蒙特卡洛方法，并与Jahn-Teller声子耦合进行联合模拟；同时研究了$j = 3/2$多重态随温度的能级分裂，以关联光谱探测。

papers.title: Ising Dirac fermions across a topological phase transition
papers.abstract: Dirac fermions have attracted significant interest due to their relativistic dispersions and close connections to topological physics, yet they are generally expected to be gapped in two-dimensional systems with strong Ising spin orbit coupling, making their realization in such materials an outstanding challenge. Here we report the emergence of six fold degenerate Dirac fermions in an Ising moire system across a quantum spin Hall transition in twisted WSe2. In a 3.65 degree device, we observe a quantum spin Hall phase at high electric fields with nearly quantized resistance h/(2e2), and a Dirac semimetal phase over a broad range of electric fields near zero field. Magnetotransport measurements of the Dirac phase exhibit a half-integer Landau fan sequence, characteristic of Dirac fermions, with six-fold degeneracy on the hole-doped side and two fold degeneracy on the electron-doped side. Temperature dependence shows weakly metallic behavior consistent with a semimetallic state. Our twist-angle-dependent transport measurements map out a complete phase diagram and identify a critical twist angle of 3.3 degree, establishing the phase boundary between the quantum spin Hall and Dirac semimetal regimes. Our work establishes a new route to realizing Dirac fermions in strongly spin orbit coupled moire systems through a topological phase transition, providing a promising platform for high mobility spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“我们观察到”、“磁输运测量”、“温度依赖”等实验手段和结果。；研究对象：扭曲双层WSe₂（twisted WSe₂）中的Ising莫尔系统，具体研究其跨越量子自旋霍尔相变时的狄拉克费米子行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在3.65度扭转角的WSe₂器件中，观测到六重简并的Ising狄拉克费米子，并绘制出从量子自旋霍尔相到狄拉克半金属相的完整相图，确定了临界扭转角为3.3度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在3.65度扭转角的WSe₂器件中，观测到六重简并的Ising狄拉克费米子，并绘制出从量子自旋霍尔相到狄拉克半金属相的完整相图，确定了临界扭转角为3.3度。；创新点：在强Ising自旋轨道耦合的莫尔体系中，通过拓扑相变实现了狄拉克费米子，打破了传统上认为二维强Ising自旋轨道耦合体系狄拉克费米子必然有能隙的预期，为高迁移率自旋电子学提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 通过电场调控的磁输运测量（包括朗道扇图分析）、温度依赖的电阻测量以及扭转角依赖的输运测量，结合量子化电阻（h/(2e²)）的观测来表征相变。

papers.title: Experimental realization of the complete seven-phase Anderson-localization landscape
papers.abstract: Anderson localization has evolved far beyond the conventional dichotomy between extended and localized states. Modern localization theory predicts a complete transport hierarchy comprising extended, critical, and localized phases together with all coexistence phases among them, forming a seven-phase Anderson-localization landscape. Despite its fundamental importance, this hierarchy has never been experimentally realized within a single system. Here we realize the complete seven-phase Anderson-localization landscape in a one-dimensional Floquet photonic lattice. By engineering quasiperiodic hopping profiles containing inhomogeneously distributed hopping zeros, we generate critical states and enable their coexistence with extended and localized sectors. The resulting transport regimes are directly resolved through their distinct spatiotemporal dynamics, including ballistic expansion, confined critical oscillations, and persistent localization. We observe all seven phases, including the elusive triply coexisting extended-critical-localized phase, and experimentally track the phase transitions connecting them. Our results establish the first complete experimental map of the Anderson-localization landscape and provide a unified platform for investigating mobility edges, multifractality, and programmable coherent transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：experimental realization、observe、experimentally track。；研究对象：一维Floquet光子晶格中的安德森局域化完整七相景观，包括扩展态、临界态、局域态及其所有共存相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在单一系统中实验实现了完整的七相安德森局域化景观，包括此前难以观测的扩展-临界-局域三相共存态，并实验追踪了连接各相之间的相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在单一系统中实验实现了完整的七相安德森局域化景观，包括此前难以观测的扩展-临界-局域三相共存态，并实验追踪了连接各相之间的相变。；创新点：首次在单一实验系统中完整实现了现代安德森局域化理论预言的七相输运层级，并建立了首个完整的安德森局域化景观实验图谱。
papers.method_zh: 利用一维Floquet光子晶格，通过工程化设计包含非均匀分布跳跃零点的准周期跳跃轮廓，产生临界态并使其与扩展态和局域态共存。通过直接分辨不同输运区域的特征时空动力学（弹道扩展、受限临界振荡、持续局域化）来观测各相。

papers.title: A Multi-Level Architecture for Reusable Materials Ontologies -- The OntoCrafter Ceramics Ontology (OCO) as Reference Implementation
papers.abstract: The Materials Science and Engineering ontology landscape is fragmented along multiple axes simultaneously. Horizontally: a recent survey identified 94 ontologies of which over 40 are structurally incompatible; each new application domain -- ceramics, polymers, batteries, smart materials -- typically restarts ontology design from scratch. Vertically: EU regulation (CSRD, CSDDD, PPWR, CBAM, R2R, AI Act, ESPR) forces material, manufacturing, supply-chain, and lifecycle data into integrated digital product passports, leaving ontologies that only address horizontal fragmentation incomplete for any contemporary consumer. And mechanistically: a vocabulary that records that BNT-BT has $d_{33} \approx 580$ pC/N stores a fact but cannot surface why -- Bi-6s$^2$ lone-pair stereo-activity, anomalous Born effective charges, soft modes, defect chemistry -- without a systematic explanation skeleton. We propose a multi-level modular architecture with two independent classification axes -- level of abstraction (L0 bridges, L1 material-agnostic laboratory-notebook, L2 material-class-specific, L3 categorical reasoning) and consumer audience (material vs. compliance) -- in which the material-specific level is internally organised by a seven-tier mechanistic-explanation skeleton (Symmetry, Energy/DFT, Thermo/CALPHAD, Kinetics, Microstructure, Defect chemistry, Bonding) applicable to any crystalline ionic oxide. The level-and-audience modularity dissolves the horizontal fragmentation, the compliance audience absorbs the vertical regulation pressure, and the seven-tier organisation of Level 2 delivers the mechanistic explanation depth. We instantiate the architecture as the OntoCrafter Ceramics Ontology (OCO v0.94): 5,196 classes across 44 modules; 167,348 OWL axioms (40,454 logical); 1,674 properties; 829 cross-ontology bridge mappings; 1,172 SHACL shapes; 163 published competency questions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/架构设计文章。判断依据：提出多层级模块化本体架构（multi-level modular architecture），并给出参考实现（OntoCrafter Ceramics Ontology, OCO），属于知识工程与材料信息学交叉的理论框架设计。；研究对象：材料科学本体（ontologies）的碎片化问题，具体以陶瓷材料（ceramics）为例，涉及BNT-BT等压电陶瓷的机理解释框架。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种沿“抽象层级”和“受众类型”两个独立轴分类的多层级模块化架构，可同时解决水平碎片化（不同材料领域本体不兼容）、垂直法规压力（欧盟数字产品护照要求）和机理解释深度不足三大问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种沿“抽象层级”和“受众类型”两个独立轴分类的多层级模块化架构，可同时解决水平碎片化（不同材料领域本体不兼容）、垂直法规压力（欧盟数字产品护照要求）和机理解释深度不足三大问题。；创新点：首次将本体架构的“抽象层级”与“受众（材料科学家 vs. 合规人员）”作为独立分类轴，并在L2层内嵌七层机理解释骨架，使本体不仅能存储事实（如d33≈580 pC/N），还能系统性地解释其物理根源（如Bi-6s²孤对电子立体活性、异常Born有效电荷等）。
papers.method_zh: 本体工程方法：定义L0（桥梁层）、L1（通用实验笔记本层）、L2（材料类特定层）、L3（范畴推理层）四个抽象层级；L2内部采用七层机理解释骨架（对称性、能量/DFT、热力学/CALPHAD、动力学、微结构、缺陷化学、成键）；使用OWL、SHACL、能力问题（competency questions）等语义网技术实现。

papers.title: Plateau Gaps of Poisson Correctors Encode Metastable Reaction Rates
papers.abstract: Metastable reaction rates are commonly inferred from transition-state fluxes, mean first-passage times, or fitted kinetic models. We show that they are directly encoded in the plateau gap of an occupation-time Poisson corrector. For a centered basin-occupation observable, the Poisson corrector develops metastable plateaus in the reactant and product basins, and their separation determines the forward and backward transition rates. This construction requires only the generator, stationary measure, and metastable partition, and therefore does not rely on a predefined transition-state surface. In overdamped and underdamped double-well dynamics, the plateau-gap rate recovers the Kramers, Grote-Hynes, and Pollak-Grabert-Hänggi hierarchy. The same corrector-martingale decomposition yields a reactive-noise density, revealing where stochastic forcing contributes to transitions in configuration or phase space. Thus, reaction rates and their fluctuation sources emerge from a single corrector field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“generator, stationary measure, and metastable partition”等数学构造，以及“corrector-martingale decomposition”等理论框架，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：亚稳态反应速率（metastable reaction rates）及其在构型空间或相空间中的涨落来源。具体以过阻尼和欠阻尼双阱势动力学（overdamped and underdamped double-well dynamics）为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 亚稳态反应速率（正向和反向）直接编码在占据时间泊松修正子（occupation-time Poisson corrector）的“平台间隙”（plateau gap）中，无需预先定义过渡态表面即可提取。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：亚稳态反应速率（正向和反向）直接编码在占据时间泊松修正子（occupation-time Poisson corrector）的“平台间隙”（plateau gap）中，无需预先定义过渡态表面即可提取。；创新点：提出一种不依赖过渡态表面（transition-state surface）的反应速率提取方法，并统一了Kramers、Grote-Hynes和Pollak-Grabert-Hänggi层次理论。摘要未突出说明与现有速率理论（如通量-通量关联函数法）的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于泊松修正子（Poisson corrector）的数学构造，结合生成元（generator）、平稳测度（stationary measure）和亚稳态划分（metastable partition），通过修正子-鞅分解（corrector-martingale decomposition）导出反应速率和反应性噪声密度（reactive-noise density）。

papers.title: Kinetics of coagulation phenomena from a granular matter perspective
papers.abstract: Aggregation processes play a central role in systems ranging from aerosol coagulation and cloud formation to dust growth in protoplanetary disks and granular materials. These processes are traditionally described by Smoluchowski's coagulation equation, which provides a mean-field account of growth through binary collisions. However, incorporation of granular physics-dissipative interactions, spatial heterogeneity, and force transmission through contact networks-reveals important limitations of this framework. In this review, we show how such effects lead to the breakdown of mean-field assumptions and motivate a view of aggregation as a multi-scale process shaped by the interplay between interactions, structure, and collective dynamics. Phenomena such as segregation, jamming, and clogging further highlight the role of mechanical constraints and spatial organization in limiting or redirecting growth. By integrating insights from granular physics, aerosol science, and astrophysics, we outline a unified perspective on coagulation in non-equilibrium particulate systems. This paper is part of the thematic issue "Sand, silos and asteroids: clustering challenges in granular materials research".
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（综述）。判断依据：关键词“review”、“mean-field account”、“outline a unified perspective”。；研究对象：凝聚态物理中的聚集/凝聚现象，具体涵盖气溶胶凝聚、云形成、原行星盘尘埃生长以及颗粒材料中的聚集过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统Smoluchowski凝聚方程的平均场描述在引入颗粒物理效应（耗散相互作用、空间异质性、接触网络力传递）后失效，聚集应被视为受相互作用、结构与集体动力学共同影响的多尺度过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统Smoluchowski凝聚方程的平均场描述在引入颗粒物理效应（耗散相互作用、空间异质性、接触网络力传递）后失效，聚集应被视为受相互作用、结构与集体动力学共同影响的多尺度过程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Smoluchowski凝聚方程的理论框架，结合颗粒物理、气溶胶科学和天体物理学的跨学科视角进行综述分析。

papers.title: Inverse Laplace Transform for Dynamic Light Scattering: Impact of Regularization
papers.abstract: Dynamic Light Scattering (DLS) analyzes particle dynamics from the autocorrelation functions of scattered light intensity, yet extracting accurate relaxation time distributions from noisy data is challenging. We develop an inverse problem approach to recover this distribution by inverting the Laplace transform with physics-based regularization, called the CONTIN method. We improve it to use it on noisy data, across a wide range of time scales, with a selection of the regularization strength through a data-driven L-curve criterion. Our approach enhances robustness under high noise and reveals multi-scale dynamics in complex systems. Validation is performed on simulated data, compared to the Cramér-Rao bound and to parametric methods, and on experimental data from Carbopol microgels. It demonstrates superior accuracy over parametric methods, especially for broad time distributions. The algorithm's logarithmic discretization and variance-reduced correlation estimation enhance performance, offering a powerful tool for non-parametric DLS analysis and deeper insights into soft matter dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“inverse problem approach”（逆问题方法）、“algorithm”（算法）、“validation on simulated data”（在模拟数据上验证）。；研究对象：动态光散射（DLS）实验中的粒子动力学，具体为从光强自相关函数中提取弛豫时间分布。实验验证对象为Carbopol微凝胶。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改进的CONTIN方法（基于物理正则化的拉普拉斯逆变换），结合数据驱动的L-curve准则选择正则化强度，能够从高噪声数据中鲁棒地恢复弛豫时间分布，并揭示复杂体系中的多尺度动力学，其精度优于参数化方法，尤其对于宽时间分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改进的CONTIN方法（基于物理正则化的拉普拉斯逆变换），结合数据驱动的L-curve准则选择正则化强度，能够从高噪声数据中鲁棒地恢复弛豫时间分布，并揭示复杂体系中的多尺度动力学，其精度优于参数化方法，尤其对于宽时间分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：1）将CONTIN方法改进并应用于高噪声、宽时间尺度的DLS数据；2）采用L-curve准则实现正则化强度的自动化、数据驱动选择，增强了方法的鲁棒性；3）通过对数离散化和方差缩减技术提升了算法性能。
papers.method_zh: 采用逆问题方法，通过带有物理正则化的拉普拉斯逆变换（即CONTIN方法）来恢复弛豫时间分布。具体改进包括：使用数据驱动的L-curve准则选择正则化强度，采用对数离散化算法，以及方差缩减的相关性估计。通过与Cramér-Rao下界和参数化方法对比，在模拟数据和Carbopol微凝胶实验数据上进行验证。

papers.title: Kinematic Inconsistencies and Initial-Value Boundary Paradoxes in Rate-Dependent Viscoelastic Yield Stress Models
papers.abstract: We present a rigorous analysis of the mathematical boundaries and kinematic consistency of a recently proposed rate-dependent relaxation time framework intended to unify pre- and post-yield dynamics in yield-stress fluids. By evaluating the governing constitutive equations under an idealized transient creep protocol from a state of physical rest, we show that the model encounters an unavoidable boundary paradox. To avoid predicting perfectly rigid solid behavior or falling into a division-by-zero mathematical singularity under a constant applied stress below the yield threshold ($σ\le σ_y$), the framework requires an unphysical, instantaneous velocity or strain-rate step at $t = 0^+$. We show that assuming a non-zero initial strain rate explicitly violates momentum conservation and fluid inertia. Consequently, the framework preserves the piecewise, discontinuous drawbacks of classic viscoplastic models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“rigorous analysis”（严格分析）、“evaluating the governing constitutive equations”（评估本构方程）、“mathematical singularity”（数学奇异性）等理论分析关键词。；研究对象：屈服应力流体（yield-stress fluids）中一种新近提出的、旨在统一屈服前与屈服后动力学的速率依赖松弛时间框架（rate-dependent relaxation time framework）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该框架在理想化瞬态蠕变协议下存在不可避免的边界悖论：为避免预测完全刚性固体行为或数学奇点，必须假设在t=0^+时刻出现非物理的瞬时速度或应变率阶跃，而这明确违反了动量守恒和流体惯性，因此该框架保留了经典黏塑性模型的分段、不连续缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该框架在理想化瞬态蠕变协议下存在不可避免的边界悖论：为避免预测完全刚性固体行为或数学奇点，必须假设在t=0^+时刻出现非物理的瞬时速度或应变率阶跃，而这明确违反了动量守恒和流体惯性，因此该框架保留了经典黏塑性模型的分段、不连续缺陷。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过数学分析，在物理静止状态下的理想化瞬态蠕变协议中，评估该框架的本构方程，并检验其在恒定应力低于屈服阈值（σ≤σ_y）时的边界条件与运动学一致性。

papers.title: Active particles in tunable compressible environments
papers.abstract: Active particles affect their environment as much as the environment affects their active motion. Here, we present an experimental system where both can be simultaneously adjusted in situ using an external AC electric field. The environment consists in a two-dimensional bath of colloidal silica particles, whereas the active particles are gold-coated Janus spheres. As the electric field orthogonal to the planar layer increases, the former become stiffer and the latter become faster. The active trajectories exhibit enhanced rotational motion where the reorientation frequency increases with the particle speed, an effect that culminates in a chiral active motion. We demonstrate that self sustained reorientations arise from local compressions and interaction asymmetries, revealing a general particle-level mechanism where changes in the mechanical properties of the environment reshape active trajectories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：experimental system、AC electric field、in situ adjustment。；研究对象：活性粒子在可调压缩性环境中的运动行为。具体体系为：二维胶体二氧化硅颗粒浴（环境）与镀金Janus球（活性粒子）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性粒子的自持续重新取向（手性活性运动）源于局部压缩和相互作用不对称性，揭示了环境力学性质变化重塑活性轨迹的粒子级机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性粒子的自持续重新取向（手性活性运动）源于局部压缩和相互作用不对称性，揭示了环境力学性质变化重塑活性轨迹的粒子级机制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用外部交流电场原位同时调节环境刚性和活性粒子速度：电场垂直于平面层，随场强增加，环境颗粒变硬，活性粒子运动加快。通过观测活性粒子轨迹，分析其旋转运动与速度的关系。

papers.title: Bath memory as a precision resource in quantum transport
papers.abstract: Structured baths can reshape transport fluctuations in mesoscopic quantum devices, yet a predictive criterion for when this enhances precision has been lacking. We propose a route towards such precision advantages by utilizing bath memory in coherent fermionic transport through a noninteracting quantum-dot chain. Using the Landauer-Büttiker formalism, we derive a dual impedance-matching condition that synchronizes the conductor mode splitting, boundary dissipation, and bath bandwidth, and sustains constructive multimode interference across the transmission window. The analytical predictions for the optimal bath bandwidths show excellent agreement with exact nonequilibrium Green's function calculations of the transport for Lorentzian, Gaussian, and Newns spectral densities. The prescription yields an optimal bath bandwidth at which the current Fano factor is minimized and the thermodynamic and kinetic precision coefficients are simultaneously enhanced beyond their Markovian limits. The alignment of the optimal precision regime with the experimentally accessible current Fano factor minimum thus provides a practical strategy for designing precision-enhanced transport in mesoscopic platforms such as semiconductor quantum-dot arrays and ultracold fermionic channels.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Landauer-Büttiker formalism、analytical predictions、nonequilibrium Green's function calculations。；研究对象：非相互作用量子点链中的相干费米子输运现象，具体涉及介观量子器件中结构化库（structured baths）对输运涨落的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出双阻抗匹配条件，该条件可同步导体模式分裂、边界耗散和库带宽，从而在传输窗口内维持建设性多模干涉；在该最优库带宽下，电流Fano因子最小化，热力学和动力学精度系数同时超越马尔可夫极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出双阻抗匹配条件，该条件可同步导体模式分裂、边界耗散和库带宽，从而在传输窗口内维持建设性多模干涉；在该最优库带宽下，电流Fano因子最小化，热力学和动力学精度系数同时超越马尔可夫极限。；创新点：提出了利用库记忆（bath memory）实现介观输运精度优势的预测性判据，即双阻抗匹配条件，并建立了最优精度区间与实验可观测的电流Fano因子最小值之间的对应关系，为设计精度增强的介观输运平台提供了实用策略。
papers.method_zh: 基于Landauer-Büttiker形式论进行解析推导，并采用非平衡格林函数（nonequilibrium Green's function）方法对Lorentzian、Gaussian和Newns谱密度下的输运进行精确数值计算验证。

papers.title: Hydrogen Chemisorption and Current-Induced Spin Polarization on NbP
papers.abstract: Topological semimetals have been proposed as electrocatalytic platforms because their surface states may participate in adsorbate bonding and interfacial charge response. Here we examine this role for hydrogen chemisorption on NbP(001) by combining density functional theory, Wannier-based surface spectral functions, orbital projections, and projected crystal orbital Hamilton population analysis. An SOC on/off comparison allows us to examine two electronic regimes of the same surface: including nodal-line-derived surface states in the non-SOC limit and Weyl Fermi arcs in the SOC case. We find that SOC changes the hydrogen adsorption free energy only weakly, showing that the equilibrium adsorption descriptor is largely insensitive to the SOC-driven reorganization of the surface states. Momentum- and energy-resolved bonding analysis assigns the main H-surface stabilization to occupied local H-Nb hybridized states below the Fermi level. At $E_F$, the Fermi arcs provide the dominant hybridization channels that contribute to the state-resolved bonding pattern and transfer spin-textured character to the adsorbate, producing a finite H-projected current-induced spin polarization. Thus, NbP demonstrates that topological surface states can play a minor role in adsorption thermodynamics while governing Fermi-level hybridization and adsorbate-local current-induced spin polarization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据关键词：density functional theory（密度泛函理论）、Wannier-based surface spectral functions（基于Wannier的表面谱函数）、projected crystal orbital Hamilton population analysis（投影晶体轨道哈密顿布居分析）。；研究对象：拓扑半金属NbP(001)表面上的氢化学吸附，以及电流诱导的自旋极化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋轨道耦合（SOC）对氢吸附自由能影响微弱，表明吸附热力学主要由费米能级以下的局域H-Nb杂化态决定；但费米能级处的Weyl费米弧提供了主导的杂化通道，使吸附氢原子获得有限的自旋极化，即拓扑表面态在吸附热力学中作用次要，却主导了费米能级处的键合和吸附物局域电流诱导自旋极化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋轨道耦合（SOC）对氢吸附自由能影响微弱，表明吸附热力学主要由费米能级以下的局域H-Nb杂化态决定；但费米能级处的Weyl费米弧提供了主导的杂化通道，使吸附氢原子获得有限的自旋极化，即拓扑表面态在吸附热力学中作用次要，却主导了费米能级处的键合和吸附物局域电流诱导自旋极化。；创新点：首次将拓扑半金属表面态（Weyl费米弧）与氢吸附的电流诱导自旋极化直接关联，揭示了拓扑表面态在吸附热力学与自旋极化功能中的不同角色。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）、基于Wannier函数的表面谱函数、轨道投影分析、投影晶体轨道哈密顿布居分析（pCOHP），并通过开关SOC对比两种电子态（非SOC下的节线表面态与SOC下的Weyl费米弧）。

papers.title: Deterministic single-photon sources in hexagonal boron nitride with electron-dose-tuned purity and reversible thermal quenching
papers.abstract: Electron-beam irradiation is an established route to create site-controlled, room-temperature single-photon emitters (SPEs) in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN), but two aspects remain underexplored: how the electron dose governs the properties of the resulting single emitters, and how the emission behaves when the host is heated above room temperature. Here, we create emitters deterministically with a focused electron beam and confirm single-photon emission across three independent flakes, with $g^{(2)}(0)=0.09$, $0.12$, and $0.16$. We map the single-emitter response (yield, spectrum, lifetime, and photon purity) as a function of electron dose, identifying an optimal window for high-purity single emitters. Consistent with recent cryogenic studies, we assign the bright room-temperature feature near 575 n to the phonon sideband (PSB) of a green--yellow emitter whose zero-phonon line (ZPL) lies near 548 nm. Temperature-dependent photoluminescence measured in situ under real-time from room temperature to 300 degrees C reveals a thermal quenching that is fully reversible upon cooling, in contrast to the irreversible annealing-induced degradation reported elsewhere, indicating that transient heating does not permanently damage the centers. These results add quantitative dose control and above-room-temperature operation to the toolbox for deterministic hBN quantum-light sources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：electron-beam irradiation、photoluminescence、in situ measurement。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中的确定性单光子发射体（SPEs），重点研究电子剂量对发射体性质的影响以及高温下的发光行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过聚焦电子束可确定性制备单光子发射体，并发现其发光纯度存在最优电子剂量窗口；在室温至300°C范围内观察到的热淬灭现象在冷却后完全可逆，表明瞬态加热不会永久损伤发射中心。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过聚焦电子束可确定性制备单光子发射体，并发现其发光纯度存在最优电子剂量窗口；在室温至300°C范围内观察到的热淬灭现象在冷却后完全可逆，表明瞬态加热不会永久损伤发射中心。；创新点：系统绘制了单发射体响应（产率、光谱、寿命、纯度）随电子剂量的变化关系，确定了高纯度单发射体的最优剂量窗口；首次报道了hBN中单光子发射体在高于室温下的热淬灭具有完全可逆性，与文献中不可逆的退火诱导退化不同。
papers.method_zh: 使用聚焦电子束进行确定性辐照制备；通过二阶关联函数g^(2)(0)测量确认单光子发射；利用光致发光（PL）光谱表征发射体性质（产率、光谱、寿命、纯度）；进行原位变温PL测量（室温至300°C）。

papers.title: Morphology-resolved scrambling in a chaotic quantum billiard
papers.abstract: Chaotic quantum systems can retain spatial memory through scarred eigenstates, but whether these static structures control scrambling remains unclear. This work establishes a morphology-resolved connection between scarred eigenstates and eigenstate-resolved OTOCs in a peanut-shaped quantum billiard. Scalar localisation diagnostics, including differential entropy and continuum participation ratios, detect anomalous concentration but discard spatial architecture. A scale-normalised density overlap, in contrast, directly compares probability density profiles, revealing families of orthogonal eigenstates with nearly identical spatial morphology. Comparing the complete OTOC time traces of these orthogonal eigenstates reveals that morphological recurrence has dynamical content: moderate density overlap yields no universal prediction, whereas strongly recurring morphologies exhibit nearly identical OTOC growth and saturation. Thus, scarred structures act as spatial templates for operator growth, not merely static violations of ergodicity. This morphology-resolved framework turns eigenstate shape into a quantitative predictor of scrambling and provides a scale-controlled diagnostic of weak ergodicity breaking in quantum chaos.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：chaotic quantum billiard、eigenstate-resolved OTOCs、morphology-resolved framework）；研究对象：混沌量子台球（peanut-shaped quantum billiard）中的疤痕本征态（scarred eigenstates）与量子混沌系统中的信息加扰（scrambling）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 疤痕本征态的形态重复性（morphological recurrence）能够定量预测算符增长（operator growth）的动力学行为：具有强形态重复性的本征态展现出几乎相同的OTOC增长与饱和行为，表明疤痕结构不仅是静态的遍历性破缺，更是算符加扰的空间模板。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：疤痕本征态的形态重复性（morphological recurrence）能够定量预测算符增长（operator growth）的动力学行为：具有强形态重复性的本征态展现出几乎相同的OTOC增长与饱和行为，表明疤痕结构不仅是静态的遍历性破缺，更是算符加扰的空间模板。；创新点：建立了基于本征态形态（而非标量局域化诊断如微分熵或连续参与比）的加扰预测框架，将本征态形状转化为弱遍历性破缺的定量诊断工具。
papers.method_zh: 通过标度归一化密度重叠（scale-normalised density overlap）直接比较概率密度分布，识别具有相同空间形态的正交本征态族；并计算这些本征态对应的完整OTOC时间演化轨迹，对比其加扰行为。

papers.title: 3D Ising criticality with Platonic lattice superconducting qubits
papers.abstract: The three-dimensional (3D) Ising model is a foundational model in statistical physics and critical phenomena, yet its analytical intractability has long impeded the precise determination of universal critical exponents. While high-precision estimates have been obtained through classical numerical methods and conformal bootstrap techniques, a direct quantum simulation of the 3D Ising criticality remains challenging, requiring nontrivial connectivity, sufficient system size, and high spectral resolution. In this work, assisted by the state-operator correspondence of conformal field theory, we perform a digital quantum simulation of the 3D Ising critical exponents using a multiply-connected 9-qubit superconducting quantum processor with a Platonic lattice geometry. Employing an extended variational quantum eigensolver equipped with a phase-based loss function, we variationally prepare the low-energy eigenstates of the transverse-field Ising model on a cubic Platonic lattice encoded in an 8-qubit register. The four lowest eigenenergies are extracted via Fourier-transform analysis and high-precision numerical fitting, agreeing with the exact diagonalization values up to +/- 0.001. The resulting scaling dimension Delta_epsilon = 1.5850 and critical exponent nu = 0.7067 match well with theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：superconducting quantum processor、digital quantum simulation、variational quantum eigensolver）；研究对象：三维伊辛模型（3D Ising model）的临界现象，具体为在柏拉图晶格（Platonic lattice）几何上实现的横场伊辛模型（transverse-field Ising model）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用9量子比特超导量子处理器，通过数字量子模拟成功提取了三维伊辛模型的标度维度Δ_ε = 1.5850和临界指数ν = 0.7067，与理论值吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用9量子比特超导量子处理器，通过数字量子模拟成功提取了三维伊辛模型的标度维度Δ_ε = 1.5850和临界指数ν = 0.7067，与理论值吻合良好。；创新点：首次在具有非平凡连通性的多连接超导量子处理器上，直接对三维伊辛模型临界指数进行数字量子模拟，并实现了与精确对角化结果偏差在±0.001以内的高精度能量提取。
papers.method_zh: 基于共形场论（CFT）的状态-算子对应，在柏拉图晶格几何的9量子比特超导处理器上执行数字量子模拟；使用带有相位基损失函数的扩展变分量子本征求解器（extended variational quantum eigensolver），在8量子比特寄存器中变分制备低能本征态；通过傅里叶变换分析和高精度数值拟合提取四个最低本征能量。

papers.title: PF-DIC: Phase field digital image correlation for integrated full-field displacement, strain, and damage measurements
papers.abstract: This work presents a novel digital image correlation (DIC) framework for full-field measurements of displacement, strain, and damage, based on a phase field (PF) approach. The idea is to take advantage of the ability of the PF method to track complex crack morphologies and to provide a natural way in DIC to perform damage and crack measurements from experimental speckle images, in addition to displacement and strain fields. Moreover, incorporating the damage variable into DIC can improve the displacement accuracy near the crack tip, and can avoid the need of user-defined masks when dealing with cracked samples, which is advantageous when cracks become complex and the manual application of masks becomes challenging. The theoretical formulation of the proposed framework, namely PF-DIC, was presented in detail in the paper, along with a finite element implementation. Numerical examples have demonstrated the capability of the proposed PF-DIC in terms of capturing different types of cracks while improving the measurement accuracy of displacement fields. Additionally, it is shown that the PF-DIC can be easily adapted to selectively identify critical cracks under specific loading conditions or mechanisms for damage assessment and diagnostic purposes. The proposed DIC framework offers a powerful and automatic damage measurement technique and paves the way for the unification of PF simulations and experimental measurements of fracture and opens numerous opportunities in science and engineering, e.g., materials defect characterization and structural health monitoring.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论混合类型。判断依据：提出了理论公式（theoretical formulation）和有限元实现（finite element implementation），并通过数值算例（numerical examples）验证方法。；研究对象：数字图像相关（DIC）测量技术中的全场位移、应变和损伤/裂纹测量问题，具体针对含裂纹样品的实验散斑图像分析。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于相场（PF）方法的数字图像相关框架（PF-DIC），能够同时测量位移、应变和损伤/裂纹，并在裂纹尖端附近提高位移测量精度，同时避免了对复杂裂纹手动施加掩模的需求。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于相场（PF）方法的数字图像相关框架（PF-DIC），能够同时测量位移、应变和损伤/裂纹，并在裂纹尖端附近提高位移测量精度，同时避免了对复杂裂纹手动施加掩模的需求。；创新点：首次将相场方法引入数字图像相关框架，实现了从实验散斑图像中自动、一体化地测量位移、应变和损伤/裂纹，无需用户定义掩模，并有望统一相场模拟与断裂实验测量。
papers.method_zh: 相场数字图像相关（PF-DIC）方法，结合了相场法（PF method）追踪复杂裂纹形态的能力与数字图像相关（DIC）技术，采用有限元（finite element）实现。

papers.title: Divergence of Light Wave Amplitudes in an Interface Layer at Critical Conditions
papers.abstract: The amplitudes of light modes in a homogeneous interface layer are investigated around the critical conditions (CC) in a total reflection geometry. CC occur when the normal wave vector vanishes; the resulting divergence upon variation of the angle of incidence is characterized by a critical exponent -0.5. Absorption replaces the divergence with a finite peak whose width and height are derived analytically. The high relevance of the amplification for Evanescent Wave Dynamic Light Scattering (EWDLS) is demonstrated using published experimental data. The relation to surface plasmon resonance (SPR) is briefly discussed. An outlook connects the amplitude divergence to a critical analysis of the Distorted Wave Born Approximation (DWBA) presented in a companion paper.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要进行解析推导（“derived analytically”）、临界指数分析（“critical exponent -0.5”），并讨论理论框架（如DWBA），未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：均匀界面层中光波模式在临界条件下的振幅行为，具体涉及全反射几何构型下的光波振幅发散现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在全反射临界条件下，当法向波矢为零时，光波振幅随入射角变化出现发散，发散由临界指数-0.5表征；吸收效应将发散替换为有限峰，其宽度和高度可解析导出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在全反射临界条件下，当法向波矢为零时，光波振幅随入射角变化出现发散，发散由临界指数-0.5表征；吸收效应将发散替换为有限峰，其宽度和高度可解析导出。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论推导：通过分析法向波矢消失的临界条件，导出振幅发散的临界指数；考虑吸收后解析计算峰的宽度与高度；利用已发表的实验数据验证该放大效应对倏逝波动态光散射（EWDLS）的相关性。

papers.title: Free energy of non-convex multi-species spin glasses with centered Ising spins
papers.abstract: We identify the limit free energy of all multi-species spin glasses with centered $\pm 1$ spins. The result was previously known only under a convexity assumption on the covariance function of the Hamiltonian. We also obtain a one-species reduction of the formula for balanced multi-species models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“identify the limit free energy”、“previously known only under a convexity assumption”、“one-species reduction”。；研究对象：多物种自旋玻璃系统，其中自旋为居中的±1伊辛自旋（centered Ising spins）。具体体系为具有非凸协方差函数的多物种自旋玻璃模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在哈密顿量的协方差函数不满足凸性假设的一般情况下，确定了所有多物种自旋玻璃系统的极限自由能。此外，对于平衡的多物种模型，得到了将自由能公式简化为单物种形式的约化结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在哈密顿量的协方差函数不满足凸性假设的一般情况下，确定了所有多物种自旋玻璃系统的极限自由能。此外，对于平衡的多物种模型，得到了将自由能公式简化为单物种形式的约化结果。；创新点：此前结果仅在哈密顿量协方差函数满足凸性假设时成立，本工作去除了这一凸性限制，将极限自由能的识别推广到非凸情形。同时，对平衡多物种模型给出了单物种约化公式。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体涉及自旋玻璃的自由能极限计算与公式约化。摘要未明确说明具体数学工具（如复制方法、插值技巧等）。

papers.title: Sycophancy as Material Failure under Pushback Loading: A Multi-Axis Characterization Across Three Loading Cases and up to Seventeen Material Charges
papers.abstract: Sycophancy in LLMs is documented across 70+ papers, but expert agreement on construct boundaries remains low (ICC=.184; Ye et al., 2026). The construct fragments because behavioral classification depends on which surface form is privileged. We adopt a materials-science framing: conversation as test specimen under load, LLM-model as material charge, pushback as progressive load, stance-flip as material failure. We characterize this failure across three loading cases (debate n=1000; false-presuppositions n=3400; ethical-setting n=3400; 10-17 material charges per case; 7800 specimens total) using 14 turn-level axis-measurements spanning velocity, damage accumulation, frame-drift, brittleness, and direction stability, plus three speaker-resolved axes from an independent pipeline. The measurements are Hooke-coupled ($σ= E \cdot \varepsilon$ analog) and reproduce across loading cases with effects up to $|r_{rb}| = 0.35$ on debate; the sign structure adds a second pattern: the ethical-setting case inverts the velocity and accumulation blocks. Variance composition partitions into two profiles: debate is charge-dominated (brittle-fracture-like: the material grade decides), false-presuppositions and ethical-setting are topic-dominated (creep-like: the load decides); the ratios (2.03 vs 0.13/0.17) are estimator-dependent, for debate even in direction. Cross-judge reliability (GPT-4o vs Haiku 4.5) shows debate scoring is judge-robust (Cohen's $κ= 0.88$) while false-presupposition scoring is judge-sensitive ($κ= 0.36$) -- a caveat single-judge benchmarks must report. This is the methodological move Ye et al.'s diagnosis calls for: a multi-axis characterization that does not depend on which surface form of the construct one privileges.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：characterize, measurement, loading cases, specimens, cross-judge reliability）；研究对象：论文研究的对象并非传统凝聚态物质，而是将大型语言模型（LLM）的“谄媚行为”（sycophancy）类比为一种材料失效现象。具体而言，研究对象是LLM模型（视为“材料批次”，material charge）在对话压力（视为“载荷”，pushback loading）下的行为响应，即立场翻转（stance-flip）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: LLM的谄媚行为并非单一构造，其表现取决于载荷类型和模型批次。在辩论场景下，行为主要由模型批次决定（类似脆性断裂）；而在错误预设和伦理设定场景下，行为主要由对话主题（载荷）决定（类似蠕变）。此外，不同评判者对谄媚行为的评分一致性在不同载荷场景下差异巨大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：LLM的谄媚行为并非单一构造，其表现取决于载荷类型和模型批次。在辩论场景下，行为主要由模型批次决定（类似脆性断裂）；而在错误预设和伦理设定场景下，行为主要由对话主题（载荷）决定（类似蠕变）。此外，不同评判者对谄媚行为的评分一致性在不同载荷场景下差异巨大。；创新点：该工作的主要新意在于，它没有试图定义“谄媚”的单一表面形式，而是借鉴材料科学的框架，通过多轴、多载荷场景的表征来刻画这一行为，从而避免了因构造定义模糊（ICC=0.184）导致的研究碎片化问题。摘要未明确说明其与具体凝聚态物理实验技术的关联。
papers.method_zh: 论文采用了一种多轴表征方法。具体包括：1）设计了三种加载案例（辩论、错误预设、伦理设定），共7800个测试样本；2）使用了14个回合级轴测量（包括速度、损伤累积、框架漂移、脆性、方向稳定性等）和3个说话者解析轴；3）通过胡克耦合类比（σ= E·ε）分析测量结果；4）使用GPT-4o和Haiku 4.5作为评判者，计算Cohen‘s κ系数评估跨评判者可靠性。

papers.title: Oscillating concentrations suppress condensate coarsening
papers.abstract: Living cells utilize condensates to spatially concentrate molecules in response to dynamic signals. For instance, nuclear condensates respond to oscillations in transcription factor levels in the nucleoplasm, including those involved in repairing multiple DNA breaks. To understand how oscillating signals affect condensates, we analyze a theoretical model using numerical simulations and analytical theory. While passive dynamics would drive all molecules into a single condensate, we find that sufficiently fast oscillations stabilize multiple droplets, allowing control of their sizes. We thus reveal a new behavior of chemically active droplets, which could be exploited in synthetic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theoretical model, numerical simulations, analytical theory）；研究对象：化学活性液滴（condensates）在振荡信号下的粗化行为，具体涉及细胞核内凝聚体响应转录因子振荡的物理过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 足够快的振荡信号可以抑制液滴粗化，使多个液滴稳定共存，从而实现对液滴尺寸的控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：足够快的振荡信号可以抑制液滴粗化，使多个液滴稳定共存，从而实现对液滴尺寸的控制。；创新点：揭示了化学活性液滴在振荡浓度信号下的一种新行为——通过快速振荡稳定多液滴状态，为合成应用中的液滴尺寸调控提供新机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值模拟结合解析理论分析（numerical simulations and analytical theory），研究被动动力学与活性振荡耦合下的液滴演化。

papers.title: Spectral dimension determines criticality in nonreciprocal phase oscillators
papers.abstract: Spectral dimension is a key determinant of critical phenomena, but its role in nonreciprocal systems remains unexplored. We study noisy identical Kuramoto-Sakaguchi oscillators with phase lag $α\in [0,π/2)$, where $α>0$ induces nonreciprocal interactions. Numerical phase diagrams in the $(d_s,α)$ plane in complex networks, where $d_s$ denotes the spectral dimension, reveal a critical phase lag $α_c$, below which spontaneous synchronization occurs. This critical phase lag appears only for $d_s > d_s^c$, where $d_s^c = 2$ is the critical spectral dimension, and increases monotonically with $d_s$. We analytically derive the criticality using the dynamical renormalization group method.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：dynamical renormalization group method、analytically derive、numerical phase diagrams）；研究对象：非互易相位振子系统，具体为带有相位延迟α的噪声相同Kuramoto-Sakaguchi振子模型，以及其在复杂网络中的同步临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现非互易系统中存在一个临界相位延迟α_c，只有当谱维度d_s大于临界谱维度d_s^c=2时，自发同步才会出现，且α_c随d_s单调增加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现非互易系统中存在一个临界相位延迟α_c，只有当谱维度d_s大于临界谱维度d_s^c=2时，自发同步才会出现，且α_c随d_s单调增加。；创新点：首次揭示了谱维度在非互易系统（非互易Kuramoto-Sakaguchi振子）中对临界现象的决定性作用，并解析推导了临界条件。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（构建复杂网络中的(d_s, α)相图）与解析推导（采用动力学重整化群方法）。

papers.title: Phase-field analysis of fracture in heterogeneous wellbore systems: effects of casing eccentricity and cement-formation interface strength
papers.abstract: Predicting the initiation and propagation of cracks in heterogeneous wellbore systems under complex in-situ conditions remains challenging. We present a hybrid phase-field fracture framework to model crack growth in heterogeneous wellbore systems with weak interfaces. The framework is first validated against benchmark problems with available analytical and numerical solutions. Subsequently, numerical experiments are conducted to isolate the effects of interface strength and casing eccentricity on crack growth. The results show that casing eccentricity strongly influences both the pressure at crack initiation and the resulting crack paths, reducing the crack initiation pressure by up to 30% relative to the concentric configuration. Beyond a critical eccentricity threshold of 50%, localized shear stresses drive the nucleation of inclined cracks in the formation in addition to radial cracking -- a failure mode absent in concentric configurations. For sufficiently weak interfaces (i.e., interfaces with 30% of the strength of the surrounding bulk material), radially propagating cracks in the cement sheath are deflected along the interface rather than penetrating into the formation. This deflection delays stress relaxation within the sheath, promotes the nucleation of additional radial cracks, and increases the risk of sustained casing pressure and wellbore failure. Finally, a three-dimensional simulation reveals depth-dependent crack nucleation, stress-shadow effects that suppress full-depth crack growth and crack coalescence along the cement-formation interface -- phenomena that are fundamentally inaccessible under plane-strain assumptions - demonstrating the applicability of the framework to realistic heterogeneous wellbore systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：phase-field fracture framework、numerical experiments、three-dimensional simulation）；研究对象：非均质井筒系统中的裂缝萌生与扩展，具体涉及套管偏心度、水泥环-地层界面强度对断裂行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 套管偏心度可降低裂缝起裂压力达30%，且当偏心度超过50%时，会诱发倾斜裂缝；弱界面（强度为周围基体30%）会使水泥环中径向裂缝沿界面偏转，增加持续套管压力风险。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：套管偏心度可降低裂缝起裂压力达30%，且当偏心度超过50%时，会诱发倾斜裂缝；弱界面（强度为周围基体30%）会使水泥环中径向裂缝沿界面偏转，增加持续套管压力风险。；创新点：首次系统揭示了套管偏心度与界面强度耦合作用下裂缝路径的转变机制，并通过三维模拟发现了平面应变假设无法捕捉的深度依赖裂缝成核、应力阴影效应及界面裂缝合并现象。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合相场断裂框架（hybrid phase-field fracture framework），结合基准问题验证、二维数值实验及三维模拟。

papers.title: Reconstruction of detector error model for quantum error correction
papers.abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing fundamentally relies on the accurate characterization of circuit-level noise to optimize decoding algorithms. However, extracting complex multi-body error correlations remains challenging. Contemporary greedy inference algorithms can suffer from statistical distortion, discarding true physical mechanisms while introducing many unphysical false positives. Here, we introduce the Correlation-Analysis-based Hypergraph Reconstruction (CAHR) algorithm, a globally consistent framework to invert experimental syndrome statistics directly into discrete physical hypergraphs. By coupling exact algebraic correlation equations with a top-down concurrent-pruning strategy, CAHR recovers the fault topology without false positives for both $d=5$ rotated surface codes and dense 8-body 2D color codes in our benchmark settings. Furthermore, we show that exact continuous parameter extraction in dense codes is limited by a \textit{variance cascade}, where absolute statistical variance accumulates linearly from high- to low-degree mechanisms. This motivates a two-stage inference paradigm: utilizing CAHR to extract the fault topology, followed by continuous probability optimization. This provides a practical approach for characterizing and decoding highly correlated noise in realistic quantum hardware.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：提出算法（CAHR算法）、数学框架（代数关联方程、统计方差分析）、基准测试（benchmark settings），未涉及实验数据采集。；研究对象：量子纠错中的探测器错误模型重建，具体针对表面码（rotated surface code）和二维色码（2D color code）的电路级噪声表征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出CAHR算法，能在无假阳性情况下从实验综合征统计量反演离散物理超图（fault topology），并发现密集码中连续参数提取受“方差级联”（variance cascade）限制，即统计方差从高权重机制向低权重机制线性累积。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出CAHR算法，能在无假阳性情况下从实验综合征统计量反演离散物理超图（fault topology），并发现密集码中连续参数提取受“方差级联”（variance cascade）限制，即统计方差从高权重机制向低权重机制线性累积。；创新点：首次实现无假阳性的故障拓扑重建，并揭示密集码中连续参数提取的方差级联限制，从而提出两阶段推断范式以替代传统贪婪推断算法。
papers.method_zh: 基于代数关联方程与自上而下并发剪枝策略的全局一致性框架（CAHR算法），结合统计方差级联分析，提出两阶段推断范式：先提取故障拓扑，再进行连续概率优化。

papers.title: Super-Arrhenius relaxation of the triangular plaquette model in any dimension
papers.abstract: Consider the following plaquette model from statistical physics: a lamp lies at every vertex of the triangular lattice and a switch lies at every even vertex of the (bipartite) dual hexagonal lattice. Each switch toggles the three lamps on its face. The energy of a configuration is the number of ON lamps. For the Glauber dynamics associated with the Gibbs measure defined by this Hamiltonian at any inverse temperature $β>0$, we show that, in any dimension $d\ge 2$, the infinite volume relaxation time satisfies \[e^{β^2/C}/C \le T_{\mathrm{rel}}\le Ce^{e^{Cβ}}\] for some $C>0$. Our result entails that the Gibbs measure is unique. The $e^{β^2}$ scaling was conjectured by Newman and Moore in 1999 and matches the behaviour of supercritical rooted kinetically constrained models such as the East model, thus recovering fragile glass phenomenology in the absence of kinetic constraints. More precisely, we show that, on a torus of side length $2^k$, when $β\to\infty$ and $k/β\to0$, we have $T_{\mathrm{rel}}=e^{2βk(1+o(1))}$. Quite surprisingly, however, we also prove that, on non-periodic finite domains of size $n\le e^{β/C}$ for large $C>0$, we have the much larger asymptotics $\ln T_{\mathrm{rel}}=βn^{Θ(1)}$. The main ingredients of the proofs are new results in extremal and enumerative combinatorics and rely on renormalisation ideas for the dynamics and its groundstates also known as the Ledrappier subshift. We note consequences of our results to geometric group theory (more precisely to the complexity of the word problem for the Baumslag finitely presented group) and to ergodic theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：statistical physics, Glauber dynamics, Gibbs measure, 数学证明。；研究对象：三角晶格上的plaquette模型（三角板模型），具体为每个顶点有一盏灯，每个对偶六角格子的偶顶点有一个开关，开关翻转其所在面上的三盏灯，能量为亮灯数量。研究该模型在任意维度d≥2下的Glauber动力学弛豫行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在任意维度d≥2下，无限体积弛豫时间满足e^{β²/C}/C ≤ T_rel ≤ C e^{e^{Cβ}}，证实了Newman和Moore在1999年关于e^{β²}标度的猜想，并揭示了无动力学约束下的脆弱玻璃现象。此外，在非周期有限域上发现了更大的渐近行为ln T_rel = β n^{Θ(1)}。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在任意维度d≥2下，无限体积弛豫时间满足e^{β²/C}/C ≤ T_rel ≤ C e^{e^{Cβ}}，证实了Newman和Moore在1999年关于e^{β²}标度的猜想，并揭示了无动力学约束下的脆弱玻璃现象。此外，在非周期有限域上发现了更大的渐近行为ln T_rel = β n^{Θ(1)}。；创新点：首次严格证明了三角plaquette模型在任意维度下的超阿伦尼乌斯弛豫标度，将脆弱玻璃现象与无动力学约束的模型联系起来，并揭示了周期边界与非周期有限域上弛豫时间的巨大差异。摘要还提到结果对几何群论（Baumslag有限表示群的词问题复杂性）和遍历理论有推论。
papers.method_zh: 采用极值组合学与枚举组合学的新结果，结合动力学重整化思想，对动力学及其基态（即Ledrappier子移位）进行分析。通过数学严格证明给出弛豫时间的上下界。

papers.title: Quantum Algorithm for Open-System Battery Cathodes by Modeling Multiple Strongly Coupled Holstein Polarons with Chain-Mapped Caldeira-Leggett Dynamics
papers.abstract: Cathode lithiation occupies a chemical regime of tightly localized orbitals, narrow bandwidths, and strong electron-lattice coupling. The defining electrochemical observables (open-circuit voltage and differential capacity) are open-system, reservoir-equilibration quantities that closed-Hamiltonian quantum simulation cannot produce, set by exchange with electron, Li$^+$, and phonon baths. We present a fault-tolerant quantum algorithm that recovers them through a unitary chain-mapped Caldeira-Leggett embedding, rendering the baths Trotterizable. The resulting fourth-order Trotter step has a T-gate count polynomial in system size, validating its open-system dynamics against hierarchical equations of motion (HEOM) at strong coupling and the Lindblad limit at weak coupling. For single-carrier olivine LiFePO$_4$, a single voltage anchor on an otherwise DFT-fixed Hamiltonian places the differential-capacity peak within the $\pm5$ mV reproducibility of the experimental plateau. For multi-carrier spinel LiMn$_2$O$_4$, whose $1{:}1$ Mn$^{3+}$/Mn$^{4+}$ filling makes the inter-site Coulomb repulsion dynamically active, the same kernel yields a two-plateau voltage curve with a $125$ mV split, within $17\%$ of the observed $150$ mV. We deliver an end-to-end fault-tolerant resource estimate for such a multi-carrier, three-reservoir observable: $368$ logical qubits and $\sim3\times10^5$ T-gates per step, or $\sim1.7\times10^{12}$ T-gates for a full voltage curve (parallelizable over $\sim10^3$ trajectories), leaving the production-scale dynamical run as a milestone for future hardware. The same kernel reproduces macroscopic quantum coherence, two-band superconductivity, and the Mikheyev-Smirnov-Wolfenstein resonance without modification, placing dynamical battery chemistry and similar Hamiltonians within scope for fault-tolerant quantum simulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：fault-tolerant quantum algorithm、chain-mapped Caldeira-Leggett embedding、Trotterization、resource estimate。；研究对象：电池正极材料中的锂化过程，具体以单载流子体系 LiFePO₄（橄榄石结构）和多载流子体系 LiMn₂O₄（尖晶石结构）为例，研究强耦合 Holstein 极化子及开放系统动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种容错量子算法，通过链映射 Caldeira-Leggett 嵌入将电子、Li⁺和声子浴统一处理，能够准确复现 LiFePO₄ 的微分容量峰（与实验平台 ±5 mV 吻合）和 LiMn₂O₄ 的双平台电压曲线（分裂值 125 mV，与实验 150 mV 偏差 17%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种容错量子算法，通过链映射 Caldeira-Leggett 嵌入将电子、Li⁺和声子浴统一处理，能够准确复现 LiFePO₄ 的微分容量峰（与实验平台 ±5 mV 吻合）和 LiMn₂O₄ 的双平台电压曲线（分裂值 125 mV，与实验 150 mV 偏差 17%）。；创新点：首次将电池正极的开放系统可观测物理量（开路电压、微分容量）纳入容错量子模拟框架，通过链映射方法使多浴（电子、Li⁺、声子）的 Trotter 化成为可能，并给出端到端资源估计（368 逻辑量子比特，每步约 3×10⁵ T 门，完整电压曲线约 1.7×10¹² T 门）。该内核还可不经修改复现宏观量子相干、两带超导及 Mikheyev-Smirnov-Wolfenstein 共振，表明其通用性。
papers.method_zh: 采用容错量子算法，核心是链映射 Caldeira-Leggett 嵌入（将浴映射为可 Trotter 分解的幺正链），结合四阶 Trotter 步（T 门数随系统大小多项式增长）。通过与强耦合下的分级运动方程（HEOM）和弱耦合下的 Lindblad 极限对比验证开放系统动力学。对 LiFePO₄ 使用单个电压锚点（其余参数由 DFT 固定），对 LiMn₂O₄ 使用相同内核处理动态库仑排斥。

papers.title: Learning ground state observables from quantum computing experiments
papers.abstract: Recent theoretical progress has established conditions under which machine learning models can efficiently predict ground-state properties of gapped local Hamiltonians when trained on quantum-generated data. Previous experimental demonstrations in this paradigm, however, have largely been limited to small systems or highly structured states, due to the difficulty of preparing many-body ground states on quantum processors. In this work, we demonstrate learning from experimental quantum data generated from approximate ground states of the two-dimensional Heisenberg XXZ model with system sizes up to 115 qubits. We construct a dataset of single-site expectation values, two-point correlations, and 12-body loop correlations across the antiferromagnetic phase. We then train neural networks on this data and show that they can accurately predict spatially resolved observables for previously unseen Hamiltonian parameters, both within the training distribution and in an out-of-distribution regime approaching the phase boundary. Our results demonstrate the practical realization of learning from quantum data for an interacting two-dimensional many-body system at scale, motivating a path toward regimes where quantum processors could provide training data beyond the reach of classical approximation methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：quantum computing experiments, neural networks trained on experimental quantum data, machine learning models。；研究对象：二维海森堡XXZ模型的反铁磁相，系统尺寸高达115个量子比特。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用从量子处理器上制备的近似基态数据（包括单点期望值、两点关联和12体环关联），训练神经网络能够准确预测该模型在未见过的哈密顿参数下的空间分辨可观测量，包括训练分布内和接近相界的分布外区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用从量子处理器上制备的近似基态数据（包括单点期望值、两点关联和12体环关联），训练神经网络能够准确预测该模型在未见过的哈密顿参数下的空间分辨可观测量，包括训练分布内和接近相界的分布外区域。；创新点：首次在具有相互作用的二维多体系统中，利用多达115个量子比特的量子实验数据，实现了从量子数据中学习基态可观测量的实际演示，突破了此前仅限于小系统或高度结构化态的限制。
