papers.title: High-sensitivity hydrogen gas permeation: system development, sample preparation, and influence of testing variables
papers.abstract: There is a need to develop quantitative, high-resolution hydrogen gas (H2) permeation techniques to provide a better understanding of hydrogen-material interactions. This study aims to develop and validate a high-sensitivity H2 permeation system, which is then leveraged to systematically quantify the influence of surface condition and key testing variables (surface oxides, residual gas impurities, pressure, and temperature) on hydrogen permeation. A gas permeation system capable of operating at pressures up to 50 bar and temperatures up to 250 C was developed, incorporating high-sensitivity mass spectrometric detection and controlled surface preparation protocols. Permeation transients were analysed in a model material (annealed pure Fe) to determine hydrogen diffusivity and permeability under systematically varied surface states, oxygen contents, pressures and temperatures. Surface oxides are shown to play a dominant role in controlling hydrogen permeation at room temperature. The presence of oxide layers can severely hinder or completely suppress hydrogen uptake, with measurable permeation requiring oxide removal via pickling and Pd coating on both surfaces, or activation through hydrogen-assisted reduction at elevated temperature. Residual oxygen present prior to hydrogen exposure further reduces permeability by modifying surface boundary conditions, indicating strongly surface-controlled kinetics. Under optimised surface conditions, hydrogen transport follows bulk diffusion-controlled behaviour, with steady-state flux obeying Sieverts' law at 25 C (1-5 bar) and diffusivity and permeability exhibiting Arrhenius behaviour between 25 and 150 C at 5 bar, indicating bulk diffusion-controlled transport. The developed system resolves hydrogen fluxes as low as 1.98x10-9 mol(m2 s) and provides a robust platform for investigating surface, mechanical and environmental effects on H2 permeation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：开发并验证了高灵敏度氢气渗透系统，进行了系统的实验测量（关键词：system development, sample preparation, testing variables, permeation transients, mass spectrometric detection）。；研究对象：氢气（H₂）在退火纯铁（annealed pure Fe）中的渗透行为，重点研究表面状态、残余气体杂质、压力、温度等测试变量对渗透的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 表面氧化物在室温下对氢气渗透起主导控制作用，可严重阻碍甚至完全抑制氢吸收；在优化表面条件（如酸洗+钯涂层或高温氢辅助还原）下，氢输运遵循体扩散控制行为，稳态通量符合Sieverts定律，扩散率和渗透率在25–150°C范围内呈现Arrhenius行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：表面氧化物在室温下对氢气渗透起主导控制作用，可严重阻碍甚至完全抑制氢吸收；在优化表面条件（如酸洗+钯涂层或高温氢辅助还原）下，氢输运遵循体扩散控制行为，稳态通量符合Sieverts定律，扩散率和渗透率在25–150°C范围内呈现Arrhenius行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 自主开发的高灵敏度气体渗透系统，工作压力最高50 bar、温度最高250°C，配备高灵敏度质谱检测和可控表面制备协议；通过分析渗透瞬态曲线确定氢扩散率和渗透率。

papers.title: Experimental Observation of Dynamical Phase Transitions in a Dephased Photonic Quantum Walk
papers.abstract: Dynamical phase transitions in open quantum systems govern how non-equilibrium states relax toward a stationary state. We study these transitions experimentally using a discrete-time photonic quantum walk on a three-node graph. A tunable synthetic gauge flux and calibrated dephasing allow us to control time-reversal symmetry and the detailed balance properties of the effective Markovian dynamics. With detailed balance, we observe a first-order dynamical phase transition marked by a crossing of real Liouvillian eigenvalues. When detailed balance is broken, we observe a second-order dynamical phase transition at an exceptional point where eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce. By progressively reducing the dephasing strength, we track the crossover toward the quantum-coherent regime and determine that the transitions persist down to a finite threshold. Our results link Liouvillian spectral topology to relaxation criticality and demonstrate a controllable platform for engineered dissipative dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：标题明确包含“Experimental Observation”，摘要描述使用“photonic quantum walk”实验平台进行观测。；研究对象：开放量子系统中的动力学相变，具体研究了一个三节点离散时间光子量子行走体系中的非平衡态弛豫行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在满足细致平衡条件时观测到一阶动力学相变（实Liouvillian本征值交叉），在破坏细致平衡时观测到二阶动力学相变（本征值与本征矢在奇异点处合并）。通过降低退相干强度，发现这些相变在有限阈值以下仍然存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在满足细致平衡条件时观测到一阶动力学相变（实Liouvillian本征值交叉），在破坏细致平衡时观测到二阶动力学相变（本征值与本征矢在奇异点处合并）。通过降低退相干强度，发现这些相变在有限阈值以下仍然存在。；创新点：首次在实验上观测到开放量子系统中由Liouvillian谱拓扑决定的动力学相变，并展示了从经典退相干区间量子相干区的交叉行为，为工程化耗散动力学提供了可控平台。
papers.method_zh: 使用离散时间光子量子行走实验平台，通过可调谐合成规范通量控制时间反演对称性，通过校准的退相干过程调控有效马尔可夫动力学中的细致平衡性质。

papers.title: Flowing to Normality and the Fate of the Single Ring Theorem
papers.abstract: Random non-hermitian matrix ensembles with double-sided rotation invariance obey, in the limit of large matrix size, the Single Ring Theorem, which states that the support of the mean eigenvalue distribution in the complex plane is either a disk or an annulus. In contrast, rotational-invariant random normal matrix ensembles can have mean eigenvalue densities supported over any number of concentric annuli in the complex plane. In this paper we introduce and investigate, both analytically and numerically, a non-hermitian matrix model which flows from a generic matrix distribution obeying the Single Ring Theorem to a distribution of normal matrices by tuning a parameter which penalizes non-normality. We observe numerically breakdown of the Single Ring Theorem as the model flows towards normality, and determine the critical value of the parameter at which the transition occurs. We also study in detail the behavior of the singular values of these matrices under the flow. These singular values form a Fermi gas confined to the positive half-line. In particular, we find that at small values of the flow parameter, the interparticle spacings in the gas exhibit Wigner-Dyson repulsion, whereas for asymptotically large values of the flow parameter, at the normal matrix endpoint of the flow, the spacing statistics is Poissonian. The flow interpolates continuously between these two types of statistics. However, this change in statistics is not related directly to breaking of the Single Ring Theorem, which occurs very early-on along the flow, in the regime of Wigner-Dyson statistics. Finally, we introduce a certain ensemble of random permutations associated with the gas, and make a conjecture on how to use it in order to reconstruct approximately the average density of complex eigenvalues from that of the singular values in the large-$N$ limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analytically and numerically”，并涉及理论模型构建与数值观察。；研究对象：非厄米随机矩阵系综在“流向正态性”过程中的行为，特别是单环定理的失效与奇异值统计的转变。具体体系包括双旋转不变的非厄米随机矩阵与旋转不变的正态随机矩阵之间的插值模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节惩罚非正态性的参数，模型从满足单环定理的矩阵分布连续流向正态矩阵分布，在此过程中单环定理在参数较小（仍处于Wigner-Dyson统计区域）时即被打破；同时，奇异值的间距统计从Wigner-Dyson排斥型连续演变为泊松型，但这一统计变化与单环定理的破坏并非直接相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节惩罚非正态性的参数，模型从满足单环定理的矩阵分布连续流向正态矩阵分布，在此过程中单环定理在参数较小（仍处于Wigner-Dyson统计区域）时即被打破；同时，奇异值的间距统计从Wigner-Dyson排斥型连续演变为泊松型，但这一统计变化与单环定理的破坏并非直接相关。；创新点：首次在单一模型中连续连接单环定理适用的非厄米矩阵与正态矩阵，并揭示单环定理的破坏发生在Wigner-Dyson统计区域，而非与统计类型的转变同步。此外，提出利用随机置换系综从奇异值密度重构复特征值密度的新思路。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值模拟。具体包括：引入一个通过参数惩罚非正态性的非厄米矩阵模型；数值观察单环定理的破坏并确定临界参数；研究奇异值在流下的行为，将其类比为正半轴上的费米气体；分析粒子间距统计（Wigner-Dyson vs. 泊松）；引入与气体相关的随机置换系综，并提出从奇异值平均密度近似重构复特征值平均密度的猜想。

papers.title: Suppressing Intrinsic Spin-Phonon Errors in Trapped-Ion Quantum Simulation
papers.abstract: Trapped-ion quantum simulators realize programmable spin models through phonon-mediated interactions. For Hamiltonians with noncommuting terms, however, the same phonon bus generates intrinsic spin-phonon errors that strongly distort the target dynamics. Because these errors are governed by the full time history of the spin-dependent phonon motion, they survive standard loop-closing control and limit simulation accuracy. Using a sequence of frame transformations, we isolate the residual error dynamics and show that this intrinsic error can be strongly suppressed while preserving programmable Ising couplings. Full spin-boson simulations of multi-ion chains demonstrate orders-of-magnitude lower error than both constant-drive and conventional loop-closing protocols. These results remove a central precision barrier in trapped-ion analog quantum simulation and enable accurate programmable simulation of noncommuting many-body Hamiltonians and dynamical protocols.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：frame transformations、spin-boson simulations、analytical isolation of error dynamics）；研究对象：离子阱量子模拟器中的自旋-声子耦合系统，具体研究非对易哈密顿量下由声子总线引起的本征自旋-声子误差。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过一系列框架变换，可以隔离并强烈抑制本征自旋-声子误差，同时保持可编程的伊辛耦合，从而将模拟误差降低数个数量级，消除了离子阱模拟非对易多体哈密顿量的关键精度障碍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过一系列框架变换，可以隔离并强烈抑制本征自旋-声子误差，同时保持可编程的伊辛耦合，从而将模拟误差降低数个数量级，消除了离子阱模拟非对易多体哈密顿量的关键精度障碍。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：使用框架变换序列隔离残余误差动力学；数值模拟：对多离子链进行全自旋-玻色子模拟，并与恒驱动和传统闭环控制协议进行误差对比。

papers.title: Positive-Real Identification of Sparse Mori-Hamiltonians from Partial Observations
papers.abstract: Discovering the governing equations of a physical system from data is a central goal across the sciences, yet in most experiments only a few states are accessible while the rest stay hidden. Existing approaches treat this partial observability as an obstacle to be removed by first reconstructing the hidden state -- a step that is ill-posed under noise and that discards the physical constraints, such as energy conservation, that the true dynamics obey. We show that for conservative (Hamiltonian) systems no reconstruction is needed: projecting the dynamics onto the measured coordinates yields a memory kernel that we prove to be a lossless positive-real rational matrix, whose poles are the hidden natural frequencies and whose positive-semidefinite residues encode the couplings. The governing equation -- and the underlying Hamiltonian -- can therefore be read directly from the autocorrelation of the measured signal, with guarantees of uniqueness and physical passivity, and without neural networks. We validate the approach on linear, nonlinear, and chaotic systems under realistic noise. By recovering interpretable equations of motion that conserve energy by construction from partial measurements, the method offers a common tool for problems spanning mechanics, fluid and plasma physics, and beyond.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值验证）。判断依据：摘要中提出数学证明（“we prove that...”），并在线性、非线性和混沌系统上进行了数值验证（“validate the approach on...”），但未提及具体实验手段。；研究对象：保守（哈密顿）动力系统，特别是仅能观测到部分状态（partial observations）的物理系统，涵盖力学、流体、等离子体物理等领域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于保守哈密顿系统，无需先重构隐藏状态，直接从测量信号的关联函数中即可唯一地、无损耗地提取出稀疏的Mori-Hamiltonian，其记忆核是一个正实有理矩阵，极点对应隐藏的自然频率，半正定残差编码耦合强度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于保守哈密顿系统，无需先重构隐藏状态，直接从测量信号的关联函数中即可唯一地、无损耗地提取出稀疏的Mori-Hamiltonian，其记忆核是一个正实有理矩阵，极点对应隐藏的自然频率，半正定残差编码耦合强度。；创新点：首次证明在部分观测条件下，无需重构隐藏状态即可直接识别保守系统的哈密顿量，且该方法天然满足能量守恒和物理无源性，克服了传统先重构后辨识方法在噪声下的不适定性。
papers.method_zh: 利用正实有理矩阵理论（positive-real rational matrix）和Mori投影算子，将动力学投影到可观测坐标上，从测量信号的自关联函数直接读取记忆核，进而恢复哈密顿量。不依赖神经网络，且保证唯一性和物理无源性（passivity）。

papers.title: Connecting entanglement growth with local integrals of motion in the disordered Fermi-Hubbard model
papers.abstract: Generically a quantum system initialized in an unentangled state will, under unitary dynamics, rapidly become entangled, a process closely related to information transport and to thermalization. Disorder can suppress the growth of entanglement and result in memory of initial conditions. In non-interacting systems this arises from localization of single-particle states, the occupancy of which is fixed by the initial condition. In interacting systems similar localized conserved quantities persist, but with the added feature that they are coupled, resulting in entanglement growth which is distinct from both non-interacting localized systems and from generic ergodic systems. The Fermi-Hubbard model has two degrees of freedom per site -- charge and spin -- and disorder may be present in both of these. We study the growth of entanglement in two scenarios -- disorder in charge equal and unequal to that in spin, and determine the distinct contributions of charge and spin degrees of freedom by expanding the Hamiltonian in terms of a set of optimally localized conserved quantities with separate charge and spin character. We find that coupling between charge and spin is significantly weaker than charge-charge and spin-spin coupling. While this decoupling is present in all our results, it is only apparent when the strength of the disorder in the two sectors is different such that there is a separation between the characteristic timescales of the contributions to entanglement made by charge and by spin.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：study the growth of entanglement, expanding the Hamiltonian, determine the distinct contributions）；研究对象：无序费米-哈伯德模型（Fermi-Hubbard model）中的纠缠增长与局域守恒量的关系，具体关注电荷和自旋两个自由度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无序费米-哈伯德模型中，电荷与自旋自由度之间的耦合显著弱于电荷-电荷和自旋-自旋耦合；这种退耦效应只有在两个无序强度不同、导致电荷和自旋对纠缠贡献的特征时间尺度分离时才显现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无序费米-哈伯德模型中，电荷与自旋自由度之间的耦合显著弱于电荷-电荷和自旋-自旋耦合；这种退耦效应只有在两个无序强度不同、导致电荷和自旋对纠缠贡献的特征时间尺度分离时才显现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过将哈密顿量展开为一组具有独立电荷和自旋特征的优化局域守恒量（optimally localized conserved quantities），分析电荷和自旋自由度对纠缠增长的独立贡献。

papers.title: Linear algebra at exponential scale via tensor network dimension reduction
papers.abstract: Many problems in modern scientific computing are challenging because of a \emph{curse of dimension}, where their mathematical formulation involves objects whose dimension is \emph{exponential} in the nominal "size" of the problem. Tensor networks can provide a compact representation for exponentially large vectors and matrices that arise in applications, but these representations do not always lead to reliable algorithms. This paper develops and analyzes techniques for randomized dimension reduction of tensor network data. These techniques support a suite of efficient algorithms for provably solving exponential-scale linear algebra problems, including trace estimation and eigenvalue approximation. The paper includes several stylized illustrations from quantum many-body physics with ambient dimension up to $2^{200}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：tensor network dimension reduction（张量网络降维）、randomized dimension reduction（随机降维）、provably solving（可证明求解）。；研究对象：量子多体物理中出现的指数级规模线性代数问题，具体涉及环境维度高达 $2^{200}$ 的量子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过张量网络数据的随机化降维技术，可以设计出高效且可证明正确的算法，用于求解指数级规模的线性代数问题（如迹估计和本征值近似）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过张量网络数据的随机化降维技术，可以设计出高效且可证明正确的算法，用于求解指数级规模的线性代数问题（如迹估计和本征值近似）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用张量网络表示（tensor network representation）对指数级大小的向量和矩阵进行紧凑编码，并结合随机化降维（randomized dimension reduction）技术，开发出一套可证明的算法框架。

papers.title: Biological proper time and entropy-cost invariance in cardiac and respiratory lifespan scaling
papers.abstract: Warm-blooded vertebrates accumulate approximately conserved numbers of physiological cycles over a natural lifetime: of order $10^9$ heartbeats and $10^8$--$3\times10^8$ breaths. These regularities are not exact constants, but their persistence across orders-of-magnitude variation in body mass, metabolic power, physiological frequency, and lifespan suggests that biological time is not measured by chronological duration alone. We develop the Principle of Biological Time Equivalence (PBTE), a thermodynamic framework in which lifetime cycle count is determined by the ratio between total lifetime entropy production and the entropy cost of one physiological cycle. Starting from the open-system entropy balance $\dot S=\dot e_p-\dot h_d$, we define the entropy cost per cycle as $σ_0=dΣ/dN$, where $dΣ$ is the entropy produced as the physiological clock advances by $dN$ cycles. For an adult homeostatic regime, this gives the cycle-count relation $N_\star=Σ/\langleσ_0\rangle$, with $Σ=\int_0^L \dot e_p(t)\,dt$, where $N_\star$ is the lifetime cycle count, $Σ$ is total lifetime entropy production, and $\langleσ_0\rangle$ is the lifetime-averaged entropy cost per cycle. In the homeostatic limit, $\dot e_p\simeq P/T$, so direct measurement of metabolic power $P$, body temperature $T$, and physiological frequency $f$ gives $σ_0\simeq P/(Tf)$. PBTE converts the empirical lifetime-cycle invariants into entropy-cost invariants. Under Kleiber metabolic scaling and quarter-power physiological-frequency scaling, the mass-specific entropy cost satisfies $\barσ_0=P/(TfM)\propto M^{3/4+1/4-1}=M^0$, providing a thermodynamic interpretation of allometric mass cancellation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提出“发展了一个热力学框架”（Principle of Biological Time Equivalence, PBTE），并基于熵平衡方程和标度关系进行推导，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：温血脊椎动物（warm-blooded vertebrates）的心跳和呼吸寿命周期数（约10^9次心跳和10^8–3×10^8次呼吸）的标度规律，以及生物时间与熵产生之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出“生物时间等价原理”（PBTE），将生理寿命周期数（如心跳总数）解释为终身总熵产生与每个生理周期熵成本之比，从而将经验性的寿命周期不变量转化为熵成本不变量。在Kleiber代谢标度和四分之一幂律生理频率标度下，质量比熵成本呈标度不变性（∝ M^0），为异速生长中的质量抵消提供了热力学解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出“生物时间等价原理”（PBTE），将生理寿命周期数（如心跳总数）解释为终身总熵产生与每个生理周期熵成本之比，从而将经验性的寿命周期不变量转化为熵成本不变量。在Kleiber代谢标度和四分之一幂律生理频率标度下，质量比熵成本呈标度不变性（∝ M^0），为异速生长中的质量抵消提供了热力学解释。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于开放系统熵平衡方程（Ṡ = ė_p - ḣ_d），定义每个生理周期的熵成本σ₀ = dΣ/dN，推导出寿命周期数关系 N_⋆ = Σ/⟨σ₀⟩。在稳态近似下，利用代谢功率P、体温T和生理频率f，得到σ₀ ≈ P/(Tf)，并结合Kleiber标度律（P ∝ M^{3/4}）和生理频率标度（f ∝ M^{-1/4}）进行标度分析。

papers.title: Discontinuous strong-to-weak symmetry breaking transition from thermal pure states
papers.abstract: We investigate the nonequilibrium dynamics of strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking in many-body quantum systems undergoing decoherence from thermal pure states. For generic initial pure states with volume-law entanglement entropy, we show that the system undergoes a discontinuous dynamical phase transition at a critical time. This transition is accompanied by a singularity in the entropy of the system, which saturates to its maximum value at the same critical time. Through numerical simulations of the dephasing Ising and hard-core boson models, we establish the universality of this transition across different symmetries. Our results reveal that the dynamical emergence of a decohered mixed state from a highly entangled state is not a gradual asymptotic relaxation, but rather a sharp phase transition driven by a sudden collapse of global coherence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：investigate, show, numerical simulations, reveal）；研究对象：多体量子系统在热纯态退相干过程中的强-弱自发对称性破缺非平衡动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从具有体积律纠缠熵的初始纯态出发，系统在临界时间处经历一个不连续的动力学相变，同时伴随熵的奇异性，熵在相同临界时间饱和至最大值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从具有体积律纠缠熵的初始纯态出发，系统在临界时间处经历一个不连续的动力学相变，同时伴随熵的奇异性，熵在相同临界时间饱和至最大值。；创新点：揭示了从高度纠缠态到退相干混合态的动力学过程并非渐近弛豫，而是一个由全局相干性突然坍缩驱动的尖锐相变。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值模拟，具体模拟了退相干伊辛模型和硬核玻色子模型。

papers.title: VQE as Initial State Preparation for QPE on Heisenberg Spin-Glass Hamiltonians
papers.abstract: Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE) is the quantum algorithmic workhorse for computing ground state energies of quantum Hamiltonians with quantum computers. Ground state energy calculation of physical systems is perhaps the most promising use case for quantum computing in terms of scientific and commercial value with a plausible path to outperformance of classical alternatives. This path, however, hinges on the availability of initial states for QPE with significant overlap with the true ground state. Using extensive (classical) numerical computations, we study whether the NISQ-era algorithm VQE (Variational Quantum Eigensolver) could be used to efficiently prepare high-overlap states of disordered fully-connected anisotropic Heisenberg spin glass quantum Hamiltonians with up to $15$ qubits. We find that (i) -- consistent with widely held, but rarely numerically illustrated beliefs -- VQE is generally unable to efficiently converge to the ground state for our Hamiltonians, which is a well-known issue with VQE due to a variety of factors including vanishing gradients and local minima; (ii) low energy states do not necessarily have large ground-state overlap, but there is typically a correlation between the two measures; (iii) adding more than three layers to the VQE ansatz neither improves overlap nor the energies found; and (iv) the best-found overlap scaling as a function of the Hamiltonian system size is not strongly exponentially decreasing, suggesting potential for VQE to be a heuristic state preparation algorithm for QPE.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：classical numerical computations、VQE、QPE、numerical study。；研究对象：无序全连接各向异性海森堡自旋玻璃量子哈密顿量（Heisenberg spin-glass quantum Hamiltonians），最多15个量子比特。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: VQE通常无法高效收敛到基态，但最佳重叠随系统规模增大并未呈现强指数衰减，表明VQE有潜力作为QPE的启发式初始态制备算法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：VQE通常无法高效收敛到基态，但最佳重叠随系统规模增大并未呈现强指数衰减，表明VQE有潜力作为QPE的启发式初始态制备算法。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过经典数值计算，使用变分量子本征求解器（VQE）为量子相位估计（QPE）制备初始态，研究VQE ansatz层数、能量与基态重叠之间的关系。

papers.title: Distilling latent electrostatics from foundation machine learning interatomic potentials
papers.abstract: Foundation machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have enabled atomistic simulations across broad regions of chemical and materials space, but many remain computationally expensive and lack explicit electrostatics, limiting their use for systems governed by long-range interactions and electrical response. Previously, we introduced Latent Ewald Summation (LES), which learns latent atomic charges and long-range electrostatics from density functional theory (DFT) energy and force labels alone. Here, we use LES to extract electrostatics that are latent in foundation models: energies and forces predicted by a teacher model are used to train a lightweight LES-augmented student MLIP, with optional fine-tuning on additional DFT data. The resulting models reduce computational cost while providing access to Born effective charge tensors, and infrared spectra. We benchmark student models distilled from a broad set of foundation MLIPs, including UMA, MACE, Orb, eSEN, GemNet-OC, PET, and EquiformerV2-based models, against experimental infrared spectra for liquid water, concentrated hydrochloric acid, and the anatase TiO2(101)-water interface. Across these systems, electrostatic response can be extracted from most foundation MLIPs. The benchmark further shows that the underlying DFT level and dataset used to train the teacher model play a larger role than architecture in determining electrostatic and spectroscopic accuracy. For the TiO2-water interface, fine-tuning with a modest amount of higher-level DFT data improves structural and infrared predictions. LES-based distillation therefore provides a practical route for converting foundation MLIPs into efficient, electrically responsive models, while also testing the physical fidelity encoded in foundation models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：foundation machine learning interatomic potentials、Latent Ewald Summation、DFT、蒸馏（distillation）。；研究对象：液态水、浓盐酸、锐钛矿TiO2(101)-水界面等体系中的静电相互作用和红外光谱响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Latent Ewald Summation（LES）方法，可以从多种基础机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）中蒸馏出隐含的静电信息，并高效预测Born有效电荷张量和红外光谱；教师模型的DFT能级和训练数据对静电与光谱精度的影响大于模型架构本身。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Latent Ewald Summation（LES）方法，可以从多种基础机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）中蒸馏出隐含的静电信息，并高效预测Born有效电荷张量和红外光谱；教师模型的DFT能级和训练数据对静电与光谱精度的影响大于模型架构本身。；创新点：提出了一种基于LES的蒸馏框架，将计算昂贵且缺乏显式静电的基础MLIPs转化为高效、具有电响应能力的模型，同时系统评估了不同基础MLIPs在静电和光谱预测中的物理保真度。
papers.method_zh: 使用Latent Ewald Summation（LES）方法，从教师模型（多种基础MLIPs，如UMA、MACE、Orb、eSEN、GemNet-OC、PET、EquiformerV2）预测的能量和力中训练轻量级LES增强的学生MLIP，并可选择在额外DFT数据上进行微调。

papers.title: Finite-Element Matrix Product States for Continuum Models in One Dimension
papers.abstract: We present a matrix product state framework for simulating one-dimensional quantum many-body systems in the continuum using non-orthogonal single-particle basis sets. By mapping the physical problem to an auxiliary computational space, we show that the resulting many-body overlap operator can be efficiently encoded as a matrix product operator for sufficiently localized orbitals, thereby generalizing a construction that first appeared in [arXiv:2405.10285]. This construction recasts the variational ground-state search into a generalized eigenvalue problem, which can be solved using a generalized density matrix renormalization group algorithm. As a primary application, we employ a first-order finite-element expansion to study the ground state properties of the Lieb-Liniger gas in the presence of inhomogeneities. This approach also provides a natural setting for exactly refining the lattice, thereby enabling multigrid optimization strategies for matrix product states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：matrix product state framework、generalized eigenvalue problem、density matrix renormalization group algorithm。；研究对象：一维连续介质中的量子多体系统，具体以非均匀Lieb-Liniger气体作为主要应用示例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于非正交单粒子基组的矩阵乘积态框架，可将连续模型中的变分基态搜索转化为广义本征值问题，并通过广义密度矩阵重正化群算法求解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于非正交单粒子基组的矩阵乘积态框架，可将连续模型中的变分基态搜索转化为广义本征值问题，并通过广义密度矩阵重正化群算法求解。；创新点：将原本仅出现在[arXiv:2405.10285]中的矩阵乘积算符构造推广至一般化的非正交局域轨道情形，并引入多网格优化策略实现晶格精确细化。
papers.method_zh: 采用有限元展开（first-order finite-element expansion）作为非正交基组，将物理问题映射到辅助计算空间，利用矩阵乘积算符高效编码多体重叠算符，并结合广义密度矩阵重正化群（generalized DMRG）算法求解广义本征值问题。

papers.title: Magic transfer in quantum spin chains
papers.abstract: Quantum communication protocols based on spin chains have been extensively studied, yet their ability to transmit nonstabilizer resources has not been systematically addressed. We investigate the transport of quantum magic in spin chains through the natural dynamics of systems initialized in nonstabilizer states, and quantify the transported resource via the stabilizer norm. We analyze three experimentally feasible state-transfer protocols, ranging from noisy to (quasi-)perfect transfer, including one realizable in trapped-ion platforms. We find that the geometry of the injected state strongly influences transport: states in the lower Bloch hemisphere achieve higher transfer quality, whereas states in the upper hemisphere give rise to an efficient magic transport only beyond a threshold value of the parameter controlling the tendency towards perfect transfer. These features are robust across all protocols and identify the Hamiltonian and state properties that favor high-quality transfer. Moreover, we identify a parameter region, relevant to the initial state preparation, in which the transported magic exceeds the initial encoding, indicating that such spin systems can act as magic-amplification channels. Our results establish the conditions for efficient transport of nonstabilizer resources and demonstrate quantum magic as a sensitive probe of quantum transport beyond population dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“quantify the transported resource via the stabilizer norm”、“analyze three experimentally feasible protocols”、“identify the Hamiltonian and state properties”，主要基于理论分析和数值计算，未涉及具体实验数据或样品制备。；研究对象：量子自旋链中的“魔法”（magic）资源输运现象，即非稳定子（nonstabilizer）量子态在自旋链中的传输行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 注入态在布洛赫球下半球时传输质量更高，而在上半球时仅当参数超过某一阈值才能实现高效魔法传输；此外，存在一个参数区域，其中传输的魔法量超过初始编码量，表明自旋链可作为魔法放大通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：注入态在布洛赫球下半球时传输质量更高，而在上半球时仅当参数超过某一阈值才能实现高效魔法传输；此外，存在一个参数区域，其中传输的魔法量超过初始编码量，表明自旋链可作为魔法放大通道。；创新点：首次系统研究自旋链中非稳定子资源的输运能力，并发现魔法可作为超越布居动力学的灵敏探针；识别出魔法放大效应，即输运后魔法量可超过初始编码量。
papers.method_zh: 通过稳定子范数（stabilizer norm）量化输运的魔法资源；分析了三种实验上可行的态传输协议（从有噪声到准完美传输，包括一种可在离子阱平台实现的协议）；基于系统在非稳定子初态下的自然动力学进行理论分析。

papers.title: Physics of anticipatory active matter, with application to crowd dynamics
papers.abstract: Statistical Physics has traditionally dealt with entities that interact merely based on the present, and possibly past, configurations. This reactive framework is inefficient in many situations involving living beings, such as predators chasing a prey, pedestrians, or even robots. This paper introduces a statistical physical framework for the dynamics of anticipatory agents, whose present-time dynamics depend on the prospective system state that they anticipate. We clarify how these dynamics can be expressed in terms of a cost function constructed based on observations and we show that the dynamics of an anticipatory agent in d dimensions can be mapped onto the dynamics of a (non-anticipatory) chain in d + 1 dimensions, with fluctuations acting transversely on the chain to account for the uncertainty about the future state. Insights from polymer Physics help us characterize the dynamics of these chains and delineate an anticipation horizon beyond which the blurry future can be handled in a mean-field way. The foregoing framework is successfully applied to pedestrian dynamics, leading to a seamless integration of operational and tactical levels in an agent-based model. Even with a minimal expression of the cost, the model succeeds in reproducing various experimental scenarios which are challenging for state-of-the-art models, such as crossing cluttered environments or alighting from a crowded train. The transparent and flexible basis of the model allows the straightforward incorporation of additional mechanisms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：statistical physical framework、dynamics、mapping、polymer Physics。；研究对象：预期性活性物质（anticipatory active matter），具体应用于行人动力学（crowd dynamics / pedestrian dynamics）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个统计物理框架，将预期性主体的动力学映射为d+1维非预期性链的动力学，并利用高分子物理刻画其动力学行为，成功应用于行人运动模拟，复现了多种实验场景。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个统计物理框架，将预期性主体的动力学映射为d+1维非预期性链的动力学，并利用高分子物理刻画其动力学行为，成功应用于行人运动模拟，复现了多种实验场景。；创新点：首次将预期性（anticipation）机制纳入统计物理框架，并通过维度提升映射将预期性动力学转化为可解析处理的高分子链问题，同时定义了预期视界（anticipation horizon）用于平均场处理模糊未来。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架构建：基于观测构造代价函数（cost function）描述预期性动力学；映射方法：将d维预期性主体动力学映射为d+1维非预期性链的动力学，其中横向涨落代表对未来状态的不确定性；应用：基于智能体（agent-based）的行人动力学模型，采用最小化代价函数实现操作层与战术层的无缝整合。

papers.title: A pure stress formulation for modeling elastic waves using central finite differences
papers.abstract: A pure stress-based finite difference formulation is introduced for modeling elastic wave propagation in linear elastic solids with spatial heterogeneity. The approach derives from the strong form of the elastodynamic equation of motion, in which stress is the only dependent variable. A standard second-order central difference scheme is applied to discretize the equation of motion, allowing the space-time-dependent evolution of stress components to be modeled. Numerical dispersion analysis is performed for homogeneous, elastically isotropic materials. Simulations are then carried out for a spatially heterogeneous case consisting of a bimaterial with stiffness heterogeneity. This bimaterial case allows comparison with known closed-form solutions for reflection and transmission coefficients and with an analogous displacement-based finite difference model. Simulations are executed on modern graphics processing unit architectures, enabling stress-based modeling of large-scale three-dimensional problems exceeding one billion degrees of freedom. The approach shows promise for ultrasonic simulations in materials with stiffness heterogeneity and uniform mass density, conditions common in polycrystalline metals used in engineering applications. The formulation offers a potential alternative means of modeling wave propagation and scattering in heterogeneous materials, with possible applications in nondestructive evaluation, materials characterization, biomedical ultrasound, and geosciences.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：finite difference formulation、numerical dispersion analysis、simulations、modeling。；研究对象：弹性波在线弹性固体中的传播，特别是具有空间异质性（如双材料界面）的介质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种纯应力形式的有限差分方法，能够有效模拟具有刚度异质性和均匀质量密度的材料中的弹性波传播，并在GPU上实现了超过十亿自由度的三维大规模计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种纯应力形式的有限差分方法，能够有效模拟具有刚度异质性和均匀质量密度的材料中的弹性波传播，并在GPU上实现了超过十亿自由度的三维大规模计算。；创新点：提出了一种纯应力（而非传统位移或速度-应力）的有限差分公式，用于弹性波建模，为处理刚度异质性材料中的波传播和散射提供了新的替代途径。
papers.method_zh: 基于弹性动力学运动方程的强形式，仅以应力为因变量，采用标准二阶中心差分格式进行时空离散化；对均匀各向同性材料进行数值色散分析；对双材料异质体系进行模拟，并与已知的反射/透射系数解析解及基于位移的有限差分模型进行对比；在GPU架构上执行大规模三维模拟。

papers.title: O(N) BCFT: new data from conformal partial wave expansions
papers.abstract: The $\mathsf{O}(N)$ $\mathsf{BCFT}$ is analyzed in the large $N$ expansion in a generic bulk dimension $2<d+1<4$. Focus is on boundary conditions corresponding to the ordinary transition, however techniques used can be generalized to special or extraordinary transitions. We study the system of bulk $2$-pt functions $\langle φφ\rangle$, $\langle φ^2 φ^2\rangle$ and $\langle σσ\rangle$, where $σ$ is the Hubbard--Stratonovich field. They are expanded in bulk/boundary conformal partial waves. The coefficient functions of this expansion -- the spectral functions -- encode $\mathsf{BCFT}$ data and determine bulk/boundary conformal block expansions. We prove conjectures about boundary spectral functions in Dujava et al. [arXiv:2503.16345] and reproduce the bulk expansion of $\langle φφ\rangle$ in Giombi et al. [arXiv:2007.04955]. The bulk expansion of $\langleσσ\rangle$ is new and allows to extract the leading large $N$ expression for an unknown OPE coefficient $C_{σσσ^3}$ (the computation outputs as a byproduct also a mixing coefficient, which matches an existing result by Derkachov et al. [arXiv:hep-th/9705020], providing further support for the main result). Besides these derived data infinitely many constraints are produced, though due to operator mixing growing in complexity as degeneracy increases, they cannot be disentangled without further input.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：large N expansion、conformal partial wave expansions、BCFT（边界共形场论）。；研究对象：O(N) 边界共形场论（BCFT），具体研究在一般体维度 2<d+1<4 下、对应“普通转变”边界条件的系统，涉及体两点函数 ⟨φφ⟩、⟨φ²φ²⟩ 和 ⟨σσ⟩（σ 为 Hubbard–Stratonovich 场）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过体/边界共形分波展开，证明了 Dujava 等人关于边界谱函数的猜想，并首次给出了 ⟨σσ⟩ 的体展开，从而提取了未知 OPE 系数 C_{σσσ³} 的领头大 N 表达式；同时作为副产品得到的混合系数与已有结果一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过体/边界共形分波展开，证明了 Dujava 等人关于边界谱函数的猜想，并首次给出了 ⟨σσ⟩ 的体展开，从而提取了未知 OPE 系数 C_{σσσ³} 的领头大 N 表达式；同时作为副产品得到的混合系数与已有结果一致。；创新点：首次给出 ⟨σσ⟩ 的体展开并提取了未知 OPE 系数 C_{σσσ³} 的领头大 N 表达式；证明了关于边界谱函数的猜想；同时产生了无限多个约束条件，但由于算子混合随简并度增加而复杂化，这些约束在缺乏额外输入时无法完全解耦。
papers.method_zh: 采用大 N 展开方法，结合体/边界共形分波展开（conformal partial wave expansions），通过谱函数编码 BCFT 数据，并推导体/边界共形块展开。

papers.title: Ultrafast Terahertz and Optical Spectroscopy under Synergetic Extreme Conditions
papers.abstract: Elucidating and manipulating emergent phases in complex materials requires direct access to their low-energy collective modes. Terahertz (THz) time-domain and ultrafast optical spectroscopies have emerged as indispensable experimental tools, enabling the probing of intrinsic electrodynamics and the coherent control of non-equilibrium states. At the Synergetic Extreme Condition User Facility (SECUF), we have developed a suite of intense ultrashort light sources covering the near-infrared, mid-infrared, and THz spectral ranges. By integrating these strong-field pulses with extreme sample environments, such as low temperatures, strong magnetic fields, and high pressures, we have established several state-of-the-art spectroscopy platforms. In this article, we outline the technical specifications of each setup and highlight representative user experiments. The presented results underscore the exceptional capability of the THz experimental unit (A4-2) to explore ultrafast dynamics across a multi-parameter thermodynamic phase space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：developed、established、spectroscopy platforms、user experiments。；研究对象：复杂材料中的涌现相及其低能集体模式，以及多参数极端条件（低温、强磁场、高压）下的超快动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在协同极端条件用户装置（SECUF）上集成的太赫兹与超快光学光谱平台，能够有效探测多参数热力学相空间中的超快动力学，展示了太赫兹实验单元（A4-2）的卓越能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在协同极端条件用户装置（SECUF）上集成的太赫兹与超快光学光谱平台，能够有效探测多参数热力学相空间中的超快动力学，展示了太赫兹实验单元（A4-2）的卓越能力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 近红外、中红外和太赫兹波段的强超短脉冲光源，结合极端样品环境（低温、强磁场、高压），建立太赫兹时域光谱和超快光学光谱实验平台。

papers.title: q-Exponential Random Graphs: higher-order networks from simple constraints
papers.abstract: Exponential Random Graphs (ERGs) are among the most widely used network models, derived as principled least-bias graph ensembles that maximize Shannon entropy under constraints on the expected values of given structural properties. However, it has been recently (re)discovered that, in the absence of additional information privileging Shannon entropy, the most agnostic inferential construction should maximize the broader class of Uffink entropies. The resulting entropy-maximizing distribution changes from the exponential (Boltzmann-Gibbs) to the so-called q-exponential one. Since maximizing Shannon entropy may produce an unjustified independence between degrees of freedom, here we investigate how the most popular ERGs with independent edges (namely, the Erdos-Renyi and configuration models) generalize to higher-order q-Exponential Random Graphs with dependent edges in the non-Shannon case, while keeping their defining constraints (number of links and degree sequence, respectively) unchanged. We find features, such as a phase transition between sparse and dense regimes, that are absent in the original ERGs but typical of higher-order networks, plus novel phenomena such as richer assortativity and clustering profiles, which allow for the coexistence of link sparsity and triadic closure. These results show that higher-order networks do not necessarily require higher-order constraints, as they naturally arise from simpler ones in a framework that is even more agnostic than Shannon's.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论网络模型的数学构造（熵最大化、概率分布推导），未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：高阶网络（higher-order networks）的统计物理模型，具体为q-指数随机图（q-Exponential Random Graphs），以及其与经典指数随机图（ERGs）的对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非香农熵（Uffink熵）最大化框架下，仅使用简单的约束条件（如总边数、度序列）即可自然产生高阶网络特征，包括稀疏-稠密相变、更丰富的同配性与聚类结构，以及边稀疏性与三角闭合的共存。这些现象在传统香农熵最大化的指数随机图中不存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非香农熵（Uffink熵）最大化框架下，仅使用简单的约束条件（如总边数、度序列）即可自然产生高阶网络特征，包括稀疏-稠密相变、更丰富的同配性与聚类结构，以及边稀疏性与三角闭合的共存。这些现象在传统香农熵最大化的指数随机图中不存在。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但核心创新在于：证明高阶网络行为（如相变、高阶聚类）不一定需要引入高阶约束（如三角形计数），而可以从更无偏（agnostic）的非香农熵框架下、仅用简单的一阶约束自然涌现。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于Uffink熵最大化得到q-指数分布，将经典的Erdos-Renyi模型和配置模型推广到非香农情形，保持约束条件不变但允许边之间产生依赖。

papers.title: On the transformation of the Maxwell-Boltzmann Distribution to a Power-Law
papers.abstract: Power-law (PL) distribution functions (DF) are prevalent in highly diverse systems. The systems range in size from nanometer to mega light years, in complexity from dust grains to living organisms, and characterize the distribution of various events in nature and in various human activities. To gain some insight on why PL DF are so prevalent, we explore the conditions leading to the formation of a PL DF in a simple system of colliding hard sphere. We follow the time evolution of the energy DF through direct Monte Carlo simulations. In statistical equilibrium, the DF evolves into the Maxwell-Boltzmann (MB) DF. A transition to a PL DF occurs when: 1. The system is initially far from equilibrium. For example, a mix of light and heavy particles with the same velocity. 2. The system dynamics is scale-free, which holds in the intermediate asymptotic regime, far from the initial and the final equilibrium states. The scale-free dynamics leads to a DF which evolves in a self-similar form. 3. The system is open with a scale-free boundary condition. For example, a constant injection of particles far from equilibrium. The DF PL index is set by the time dependence of the self-similar DF and by the boundary condition. The PL index is independent of the self-similar DF form. Conditions 1-3 are common in a great variety of systems, which may explain why PL DF are so prevalent in nature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Monte Carlo simulations、理论分析、统计力学模型。；研究对象：硬球碰撞系统中能量分布函数从麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼分布向幂律分布的转变条件与机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在远离平衡态的初始条件、无标度动力学（中间渐近区）以及无标度边界条件（如持续注入非平衡粒子）这三种条件下，硬球碰撞系统的能量分布函数会从平衡态的麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼分布演化为幂律分布，且幂律指数由自相似分布的时间依赖性和边界条件决定，与自相似分布的具体形式无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在远离平衡态的初始条件、无标度动力学（中间渐近区）以及无标度边界条件（如持续注入非平衡粒子）这三种条件下，硬球碰撞系统的能量分布函数会从平衡态的麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼分布演化为幂律分布，且幂律指数由自相似分布的时间依赖性和边界条件决定，与自相似分布的具体形式无关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 直接蒙特卡洛模拟（Direct Monte Carlo simulations），追踪硬球碰撞系统能量分布函数的时间演化，并结合自相似分析与边界条件理论推导。

papers.title: Monolithic hybrid quantum dot devices in superconducting twisted bilayer graphene
papers.abstract: Gate-tunable superconductivity in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG) has enabled the realization of superconducting devices, such as Josephson junctions, within a single crystal. This interface-free platform provides a reconfigurable and scalable architecture that overcomes limitations of conventional superconducting-semiconducting systems. Incorporating single-electron control enables access to regimes in which flat-band superconductivity competes with strong Coulomb repulsion, providing a platform for studying correlated physics phenomena. Here, we report a new class of quantum devices that combines electrostatic confinement with tunable superconductivity in a monolithic MATBG architecture. Within a single device, we demonstrate two complementary hybrid systems: superconducting islands and proximitized quantum dots. The superconducting island exhibits $2e$-periodic transport, indicating a well-defined gap protected against quasiparticle poisoning. The proximitized quantum dot hosts subgap Andreev states together with a strongly parity-modulated supercurrent.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we report a new class of quantum devices”以及“we demonstrate two complementary hybrid systems”，属于实验实现与表征。；研究对象：魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（MATBG）中的单片混合量子点器件，具体包括超导岛和近邻化量子点两种互补的混合系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单片MATBG架构中同时实现了超导岛（表现出2e周期输运，表明具有良好定义的能隙且抗准粒子中毒）和近邻化量子点（存在亚能隙Andreev态以及强宇称调制的超电流）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单片MATBG架构中同时实现了超导岛（表现出2e周期输运，表明具有良好定义的能隙且抗准粒子中毒）和近邻化量子点（存在亚能隙Andreev态以及强宇称调制的超电流）。；创新点：首次在单片MATBG架构中同时集成超导岛和近邻化量子点两种互补的混合量子系统，实现了平带超导电性与强库仑排斥竞争的可控研究平台，克服了传统超导-半导体异质结体系的界面限制。
papers.method_zh: 静电限域结合可调超导电性的单片器件制备与输运测量。具体手段包括：利用MATBG中的栅极可调超导电性构建约瑟夫森结，并通过静电限域实现单电子控制。

papers.title: Quantum geometrical description of hole spin qubits far away from the $Γ$-point
papers.abstract: Hole spin qubits provide one of the leading platforms for spin-based quantum computing due to their large intrinsic spin-orbit interaction (SOI), which enables fast electrical manipulation. The SOI of planar quantum dots has mostly been investigated in theoretical studies by examining the SOI already present in the two-dimensional hole gas (2DHG). Here, we study the SOI created by the in-plane confinement by deriving non-perturbative effective Hamiltonians numerically for hole spin qubits. We find that the quantum geometry of the 2DHG naturally emerges, leading to a meaningful non-perturbative definition of pseudospin valid far away from the $Γ$-point. The SOI of the 2DHG and of the in-plane confinement have different forms; therefore, they cannot be turned off simultaneously, ruining the perfect spin-orbit switch functionality of spin qubits. We construct effective Hamiltonians using the symmetry approach for various low-dimensional hole systems: (i) a heavy-hole confined in a SiGe/Ge/SiGe heterostructure, (ii) a light-hole confined in SnGe/Ge, (iii) a gate-defined nanowire in SiGe/Ge/SiGe, and (iv) a hole confined in a Ge/Si core/shell nanowire. The non-perturbative effective Hamiltonians provide results with excellent agreement with the full Hamiltonians.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：deriving non-perturbative effective Hamiltonians numerically、symmetry approach、theoretical studies）；研究对象：空穴自旋量子比特，具体包括四种低维空穴系统：(i) SiGe/Ge/SiGe异质结中的重空穴，(ii) SnGe/Ge中的轻空穴，(iii) SiGe/Ge/SiGe中栅极定义的纳米线，(iv) Ge/Si核壳纳米线中的空穴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维空穴气的量子几何自然涌现，给出了远离Γ点仍有效的非微扰赝自旋定义；二维空穴气自旋轨道耦合与面内限制势产生的自旋轨道耦合形式不同，无法同时关闭，破坏了自旋量子比特的完美自旋-轨道开关功能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维空穴气的量子几何自然涌现，给出了远离Γ点仍有效的非微扰赝自旋定义；二维空穴气自旋轨道耦合与面内限制势产生的自旋轨道耦合形式不同，无法同时关闭，破坏了自旋量子比特的完美自旋-轨道开关功能。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过数值方法推导非微扰有效哈密顿量，并利用对称性方法构建低维空穴系统的有效哈密顿量。

papers.title: Interfacial mass transfer resistance at fluid-fluid interfaces
papers.abstract: Complex chemistry in nano- and microscale compartments is often governed by how quickly reagents transit a fluid-fluid interface. Mass transport across interfaces is commonly modeled by assuming local equilibrium, enforcing continuity of chemical potential across the interface. While adequate at large scales, this approximation may break down at the microscale, where interfacial processes can become rate-limiting. Here, we extend linear irreversible thermodynamics to describe nonequilibrium interfacial mass transport. We identify an interface-limited regime, in which transport is governed by interfacial resistance and exhibits exponential relaxation. Combining microfluidic and spectroscopic techniques, we introduce an experimental technique that explores this regime and provides a direct measurement of the interfacial mass transfer coefficient. For a model system consisting of acetonitrile transport across a surfactant-stabilized water-oil interface, we obtain an interfacial transport coefficient ${M \sim 7\,{\rm nm/s}}$. These results establish interfacial mass transfer resistance as a governing mechanism in microscale transport and provide a framework to predict, control and measure mass transport in multiphase systems at microscale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论推导 + 实验测量）。关键词：extend linear irreversible thermodynamics（理论扩展）、introduce an experimental technique（实验技术）、microfluidic and spectroscopic techniques（微流控与光谱技术）。；研究对象：流体-流体界面处的质量传输阻力，具体以表面活性剂稳定的水-油界面中乙腈的跨界面传输为模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在微尺度下，界面质量传输存在一个由界面阻力主导的指数弛豫区域，并首次直接测量了界面传质系数（约7 nm/s），证实界面传质阻力是微尺度多相传输的关键机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在微尺度下，界面质量传输存在一个由界面阻力主导的指数弛豫区域，并首次直接测量了界面传质系数（约7 nm/s），证实界面传质阻力是微尺度多相传输的关键机制。；创新点：突破了传统假设界面局部平衡的局限，揭示了微尺度下界面传质阻力成为速率限制步骤的新机制，并提供了直接测量界面传质系数的实验框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面：扩展线性不可逆热力学描述非平衡界面质量传输，识别出界面限制区域。实验方面：结合微流控与光谱技术，设计直接测量界面传质系数的实验方法。

papers.title: Percolation of a rod-like particle in a static bed of spheres: trapping and passing
papers.abstract: We numerically investigate percolation of independent frictionless glued-sphere rod-like particles under gravity through a disordered static bed of larger spheres. We identify two distinct regimes: a \emph{trapping} regime, where rods stop after percolating a limited distance in the bed and a \emph{passing} regime, where rods percolate continuously with constant mean velocity. The transition between these regimes is governed by the length of the rod and the geometrical trapping threshold for spherical particles based on the rod diameter and the minimum pore throat diameter defined by three touching large spheres. The percolation velocity for all rod geometries, including the single sphere limit, collapses onto a single curve when scaled with the gravitational acceleration and the bed sphere diameter. The results also demonstrate that short rods percolate nearly twice as fast as long rods due to the geometric constraints associated with the disordered pore structure of the static bed. Consequently, long rods are more susceptible to trapping via specific contact configurations with the bed spheres, which differ from those for short rods. These results reveal how shape anisotropy introduces dynamical constraints and thresholds in granular percolation, with implications for predicting segregation in mixtures of non-spherical particles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：numerically investigate、glued-sphere rod-like particles、disordered static bed）；研究对象：棒状颗粒在静态球体颗粒床中的渗透行为，具体研究重力作用下独立无摩擦的棒状颗粒在无序大球床中的渗透、捕获与通过现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 棒状颗粒在球床中存在两种截然不同的渗透状态：被捕获（trapping）和持续通过（passing），其转变由棒长与基于棒直径及最小孔喉直径的几何捕获阈值共同决定。短棒渗透速度约为长棒的两倍，长棒更易因特定接触构型而被捕获。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：棒状颗粒在球床中存在两种截然不同的渗透状态：被捕获（trapping）和持续通过（passing），其转变由棒长与基于棒直径及最小孔喉直径的几何捕获阈值共同决定。短棒渗透速度约为长棒的两倍，长棒更易因特定接触构型而被捕获。；创新点：揭示了形状各向异性（棒状 vs 球形）在颗粒渗透中引入的动力学约束和阈值，特别是棒长对渗透速度及捕获机制的差异化影响，为预测非球形颗粒混合物中的分离行为提供了新见解。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟方法，采用无摩擦的胶合球模型构建棒状颗粒，在重力作用下通过无序静态大球床进行渗透模拟，分析不同棒长下的渗透速度、捕获概率及接触构型。

papers.title: Generic long-range correlations in nonequilibrium mixtures
papers.abstract: We study correlation functions in generic non-equilibrium mixtures, including multi-temperature systems and non-reciprocal field theories. The corresponding linear theory is short-ranged, and nonlinearities are irrelevant in the renormalization-group sense. Nonetheless, we find that these nonlinearities generate long-ranged three-point correlations in the isotropic disordered phase. Our analytical predictions, which are based on a phenomenological theory, are confirmed by numerical simulations of Brownian colloids in contact with thermal baths at different temperatures. Dangerously irrelevant nonlinearities in non-equilibrium mixtures thus offer a new route to long-range correlations, supporting the hypothesis that such correlations are not the exception but the rule out of equilibrium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟验证）。关键词：phenomenological theory、renormalization-group、numerical simulations。；研究对象：非平衡混合体系中的长程关联现象，包括多温度系统和不可逆场论。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非平衡混合体系中，即使线性理论是短程的且非线性项在重整化群意义下是“危险无关”的，这些非线性项仍能在各向同性无序相中产生长程的三点关联函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非平衡混合体系中，即使线性理论是短程的且非线性项在重整化群意义下是“危险无关”的，这些非线性项仍能在各向同性无序相中产生长程的三点关联函数。；创新点：揭示了非平衡混合体系中“危险无关非线性项”是产生长程关联的新机制，支持了“长程关联在非平衡体系中是常态而非例外”的假设。
papers.method_zh: 基于唯象理论进行解析分析，并通过布朗胶体粒子在不同温度热浴中的数值模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Open Wilson chain numerical renormalization group approach to steady-state non-equilibrium quantum transport
papers.abstract: The numerical renormalization group (NRG) approach was developed to identify and quantify different equilibrium regimes of quantum impurity systems (QISs) with unprecedented accuracy by a tailored finite size representation. Out of equilibrium, the steady-state density operator is not of the Boltzmannian form but one that is determined by the imposed boundary conditions. We extend the NRG to the nonequilibrium setting by augmenting each Wilson site with a reservoir, whose coupling functions are calculated via a continuous fraction expansion in order to recover the continuum limit exactly. The nonequilibrium parameters such as a finite bias as well as a finite temperature gradient enters through the Bloch-Redfield tensor (BRT), whose zero eigenvector gives the steady-state density operator. We used the resulting open chain full density matrix (OC-FDM) approach with an effective single lead description to investigate the charge and spin transport through a quantum dot (QD) under finite bias and temperature gradient. The influence of lead asymmetry and an external magnetic field on the transport properties are also studied. For completeness, we have also investigated local properties of the QD, such as charge fluctuations and find excellent agreement with real-time quantum Monte Carlo (RT-QMC) data. The OC-FDM approach was able to explore Kondo energy scales as low as $T_K/D \approx 10^{-8}$ in the non-equilibrium regime, as well as show convergence with the established equilibrium benchmarks, such as a quantitative agreement with full density matrix numerical renormalization group (FDM-NRG) and Fermi-liquid scaling at small bias and temperature. Owing to the effective single lead description, a single OC-FDM data point takes orders of magnitude less time on a standard laptop, compared to other state-of-the-art numerical methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：numerical renormalization group (NRG)、steady-state density operator、Bloch-Redfield tensor、full density matrix approach。；研究对象：非平衡稳态下的量子杂质系统（QIS），具体为有限偏压和温度梯度下的量子点（QD）中的电荷与自旋输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将每个Wilson位点耦合一个储库并利用连续分数展开恢复连续极限，成功将数值重整化群（NRG）扩展至非平衡稳态，实现了对低至 \( T_K/D \approx 10^{-8} \) 的Kondo能标的探索，并与平衡态基准（如FDM-NRG和费米液体标度）定量吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将每个Wilson位点耦合一个储库并利用连续分数展开恢复连续极限，成功将数值重整化群（NRG）扩展至非平衡稳态，实现了对低至 \( T_K/D \approx 10^{-8} \) 的Kondo能标的探索，并与平衡态基准（如FDM-NRG和费米液体标度）定量吻合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 开放Wilson链全密度矩阵（OC-FDM）方法，结合Bloch-Redfield张量（BRT）求零本征矢以获得稳态密度算符，采用有效单引线描述，并与实时量子蒙特卡洛（RT-QMC）数据对比验证。

papers.title: Lattice dynamics and the spectroscopic signatures of H-bond disorder in $δ$-AlOOH
papers.abstract: Raman and infrared anomalies associated with H-bond symmetrization in $δ$-AlOOH, including mode softening and linewidth broadening at 5-10 GPa, occur at significantly lower pressures than predicted by static harmonic theory. To resolve this discrepancy, we combine harmonic phonon calculations with strongly constrained and appropriately normed (SCAN)-based deep-potential molecular dynamics and phonon quasiparticle analysis at 300 K. This framework extracts temperature- and pressure-dependent frequencies and lifetimes from long-time trajectories, capturing the branch reorganization and rapid linewidth growth characteristic of the disordering regime. Incorporating quasiparticle renormalization and directional longitudinal-optical-transverse-optical (LO-TO) splitting further yields near-quantitative agreement with the ambient-pressure OH-stretching Raman multiplet. These results identify finite-temperature dynamical effects and the progressive loss of spectral coherence as the origin of the spectroscopic signatures of H-bond symmetrization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：harmonic phonon calculations、deep-potential molecular dynamics、phonon quasiparticle analysis）；研究对象：δ-AlOOH 中氢键无序化相关的晶格动力学及其光谱特征，特别是氢键对称化过程中的拉曼和红外异常。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限温度动力学效应和光谱相干性的逐步丧失是 δ-AlOOH 中氢键对称化光谱特征（如模式软化、线宽展宽）的起源，解释了这些现象在远低于静态谐波理论预测压力下出现的原因。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限温度动力学效应和光谱相干性的逐步丧失是 δ-AlOOH 中氢键对称化光谱特征（如模式软化、线宽展宽）的起源，解释了这些现象在远低于静态谐波理论预测压力下出现的原因。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合谐波声子计算、基于强约束适当范数泛函（SCAN）的深度势分子动力学模拟（300 K），以及声子准粒子分析，从长时间轨迹中提取随温度和压力变化的频率与寿命，并引入准粒子重整化和方向性 LO-TO 分裂。

papers.title: Tailoring the properties of YBa$_{2}$Cu$_{3}$O$_{7-δ}$ thin films by 30 keV He$^+$ irradiation: An enabling route to superconducting device nanopatterning
papers.abstract: Focused helium ion beam (He-FIB) irradiation with 30 keV ions is a key tool for nanoscale patterning and defect engineering in high transition temperature (Tc) cuprate superconducting devices, yet its usable fluence window is constrained by the competing requirements of reliable superconductivity suppression and minimal structural degradation. In this work, we provide a comprehensive dataset on the effects of large-area 30 keV He+ ion exposure on the electric transport and superconducting properties of epitaxial YBa2Cu3O7 (YBCO) thin films. X-ray diffraction shows a fluence-driven loss of crystalline order accompanied by an out-of-plane lattice expansion and an orthorhombic-to-tetragonal transition, culminating at predominant amorphization at the highest fluence of 1 x 10^16 cm^-2. Raman spectra exhibit increasing disorder while lacking signatures of oxygen depletion, indicating that irradiation mainly generates oxygen-related Frenkel defects rather than changing the carrier concentration. Consistently, with increasing fluence, the normal-state resistivity ρ_N(T) at temperature T above Tc increases strongly, while d ρ_N/d T remains nearly unchanged at moderate fluence. The suppression of Tc is accurately described by Abrikosov-Gor'kov pair breaking and reaches complete quenching of superconductivity at 4.5 x 10^15 cm^-2. The anisotropic upper critical fields decrease approximately exponentially with increasing fluence, the vortex activation energy is reduced, and the anisotropy drops, in contrast to oxygen-depleted YBCO. Hall-angle analysis confirms a nearly constant carrier density but a systematic increase in defect scattering and reduced mobility, consistent with a crossover toward the dirty limit at high fluence. These results establish quantitative fluence thresholds and a practical operational window for He-FIB nanopatterning of YBCO quantum circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了X射线衍射、拉曼光谱、电输运测量等具体实验手段，并提供了系统的实验数据。；研究对象：YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ（YBCO）高温超导薄膜，以及30 keV He⁺离子辐照对其电输运和超导性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 30 keV He⁺离子辐照通过产生氧相关的弗仑克尔缺陷而非改变载流子浓度，有效抑制YBCO薄膜的超导电性，并在4.5×10¹⁵ cm⁻²的注量下完全淬灭超导，同时建立了可用于He-FIB纳米图案化的定量注量阈值和操作窗口。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：30 keV He⁺离子辐照通过产生氧相关的弗仑克尔缺陷而非改变载流子浓度，有效抑制YBCO薄膜的超导电性，并在4.5×10¹⁵ cm⁻²的注量下完全淬灭超导，同时建立了可用于He-FIB纳米图案化的定量注量阈值和操作窗口。；创新点：系统提供了大面积He⁺离子辐照对YBCO薄膜电输运和超导性质的完整数据集，明确了辐照主要产生氧弗仑克尔缺陷而非改变载流子浓度，并建立了与氧缺失YBCO不同的各向异性演化行为，为He-FIB纳米图案化YBCO量子电路提供了定量指导。
papers.method_zh: 大面积30 keV He⁺离子辐照、X射线衍射（XRD）、拉曼光谱、电阻率与上临界场各向异性测量、霍尔角分析、Abrikosov-Gor'kov对破坏模型拟合。

papers.title: On the physical meaning of latent track boundaries in swift heavy ion irradiated polymers
papers.abstract: A large body of experimental studies of swift heavy ion latent tracks in dielectric materials has produced a wide range of estimates of track size. We investigate the physical meaning of these estimates by examining the different criteria of track boundary probed by various experimental techniques, including SAXS, XRD, chemical etching and conductometry. We show that different methods probe different physical aspects of ion induced modification, such as electron density redistribution, molecular ordering, chemical reactivity and charge separation, resulting in different determinations of effective track boundaries. Particular attention is paid to polymer films with electret-like properties, where post irradiation redistribution of weakly bound electrons may play an important role in the evolution of latent track structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experimental studies、SAXS、XRD、chemical etching、conductometry）；研究对象：快重离子在聚合物中产生的潜径迹（latent tracks），特别是具有驻极体性质的聚合物薄膜中潜径迹边界的物理意义。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不同实验技术（如SAXS、XRD、化学刻蚀、电导测量）探测的是离子辐照诱导的不同物理方面（如电子密度重分布、分子有序性、化学反应活性、电荷分离），因此会得到不同的有效径迹边界尺寸估计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不同实验技术（如SAXS、XRD、化学刻蚀、电导测量）探测的是离子辐照诱导的不同物理方面（如电子密度重分布、分子有序性、化学反应活性、电荷分离），因此会得到不同的有效径迹边界尺寸估计。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 综合分析了多种实验技术对潜径迹边界的探测结果，包括小角X射线散射（SAXS）、X射线衍射（XRD）、化学刻蚀和电导测量（conductometry），并特别关注了具有驻极体性质的聚合物薄膜中弱束缚电子的后辐照重分布效应。

papers.title: First-principles calculations of internal conversion processes in spin defects
papers.abstract: Optically active spin defects are foundational for quantum technologies, yet common approximations underestimate their internal conversion (IC) rates by orders of magnitude. We propose a broad, predictive framework to compute IC rates that incorporates multi-configurational effects via many-body wavefunctions in TDDFT, and includes all-phonon-mode contributions via analytical non-adiabatic couplings. Our approach resolves discrepancies with experiment, achieving quantitative agreement for the NV$^-$ center in diamond, and identifying a previously overlooked non-radiative channel in the divacancy triplet lifetime in SiC.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“First-principles calculations”、“TDDFT”、“analytical non-adiabatic couplings”。；研究对象：光学活性自旋缺陷中的内转换（IC）过程，具体包括金刚石中的NV⁻色心和碳化硅（SiC）中的双空位缺陷。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种新的计算框架，能够定量解释NV⁻色心的内转换速率与实验的差异，并发现了SiC中双空位三重态寿命中一个此前被忽视的非辐射通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种新的计算框架，能够定量解释NV⁻色心的内转换速率与实验的差异，并发现了SiC中双空位三重态寿命中一个此前被忽视的非辐射通道。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）的多体波函数来包含多组态效应，并通过解析非绝热耦合计算所有声子模式的贡献。

papers.title: Bacterial adhesion to curved surfaces in fluid flow
papers.abstract: Minimising bacterial surface adhesion and subsequent biofilm formation in industrial and medical settings requires understanding how bacteria are transported and adhere to complex surface geometries in the presence of non-uniform flow. In this paper, we consider the transport of a dilute suspension of motile bacteria through a corrugated two-dimensional channel with perfectly adhesive walls. We asymptotically analyse the diffusive boundary layer that forms in high velocity flows using a curvilinear coordinate system based on the fluid streamfunction, presenting a similarity solution to the diffusivity-varying diffusion-type equation that arises. From this solution, we derive an analytical expression for the bacterial adhesion rate as a function of surface arclength and the spatially varying wall shear rate. Our model predicts that bacterial adhesion becomes localised on curved surfaces, with bacteria showing preferential adhesion to wall `peaks' at lower shear rates and preferential adhesion to wall `valleys' at higher shear rates. More broadly, our results highlight how spatially varying flows generated by complex geometries can lead to localised bacterial adhesion, with potential implications for both enhancing and minimising biofilm formation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：asymptotically analyse、similarity solution、analytical expression、model predicts）；研究对象：细菌在流体流动中对弯曲表面的粘附行为，具体为运动细菌在具有波纹形壁面的二维通道中的输运与粘附。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 细菌粘附在弯曲表面上呈现局域化特征：在低剪切速率下，细菌优先粘附于壁面“峰”处；在高剪切速率下，则优先粘附于壁面“谷”处。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：细菌粘附在弯曲表面上呈现局域化特征：在低剪切速率下，细菌优先粘附于壁面“峰”处；在高剪切速率下，则优先粘附于壁面“谷”处。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于流体流函数的曲线坐标系，对高速流动中形成的扩散边界层进行渐近分析，推导出变扩散系数扩散型方程的相似解，并由此得到细菌粘附率随表面弧长和局部壁面剪切速率的解析表达式。

papers.title: Boltzmann-Like Occupation of Nonequilibrium Steady States on Dense Networks
papers.abstract: A central problem in statistical physics is to extend the Boltzmann distribution to nonequilibrium steady states (NESS). We prove that NESS on large dense networks have Boltzmann-like occupation despite extensive entropy production. We further show that the active-matter heuristic of "low rattling" is asymptotically exact. Intuitively, these NESS spend a greater fraction of their time in states they leave more slowly. This explanation extends to the broader class of "equiaccessible" steady states, which play a role in our analysis akin to that of equilibrium in linear response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：prove、heuristic、analysis、linear response。；研究对象：非平衡稳态（NESS）在大规模稠密网络上的占据行为，以及“低抖动”（low rattling）启发式方法的有效性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了在大规模稠密网络上，尽管存在广泛的熵产生，非平衡稳态仍具有类似玻尔兹曼分布的占据数；并进一步证明了“低抖动”启发式方法在渐近意义上是精确的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了在大规模稠密网络上，尽管存在广泛的熵产生，非平衡稳态仍具有类似玻尔兹曼分布的占据数；并进一步证明了“低抖动”启发式方法在渐近意义上是精确的。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数学证明，涉及“等可达”（equiaccessible）稳态的概念，并将其类比于线性响应中的平衡态。

papers.title: Extending Covariant Fluctuation Theorems into Quantum Regime through Quasiprobability Approach
papers.abstract: The covariant formulation of stochastic thermodynamics requires treating the stochastic work as a 4-vector, posing significant challenges for quantum systems due to the non-commutativity. We introduce a new quasiprobability distribution for the work 4-vector, which combines the Wigner and Margenau-Hill quasiprobabilities. This extends the covariant fluctuation theorems from classical to quantum regime. We illustrate our findings with a scalar field driven by classical particles with a generalized version of trace formula. Our work establishes a quasiprobability approach to studying relativistic quantum thermodynamics in a covariant way.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“introduce a new quasiprobability distribution”、“extends the covariant fluctuation theorems”等理论构建与推导的表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：相对论性量子热力学中的协变涨落定理，具体涉及标量场与经典粒子驱动的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入一种结合Wigner和Margenau-Hill准概率的新准概率分布，成功将协变涨落定理从经典领域推广到量子领域，实现了对相对论量子热力学的协变描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入一种结合Wigner和Margenau-Hill准概率的新准概率分布，成功将协变涨落定理从经典领域推广到量子领域，实现了对相对论量子热力学的协变描述。；创新点：首次将协变涨落定理（原本因非对易性在量子系统中难以处理）通过准概率分布扩展到量子领域，建立了协变形式的相对论量子热力学研究框架。
papers.method_zh: 准概率方法（quasiprobability approach），具体结合了Wigner准概率与Margenau-Hill准概率，并利用广义迹公式（generalized version of trace formula）对标量场体系进行验证。

papers.title: Spin-orbit coupling by design in quantum state engineering of atomically defined quantum dots
papers.abstract: Tuning spin-orbit coupling is essential in controlling both spin and charge in confined semiconductor nanostructures, yet it is rarely a truly controllable parameter. Here, we show control over the spin-orbit Hamiltonian in quantum dots and the resulting quantum states by tailoring the confinement potential with atomic-scale precision. Using scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy, we pattern individual Cs ions into designer quantum dot structures on the surface of indium antimonide, in which electrons from a two-dimensional electron gas are confined with chosen in-plane electric-field gradients. We then quantify the atomic level structure, both spatially resolving the orbital character of the electronic states and their magnetic-field evolution. We demonstrate that the level structure, including the induced zero-field splitting, can be tailored by the designed geometry of the local electric fields. These effects can be described using a Hamiltonian that allows consistent treatment of the confinement-induced spin-orbit coupling beyond the conventional Bychkov-Rashba description. This Hamiltonian is derived from a multiband k.p model and takes the energy dependence of the relevant physical parameters into account. Such precise control of spin-orbit coupling in semiconductor quantum dots is relevant to quantum and spintronic technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy、patterning individual Cs ions、spatially resolving orbital character）；研究对象：在锑化铟（indium antimonide）表面通过原子级精度图案化Cs离子构建的量子点结构，以及其中二维电子气电子的自旋-轨道耦合调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过原子级精度设计量子点的限制势，可以调控自旋-轨道哈密顿量及由此产生的量子态能级结构（包括零场分裂），且该效应可用超越传统Bychkov-Rashba描述的哈密顿量统一处理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过原子级精度设计量子点的限制势，可以调控自旋-轨道哈密顿量及由此产生的量子态能级结构（包括零场分裂），且该效应可用超越传统Bychkov-Rashba描述的哈密顿量统一处理。；创新点：实现了对半导体量子点中自旋-轨道耦合的原子级精确设计控制，而非仅作为不可调参数；提出了超越Bychkov-Rashba描述的哈密顿量框架，能一致处理限制诱导的自旋-轨道耦合效应。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用扫描隧道显微镜（STM）和扫描隧道谱（STS）在InSb表面图案化单个Cs离子，构建具有特定面内电场梯度的量子点；理论上基于多带k·p模型推导出考虑限制诱导自旋-轨道耦合的哈密顿量，并纳入相关物理参数的能量依赖性。

papers.title: Generic nonlocal statistics of the stationary measure in conserved active systems
papers.abstract: The stationary measure of equilibrium systems with detailed balance follows a Boltzmann distribution, so that for short-ranged interactions the measure is local, meaning that distant spatial domains are statistically independent. In contrast, active systems break detailed balance, and can have nonlocal stationary measure even for fully local dynamics. Here, by expanding in nonlinearity about a Gaussian-model limit, we construct the measure perturbatively deep in the disordered phase for a class of models that includes Active Model A, Active Model B+, Model AB, the Nonreciprocal Cahn--Hilliard model, and the Toner--Tu model. In this regime, nonlocality is linked to a dynamical conservation law. Our results generically preclude construction of a Landau--Ginzburg expansion of the stationary measure (as opposed to the dynamical equations) for conserved active field theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“perturbatively”（微扰展开）、“construct the measure”（构造测度）、“Landau--Ginzburg expansion”（朗道-金兹堡展开）等理论方法关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：守恒活性系统（conserved active systems）的稳态测度（stationary measure）的非局域统计性质。具体涵盖的模型包括：Active Model A、Active Model B+、Model AB、非互易Cahn--Hilliard模型以及Toner--Tu模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无序相深处，即使动力学是完全局域的，守恒活性系统的稳态测度仍具有非局域性（即远距离空间域统计相关），且这种非局域性与动力学守恒律直接相关。该结果排除了为守恒活性场论构造稳态测度的朗道-金兹堡展开的可能性（区别于动力学方程的展开）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无序相深处，即使动力学是完全局域的，守恒活性系统的稳态测度仍具有非局域性（即远距离空间域统计相关），且这种非局域性与动力学守恒律直接相关。该结果排除了为守恒活性场论构造稳态测度的朗道-金兹堡展开的可能性（区别于动力学方程的展开）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 围绕高斯模型极限进行非线性微扰展开，在无序相深处微扰构造稳态测度。

papers.title: On-chip superconducting GHz RF reflectometry of the capacitance response in bilayer graphene
papers.abstract: In dual-gated bilayer graphene, a perpendicular displacement field opens a band gap that modifies both the channel conductance and the electronic compressibility, motivating measurements that resolve resistive and capacitive responses on the same device. We integrate an hBN-encapsulated bilayer graphene heterostructure with an on-chip superconducting Nb lumped-element LC resonator and carry out RF reflectometry near 4.25 GHz. DC transport and finite-bias spectroscopy on the same device provide a transport reference. Top and bottom gates independently set the carrier density and displacement field. The DC and RF gate maps share the same gate-dependent features, with finite-bias measurements revealing a region of suppressed conductance whose bias extent grows with the displacement field, consistent with a field-induced gap. The gate-dependent resonance-frequency shift is converted to the effective capacitance seen by the resonator using an equivalent-circuit model. The capacitance shows a minimum near the conductance-suppressed region, consistent with reduced electronic compressibility in the gapped bilayer graphene, and exhibits an electron-hole asymmetry. The on-chip configuration probes the gate-dependent admittance of a dual-gated van der Waals heterostructure, providing capacitance-sensitive information that complements DC transport within a single device.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“集成”、“进行射频反射测量”、“直流输运和有限偏压光谱”等实验操作和测量手段。；研究对象：双栅极双层石墨烯（bilayer graphene）异质结。具体研究其在外加垂直位移场下产生的能隙，以及该能隙对沟道电导和电子压缩率（电容响应）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双层石墨烯中，通过片上超导射频反射测量技术，观测到与位移场诱导能隙相关的电容最小值，该最小值与电导抑制区域一致，并表现出电子-空穴不对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双层石墨烯中，通过片上超导射频反射测量技术，观测到与位移场诱导能隙相关的电容最小值，该最小值与电导抑制区域一致，并表现出电子-空穴不对称性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：在单个器件上，利用片上超导射频反射技术同时且互补地探测了双栅极范德华异质结的电阻（直流输运）和电容（电子压缩率）响应，特别是对能隙区域的电容特性进行了高灵敏度测量。

papers.title: SmoQyElPhQMC.jl: An open-source Julia package for efficient and scalable quantum Monte Carlo simulations of electron-phonon coupled models
papers.abstract: We introduce version 1.0 of the SmoQyElPhQMC package, an open-source Julia code for performing scalable quantum Monte Carlo simulations of electron-phonon coupled model Hamiltonians. SmoQyElPhQMC is built upon the SmoQyDQMC codebase and implements improved versions of the algorithms presented in [B. Cohen-Stead \textit{et al}., Phys. Rev. E {\bf 105}, 065302 (2022)] to enable linear-scaling simulations of a broad class of uncorrelated $e$-ph models both in system size and inverse temperature. By extending the functionality of the flexible scripting interface introduced in SmoQyDQMC, the SmoQyElPhQMC package continues to allow users to adapt it to different workflows and interface with other software packages in the Julia ecosystem. The code for this package can be downloaded from our GitHub repository at https://github.com/SmoQySuite/SmoQyElPhQMC.jl or installed using the Julia package manager. The online documentation, including examples, can be obtained from our documentation page at https://smoqysuite.github.io/SmoQyElPhQMC.jl/stable/.

papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要介绍软件包的功能与性能：实现了线性标度（linear-scaling）的量子蒙特卡洛模拟，可高效处理大系统尺寸和低温。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要介绍软件包的功能与性能：实现了线性标度（linear-scaling）的量子蒙特卡洛模拟，可高效处理大系统尺寸和低温。；创新点：在SmoQyDQMC的灵活脚本接口基础上，扩展了电子-声子耦合模型模拟功能，并实现了更高效的线性标度算法，同时保持与Julia生态系统中其他软件包的兼容性。

papers.title: Strain- and doping-tunable optical resonance in Kekulé-Y graphene
papers.abstract: We investigate the optical response of Kekulé-Y graphene under uniaxial strain and carrier doping. Using a low-energy effective Hamiltonian, we show that strain reshapes the low-energy electronic structure of the Kekulé-Y phase and induces Van Hove singularities at energies well below those of pristine graphene. Within the Kubo formalism, we calculate the optical conductivity and identify multiple anisotropic interband features, with a pronounced resonance arising from strain-induced Van Hove singularities. The pronounced resonance is strongly anisotropic and robust against moderate thermal broadening and disorder, providing a clear optical signature of Kekulé-Y ordering. We further derive analytical expressions for the low-energy optical conductivity and the Drude weight, providing a detailed characterization of the strain- and doping-dependent optical response. Our results establish strain engineering as an effective route for controlling valley-dependent optical properties in Kekulé-Y graphene, originating from the Kekulé-induced coupling of the Dirac valleys, and suggest feasible optical probes for the experimental identification of the Kekulé-Y phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。关键词：low-energy effective Hamiltonian、Kubo formalism、analytical expressions。；研究对象：Kekulé-Y 石墨烯在单轴应变和载流子掺杂下的光学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 应变在Kekulé-Y石墨烯中诱导出能量远低于原始石墨烯的范霍夫奇点，从而产生强各向异性的光学共振，该共振对热展宽和无序具有鲁棒性，可作为Kekulé-Y相的光学特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：应变在Kekulé-Y石墨烯中诱导出能量远低于原始石墨烯的范霍夫奇点，从而产生强各向异性的光学共振，该共振对热展宽和无序具有鲁棒性，可作为Kekulé-Y相的光学特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但核心新意在于揭示了应变工程可有效调控Kekulé-Y石墨烯中由谷耦合导致的谷依赖光学性质，并提出了实验上识别Kekulé-Y相的光学探测手段。
papers.method_zh: 采用低能有效哈密顿量描述电子结构，基于Kubo公式计算光学电导率，并推导了低能光学电导率和Drude权重的解析表达式。

papers.title: Modifying Electrochemical Doping in Light-Emitting Electrochemical Cells with Gold Nanoparticles
papers.abstract: Electrochemical doping offers dynamic control of the electronic properties of organic semiconductors, and it is the enabling feature of a range of technologies, including electrochemical transistors, energy-storage devices, light-emitting electrochemical cells (LECs), and bioelectronics. Electrochemical doping is commonly controlled by the selection of the constituents in the active material of the device or the applied voltage bias, but herein we report that the incorporation of Au nanoparticles (Au-NPs) at an electrode interface can constitute an alternative control parameter. The LEC features balanced p- and n-type electrochemical doping that forms a p-n junction doping structure in its active material, and we find that it is possible to reshape this doping profile by incorporating Au-NPs at an electrode interface. Specifically, we establish that the inclusion of neat non-capped Au-NPs at the anodic interface shifts the p-n junction (i.e., the emission zone) away from the anode. In contrast, the inclusion of Au-NPs capped with sodium citrate is found to reverse this behavior, so that the emission zone is instead moved towards the anode. We utilize this control parameter to shift the emission zone towards a position of constructive (destructive) interference, as manifested in a strong increase (decrease) of the LEC emission efficiency. Our findings establish an interfacial strategy for modulating the spatial profile of electrochemical doping and tuning device performance without altering the chemistry of the active material, relying instead on the surface modification of one electrode. This approach is important because it provides a versatile and minimally invasive route to optimize electrochemical devices while preserving the intrinsic properties and formulation of the active material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：incorporation of Au nanoparticles、LEC features、experimental observation。；研究对象：发光电化学池（LEC）中电化学掺杂的空间分布调控，具体涉及在电极界面引入金纳米颗粒（Au-NPs）对p-n结掺杂结构的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在LEC阳极界面引入无配体金纳米颗粒可使p-n结（即发光区）远离阳极，而引入柠檬酸钠包覆的金纳米颗粒则使发光区移向阳极；利用这一效应可调控发光区位置至干涉相长或相消位置，从而显著增强或降低器件发光效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在LEC阳极界面引入无配体金纳米颗粒可使p-n结（即发光区）远离阳极，而引入柠檬酸钠包覆的金纳米颗粒则使发光区移向阳极；利用这一效应可调控发光区位置至干涉相长或相消位置，从而显著增强或降低器件发光效率。；创新点：提出了一种不改变活性材料化学组成，仅通过电极界面修饰（引入金纳米颗粒）来调控电化学掺杂空间分布的新策略，为优化电化学器件性能提供了一种通用且微扰小的途径。
papers.method_zh: 制备发光电化学池器件，在电极界面分别引入无配体金纳米颗粒和柠檬酸钠包覆的金纳米颗粒，通过测量发光区位置变化及器件发光效率来表征电化学掺杂轮廓的调控效果。

papers.title: Local Coverage Governs Memorization in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Memorization in diffusion models is often treated as a global property of the model or dataset. In practice, however, a single diffusion model can simultaneously generate both memorized and novel samples. Which training samples are most likely to be memorized? In this work, we show that memorization is governed by \emph{local data coverage}. Leveraging the connection between diffusion models and kernel density estimation (KDE), we derive a theoretical criterion that predicts whether a point is memorized based on the density of training data in its neighborhood and the size of the training dataset. In the high-dimensional limit, this leads to a sharp, local transition: regions of low coverage are dominated by isolated training samples, which are memorized, while dense regions support interpolation and generalization. We validate these predictions empirically, showing that memorization increases with local sparsity and that diffusion models exhibit a coexistence of memorized and novel samples within the same model. Extending this framework to multi-class settings, we further show that classes with higher intra-class sparsity (and thus lower local coverage) are more strongly memorized. Our results provide a local view of memorization in diffusion models, explaining when and where memorization occurs in terms of data geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验验证）。判断依据：推导理论判据（derived a theoretical criterion）、高维极限分析（high-dimensional limit）、以及经验验证（validate empirically）。；研究对象：扩散模型（Diffusion Models）中的记忆化（Memorization）现象。具体研究的是训练样本在何种局部数据几何条件下会被模型记忆，而非泛化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 扩散模型的记忆化由局部数据覆盖度（local data coverage）决定：在训练数据稀疏的局部区域，孤立样本容易被记忆；而在数据密集区域，模型倾向于插值与泛化。同一模型可同时产生记忆化样本和新颖样本。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：扩散模型的记忆化由局部数据覆盖度（local data coverage）决定：在训练数据稀疏的局部区域，孤立样本容易被记忆；而在数据密集区域，模型倾向于插值与泛化。同一模型可同时产生记忆化样本和新颖样本。；创新点：将记忆化从全局属性重新定义为局部现象，并建立了基于数据几何（局部覆盖度）的定量判据，解释了同一模型内记忆化与泛化共存的原因。
papers.method_zh: 利用扩散模型与核密度估计（Kernel Density Estimation, KDE）之间的理论联系，推导出一个基于邻域训练数据密度和数据集大小的理论判据，用于预测一个数据点是否会被记忆。在高维极限下，该判据导致一个尖锐的局部相变。研究还通过实验验证了理论预测，并扩展到多类设置。

papers.title: The Future of Computing for Materials Science Challenges
papers.abstract: Materials discovery increasingly relies on the coordinated use of theory, computation, experiment, data-driven methods, and emerging quantum technologies, yet the full potential of these tools is realised only when they operate within workflows that reflect the complexity of real systems. This perspective summarises current capabilities, limitations, and opportunities across these domains, drawing on contributions from academia, industry, and national laboratories to identify the scientific and structural requirements for more reliable and efficient discovery. Classical simulations provide broad coverage across design spaces, while experimental measurements reveal degradation, heterogeneity, and kinetic processes that determine performance under realistic conditions. Machine learning accelerates exploration when supported by well-curated datasets with clear provenance and uncertainty quantification, and quantum computing offers promising routes into correlated electronic behaviour when aligned with properties that influence engineering decisions. Collectively, these insights highlight the need for reproducible workflows, shared data standards, realistic benchmarks, and a research culture that prepares scientists to work across paradigms. By integrating these methodological and organisational elements, the community can move toward discovery processes that deliver robust predictions, support confident decision making, and shorten the path from conceptual design to deployable materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（观点/展望文章）。判断依据：关键词“perspective”（观点）、“summarises current capabilities, limitations, and opportunities”（总结当前能力、局限与机遇）、“drawing on contributions from academia, industry, and national laboratories”（综合学术界、工业界和国家实验室的贡献）。；研究对象：材料科学中的计算与发现流程。具体涉及：经典模拟、实验测量、机器学习、量子计算等多种方法在材料发现中的应用与整合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 材料发现需要将理论、计算、实验、数据驱动方法和量子技术整合到反映真实系统复杂性的工作流中，才能实现更可靠和高效的发现。当前的关键需求包括可重复的工作流、共享数据标准、现实的基准测试以及跨范式的研究文化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：材料发现需要将理论、计算、实验、数据驱动方法和量子技术整合到反映真实系统复杂性的工作流中，才能实现更可靠和高效的发现。当前的关键需求包括可重复的工作流、共享数据标准、现实的基准测试以及跨范式的研究文化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的单一技术突破，其创新点在于从系统性和组织性层面，指出了整合多种方法（经典计算、实验、机器学习、量子计算）所面临的科学和结构需求，并强调了建立可重复工作流、共享数据标准和跨范式研究文化的重要性。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的研究方法，而是对以下领域的现状进行了综述性分析：经典模拟（classical simulations）、实验测量（experimental measurements）、机器学习（machine learning）、量子计算（quantum computing）。摘要未提及具体的计算框架（如DFT+U、DMRG）或实验技术（如ARPES、分子束外延）。

papers.title: Multistate Manipulation of Charge-Spin Conversion in Two-Dimensional Ferroelectric Bilayers
