papers.abstract: Achieving nonvolatile and multistate manipulation of charge-spin conversion, including the Edelstein effect (EE) and spin Hall effect (SHE), is crucial for high-density spintronic memory. Here, we propose a mechanism to simultaneously control both EE and SHE in two-dimensional ferroelectric bilayers, where interlayer-parallel and interlayer-antiparallel polarization configurations can coexist. Symmetry analysis shows that in the interlayer-parallel states, reversal of the total polarization switches the sign of the EE, whereas changing to an interlayer-antiparallel configuration suppresses the EE to zero, enabling electrically switchable current-induced spin accumulation among three distinct states, which could be used for ternary logic operations. Meanwhile, the magnitude of the SHE can be tuned by switching between two different classes of polarization configurations, namely interlayer-parallel and interlayer-antiparallel configurations. Using first-principles calculations, we demonstrate this mechanism in bilayer metallic ferroelectric PtBi2, where both interlayer-parallel and interlayer-antiparallel polarization configurations are energetically stable. The EE coefficient in interlayer-parallel states, which can be reversed by polarization switching, arises from competing electron- and hole-pocket contributions near the Fermi surface. The intrinsic SHE coefficients originate from spin Berry curvature that can be reshaped by polarization configuration variation and Fermi-level tuning. Our results establish ferroelectric bilayers as an all-in-one platform for electrically programmable charge-spin conversion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章（关键词：symmetry analysis, first-principles calculations, spin Berry curvature）；研究对象：二维铁电双层材料中的电荷-自旋转换现象，包括Edelstein效应（EE）和自旋霍尔效应（SHE），具体材料为双层金属铁电体PtBi₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维铁电双层中，通过切换层间平行与反平行极化构型，可实现EE在正、负、零三个不同状态间的电学可调切换，同时SHE的强度也可在两种构型间被调控，从而为多态自旋电子学存储和三元逻辑操作提供全电学可编程平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维铁电双层中，通过切换层间平行与反平行极化构型，可实现EE在正、负、零三个不同状态间的电学可调切换，同时SHE的强度也可在两种构型间被调控，从而为多态自旋电子学存储和三元逻辑操作提供全电学可编程平台。；创新点：提出在单一二维铁电双层体系中同时调控EE和SHE的机制，利用层间平行与反平行极化构型的共存与切换，实现电荷-自旋转换的多态（非易失、三态）电学操控，而非仅局限于传统的二态翻转。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析（symmetry analysis）与第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）。

papers.title: Bond-operator analytical approach for the $t$-$J$ model
papers.abstract: We present a bond-operator theory (BOT) for analytical consideration of the $t$-$J$ model and its extensions with longer-rage hopping terms. This technique is based on previously suggested representation of electron operators via localized spins 1/2 and spinless Fermi-operators of mobile holons which requires no constraint between them. We introduce a representation of operators of spins, holons, and electrons in (extended) unit cell containing several lattice sites via a zoo of Bose- and Fermi-operators acting in the Hilbert space of all quantum states of the whole unit cell. BOT provides a regular expansion of physical quantities in powers of $1/n$ using conventional diagrammatic technique, where $n\ge1$ is the maximum number of introduced quasiparticles (bosons and fermions) which can occupy a unit cell. The suggested representation reproduces commutation algebra of all operators at any $n>0$ and allows to consider both magnetically ordered and disordered phases. Some elementary excitations described in the BOT by separate bosons or fermions appear in common approaches as bound states of conventional quasiparticles. In particular, there are two-hole bound states (Cooper pairs of two holes) which are described within the BOT by separate bosons. We discuss in detail properties of the $t$-$J$ model on the square lattice with no more than two holes (polarons). Although the expansion parameter $1/n$ is not small in the physically meaningful case of $n=1$, we obtain a good quantitative agreement with previous numerical findings at $n=1$ even in the first order in $1/n$ after taking into account a few simple diagrams. Self-consistent calculations in the first order in $1/n$ bring our results to a very good quantitative agreement with previous numerical findings of the ground state energy, staggered magnetization, and spectra of magnons, polarons, and lowest-energy two-hole bound states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：bond-operator theory、analytical consideration、diagrammatic technique、self-consistent calculations。；研究对象：$t$-$J$ 模型及其包含长程跳迁项的扩展形式，具体讨论了正方晶格上不超过两个空穴（极化子）的情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于键算符理论（BOT）的解析方法，即使在物理上有意义的 $n=1$ 情况下（此时展开参数 $1/n$ 并不小），仅考虑少数简单图并在一阶 $1/n$ 下进行自洽计算，也能与之前数值结果在基态能量、交错磁化强度、磁振子、极化子及最低能量双空穴束缚态谱等方面取得非常好的定量一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于键算符理论（BOT）的解析方法，即使在物理上有意义的 $n=1$ 情况下（此时展开参数 $1/n$ 并不小），仅考虑少数简单图并在一阶 $1/n$ 下进行自洽计算，也能与之前数值结果在基态能量、交错磁化强度、磁振子、极化子及最低能量双空穴束缚态谱等方面取得非常好的定量一致。；创新点：BOT 将通常方法中视为常规准粒子束缚态（如双空穴库珀对）的激发，描述为独立的玻色子或费米子，从而提供了一种新的解析处理框架。摘要未突出说明与已有键算符理论相比的具体改进。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种键算符理论（BOT），通过引入局域自旋1/2和无自旋费米子空穴算符（两者之间无约束）来表示电子算符，并在包含多个格点的（扩展）原胞中，利用玻色子和费米子算符的集合来构建自旋、空穴和电子的算符表示。该方法基于常规的费曼图技术，以 $1/n$ 为展开参数进行正则展开（$n$ 为原胞中可容纳的最大准粒子数），并允许同时处理磁有序相和无序相。

papers.title: Spherical metadensity functional learning for inhomogeneous classical fluids
papers.abstract: We develop classical density functional learning to address fluids with truncated pairwise interparticle interactions in three-dimensional spherical geometry. Simulation data for systems with randomized repulsive pair potentials provide the basis for supervised training of a neural metadensity functional, thereby making efficient use of results for radial distribution functions in the bulk fluid via the test particle route. Specifically, we develop spherical local learning in order to represent the one-body direct correlation functional in terms of a neural network, which captures spatial curvature effects as well as the metadensity functional dependence on the thermally scaled pair potential. The framework yields efficient access to inhomogeneous structuring and related physical phenomena that occur in fluids and general solvents when adsorbed against curved solutes and confined inside of spherical and planar cavities. Test particle setups facilitate accurate prediction of the bulk fluid pair structure and verification of thermodynamic test particle sum rules via functional line integration. Applying the metadensity functional for Henderson inversion allows one to infer accurately the pair potential from the bulk radial distribution function. We address implications of the geometrical setup for two-body quantities and obtain the two-body direct correlation functional from automatic differentiation. For the hard sphere fluid, we confirm metadensity functional predictions against results from a standard neural density functional with fixed pair potential as well as to an analytic functional as given by fundamental measure theory. Simulation results provide further reference and corroborate reliable results of the spherical neural metadensity functional across a broad range of applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：classical density functional learning、neural metadensity functional、supervised training、automatic differentiation。；研究对象：非均匀经典流体，具体为具有截断成对相互作用的流体在三维球对称几何中的结构，以及硬球流体等模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过球面局域学习构建的神经元密度泛函，能够有效捕捉空间曲率效应和热标度对势的依赖，准确预测非均匀流体的结构，并可从体相径向分布函数反推对势（Henderson反演）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过球面局域学习构建的神经元密度泛函，能够有效捕捉空间曲率效应和热标度对势的依赖，准确预测非均匀流体的结构，并可从体相径向分布函数反推对势（Henderson反演）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用经典密度泛函学习框架，基于随机排斥对势系统的模拟数据进行监督训练，构建神经元密度泛函；利用测试粒子方法获取体相径向分布函数；通过自动微分获得两体直接关联泛函；与标准神经密度泛函和基本度量理论解析泛函进行对比验证。

papers.title: Modeling light-matter coupled systems with neural quantum states
papers.abstract: Recent advances in cold atom manipulation enable the study of many-body systems where short-range interactions between neighboring atoms coexist with long-range interactions mediated by photons. Such a combination of interactions makes a theoretical approach challenging beyond mean-field methods. In this work, we develop a neural quantum state based approach to study these systems numerically. We introduce a neural-network architecture capable of handling hybrid Hilbert spaces with large local bosonic dimensions in strongly interacting spin-photon systems. We benchmark this approach on a model of a two-dimensional lattice of Rydberg atoms coupled to a photon mode. The superradiant ground states found in the large spin-photon coupling regime allow us to demonstrate the efficiency of the method in the presence of high photon occupation. Furthermore, the ability to capture spin-spin and spin-photon correlations leads us to observe quantitative deviations in the ground state phase boundaries with respect to mean-field theory. The method extends to other systems with a similar hybrid Hilbert space structure, such as spin-phonon systems, and provides a scalable framework for investigating their ground state properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：neural quantum state based approach, numerically, benchmark, method extends。；研究对象：光-物质耦合系统，具体为二维里德伯原子晶格与一个光子模式耦合的模型。该系统同时存在原子间的短程相互作用和光子介导的长程相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该研究开发的基于神经量子态的方法能够有效处理具有大局域玻色子维度的混合希尔伯特空间，并在强自旋-光子耦合的超辐射基态中展示了其效率。该方法在基态相边界上发现了与平均场理论相比的定量偏差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该研究开发的基于神经量子态的方法能够有效处理具有大局域玻色子维度的混合希尔伯特空间，并在强自旋-光子耦合的超辐射基态中展示了其效率。该方法在基态相边界上发现了与平均场理论相比的定量偏差。；创新点：提出了一种可扩展的、基于神经网络的数值框架，用于研究同时存在短程和长程相互作用的复杂光-物质耦合系统，并且能够超越平均场理论，捕捉到更精确的基态相边界。该方法可推广至其他具有类似混合希尔伯特空间结构的系统（如自旋-声子系统）。
papers.method_zh: 基于神经量子态（Neural Quantum State）的数值计算方法。具体引入了一种能够处理强相互作用自旋-光子系统中混合希尔伯特空间（包含大局域玻色子维度）的神经网络架构。

papers.title: Mass-imbalanced two-dimensional Bose-Fermi mixtures with boson-fermion pairing
papers.abstract: We analyze a two-dimensional Bose-Fermi mixture at zero temperature in the presence of a tunable Bose-Fermi attraction. We adopt a diagrammatic T-matrix approach and study the behavior of several thermodynamic quantities for the two species as functions of density, mass ratio, and coupling strength. These include the chemical potentials, the boson momentum distribution function, the condensate density, and Tan's contact parameter. We analytically demonstrate that the present T-matrix formalism recovers the correct second-order perturbative expansion of the chemical potentials in the weak-coupling regime, and test it numerically. The near-universal behavior already found in prior work for the mass-balanced case is confirmed for different masses and becomes even more accurate when the boson mass is large. The mass imbalance emerges as an additional control parameter that qualitatively affects the bosonic momentum distribution. In particular, we found that it can be used to allow for the experimental observation of a peculiar peak in the boson momentum distribution at finite momentum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：diagrammatic T-matrix approach（图解T矩阵方法）、analytically demonstrate（解析证明）、numerically test（数值检验）。；研究对象：零温下二维玻色-费米混合体系，存在可调玻色-费米吸引相互作用，并考虑质量不平衡（即玻色子与费米子质量不同）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 质量不平衡可作为额外调控参数，定性改变玻色子动量分布，特别是可在有限动量处产生一个独特的峰，有利于实验观测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：质量不平衡可作为额外调控参数，定性改变玻色子动量分布，特别是可在有限动量处产生一个独特的峰，有利于实验观测。；创新点：将先前质量平衡情况下的近普适行为推广到不同质量比，发现大玻色子质量时该行为更精确；揭示了质量不平衡可定性改变玻色子动量分布，并预言了有限动量处新峰的出现。
papers.method_zh: 采用图解T矩阵方法（diagrammatic T-matrix approach），解析推导并数值计算了化学势、玻色子动量分布函数、凝聚体密度和Tan接触参数等热力学量随密度、质量比和耦合强度的变化。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Bounds from Otto--Villani Functional Inequalities
papers.abstract: The dissipation in the relaxation of an ensemble of conservative stochastic systems towards the steady state is quantified by the free energy difference. Functional inequalities within the framework of [F. Otto and C. Villani, J. Funct. Anal. 173, 361 (2000)] are here revisited which connect the free energy dynamics and optimal transport, offering a geometric perspective on the instantaneous speed of relaxation in the presence of potential barriers. These are illustrated with numerical relaxation experiments on Landau-Ginzburg potentials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“functional inequalities”、“geometric perspective”等理论框架，且数值实验仅作为说明性示例。；研究对象：保守随机系统系综在势垒存在下向稳态弛豫过程中的耗散与自由能动力学，具体以Landau-Ginzburg势为例进行数值演示。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Otto-Villani泛函不等式框架，建立了自由能动力学与最优输运之间的几何联系，从而量化了系统在势垒存在下弛豫的瞬时速度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Otto-Villani泛函不等式框架，建立了自由能动力学与最优输运之间的几何联系，从而量化了系统在势垒存在下弛豫的瞬时速度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Otto与Villani（2000年）提出的泛函不等式理论框架，结合最优输运理论分析自由能弛豫的几何约束，并通过Landau-Ginzburg势的数值弛豫实验进行验证。

papers.title: Thinning-by-spinning: shear rheology of dense chiral fluids
papers.abstract: We investigate the linear and nonlinear rheology of dense chiral fluids composed of self-spinning particles under external shear. Using particle-based simulations of a two-dimensional Lennard-Jones model with transverse interactions, we show that chirality acts as an intrinsic source of fluctuations and shear. In the solid regime, spinning fluidizes the system, weakening hexatic order. In the liquid regime, the viscosity is quantitatively described by a Green-Kubo relation upon replacing the temperature by a chirality-dependent effective temperature. Beyond linear response, flow curves collapse when expressed in terms of the ratio between imposed shear and spinning rates, revealing a thinning-by-spinning mechanism. At large forcing, this correspondence breaks down and a pronounced handedness asymmetry emerges: when transverse interactions oppose the imposed shear, stresses relax through the formation of string-like flow channels. Our results identify chirality as a generic mechanism for fluidization and provide a unified framework for understanding the rheology of dense chiral suspensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：particle-based simulations、two-dimensional Lennard-Jones model）；研究对象：由自旋粒子组成的致密手性流体在外加剪切作用下的流变学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 手性可作为内在的波动与剪切源，导致系统在固态区发生流化、在液态区粘度由手性依赖的有效温度描述；在非线性响应中，流变曲线可通过外加剪切与自旋速率之比标度，揭示“自旋致稀”机制，且在大驱动力下出现手性不对称的应力弛豫通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：手性可作为内在的波动与剪切源，导致系统在固态区发生流化、在液态区粘度由手性依赖的有效温度描述；在非线性响应中，流变曲线可通过外加剪切与自旋速率之比标度，揭示“自旋致稀”机制，且在大驱动力下出现手性不对称的应力弛豫通道。；创新点：首次提出手性作为致密悬浮液流化的普适机制，并建立统一框架描述致密手性流体的流变学，特别是发现“自旋致稀”现象及手性不对称的流动通道形成。
papers.method_zh: 基于二维Lennard-Jones模型并引入横向相互作用的粒子模拟，分析线性与非线性流变响应，采用Green-Kubo关系计算粘度，并引入有效温度概念。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Framework for $q$-Affinity
papers.abstract: We develop a thermodynamic framework for non-equilibrium affinities based on generalized entropies. In particular, we extend the classical concept of De Donder by introducing $q$-affinities associated with Rényi and Tsallis entropies. This in turn allows us to generalize thermodynamic driving forces to systems with long-range interactions and/or strong correlations. For Rényi entropy, we build on a thermodynamic interpretation due to Baez, where the entropy is expressed through finite differences of the Helmholtz free energy at two temperatures. This leads to a generalized thermodynamic potential whose derivative with respect to a reaction coordinate defines the Rényi $q$-affinity. The resulting expression admits a representation in terms of exponential work averages, establishing a connection to Jarzynski-type fluctuation relations. For Tsallis entropy, we consider Markov jump processes using a master-equation-based approach. We derive a $q$-deformed entropy balance law and obtain an explicit expression for the Tsallis entropy production rate, proving its non-negativity and thus recovering a generalized second-law structure. This allows to identify a local stochastic $q$-affinity with the generalized thermodynamic force entering the entropy production rate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamic framework、generalized entropies、master-equation-based approach。；研究对象：非平衡热力学中的亲和力（affinity）概念，特别是针对具有长程相互作用和/或强关联的系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于Rényi熵和Tsallis熵，分别推广了经典De Donder亲和力，定义了“q-亲和力”，并证明了Tsallis熵产生率的非负性，从而恢复了广义第二定律结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于Rényi熵和Tsallis熵，分别推广了经典De Donder亲和力，定义了“q-亲和力”，并证明了Tsallis熵产生率的非负性，从而恢复了广义第二定律结构。；创新点：将非平衡亲和力的概念从经典玻尔兹曼-吉布斯熵推广到Rényi和Tsallis广义熵，从而为长程相互作用和强关联系统提供了广义热力学驱动力，并建立了与Jarzynski型涨落关系的联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架构建。对于Rényi熵，采用Baez的热力学诠释，通过两个温度下亥姆霍兹自由能的有限差分表达熵，进而定义Rényi q-亲和力；对于Tsallis熵，采用基于主方程的马尔可夫跳跃过程方法，推导q-变形熵平衡律并计算熵产生率。

papers.title: Pronounced in-plane anomalous Hall effect with vanishing out-of-plane response in Cr1.2Te2
papers.abstract: We report an unconventional anomalous Hall regime in the van der Waals ferromagnet Cr1.2Te2, in which the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) is present for in-plane magnetization but absent for out-of-plane magnetization. In this purely in-plane regime, the anomalous Hall signal exhibits a threefold angular dependence during both in-plane and out-of-plane rotations of the magnetization, which cannot be accounted for by the conventional dipolar contribution but instead requires an octupolar contribution. Although the octupolar term qualitatively captures the observed behavior, the experimentally extracted octupole differs quantitatively from first-principles calculations based solely on the intrinsic Berry-curvature mechanism, indicating an essential role for extrinsic scattering processes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：report, experimentally extracted, first-principles calculations 作为辅助验证）；研究对象：范德华铁磁体 Cr1.2Te2 中的反常霍尔效应（AHE）及其各向异性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Cr1.2Te2 中发现了仅存在于面内磁化方向、而面外磁化方向完全消失的反常霍尔效应，且该面内反常霍尔信号具有三倍角依赖关系，无法用常规偶极贡献解释，需要引入八极贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Cr1.2Te2 中发现了仅存在于面内磁化方向、而面外磁化方向完全消失的反常霍尔效应，且该面内反常霍尔信号具有三倍角依赖关系，无法用常规偶极贡献解释，需要引入八极贡献。；创新点：报道了一种“纯面内”反常霍尔效应新机制，即反常霍尔效应仅对面内磁化响应，而对垂直磁化完全无响应，并指出该现象源于八极贡献，且实验与理论计算在定量上的差异表明非本征散射过程（如杂质散射）在此机制中扮演了关键角色。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量了不同磁化方向下的反常霍尔效应，包括面内和面外旋转下的角度依赖关系；结合第一性原理计算（基于本征贝里曲率机制）进行对比分析。

papers.title: $p$-wave magnet and hedgehog-type Berry curvature in helimagnetic MnAu$_2$
papers.abstract: Recently discovered altermagnetism in collinear compensated magnets shows even-parity spin texture in momentum space. Beyond the collinear spin ordering, unique odd-parity spin textures emerge in noncollinear compensated magnets. The noncollinear candidates, however, remain unexplored toward a room-temperature metallic altermagnet. Here, we demonstrate that MnAu2 exhibits metallic p-wave magnetism and large spin splitting induced by helical spin ordering. By adapting the band-unfolding scheme based on the translation operators combined with spin rotations, first-principles calculations reveal an unconventional Fermi surface around the $\tilde{M}$-point composed of a single electron pocket with $p$-wave spin texture. Moreover, the spin twist in the helimagnet triggers topologically non-trivial hedgehog Berry curvature, which links to the nonlinear Hall effect and spin Hall effect. Considering the experimental T$_C$ = 335 to 370 K, MnAu$_2$ could establish itself as an ideal candidate for a room-temperature metallic $p$-wave magnet, promising for versatile spintronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（判断依据：first-principles calculations、band-unfolding scheme、基于第一性原理计算的分析，未提及实验测量手段）；研究对象：helimagnetic MnAu₂（螺旋磁有序金属材料），具体研究其p波磁性、自旋织构及贝里曲率拓扑性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MnAu₂在室温附近（实验TC=335-370 K）表现出金属性p波磁性，其螺旋自旋序诱导出巨大的自旋劈裂，并在费米面上形成具有p波自旋织构的单电子口袋；同时，螺旋自旋扭转触发拓扑非平庸的 hedgehog 型贝里曲率，与非线性霍尔效应和自旋霍尔效应相关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MnAu₂在室温附近（实验TC=335-370 K）表现出金属性p波磁性，其螺旋自旋序诱导出巨大的自旋劈裂，并在费米面上形成具有p波自旋织构的单电子口袋；同时，螺旋自旋扭转触发拓扑非平庸的 hedgehog 型贝里曲率，与非线性霍尔效应和自旋霍尔效应相关联。；创新点：首次在非共线补偿磁体中（超越共线交变磁体）发现p波自旋织构，并揭示螺旋磁序可诱导拓扑非平庸的 hedgehog 型贝里曲率，且该材料具有室温金属性，为室温自旋电子学应用提供了理想候选体系。
papers.method_zh: 基于平移算符与自旋旋转组合的能带展开方法（band-unfolding scheme），结合第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）分析电子结构、自旋织构及贝里曲率。

papers.title: Spin mixing induced dynamics of spinor solitons in $F=1$ Bose Einstein condensates
papers.abstract: We explore soliton interactions in a homogeneous spinor $F=1$ Bose Einstein Condensate (BEC) in the presence of a magnetic field, focusing on dark bright dark and bright dark bright configurations. We investigate how these interactions depend on the phase differences among bright solitons and their influence during the dynamics. Our findings align with prior non spinor results, i.e., repulsion among in phase bright solitons and attraction among out of phase pairs in self repulsive atomic BECs. The potential bright soliton attraction, added to the short range repulsion of dark dark soliton interactions, can lead to bound states. However, we find that these bound states break in the presence of spinor interactions due to the particle exchange dynamics between the hyperfine states of the components. Additonally, we develop an effective classical model to describe the soliton dynamics, using a Lagrangian approach. The accuracy of the model is tested by comparing it against numerical simulations. Our results suggest that the proposed model captures the essential features of soliton behavior in the presence of spin interactions, and provides congruent soliton trajectories and interspecies particle exchange dynamics in most of the cases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：explore、investigate、develop an effective classical model、Lagrangian approach、numerical simulations）；研究对象：均匀自旋为1的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（F=1 BEC）中的孤子相互作用，具体关注暗-亮-暗（dark-bright-dark）和亮-暗-亮（bright-dark-bright）两种孤子构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自旋F=1 BEC中，亮孤子间的相位关系决定了其相互作用（同相排斥、反相吸引），但自旋相互作用导致的超精细态间粒子交换动力学破坏了原本可能形成的束缚态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自旋F=1 BEC中，亮孤子间的相位关系决定了其相互作用（同相排斥、反相吸引），但自旋相互作用导致的超精细态间粒子交换动力学破坏了原本可能形成的束缚态。；创新点：将自旋混合（spin mixing）效应引入孤子相互作用研究，揭示了自旋自由度导致的粒子交换动力学如何破坏非自旋情形下存在的束缚态。摘要未突出说明与实验的对比或具体参数范围。
papers.method_zh: 采用拉格朗日方法建立有效经典模型描述孤子动力学，并通过与数值模拟结果对比验证模型准确性。

papers.title: Vapor-to-glass preparation of biaxially aligned organic semiconductors
papers.abstract: Physical vapor deposition (PVD) provides a route to prepare highly stable and anisotropic organic glasses that are utilized in multi-layer structures such as organic light-emitting devices. While previous work has demonstrated that anisotropic glasses with uniaxial symmetry can be prepared by PVD, here, we prepare biaxially aligned glasses in which molecular orientation has a preferred in-plane direction. With the collective effect of the surface equilibration mechanism and template growth on an aligned substrate, macroscopic biaxial alignment is achieved in depositions as much as 180 K below the clearing point $T_{LC-iso}$ (and 50 K below the glass transition temperature $T_g$ ) with single-component disk-like (phenanthroperylene ester) and rod-like (itraconazole) mesogens. The preparation of biaxially aligned organic semiconductors adds a new dimension of structural control for vapor-deposited glasses and may enable polarized emission and in-plane control of charge mobility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：physical vapor deposition (PVD)、preparation、depositions、template growth。；研究对象：双轴取向的有机半导体玻璃，具体材料为单组分的盘状（phenanthroperylene ester）和棒状（itraconazole）介晶分子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过物理气相沉积（PVD）在远低于清亮点（T_LC-iso）和玻璃化转变温度（T_g）的条件下，成功制备了具有宏观双轴取向的有机半导体玻璃，实现了分子取向在面内方向上的择优排列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过物理气相沉积（PVD）在远低于清亮点（T_LC-iso）和玻璃化转变温度（T_g）的条件下，成功制备了具有宏观双轴取向的有机半导体玻璃，实现了分子取向在面内方向上的择优排列。；创新点：首次通过PVD制备出具有双轴取向（而非以往的单轴对称）的有机玻璃，为气相沉积玻璃的结构控制增加了新的维度，有望实现偏振发射和面内电荷迁移率的调控。
papers.method_zh: 采用物理气相沉积（PVD）技术，结合表面平衡机制与在取向基底上的模板生长效应，在低于清亮点180 K（低于T_g 50 K）的温度下进行沉积。

papers.title: Ferromagnetic Order of Reduced Magnetic Moments in a Frustrated Sawtooth Chain of the Magnetic Semiconductor ZnYb$_2$S$_4$
papers.abstract: In a sawtooth spin chain, competing nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor interactions suppress long-range order, yielding novel quantum states such as a spin-dimer singlet, 1/2 magnetization plateau, and spin contraction. Here, we investigate the magnetic properties of the orthorhombic semiconductor ZnYb$_2$S$_4$, in which Yb$^{3+}$ ions with an effective spin-1/2 form a sawtooth chain along the $b$-axis. The specific heat exhibits a sharp peak at ${T}_{\rm m}$ $=$ 1.4 K, at which the magnetic entropy $S_{\rm m}$ reaches only 27% of $R$ln2. This reduced $S_{\rm m}$ at $T_{\rm m}$ indicates the entropy release of the ground state doublet of Yb$^{3+}$ even for $T$ $>$ $T_{\rm m}$. The isothermal magnetization $M(B)$ at 0.28 K exhibits hysteresis for $\left|B\right| \leq 0.2$ T and increases monotonically for $B > 0.2$ T. The spontaneous magnetization is only 0.1 ${\it μ}_{\rm B}$$/$Yb, an order of magnitude smaller than that expected for the ground state doublet of Yb$^{3+}$. Moreover, in powder neutron diffraction measurements, no superlattice reflections due to antiferromagnetic order are observed for $T$ $<$ $T_{\rm m}$. Therefore, in the ground state, the Yb moments are ferromagnetically aligned, but their amplitude is reduced by magnetic frustration in the sawtooth Yb chain.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了比热、磁化强度、粉末中子衍射等具体实验测量结果。；研究对象：正交晶系磁性半导体 ZnYb₂S₄ 中，由有效自旋-1/2 的 Yb³⁺ 离子构成的锯齿形链（sawtooth chain）中的磁有序现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 ZnYb₂S₄ 中，Yb³⁺ 离子在基态下形成了铁磁有序，但由于锯齿形链的几何阻挫效应，其磁矩幅度被显著抑制，仅为 0.1 μB/Yb，远小于 Yb³⁺ 基态双重态预期的值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 ZnYb₂S₄ 中，Yb³⁺ 离子在基态下形成了铁磁有序，但由于锯齿形链的几何阻挫效应，其磁矩幅度被显著抑制，仅为 0.1 μB/Yb，远小于 Yb³⁺ 基态双重态预期的值。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作的核心新意在于，在一种具有几何阻挫的锯齿形链体系中，观察到了磁矩被大幅抑制的铁磁有序态，而非通常阻挫体系中常见的自旋液体或反铁磁序。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用了宏观磁性测量（等温磁化曲线，显示磁滞回线）和热力学测量（比热，用于确定相变温度 Tm 和磁熵 Sm），以及微观结构探测手段（粉末中子衍射，用于排除反铁磁超晶格反射）。

papers.title: Stochastic Thermodynamics on Time-Evolving Curved Spaces
papers.abstract: We construct stochastic thermodynamics of overdamped Langevin systems on nonrelaticvistic curved spaces with time-dependent metrics. The time dependence of the metric contributes to the energy balance by performing work on the kinetic energy, which is instantaneously dissipated as heat in the overdamped regime. This contribution makes our framework thermodynamically consistent so that entropy production satisfies the second law of thermodynamics. As a special case, when the metric evolves according to backward Ricci flow, the entropy balance exhibits a structure similar to Perelman's entropy functional. Our framework provides a way to quantify thermodynamic costs in dynamics on time-evolving spaces such as diffusion on membranes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct（构建）、framework（框架）、thermodynamically consistent（热力学一致）。；研究对象：时变弯曲空间上的过阻尼朗之万系统，具体涉及非相对论性弯曲空间（具有时间依赖度规）上的随机热力学，以及膜上扩散等动力学过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 时变度规通过对动能做功贡献能量平衡，该功在过阻尼区域瞬间以热量形式耗散，从而确保熵产生满足热力学第二定律；当度规按反向里奇流演化时，熵平衡结构类似于Perelman熵泛函。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：时变度规通过对动能做功贡献能量平衡，该功在过阻尼区域瞬间以热量形式耗散，从而确保熵产生满足热力学第二定律；当度规按反向里奇流演化时，熵平衡结构类似于Perelman熵泛函。；创新点：首次将随机热力学推广到时变弯曲空间，揭示了时变度规做功与耗散的热力学角色，并建立了与反向里奇流及Perelman熵泛函的联系。
papers.method_zh: 构建了非相对论性弯曲空间上过阻尼朗之万系统的随机热力学理论框架，通过引入时间依赖度规对能量平衡的贡献，推导了热力学一致性条件。

papers.title: The Structure-tuning Magnetism in the Co(NbxTa1-x)2O6 Series
papers.abstract: Low dimensional quantum materials have been extensively studied within the physics community, among which Co2+ is one of the most popular magnetic ions to be embedded into the structural motif. CoNb2O6 and CoTa2O6 both have adopted an effective spin-1/2 state, with the former attracting enduring interest while the latter being rarely investigated. This difference can be attributed to their distinct crystal structures, not only in crystal systems, but more important, how the CoO6 octahedra are connected. We successfully merge these two compounds together and map out the doping limits. We find out Ta and Nb dopants modify the properties of the parent compounds in subtle but different ways and construct a magnetic phase diagram of the Co(NbxTa1-x)2O6 (0 < x < 1) series. In addition, our results suggest that Ta-doping may pave a way to strengthen the lower-dimensional quantum phenomena in CoNb2O6 before its crystal structure starts to melt down.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要提到“mapping out the doping limits”“construct a magnetic phase diagram”等实验合成与表征关键词。；研究对象：Co(NbₓTa₁₋ₓ)₂O₆系列化合物，具体为CoNb₂O₆与CoTa₂O₆两种低维量子磁性材料及其固溶体，其中Co²⁺离子处于有效自旋-1/2态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功合成了Co(NbₓTa₁₋ₓ)₂O₆全组分固溶体，发现Ta和Nb掺杂以微妙但不同的方式调控母体化合物的磁性，并构建了该系列的磁相图；Ta掺杂可能在晶体结构开始崩塌前增强CoNb₂O₆中的低维量子现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功合成了Co(NbₓTa₁₋ₓ)₂O₆全组分固溶体，发现Ta和Nb掺杂以微妙但不同的方式调控母体化合物的磁性，并构建了该系列的磁相图；Ta掺杂可能在晶体结构开始崩塌前增强CoNb₂O₆中的低维量子现象。；创新点：首次将CoNb₂O₆与CoTa₂O₆两种结构不同的有效自旋-1/2体系通过掺杂融合，系统绘制了全组分磁相图，并揭示了Ta掺杂对低维量子现象的增强潜力。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 通过固溶体合成（掺杂实验）系统改变Nb/Ta比例，结合磁性测量等手段构建磁相图。摘要未明确提及具体表征技术（如中子散射、磁化率测量等），但可推断涉及结构表征与磁性测量。

papers.title: Fermi gas of polar molecules in the Pauli-blocked regime
papers.abstract: Quantum gases of polar molecules have recently emerged as a powerful platform for exploring exotic many-body dynamics and correlated quantum behavior. To achieve the full potential of this platform, the production of deeply degenerate quantum gases of molecules in arbitrary confinement geometries is necessary. Here, we successfully evaporate fermionic KRb molecules in both 3D and quasi-2D geometries to well below their Fermi temperatures utilizing dipolar collisions. As we evaporate deeper into degeneracy in both geometries, we enter the Pauli-blocked regime with polar molecules, which we independently confirm for the first time by measuring the Pauli suppression of elastic collisions. Moreover, the Pauli suppression of collisions contributes to the limitation of our final molecular temperature to about 25% of the Fermi temperature in both geometries, particularly limiting quasi-2D evaporation where the Pauli blockade drastically reduces an otherwise large elastic to inelastic scattering ratio. This work demonstrates the production of degenerate Fermi gases of polar molecules both in a 3D harmonic trap and in mono- and bi-layer 2D configurations. Further, our work explores the fundamental limits on evaporation of molecular Fermi gases set by the Pauli-exclusion principle, which could be overcome in the future by introducing distinguishable scattering partners.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：evaporate（蒸发）、measure（测量）、demonstrates（展示）。；研究对象：费米子极性分子（KRb分子）在泡利阻塞（Pauli-blocked）机制下的量子气体，包括三维（3D）和准二维（quasi-2D）几何约束中的简并费米气体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过偶极碰撞将KRb分子蒸发至远低于费米温度，首次独立测量到极性分子在泡利阻塞区域中弹性碰撞的泡利抑制效应，并发现该效应限制了最终分子温度约为费米温度的25%，尤其在准二维蒸发中显著降低了弹性与非弹性散射比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过偶极碰撞将KRb分子蒸发至远低于费米温度，首次独立测量到极性分子在泡利阻塞区域中弹性碰撞的泡利抑制效应，并发现该效应限制了最终分子温度约为费米温度的25%，尤其在准二维蒸发中显著降低了弹性与非弹性散射比。；创新点：首次在极性分子体系中独立确认泡利阻塞对弹性碰撞的抑制效应，并系统研究了泡利不相容原理对分子费米气体蒸发冷却的基本限制。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用蒸发冷却技术，利用极性分子的偶极碰撞在三维谐振势阱和单层/双层二维构型中进行蒸发；通过测量弹性碰撞的泡利抑制来确认进入泡利阻塞区域。

papers.title: Diffusion-driven autocatalytic dynamics on a sphere
papers.abstract: We study the collective dynamics of independent particles that diffuse outside a spherical surface, on which they are replicated with a prescribed catalytic rate. In spatial dimensions three and higher, the transient nature of diffusion creates the competition between autocatalytic and escape events, thus leading to a rich phase diagram between subcritical (extinction), critical (steady-state), and supercritical (growth) regimes at long times. The rotational symmetry of the domain and an explicit form of the single-particle diffusion propagator allow us to obtain the statistics of the population size (i.e., the number of particles). In this way, we analyze the mean population size, its variance and higher-order moments, as well as the full distribution. In particular, we obtain a fully explicit form of the distribution at long times and describe a slow, power-law approach to this steady-state limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study（研究）、obtain（获得）、analyze（分析）、explicit form（显式形式）。；研究对象：在球面上扩散并受催化复制作用的独立粒子集体动力学系统，具体研究粒子种群大小（粒子数）的统计行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三维及以上空间维度中，扩散的瞬态特性导致自催化事件与逃逸事件相互竞争，从而在长时间尺度上形成亚临界（灭绝）、临界（稳态）和超临界（增长）的丰富相图；并得到了长时间下种群大小分布的完全显式形式，描述了向稳态极限的缓慢幂律趋近过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三维及以上空间维度中，扩散的瞬态特性导致自催化事件与逃逸事件相互竞争，从而在长时间尺度上形成亚临界（灭绝）、临界（稳态）和超临界（增长）的丰富相图；并得到了长时间下种群大小分布的完全显式形式，描述了向稳态极限的缓慢幂律趋近过程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用球对称性及单粒子扩散传播子的显式形式，通过解析方法推导种群大小的均值、方差、高阶矩及完整分布函数。

papers.title: Probing Structure and Ionic Transport in Molten Lithium Carbonate
papers.abstract: Li$_2$CO$_3$ (LC) is a cornerstone material for clean energy technologies, including high-temperature molten carbonate fuel cells, electrochemical carbon capture, and lithium-based batteries. However, capturing the complex, many-body interactions governing the structure and transport in LC in its molten state has remained a challenge, constrained by the computational cost of \textit{ab initio} methods and the accuracy limitations of classical force fields. To address this gap, we deploy equivariant graph-based machine learned interatomic potentials, specifically, the multi atomic cluster expansion (MACE) and neural equivariant interatomic potential (NequIP) architectures that are trained on melt-quench \textit{ab initio} molecular dynamics data. Our benchmarking demonstrates that MACE provides superior transferability and precision in predicting energies and forces compared to NequIP. Subsequently, we use the optimized MACE model to perform large-scale molecular dynamics simulations to probe the properties of molten LC. Besides describing the structural features, such as the dominant presence of C-O pair correlations under molten conditions, our MACE model reproduces experimentally-measured static structure factors and shear viscosity values. Further, our simulations indicate that Li transport in LC is fundamentally dominated by concerted motion, as evidenced by Haven's ratios being significantly below unity (0.20-0.40). Notably, we identify a temperature-driven transition from anisotropic (and highly concerted) Li transport, supported by persistent oxygen-centered Voronoi cages at 1000~K, to isotropic (and less concerted) diffusion at 1400~K. Thus, we provide fundamental insights into the structural and transport properties of molten LC and also demonstrate a robust and scalable framework for the accelerated design of molten salt electrolytes and ionic liquids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learned interatomic potentials、molecular dynamics simulations、ab initio molecular dynamics data。；研究对象：熔融碳酸锂（molten Li₂CO₃）的结构与离子输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 熔融Li₂CO₃中锂离子输运主要由协同运动主导（Haven比显著低于1，为0.20-0.40），且存在从1000 K时各向异性（高度协同）到1400 K时各向同性（协同性降低）的温度驱动转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：熔融Li₂CO₃中锂离子输运主要由协同运动主导（Haven比显著低于1，为0.20-0.40），且存在从1000 K时各向异性（高度协同）到1400 K时各向同性（协同性降低）的温度驱动转变。；创新点：首次将等变图神经网络势（MACE/NequIP）应用于熔融碳酸锂，在保持第一性原理精度的同时大幅降低计算成本，从而实现了对熔盐中协同输运机制及温度驱动的输运各向异性转变的揭示。
papers.method_zh: 采用等变图神经网络机器学习原子间势（MACE和NequIP架构），基于熔融-淬火从头算分子动力学数据训练，并用优化后的MACE模型进行大规模分子动力学模拟。

papers.title: Interface-engineered oxidation-resistant wafer-level Tantalum-Tantalum thermocompression bonding for 3D integration of superconducting interconnects
papers.abstract: Wafer-level 3D integration of superconducting interconnects requires low-thermal budget bonding processes compatible with superconducting materials. Rapid native oxide formation on tantalum (Ta) surfaces limits low-temperature, low-pressure direct Ta-Ta thermocompression bonding. In this study, we develop an oxidation-resistant bonding process using an ultrathin Au passivation layer to suppress oxide formation during bonding. The engineered interface enables blanket Ta-Ta wafer bonding at 300 $^\circ$C under 4.93 bar, significantly reducing the bonding thermal budget and generation of $α$-Ta across the interface, which potentially improves coherence time as reported in literature. Structural and interfacial analyses confirm oxide suppression and continuous metallic bonding, having a bond strength of 169 MPa. This work demonstrates a low-temperature, low-pressure Ta-Ta thermocompression bonding strategy for scalable 3D superconducting interconnect integration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：develop、demonstrates、structural and interfacial analyses、bond strength。；研究对象：用于超导互连三维集成的钽-钽（Ta-Ta）晶圆级热压键合工艺，重点研究界面工程对氧化抑制和键合质量的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入超薄金（Au）钝化层，成功实现了在300°C、4.93 bar低热预算条件下的Ta-Ta晶圆级热压键合，有效抑制了界面氧化并获得了169 MPa的高键合强度，有望改善超导互连的相干时间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入超薄金（Au）钝化层，成功实现了在300°C、4.93 bar低热预算条件下的Ta-Ta晶圆级热压键合，有效抑制了界面氧化并获得了169 MPa的高键合强度，有望改善超导互连的相干时间。；创新点：利用超薄Au钝化层实现抗氧化Ta-Ta键合，显著降低了键合热预算（300°C、4.93 bar），并抑制了界面处α-Ta的生成，为可扩展的超导互连三维集成提供了低热预算键合策略。
papers.method_zh: 采用超薄Au钝化层进行界面工程，在300°C、4.93 bar条件下进行晶圆级Ta-Ta热压键合；通过结构分析和界面分析（摘要未明确具体表征手段，如SEM、TEM、XPS等）确认氧化抑制和连续金属键合，并测量键合强度。

papers.title: Altermagnetism and bond-nematicity in the spin-$1/2$ square lattice $J_1-J_2-δ$ model
papers.abstract: We study appearance of bond-nematicity in insulating altermagnetic materials induced by increased frustration and quantum-fluctuations driven melting of the altermagnetic order. Using novel machine learning approach that combines symmetry enhanced neural network architectures and variational Monte Carlo we consider the spin-$1/2$ square lattice $J_1-J_2-δ$ model known to have altermagnetic ordering in the regime of small geometric frustration and a gapless spin liquid phase in the regime of strong frustration and small exchange interaction modulation parameter $δ$. In the regime where exchange modulation is relatively large, resulting in the significant splitting of the magnon modes with different chiralities in the altermagnetic regime, we find that melting of the altermagnetic order by increased frustration leads to an intriguing phase that hosts coexisting symmetry protected topological valence bond solid and bond-nematic orders. The phase is characterized by condensation of magnon pairs that results in bond-nematicity, breaking of U(1) spin rotation and $\mathbb{Z}_2$ spin inversion symmetries and chiral splitting of the triplon-like energy levels in the excitation spectrum. Whilst numerous recent studies address non-trivial impact of altermagnetic moments on various properties in altermagnetic materials, like electronic band structure and superconductivity, influence of strong quantum fluctuations and phases that can result from melting of the altermagnetic order are much less explored. Our study therefore presents an important step in identifying exotic phases of matter that can emerge in vicinity of the altermagnetic order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：机器学习方法、对称增强神经网络架构、变分蒙特卡洛。；研究对象：自旋-1/2 正方晶格 \( J_1-J_2-\delta \) 模型，具体研究该模型中由几何阻挫增强和量子涨落驱动的交变磁序熔化所导致的键向列相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在交换调制参数 \(\delta\) 较大、交变磁区中不同手性磁振子模式显著分裂的区域内，增强阻挫导致交变磁序熔化，形成一种共存有对称性保护拓扑价键固体和键向列序的新奇相。该相的特征是磁振子对凝聚，破坏 U(1) 自旋旋转对称性和 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 自旋反演对称性，并在激发谱中产生类似三子能级的宇称分裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在交换调制参数 \(\delta\) 较大、交变磁区中不同手性磁振子模式显著分裂的区域内，增强阻挫导致交变磁序熔化，形成一种共存有对称性保护拓扑价键固体和键向列序的新奇相。该相的特征是磁振子对凝聚，破坏 U(1) 自旋旋转对称性和 \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) 自旋反演对称性，并在激发谱中产生类似三子能级的宇称分裂。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用结合对称增强神经网络架构与变分蒙特卡洛的新型机器学习方法，对自旋-1/2 正方晶格 \( J_1-J_2-\delta \) 模型进行数值研究。

papers.title: Field-selective criticality in 2D melting revealed by multi-field Lee-Yang zeros
papers.abstract: How a two-dimensional solid melts remains unsettled after 60 years of study, as theory, model systems, simulations, and atomic-resolution experiments continue to suggest conflicting scenarios. The same transition can appear continuous or abrupt depending on how it is observed, where this ambiguity is especially acute in confined water. Here we study bilayer water under nanoconfinement and ask not only where its phase boundaries lie, but how the system responds to the two fields that drive them: temperature and lateral pressure. Using Lee-Yang zeros together with enhanced sampling, we find that some phase boundaries are field-selective: the two responses can differ either in continuity itself, or in how strongly they are rounded in finite systems. This distinction changes the two-step melting picture. The solid--hexatic transition is field-selective first-order, with the density channel remaining unusually rounded, whereas the hexatic--liquid transition becomes a conventional first-order transition once larger cells reveal a hidden bimodal enthalpy distribution. This framework organizes the apparent disagreement among confined-water simulations, hard-disk models and AgI experiments by identifying which thermodynamic channel each probe sees.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用了Lee-Yang zeros（李-杨零点）理论框架与enhanced sampling（增强采样）方法。；研究对象：纳米限域下的双层水（bilayer water under nanoconfinement）的二维熔化相变，具体涉及固-六角相（solid-hexatic）与六角-液相（hexatic-liquid）转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维熔化中的某些相边界具有“场选择性”（field-selective）临界性：系统对温度与侧向压力这两个驱动场的响应在连续性上可以不同，且有限尺寸效应下的圆化程度也不同。这改变了传统的两步熔化图像，并解释了限域水模拟、硬圆盘模型与AgI实验之间看似矛盾的结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维熔化中的某些相边界具有“场选择性”（field-selective）临界性：系统对温度与侧向压力这两个驱动场的响应在连续性上可以不同，且有限尺寸效应下的圆化程度也不同。这改变了传统的两步熔化图像，并解释了限域水模拟、硬圆盘模型与AgI实验之间看似矛盾的结果。；创新点：首次提出并证明了二维熔化中相变对驱动场（温度 vs. 侧向压力）具有“场选择性”响应，即同一相变在不同热力学观测通道中可表现为连续或突变，并以此统一了此前限域水、硬圆盘模型与AgI实验之间的分歧。
papers.method_zh: 采用Lee-Yang零点分析结合增强采样（enhanced sampling）技术，通过识别不同热力学通道（温度通道与密度/压力通道）中相变的连续性及有限尺寸圆化行为来研究相变。

papers.title: Topology-defined computation in knitted textiles
papers.abstract: Mechanical computation, in which logic functions are realized through deformation rather than electronics, has been demonstrated in systems such as origami, kirigami, and mechanical metamaterials. In these systems, logic states and functions are typically determined by geometry and material properties, making it sensitive to deformation and imperfections. Here we introduce a mechanical computing architecture in which logic is defined by topology rather than geometry. The circuit is realized as a knitted textile formed from a single continuous yarn, where information is encoded in the topology of stitches and processed through controlled unraveling. By discretizing the textile into a lattice of interacting cells, we construct topological propagation rules that implement universal logic operations, including NOT, AND, and OR gates, as well as a half-adder. Experiments demonstrate that the logical output is robust against geometric deformation, while mechanical factors affect only if the computation can be executed. These results establish topology-defined computation as a model for information processing in textiles and other reconfigurable physical systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：Experiments demonstrate、realized as a knitted textile、controlled unraveling）；研究对象：基于编织纺织品的机械计算系统，具体为通过单一连续纱线形成的针织结构，其中逻辑由拓扑（而非几何）定义。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种由拓扑而非几何定义逻辑的机械计算架构，在编织纺织品中实现了NOT、AND、OR等通用逻辑门及半加器，且逻辑输出对几何变形具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种由拓扑而非几何定义逻辑的机械计算架构，在编织纺织品中实现了NOT、AND、OR等通用逻辑门及半加器，且逻辑输出对几何变形具有鲁棒性。；创新点：首次将机械计算中的逻辑状态和功能由几何/材料依赖转变为拓扑定义，使逻辑输出对几何变形不敏感，仅机械因素影响计算能否执行。
papers.method_zh: 通过将纺织品离散化为相互作用的晶格单元，构建拓扑传播规则；实验上通过控制纱线解编织过程实现逻辑运算，并测试了逻辑输出对几何变形的稳定性。

papers.title: General Theory for Ferroelectric Control of Spin Splitting in Collinear Antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: Electrical control of magnetism is crucial for next-generation spintronics. While recent advances have demonstrated ferroelectric switching in two-dimensional magnets, a general design strategy spanning different dimensionalities remains elusive. Here, we develop a group-theoretical framework for achieving ferroelectric control of spin splitting in collinear antiferromagnets, including altermagnets and compensated ferrimagnets. By systematically classifying switching operators through symmetry analysis, we identify a universal pathway for the simultaneous reversal of electric polarization and nonrelativistic spin splitting.We validate this approach in three representative systems: quasi-one-dimensional $(6,14)$ Zigzag graphene nanoribbons, two-dimensional~\ch{Nb3I8}, and three-dimensional altermagnetic~\ch{MnSe2}. Our work establishes a versatile design paradigm for magnetoelectric devices and expands the functional landscape of low-power spintronic materials beyond the low-dimensional limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“group-theoretical framework”、“symmetry analysis”、“develop a general theory”。；研究对象：共线反铁磁体（包括交变磁体和补偿亚铁磁体）中自旋劈裂的铁电控制，具体验证体系为准一维(6,14)锯齿型石墨烯纳米带、二维Nb₃I₈和三维交变磁体MnSe₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过对称性分析系统分类开关算符，发现了一条同时翻转电极化和非相对论性自旋劈裂的普适路径，从而在共线反铁磁体中实现铁电控制自旋劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过对称性分析系统分类开关算符，发现了一条同时翻转电极化和非相对论性自旋劈裂的普适路径，从而在共线反铁磁体中实现铁电控制自旋劈裂。；创新点：提出了跨越不同维度（一维、二维、三维）的通用设计策略，突破了以往仅局限于低维磁性材料中铁电开关的研究，为磁电器件提供了普适的设计范式。
papers.method_zh: 群论框架（对称性分析），通过分类开关算符推导铁电控制自旋劈裂的普适条件，并在三个不同维度的代表性体系中进行理论验证。

papers.title: Symmetry of the critical current function in superconducting nanodevices
papers.abstract: We study a variety of nano-scale superconducting devices containing more than one weak link. Even in devices with multiple weak links the IB symmetry is usually obeyed, which means that if we reverse both the bias current direction and the magnetic field direction at the same time, the superconducting response, namely the critical current, remains unchanged. We also provide a detailed analysis of the situations in which such symmetry is violated.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：study、analysis、symmetry）；研究对象：含多个弱连接的纳米尺度超导器件，以及其临界电流函数的对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使器件包含多个弱连接，通常仍满足IB对称性（即同时反转偏置电流方向和磁场方向时，临界电流保持不变）；同时分析了该对称性被破坏的情形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使器件包含多个弱连接，通常仍满足IB对称性（即同时反转偏置电流方向和磁场方向时，临界电流保持不变）；同时分析了该对称性被破坏的情形。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析（摘要未明确说明具体理论框架或计算方法，如是否采用Ginzburg-Landau理论或微观模型）。

papers.title: XRDiff: Crystal Structure Prediction from Powder X-Ray Diffraction Data Using Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Determining the crystal structure of a material from its powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) pattern is a central challenge in materials science. PXRD is an accessible and widely used characterization technique, yet recovering the atomic structure from diffraction data requires solving an underdetermined inverse problem due to the loss of phase information. Generative modeling can provide a prior over atomic structure and learn the mapping from PXRD patterns to crystal structures via simulated structure-spectrum pairs. We present XRDiff, a diffusion model that recovers crystal structures from PXRD given either the stoichiometry or, in a more challenging setting, the elemental constituents and total number of atoms in the unit cell. We evaluate on datasets where each stoichiometry has multiple polymorphs and all polymorphs of a given composition are held out together, ensuring that high performance reflects genuine use of the diffraction signal. XRDiff achieves strong structure recovery rates on simulated benchmarks, indicating that the model learns a spectrum-to-structure mapping precise enough to differentiate between polymorphs. To address generalization to experimental data, we compare a full-spectrum encoding against an encoding based on peak descriptors. The peak-based encoding generalizes substantially better, outperforming even a model trained on full spectra with augmentations fitted to the experimental noise distribution. These results demonstrate that representations robust to the noise and artifacts present in real-world PXRD offer a practical and scalable path toward closing the simulation-to-experiment gap, enabling zero-shot crystal structure solution from experimental PXRD with full or partial chemical composition input.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：generative modeling, diffusion model, simulated structure-spectrum pairs）；研究对象：从粉末X射线衍射（PXRD）数据中恢复晶体结构，涉及多晶型化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于扩散模型的XRDiff能够从PXRD数据中高精度恢复晶体结构，区分不同多晶型；采用峰描述符的编码方式比全谱编码在实验数据上具有更好的泛化能力，有望弥合模拟与实验之间的差距。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于扩散模型的XRDiff能够从PXRD数据中高精度恢复晶体结构，区分不同多晶型；采用峰描述符的编码方式比全谱编码在实验数据上具有更好的泛化能力，有望弥合模拟与实验之间的差距。；创新点：提出了一种从PXRD数据直接恢复晶体结构的生成式方法，并在多晶型体系中验证了其区分能力；通过峰描述符编码显著提升了模型对实验噪声和伪影的鲁棒性，实现了零样本（zero-shot）实验晶体结构解析。
papers.method_zh: 扩散模型（diffusion model），结合模拟的结构-谱图配对数据进行训练；对比了全谱编码与基于峰描述符的编码方式。

papers.title: Mean-field theory of myopic self-avoiding fractional Brownian motion
papers.abstract: Myopic self-avoiding fractional Brownian motion (FBM) is a stochastic process in which an ensemble of particles is driven by fractional Gaussian noise while being repelled by the gradient of the time-integrated ensemble density [J. House, R. Bakhshizada, S. Janušonis, R. Metzler, and T. Vojta, Phys. Rev. E 112, 034119 (2025)]. Depending on the anomalous diffusion exponent $α$ characterizing the noise, the process features two dynamical regimes: an interaction-dominated regime ($α< α_c=4/(d+2)$) where the mean-density interaction governs long-time dynamics, and a noise-dominated regime ($α> α_c$) where FBM correlations prevail. In the interaction-dominated regime, the mean-squared displacement grows as $\langle r^2(t) \rangle \sim t^{4/(d+2)}$ regardless of $α$, while for $α> α_c$ the standard FBM scaling $\langle r^2(t) \rangle \sim t^α$ is recovered. Here, we develop an analytical mean-field theory of myopic self-avoiding FBM, based on a Fokker-Planck approach to the interaction-dominated regime. This allows us to derive closed-form polynomial solutions for the probability density. To compare with computer simulations, we develop an efficient radial binning algorithm that significantly reduces the computational complexity, making large-scale three-dimensional simulations feasible. Extensive simulations in one, two, and three dimensions confirm the analytical predictions. We also discuss the application of the process to the self-organization of serotonergic axons (fibers) in vertebrate brains, where FBM paths with self-avoidance provide a natural framework for understanding spatial heterogeneities of fiber densities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop an analytical mean-field theory”、“derive closed-form polynomial solutions”、“extensive simulations”。；研究对象：近视自避分数布朗运动（myopic self-avoiding fractional Brownian motion, FBM）这一随机过程，及其在脊椎动物脑中血清素能轴突（纤维）自组织现象中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相互作用主导的动力学区域（α < α_c = 4/(d+2)），均方位移按 ⟨r²(t)⟩ ∼ t^{4/(d+2)} 增长，与反常扩散指数 α 无关；在噪声主导区域（α > α_c），恢复标准FBM标度 ⟨r²(t)⟩ ∼ t^α。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相互作用主导的动力学区域（α < α_c = 4/(d+2)），均方位移按 ⟨r²(t)⟩ ∼ t^{4/(d+2)} 增长，与反常扩散指数 α 无关；在噪声主导区域（α > α_c），恢复标准FBM标度 ⟨r²(t)⟩ ∼ t^α。；创新点：首次为近视自避分数布朗运动建立了解析平均场理论，并推导出相互作用主导区域概率密度的闭合多项式解；同时开发了高效径向分箱算法，使大规模三维模拟成为可能。
papers.method_zh: 基于Fokker-Planck方法建立平均场理论，推导概率密度的闭合多项式解；开发高效的径向分箱算法以降低计算复杂度，实现大规模三维模拟；在1、2、3维空间中进行数值模拟验证。

papers.title: Oxygen deficiency and valency reconstruction in multiferroic V-doped HfO$_2$
papers.abstract: The interplay of oxygen deficiency and vanadium multiple valency in the candidate multiferroic V-doped $Pca2_1$ hafnia HfO$_2$ is studied by first-principles calculations. Low-lying V majority gap states accept electrons from oxygen-vacancy donors, reducing their formation energy, and converting nominal V$^{4+}$ centers into V$^{3+}$. The resulting local magnetization and screening changes are reflected in the calculated V core-level shifts, which are consistent with the experimentally observed XPS signatures. The calculated V$^{3+}$/V$^{4+}$ population ratio determined by oxygen vacancies only matches experiment in reducing conditions, suggesting that additional electron reservoirs may contribute under ALD growth conditions. A similar scenario also seems to apply to the recently observed multiferroicity in Cr-doped hafnia, where oxygen deficiency is intrinsic to the growth technique.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：多铁性钒（V）掺杂的二氧化铪（HfO₂），具体为具有 \(Pca2_1\) 正交相的候选多铁材料体系，重点研究氧空位与钒多价态之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氧空位向钒的多数载流子带隙态提供电子，将名义上的 V⁴⁺ 中心转化为 V³⁺，从而降低氧空位的形成能；计算得到的 V³⁺/V⁴⁺ 比例仅在还原条件下与实验 XPS 信号一致，表明原子层沉积（ALD）生长条件下可能存在额外的电子库。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氧空位向钒的多数载流子带隙态提供电子，将名义上的 V⁴⁺ 中心转化为 V³⁺，从而降低氧空位的形成能；计算得到的 V³⁺/V⁴⁺ 比例仅在还原条件下与实验 XPS 信号一致，表明原子层沉积（ALD）生长条件下可能存在额外的电子库。；创新点：揭示了氧空位诱导的钒价态重构（V⁴⁺→V³⁺）机制，并指出该机制可能同样适用于近期发现的铬掺杂二氧化铪中的多铁性，暗示氧空位是生长技术固有的特征。摘要未突出说明与纯 HfO₂ 或其它掺杂体系相比的具体性能提升。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（DFT），具体包括计算氧空位形成能、钒的芯能级位移（core-level shifts），并与实验 XPS 谱图进行对比分析。

papers.title: Machine Learning Accelerated SSNEB for Efficient Minimum Energy Pathway Calculations
papers.abstract: Metastable states and their minimum energy pathways (MEPs) are central to understanding transformations and phase stability in complex materials, yet mapping transition pathways between competing states remains computationally demanding and experimentally challenging. Here, we introduce a hybrid solid-state nudged elastic band (SSNEB) framework that integrates two pretrained machine learning models, EquiformerV2 (eqV2) and the equivariant Smooth Energy Network (eSEN), with DFT for energy, force, and stress evaluations. Applied to three solid-state systems, CsPbI$_3$, GaN, and TiO$_2$, our framework achieves up to a 7-fold speedup while converging to the same pathways predicted by first-principles calculations. Moreover, the hybrid SSNEB framework enables systematic benchmarking of existing ML models, providing both efficiency and reliability for predicting MEPs across various materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：machine learning、DFT、SSNEB、first-principles calculations）；研究对象：固态材料中的亚稳态及其最小能量路径（MEPs），具体体系包括CsPbI₃、GaN和TiO₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将两个预训练机器学习模型（EquiformerV2和eSEN）与DFT结合，构建的混合SSNEB框架在计算MEPs时最高可实现7倍加速，且收敛路径与第一性原理计算结果一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将两个预训练机器学习模型（EquiformerV2和eSEN）与DFT结合，构建的混合SSNEB框架在计算MEPs时最高可实现7倍加速，且收敛路径与第一性原理计算结果一致。；创新点：首次将预训练的等变机器学习模型（eqV2和eSEN）与DFT结合用于SSNEB计算，在保持路径预测可靠性的同时显著加速MEP搜索，并提供了系统评估现有机器学习模型性能的基准方法。
papers.method_zh: 混合固态微动弹性带（SSNEB）框架，集成两个预训练机器学习模型（EquiformerV2和eSEN）与DFT进行能量、力和应力评估。

papers.title: Direct/adaptive-mixture phase-gradient learning for neural-network quantum states with complex phase structure
papers.abstract: Neural-network quantum states (NQS) are a leading variational tool for quantum many-body physics, yet their optimization is fragile whenever the ground state carries a non-trivial sign or complex phase structure, a situation generic to gauge fields, broken time-reversal symmetry, and fermionic statistics. We trace this fragility to the stochastic estimator of the phase gradient rather than to network expressiveness. The phase sector of the Monte Carlo energy gradient is a noisy score-function estimator; differentiating the local energy instead yields a direct estimator that is unbiased for the same phase force, has far lower variance, and requires only a separated amplitude--phase ansatz. Demonstrated on a 100-site flux ladder, a small network trained this way reaches $0.89\%$ median error, where tuned standard baselines plateau at $1.8\%$ and wider or deeper standard-gradient networks degrade from $8.4\%$ to $24.6\%$. The advantage carries over to chiral XXX chains: the direct estimator again converges to a markedly lower error than the standard one, across $α$ and size; it grows with flux and vanishes in zero-flux controls. An adaptive-mixture of the two estimators is provably never worse in variance than the better endpoint at the optimal mixing coefficient, with seed-resolved diagnostics tracing much of the gain to eliminating failed runs. Estimator design thus emerges as a first-class lever for complex-valued neural quantum states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：variational tool、Monte Carlo energy gradient、estimator design。；研究对象：神经网络量子态（NQS）在具有非平凡符号或复相位结构的基态（如规范场、时间反演对称性破缺、费米子统计）中的优化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 标准NQS优化在复相位结构下的脆弱性源于相位梯度的随机估计器方差过高；改用直接估计器可大幅降低方差，在100位点通量梯子模型中达到0.89%的中位误差，显著优于标准梯度方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：标准NQS优化在复相位结构下的脆弱性源于相位梯度的随机估计器方差过高；改用直接估计器可大幅降低方差，在100位点通量梯子模型中达到0.89%的中位误差，显著优于标准梯度方法。；创新点：将优化困难归因于估计器设计而非网络表达能力，并证明直接估计器与自适应混合策略在复相位NQS优化中的有效性。
papers.method_zh: 提出直接相位梯度估计器（direct estimator），基于分离振幅-相位形式的变分波函数，通过微分局域能量而非使用得分函数估计器来获得无偏、低方差的相位力；进一步引入两种估计器的自适应混合（adaptive-mixture），保证方差不劣于最优混合系数下的更好端点。

papers.title: Molecular Beam Epitaxy of Mn2In2Se5 van der Waals Layers Using Mn Intercalation
papers.abstract: The weak van der Waals (vdW) force in layered chalcogenide materials has enabled the growth of ternary chalcogenide layers using unconventional approaches. Here, we report the molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) growth of Mn2In2Se5, a spin glass material with high level of magnetic frustration, through the heterointegration of MnSe on In2Se3. Directly depositing α-MnSe on the vdW In2Se3 layers results in Mn intercalation, transforming the In2Se3 layer into Mn2In2Se5. Large growth windows, including substrate temperatures from 250-450 °C and Se:Mn flux ratio of 1.1-3.1, have been identified for the intercalation process. With an optimized MnSe deposition time, smooth, single-crystalline, and (0001)-oriented Mn2In2Se5 layers with a root-mean-square (RMS) roughness of 1.5 nm can be synthesized. Further extending the MnSe deposition time results in the growth of uniform rock-salt structured α-MnSe (111) layers with a thickness of up to 8 nm and a narrow full-width-at-half-maximum (FWHM) of 0.35° in MnSe (222) XRD rocking curves. This report presents a unique approach for the growths of uniform and single-crystalline Mn2In2Se5 vdW layers using MBE, and potentially opens a pathway for synthesis of ternary vdW chalcogenides by intercalation of new atomic species in binary vdW chalcogenides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) growth”、“depositing”、“synthesized”、“XRD rocking curves”。；研究对象：三元层状硫族化合物Mn₂In₂Se₅，一种具有高度磁阻挫特性的自旋玻璃材料，以及通过Mn插层在In₂Se₃上异质集成MnSe的生长过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在范德华层状In₂Se₃上直接沉积α-MnSe，实现了Mn插层，从而将In₂Se₃转化为单晶、(0001)取向的Mn₂In₂Se₅层，并确定了宽的生长窗口（衬底温度250-450°C，Se:Mn束流比1.1-3.1）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在范德华层状In₂Se₃上直接沉积α-MnSe，实现了Mn插层，从而将In₂Se₃转化为单晶、(0001)取向的Mn₂In₂Se₅层，并确定了宽的生长窗口（衬底温度250-450°C，Se:Mn束流比1.1-3.1）。；创新点：提出了一种通过分子束外延在二元范德华硫族化合物中插层新原子物种来合成三元范德华硫族化合物（Mn₂In₂Se₅）的独特方法。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长技术，结合X射线衍射（XRD）摇摆曲线、原子力显微镜（AFM）等表征手段分析薄膜的晶体结构、取向、粗糙度和厚度。

papers.title: Multi-modal machine learning analysis of GaSe molecular beam epitaxy growth conditions
papers.abstract: Autonomous synthesis platforms integrating machine learning with in situ diagnostics have the potential to revolutionize thin-film growth by enabling real-time process optimization and reducing the need for manual tuning. However, their application to molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) remains underdeveloped. Here, we present a machine learning-guided framework for MBE growth of GaSe films, leveraging reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED) as an in situ diagnostic alongside ex situ characterization via X-ray diffraction and atomic force microscopy. Unsupervised learning on RHEED patterns reveals a well-defined boundary between high- and low-quality samples, capturing physically meaningful features. Mutual information analysis shows a strong correlation between RHEED embeddings and rocking curve full-width at half-maximum (fwhm), while the correlation with AFM root-mean-square (RMS) roughness is weak. Among key growth conditions, growth rate most strongly influences fwhm, whereas the Se/Ga flux ratio primarily affects RMS roughness and the RHEED embeddings. Supervised learning models trained to predict fwhm and RMS roughness demonstrate moderate accuracy, with significant improvement achieved by incorporating RHEED embeddings. Furthermore, anomaly detection via residual analysis in supervised learning aligns well with unsupervised classification from RHEED, reinforcing the reliability of the predictive models. This study establishes a data-driven framework for machine learning-assisted MBE, paving the way for real-time process control and accelerated optimization of thin-film synthesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+机器学习分析）。判断依据：论文结合了分子束外延（MBE）实验生长、原位反射高能电子衍射（RHEED）诊断、非原位X射线衍射（XRD）和原子力显微镜（AFM）表征，以及无监督学习、互信息分析和监督学习等机器学习方法。；研究对象：GaSe薄膜的分子束外延（MBE）生长条件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过无监督学习对RHEED图案进行分析，可以清晰区分高质量与低质量GaSe样品；生长速率对X射线摇摆曲线半高宽（fwhm）影响最大，而Se/Ga通量比主要影响AFM粗糙度和RHEED嵌入特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过无监督学习对RHEED图案进行分析，可以清晰区分高质量与低质量GaSe样品；生长速率对X射线摇摆曲线半高宽（fwhm）影响最大，而Se/Ga通量比主要影响AFM粗糙度和RHEED嵌入特征。；创新点：将机器学习与RHEED原位诊断相结合，建立了一个数据驱动的MBE生长优化框架，并揭示了不同生长条件（生长速率、Se/Ga通量比）对薄膜不同质量指标（结晶质量、表面粗糙度）的差异化影响。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长GaSe薄膜；原位诊断：反射高能电子衍射（RHEED）；非原位表征：X射线衍射（XRD，用于测量摇摆曲线半高宽fwhm）、原子力显微镜（AFM，用于测量均方根粗糙度）；机器学习方法：无监督学习（对RHEED图案进行聚类）、互信息分析、监督学习（预测fwhm和粗糙度）、残差分析异常检测。

papers.title: Towards Atom-by-Atom Fabrication: Mechanosynthetic donation and abstraction
papers.abstract: Enabled by inverted-mode scanning tunneling microscopy (IM-STM) and the use of functionalized molecular tools, we demonstrate positionally-controlled mechanosynthetic addition (donation) of carbon and subtraction (abstraction) of silicon atoms on a model build site: atomically clean and crystalline Si(100). The resulting structures represent the first demonstrations of an emerging ability to manipulate radical chemistry with positional control of specific atoms and moieties in 3D. Furthermore, by comparing the behavior of molecular tools designed for atomic donation versus abstraction, we highlight general principles governing molecular tool design for selective and reliable mechanosynthetic functionality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：inverted-mode scanning tunneling microscopy (IM-STM)、demonstrate、positionally-controlled mechanosynthetic addition/subtraction。；研究对象：在原子级洁净的晶体Si(100)表面上，通过机械合成方式实现碳原子的添加（捐赠）和硅原子的移除（抽取）的原子级操控过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次展示了利用倒置模式扫描隧道显微镜（IM-STM）和功能化分子工具，在三维空间中对特定原子和基团进行位置可控的自由基化学操控能力，并揭示了实现选择性、可靠机械合成功能所需的分子工具设计原则。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次展示了利用倒置模式扫描隧道显微镜（IM-STM）和功能化分子工具，在三维空间中对特定原子和基团进行位置可控的自由基化学操控能力，并揭示了实现选择性、可靠机械合成功能所需的分子工具设计原则。；创新点：首次实验演示了通过机械合成方式在三维空间中对特定原子进行位置可控的捐赠（碳原子）和抽取（硅原子），并系统比较了用于原子捐赠与抽取的分子工具行为，提炼出分子工具设计的一般性原则。
papers.method_zh: 倒置模式扫描隧道显微镜（IM-STM），结合功能化分子工具，在原子级洁净的晶体Si(100)表面上进行位置可控的机械合成操作。

papers.title: Dynamical multiferroicity in framework materials
papers.abstract: Dynamical multiferroicity, which describes the magnetic fields generated by circularly polarized phonons in materials, is an established mechanism for optical control of magnetism. Here we perform ab initio calculations of dynamical multiferroicity in inorganic and organic framework materials, with the goal of identifying materials which enable the generation of large magnetic fields by light. We find the metal--organic framework material Zn(NH$_4$)(formate)$_3$ to have modes with magnetic moments almost twice that of SrTiO$_3$; these modes involve circular motions of NH$_4^+$ hydrogen ions with high gyromagnetic ratios. The complex structure and flexibility of framework materials can allow such angular momentum localization, and also increase the maximum light-induced magnetization permitted by the Lindemann melting criterion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：ab initio calculations（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：无机和有机框架材料中的动态多铁性，具体包括金属有机框架材料 Zn(NH₄)(formate)₃ 以及 SrTiO₃ 作为对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在金属有机框架材料 Zn(NH₄)(formate)₃ 中，由圆偏振光激发的声子模式产生的磁矩几乎是 SrTiO₃ 的两倍；框架材料的复杂结构和柔性有助于实现这种角动量局域化，并提高林德曼熔化准则所允许的最大光致磁化强度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在金属有机框架材料 Zn(NH₄)(formate)₃ 中，由圆偏振光激发的声子模式产生的磁矩几乎是 SrTiO₃ 的两倍；框架材料的复杂结构和柔性有助于实现这种角动量局域化，并提高林德曼熔化准则所允许的最大光致磁化强度。；创新点：首次将动态多铁性的研究从传统无机材料（如 SrTiO₃）拓展到无机和有机框架材料，并发现框架材料的结构特性（如 NH₄⁺ 氢离子的高旋磁比圆运动）能显著增强光致磁效应。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（ab initio calculations），具体用于计算声子模式产生的磁矩。

papers.title: DFTB coupled with NEGF study of the structural, electronic and transport properties of goldene 2D material
papers.abstract: We report the structural, electronic, and transport properties of the goldene 2D material using the density functional tight-binding (DFTB) method. Electronic transport calculations were conducted in conjunction with the non-equilibrium Green's functions (NEGF) technique. Our study reveals that the Au 2D material is dynamically and thermally stable, and it possesses good elastic properties. On the other hand, goldene has a linear relationship between current and voltage at low potentials, indicating its metallic character. The calculated current-potential curve correlates well with transmission functions and the electronic density of states around the Fermi level. We also investigated the electronic structure and magnetic properties of silicon (Si)-doped Au 2D material. Our results show that the Si atom can induce a local magnetic state in the goldene monolayer. The resulting magnetic moment is 0.63 $μ_B$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：DFTB（密度泛函紧束缚方法）、NEGF（非平衡格林函数）、电子输运计算。；研究对象：二维金烯（goldene）材料的结构、电子性质与输运性质，以及硅（Si）掺杂金烯的电子结构与磁性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 金烯二维材料具有动态和热稳定性，且表现出良好的弹性性质；在低偏压下电流与电压呈线性关系，显示金属性。硅掺杂可在金烯单层中诱导局域磁态，磁矩为0.63 μ_B。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：金烯二维材料具有动态和热稳定性，且表现出良好的弹性性质；在低偏压下电流与电压呈线性关系，显示金属性。硅掺杂可在金烯单层中诱导局域磁态，磁矩为0.63 μ_B。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函紧束缚（DFTB）方法进行结构优化与电子性质计算，结合非平衡格林函数（NEGF）技术进行电子输运计算。

papers.title: Closed-loop discovery of out-of-distribution processing protocols by evolutionary search and uncertainty-aware learning
papers.abstract: Many materials and chemical systems exhibit history-dependent responses, where functional outcomes are governed not only by final-state variables but by the time-dependent sequence of fields, temperatures, or chemical potentials applied during operation. Discovering new processing protocols is therefore a high-dimensional search problem in which the control variable is an entire waveform or sample history, and conventional strategies either remain confined to conservative interpolative families or become prohibitively measurement intensive. Here, a closed-loop workflow is introduced that couples evolutionary search over a compact waveform representation with uncertainty-aware deep kernel learning to generate, rank, and experimentally validate candidate protocols. Applied to ferroelectric thin films, with the scanning-probe tip-bias waveform as the protocol and the nonlinear electromechanical response as the reward, the workflow discovers waveform families that enhance nonlinearity by de-aging the film. Spatially resolved before/after measurements show that the best-performing waveforms selectively activate pre-existing, weakly pinned domain-wall segments, whereas the worst drive long-range irreversible switching. This framework reframes protocol tuning as out-of-distribution discovery, generalizable to synthesis and annealing trajectories, battery formation protocols, and other high-dimensional control problems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中同时提及了“闭环工作流”、“进化搜索”、“不确定性感知的深度核学习”等计算方法，以及“应用于铁电薄膜”、“扫描探针尖端偏压波形”、“空间分辨测量”等实验验证手段。；研究对象：铁电薄膜材料，具体研究其在外加电场波形（扫描探针尖端偏压波形）作用下的非线性机电响应，以及与之相关的“去老化”（de-aging）物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过闭环搜索工作流，发现了一类能够通过“去老化”薄膜来增强非线性响应的波形族。性能最佳的波形选择性地激活了预先存在的、弱钉扎的畴壁片段，而性能最差的波形则驱动了长程不可逆的开关过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过闭环搜索工作流，发现了一类能够通过“去老化”薄膜来增强非线性响应的波形族。性能最佳的波形选择性地激活了预先存在的、弱钉扎的畴壁片段，而性能最差的波形则驱动了长程不可逆的开关过程。；创新点：将处理协议（processing protocols）的调优重新定义为一种“分布外发现”（out-of-distribution discovery）问题，并为此开发了结合进化搜索与不确定性感知学习的通用闭环框架。该方法可推广至合成、退火轨迹、电池形成协议等高维控制问题，突破了传统策略局限于保守插值族或测量强度过高的限制。
papers.method_zh: 采用了一种闭环工作流，该工作流将：（1）对紧凑波形表示进行进化搜索；（2）结合不确定性感知的深度核学习（用于生成、排序候选协议）；（3）实验验证（对候选协议进行测试）三者耦合。具体实验手段为扫描探针显微镜，以尖端偏压波形作为控制协议，非线性机电响应作为奖励信号。

papers.title: Machine-learned dynamics of surface polarons at reduced oxide surfaces
papers.abstract: Reducible oxides exhibit a rich interplay of electronic, structural, and chemical properties that underpins applications in catalysis, photovoltaics, batteries, and energy storage. This interplay is strongly shaped by excess electrons, often introduced by oxygen vacancies, that localize as small polarons and influence charge transport and surface chemistry. At surfaces, these polarons play a central role in charge localization, mobility, and reactivity, yet their finite-temperature dynamics remain difficult to access from first principles. Ab initio molecular dynamics is typically limited to picosecond time scales, precluding statistically meaningful sampling of polaron hopping dynamics. To overcome this limitation, we extend machine-learning-assisted polaron dynamics [V. Birschitzky et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 134, 216301 (2025)] to redox-active oxide surfaces, using oxygen-deficient rutile TiO2(110) as a paradigmatic case. By accessing several nanoseconds of dynamics over a range of temperatures, we show that small-polaron mobility at the reduced rutile TiO2(110) surface is suppressed by several orders of magnitude relative to the corresponding bulk material, providing a microscopic interpretation of the lower electron mobilities observed in porous rutile TiO2 compared with single-crystal samples. This suppressed mobility arises from the loss of favorable hopping pathways: surface polaron motion is largely confined to planar inter-row trajectories within the second topmost layers, with only rare interlayer hopping events. Oxygen vacancies further reshape the polaron free-energy landscape by acting as attractive centers for excess electrons, biasing the polaron distribution toward nearby Ti sites and promoting occasional charge transfer to the outermost surface layer. These results establish a transferable machine-learning strategy for investigating polaron dynamics in reducible oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learning-assisted polaron dynamics、ab initio molecular dynamics、first principles。；研究对象：还原性氧化物表面（以缺氧金红石TiO₂(110)为模型体系）上的小极化子动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在还原性金红石TiO₂(110)表面，小极化子的迁移率比体相材料低数个数量级，这是由于表面极化子运动主要被限制在次表层内的平面间行轨迹中，层间跳跃事件极为罕见；氧空位作为吸引中心进一步重塑了极化子的自由能景观。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在还原性金红石TiO₂(110)表面，小极化子的迁移率比体相材料低数个数量级，这是由于表面极化子运动主要被限制在次表层内的平面间行轨迹中，层间跳跃事件极为罕见；氧空位作为吸引中心进一步重塑了极化子的自由能景观。；创新点：将机器学习辅助极化子动力学方法从体相材料拓展到氧化还原活性氧化物表面，首次实现了对表面极化子有限温度下纳秒级动力学过程的统计采样，揭示了表面与体相极化子迁移率的巨大差异及其微观机制。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习辅助的极化子动力学方法（扩展自V. Birschitzky et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 134, 216301 (2025)），结合第一性原理分子动力学，在多个温度下获取数纳秒尺度的动力学轨迹。

papers.title: Combining Frozen Trajectory Excitation and TACAW for in silico Time-Resolved Vibrational Electron Energy Loss/Gain Spectroscopy
papers.abstract: Seeing that ultrafast (picosecond timescale) vibrational electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) should soon be experimentally realizable, we present in silico approach capable of providing insight from the computational physics perspective. We present a framework that combines frozen trajectory excitation (FTE) with time auto-correlation of auxiliary wavefunctions (TACAW) to study the time-dependent spectral response of non-equilibrium lattice dynamics in a way comparable directly to experiment - (scanning) transmission electron microscope EELS, (S)TEM-EELS. In this approach, a selected phonon excitation is first introduced into an equilibrium molecular dynamics trajectory using FTE, after which the atomic positions during subsequent relaxations are treated with short-time TACAW analysis performed at different pump-probe delays. This yields momentum- and energy-resolved electron-scattering signals bearing a phonon imprint during the relaxation process, going beyond time-dependent diffuse-scattering intensities alone. We demonstrate the approach for fcc-Ni and 3C-SiC and discuss the observed phonon mode coupling and spectral redistribution during phonon relaxation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“in silico approach”（计算机模拟方法）、“computational physics perspective”（计算物理视角），以及具体计算方法（FTE、TACAW）。；研究对象：非平衡晶格动力学的时间分辨振动电子能量损失/增益谱（vibrational EELS/EEGS），具体以面心立方镍（fcc-Ni）和3C碳化硅（3C-SiC）为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种结合冻结轨迹激发（FTE）与辅助波函数时间自关联（TACAW）的计算框架，能够模拟超快时间尺度（皮秒）下非平衡晶格弛豫过程中的动量分辨和能量分辨电子散射信号，并观察到声子模式耦合与光谱重分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种结合冻结轨迹激发（FTE）与辅助波函数时间自关联（TACAW）的计算框架，能够模拟超快时间尺度（皮秒）下非平衡晶格弛豫过程中的动量分辨和能量分辨电子散射信号，并观察到声子模式耦合与光谱重分布。；创新点：该方法能够提供超越时间分辨漫散射强度的、带有声子印记的动量-能量分辨电子散射信号，并可直接与实验（S)TEM-EELS对比，为理解非平衡晶格弛豫过程中的声子模式耦合与光谱重分布提供了计算物理视角。
papers.method_zh: 采用冻结轨迹激发（FTE）在平衡分子动力学轨迹中引入特定声子激发，随后在不同泵浦-探测延迟时间下对弛豫过程中的原子位置进行短时TACAW分析，从而获得与（扫描）透射电子显微镜EELS实验直接可比的时间分辨振动谱信号。

papers.title: A Collective-Spin Derivation of the Uniform Magnon Hamiltonian in Cavity Magnonics
papers.abstract: We present a direct collective-spin derivation of the effective uniform-mode Hamiltonian used in cavity magnonics. Starting from a nearest-neighbor Heisenberg ferromagnet coupled to long-wavelength magnetic fields, we show that the relevant dynamics can be restricted to the fully symmetric spin sector, where the exchange interaction contributes only a constant energy shift and the ferromagnet behaves as a macrospin of length $Ns$. Applying the Holstein--Primakoff transformation directly to this total spin yields the usual uniform magnon mode and its leading nonlinear corrections without first introducing site-resolved bosonic operators. This collective formulation makes explicit the interpretation of the ferromagnet as a synthetic large-spin atom and provides a compact route to the effective Hamiltonians used in driven and Floquet cavity magnonics. As a physical consequence, the leading nonlinear correction produces an occupation-dependent reduction of the effective magnon--photon coupling, providing a simple signature of finite-spin saturation under strong uniform-mode driving.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“collective-spin derivation”、“effective Hamiltonian”、“Holstein--Primakoff transformation”，属于理论推导。；研究对象：腔磁学（cavity magnonics）中的均匀磁振子（uniform magnon mode）哈密顿量，具体为最近邻海森堡铁磁体与长波长磁场耦合的系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过集体自旋推导，证明铁磁体可视为一个长度为 \( Ns \) 的宏观自旋（macrospin），其交换相互作用仅贡献常数能量偏移；均匀磁振子模式及其非线性修正可直接从总自旋的Holstein-Primakoff变换得到，且主要非线性修正导致有效磁振子-光子耦合随占据数减小，这是有限自旋饱和的简单特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过集体自旋推导，证明铁磁体可视为一个长度为 \( Ns \) 的宏观自旋（macrospin），其交换相互作用仅贡献常数能量偏移；均匀磁振子模式及其非线性修正可直接从总自旋的Holstein-Primakoff变换得到，且主要非线性修正导致有效磁振子-光子耦合随占据数减小，这是有限自旋饱和的简单特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可指出：该工作提供了一种直接、紧凑的集体自旋推导方法，避免了传统先引入格点玻色子算符的步骤，明确解释了铁磁体作为合成大自旋原子的图像，并简化了驱动和Floquet腔磁学中有效哈密顿量的推导。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：从最近邻海森堡铁磁体模型出发，限制动力学到全对称自旋子空间，应用Holstein-Primakoff变换于总自旋，导出均匀磁振子哈密顿量及其非线性修正。

papers.title: Observation of intertwined charge density wave order and superconductivity in Janus monolayer
papers.abstract: Low-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) provide an ideal platform for studying the emergence of charge density wave (CDW) and superconductivity. The discovery of emergent CDW order in 1T $\mathrm{ZrTe_2}$ monolayer raises an important question: does this instability persist when one $\mathrm{Te}$ chalcogen layer is substituted by $\mathrm{Se}$? In the present work, we investigate the CDW (2$\times$2$\times$1) and superconducting instability in 1T $\mathrm{ZrSeTe}$ Janus monolayer using first-principles calculations. The phonon spectrum exhibits a pronounced anomaly at the $\mathrm{M}$ point of the irreducible Brillouin zone, arising from enhanced electron-phonon interaction together with electronic instabilities originating from both interband and intraband scattering. The resulting lattice distortion reconstructs the electronic structure, opening a small indirect band gap, driving the system from a semi-metallic to a semiconducting state. The energy gain associated with the distortion is significantly smaller than that of $\mathrm{ZrTe_2}$ monolayer, indicating that the replacement of one $\mathrm{Te}$ chalcogen layer with $\mathrm{Se}$ weakens the CDW instability. We have further investigated the effects of electronic correlation and biaxial strain, both acts as effective tuning parameters for the instabilities concerened. In the high temperature undistorted phase, $\mathrm{ZrSeTe}$ exhibits phonon mediated two-gap superconductivity. It originates primarily from the robust coupling between the soft phonon mode at $\mathrm{M}$ point and the electronic bands predominantly derived from $\mathrm{Zr}$ $\mathit{d}$ and $\mathrm{Te}$ $\mathit{p}$ orbitals crossing the Fermi level. Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) further modifies the electronic states and reduces the superconducting transition temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）、phonon spectrum（声子谱）、electron-phonon interaction（电子-声子相互作用）。；研究对象：1T相 ZrSeTe Janus单层材料中的电荷密度波（CDW）序与超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在1T ZrSeTe Janus单层中，Te层被Se替代会削弱CDW不稳定性，但该材料在高温未畸变相中仍表现出由软声子模介导的双能隙超导电性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在1T ZrSeTe Janus单层中，Te层被Se替代会削弱CDW不稳定性，但该材料在高温未畸变相中仍表现出由软声子模介导的双能隙超导电性。；创新点：首次在理论上预测了Janus结构ZrSeTe单层中CDW序与超导电性的共存，并揭示了Te层被Se替代后CDW不稳定性被削弱的机制。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体包括：声子谱计算、电子-声子耦合分析、电子关联效应（electronic correlation）及双轴应变（biaxial strain）调控研究、自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）效应分析。

papers.title: Enhancement of spin current in Fe$_{85}$Co$_{15}$/Ni$_{80}$Fe$_{20}$ bilayers via interlayer ferromagnetic coupling
papers.abstract: We present a detailed study on how the strength of the interlayer magnetic coupling on Fe$_{85}$Co$_{15}$/Ni$_{80}$Fe$_{20}$ bilayers modifies the spin wave behavior of this system. A series of Fe$_{85}$Co$_{15}$/Ni$_{80}$Fe$_{20}$ bilayers deposited on MgO[100] substrates were grown by magnetron sputtering. Magnetic characterization of the samples was performed using a vibrating sample magnetometer and magneto-optical Kerr effect. The in-plane hysteresis loops reveal a cubic magnetic anisotropy of magnetocrystalline origin, with easy and hard axis along the [100] and [110] Fe-Co crystallographic directions, respectively. Ferromagnetic resonance measurements were performed to analyze the in-plane angular dependence of the resonance field, and also the resonance field at several frequencies was determined along the hard axis. By using a bilayer model in the frame of the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert magnetization equation of motion, the magnetization precession components were calculated, as well as the dependence of precession area on the Fe-Co layer thickness and the ferromagnetic interlayer coupling. We observe a maximum in the area of the ellipsoid generated by the magnetization precession of the permalloy layer at a certain exchange constant, showing that this effect could be used to maximize the injected spin currents, which could be tuned by changing the interlayer exchange constant in bilayer systems, the saturation magnetization of the materials, or the excitation frequency.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：deposited by magnetron sputtering、magnetic characterization、ferromagnetic resonance measurements）；研究对象：Fe₈₅Co₁₅/Ni₈₀Fe₂₀双层膜体系，以及层间铁磁耦合对自旋波行为和自旋电流的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节Fe-Co层厚度和层间铁磁交换耦合常数，可以最大化坡莫合金（Ni₈₀Fe₂₀）层的磁化进动椭球面积，从而增强注入的自旋电流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节Fe-Co层厚度和层间铁磁交换耦合常数，可以最大化坡莫合金（Ni₈₀Fe₂₀）层的磁化进动椭球面积，从而增强注入的自旋电流。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用磁控溅射在MgO[100]衬底上生长Fe₈₅Co₁₅/Ni₈₀Fe₂₀双层膜；使用振动样品磁强计和磁光克尔效应进行磁性表征；通过铁磁共振测量分析共振场的面内角度依赖性和沿难轴方向的频率依赖性；基于Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程的双层膜模型计算磁化进动分量及进动面积。

papers.title: Digital programming of spin correlations in a fermionic lattice quantum simulator
papers.abstract: Analog quantum simulation provides a highly controlled platform to study diverse quantum many-body phenomena. However, current methods for state initialisation are limited to thermal ensembles or uncorrelated product states. Here we present a hybrid approach that complements analog preparation with a digital quantum-gate protocol. This approach enables the engineering of target states with specific, long-range spin-correlations from the same initial resource state. By applying collisional gates to adiabatically prepared and filtered four-fermion singlet chains, we program diverse spin-correlation patterns, including that of a Heisenberg chain. We measure the spin correlations using a sequence of quantum gates followed by singlet-pair measurements. Our method paves the way to the targeted preparation of strongly correlated states of matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：analog quantum simulation、digital quantum-gate protocol、collisional gates、measurements）；研究对象：费米子晶格量子模拟器中的自旋关联态工程，具体为四费米子单态链中的自旋关联编程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将模拟量子制备与数字量子门协议相结合，能够从同一初始资源态出发，编程生成具有特定长程自旋关联的目标态，包括海森堡链的自旋关联模式。
