papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将模拟量子制备与数字量子门协议相结合，能够从同一初始资源态出发，编程生成具有特定长程自旋关联的目标态，包括海森堡链的自旋关联模式。；创新点：突破了传统模拟量子模拟中初始态局限于热系综或无关联乘积态的限制，实现了对自旋关联模式的数字可编程控制。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合方法：先通过绝热制备和过滤获得四费米子单态链，再应用碰撞门（collisional gates）进行数字编程，最后通过量子门序列和单态对测量来检测自旋关联。

papers.title: Electrostatic Charge Model for Dual-Layer Oxide Thin-Film Transistors
papers.abstract: A simple electrostatic two-equation model for dual-layer thin-film transistor (TFT) operation is developed. The model distributes electrostatic charge between the top and bottom semiconductor layers, and the resulting transfer and mobility curves accurately simulate experimental dual-layer a-IGZO/a-IZO TFT operation. The model further provides an analytic expression that maps charge confinement in the high-mobility a-IZO bottom semiconductor layer with the a-IGZO top-layer thickness and the conduction-band offset. By considering both a-IGZO/a-IZO layer charge partition and competing thickness-dependent oxygen vacancy trap density effects, the model suggests an optimal a-IGZO layer thickness of 9 to 12 nm. Importantly, this general electrostatic model extends to most dual-layer TFT systems and calculates how the top semiconductor layer TFT turn-on voltage changes sharply with the conduction band offset and layer thickness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论模型文章。判断依据关键词：electrostatic two-equation model、analytic expression、general electrostatic model。；研究对象：双有源层氧化物薄膜晶体管（dual-layer oxide TFT），具体材料体系为a-IGZO/a-IZO（非晶铟镓锌氧/非晶铟锌氧）双层结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该静电模型通过电荷分配机制准确模拟了双有源层TFT的转移特性和迁移率曲线，并预测了最优a-IGZO层厚度为9至12 nm。模型还给出了高迁移率a-IZO层中电荷限制与顶层厚度及导带偏移的解析关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该静电模型通过电荷分配机制准确模拟了双有源层TFT的转移特性和迁移率曲线，并预测了最优a-IGZO层厚度为9至12 nm。模型还给出了高迁移率a-IZO层中电荷限制与顶层厚度及导带偏移的解析关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：建立双有源层TFT的静电双方程模型，通过解析表达式描述电荷在顶层（a-IGZO）和底层（a-IZO）之间的分配，并考虑氧空位陷阱密度随厚度的竞争效应。

papers.title: Controlling Defects and Probing Dynamics in Active Nematics with Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Topological defects govern much of the flow behavior and orientational order in active nematics, making their control relevant for active matter physics, smart materials, and microfluidics. Applied activity patterns can induce self-propulsion of active nematic defects, but general-purpose methods for exploiting this effect to control defects remain largely unexplored. Here we use deep reinforcement learning (RL) to perform minimum-time position control of +1/2 defects in hybrid lattice Boltzmann simulations of active nematodynamics. Spatiotemporally patterned activity, implemented as a control field in the active stress, steers defects through microchannel geometries and reveals finite-time reachable regions of defect position space. Reachability is shaped by director anisotropy, homeotropic wall anchoring, and the allowed activity patterns: local patterns steer defects in free domains but fail in junctions, whereas global patterns open otherwise inaccessible channels. In constrained geometries, the original defect may be unable to reach some goals intact, but controlled pair creation enlarges the effective reachable set by transferring control to a newly created +1/2 defect. The trained RL controllers outperform static and rule-based baselines, and controllers trained only on simple junctions can be combined without fine-tuning into a meta-controller that successfully steers defects through a larger test maze. Free energy visualizations show that guided defects write persistent, history-dependent distortions into the director field that can later be partially erased by -1/2 defects. Thus, RL-based control uncovers how confinement, anchoring, actuation geometry, and defect creation determine reachable motion in active nematics, providing a framework for other control tasks in soft and active matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：deep reinforcement learning, hybrid lattice Boltzmann simulations, active nematodynamics）；研究对象：活性向列相（active nematics）中拓扑缺陷（+1/2缺陷）的动力学与控制，具体涉及微通道几何结构中的缺陷位置操控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过深度强化学习训练的控制策略，能够实现活性向列相中+1/2缺陷的最短时间位置控制，并揭示出受限几何、锚定条件、驱动模式以及缺陷产生对缺陷可达运动范围的共同影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过深度强化学习训练的控制策略，能够实现活性向列相中+1/2缺陷的最短时间位置控制，并揭示出受限几何、锚定条件、驱动模式以及缺陷产生对缺陷可达运动范围的共同影响。；创新点：首次将深度强化学习应用于活性向列相缺陷的实时控制，系统性地探索了有限时间内缺陷位置空间的可达区域，并发现通过受控的缺陷对产生可扩大有效可达集；此外，展示了在简单结上训练的控制器可组合成元控制器，无需微调即可在更大迷宫中成功导航缺陷。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合格子玻尔兹曼方法（hybrid lattice Boltzmann simulations）模拟活性向列动力学，并结合深度强化学习（deep reinforcement learning, RL）设计时空变化的活性应力控制场，以驱动缺陷运动。训练后的RL控制器与静态及基于规则的基线方法进行了对比。

papers.title: Scalar dissipation anomaly and scalar-gradient scaling in turbulence: A joint velocity-scalar multifractal view
papers.abstract: We revisit the problem of scalar dissipation anomaly and scaling of scalar gradients in passive scalar turbulence using theory and data from well-resolved direct numerical simulations (DNS) on grid sizes of up to $8192^3$, spanning Taylor-scale Reynolds numbers $Re_λ=140-1000$ and Schmidt numbers $Sc = 1-512$. The theory is based on a joint multifractal description of longitudinal velocity increments and scalar increments, constrained by Yaglom's law and extended to gradients via a fluctuating Batchelor cutoff scale. The DNS data show that the normalized mean scalar dissipation approaches a single asymptotic value as both $Re_λ$ and $Sc$ increase, although larger $Sc$ requires larger $\re$ to reach this state. In the multifractal framework, this corresponds to an effective scalar Hölder exponent tending to zero, associated with sharp cliff-like scalar fronts, and saturation of inertial-range scaling scalar structure-function exponents. The joint velocity-scalar fractal dimension of the dissipative structures is inferred to approach $7/3$, indicating a non-space-filling support. The framework further predicts that for fixed $Re_λ$, higher-order central moments of scalar gradients are independent of $Sc$. This prediction is confirmed by DNS data and by the collapse of standardized probability distributions of scalar-gradient across Schmidt numbers. These results suggest that the $Sc$-scaling of scalar gradients is dictated solely by scalar dissipation anomaly. In contrast, their $Re_λ$-dependence reflects strong intermittency, which can be directly related to mixed velocity-scalar structure function exponents.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论分析 + 计算验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“using theory and data from well-resolved direct numerical simulations (DNS)”，即理论框架与高分辨率直接数值模拟数据相结合。；研究对象：被动标量湍流中的标量耗散异常（scalar dissipation anomaly）以及标量梯度（scalar gradients）的标度行为。具体涉及速度场与标量场的联合多分形描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 归一化平均标量耗散在雷诺数 \(Re_\lambda\) 和施密特数 \(Sc\) 同时增大时趋于单一渐近值；标量梯度的 \(Sc\) 标度完全由标量耗散异常决定，而其 \(Re_\lambda\) 依赖性则反映了强间歇性，并与混合速度-标量结构函数指数直接相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：归一化平均标量耗散在雷诺数 \(Re_\lambda\) 和施密特数 \(Sc\) 同时增大时趋于单一渐近值；标量梯度的 \(Sc\) 标度完全由标量耗散异常决定，而其 \(Re_\lambda\) 依赖性则反映了强间歇性，并与混合速度-标量结构函数指数直接相关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面采用联合多分形（joint multifractal）框架描述纵向速度增量与标量增量，受 Yaglom 定律约束，并通过涨落的 Batchelor 截断尺度推广至梯度。计算方面使用网格尺寸高达 \(8192^3\) 的直接数值模拟（DNS），覆盖 \(Re_\lambda = 140-1000\) 和 \(Sc = 1-512\)。

papers.title: Prospective Coding and Path Integration Emerge as Equilibrium Solutions of Self-Organizing Neural Networks with Firing-Rate Adaptation
papers.abstract: Continuous Attractor Neural Networks (CANNs) traditionally rely on pre-wired recurrent connectivity to model spatial representations, path integration, and anticipatory dynamics. However, the biological mechanisms through which this structured connectivity emerges via learning remain relatively unexplored. This work presents a theoretical framework revealing how continuous attractor connectivity and its computational properties self-organize through Hebbian plasticity, firing-rate adaptation, and global inhibition. We show that translationally invariant inputs naturally drive the emergence of stable, Gaussian-profiled feedforward weights. Crucially, anticipatory dynamics arise spontaneously within these feedforward architectures, shifting the activity bump forward without requiring recurrent excitatory collaterals. This predictive shift can be linearly amplified across multilayer networks, consistent with anticipatory activity observed in the superficial layers of the entorhinal cortex. Furthermore, introducing recurrent interactions allows the network to learn connections capable of self-sustaining a moving bump of activity. Finally, by modulating the network with an external, time-varying baseline current that encodes speed, the system adjusts its intrinsic velocity to function as a precise unidirectional path integrator. Ultimately, this study suggests that prospective coding and path integration are not manually engineered features, but rather naturally co-emergent properties of a single self-organizing competitive network.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：theoretical framework、self-organizing、learning、modeling。；研究对象：连续吸引子神经网络（CANN）中空间表征、路径积分和预期动力学的自组织涌现机制，具体涉及神经网络的突触可塑性、发放率适应和全局抑制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过赫布可塑性、发放率适应和全局抑制，连续吸引子连接及其计算特性（如预期编码和路径积分）可以自发自组织产生，无需预先布线；预期动力学可在无递归兴奋性侧支的前馈架构中自发出现，并可通过多层网络线性放大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过赫布可塑性、发放率适应和全局抑制，连续吸引子连接及其计算特性（如预期编码和路径积分）可以自发自组织产生，无需预先布线；预期动力学可在无递归兴奋性侧支的前馈架构中自发出现，并可通过多层网络线性放大。；创新点：揭示了预期编码和路径积分并非人工设计的特征，而是单一自组织竞争网络自然共生的平衡解，并展示了前馈架构中自发产生预期动力学的新机制，无需依赖传统递归兴奋性连接。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值模拟。具体包括：基于赫布可塑性的自组织学习规则、发放率适应机制、全局抑制调控，以及通过外部时变基线电流（编码速度）调制网络以实现单向路径积分。

papers.title: Spin disorder competing with positional symmetry breaking governs the metal-insulator behavior in oxide paramagnets
papers.abstract: Numerous transition-metal oxides have low-temperature antiferromagnetic (AFM) states and high-temperature paramagnetic (PM) phases, where the AFM state is usually insulating while the PM phase can be either insulating or metallic. Without involving strong correlation, we use symmetry-broken density-functional theory (DFT) to obtain the PM phases of insulating NaFeO3 vs the recently discovered metallic NaOsO3. We develop the understanding of insulating and metallic behaviors in paramagnetic oxides by analyzing the interactions between magnetic and positional symmetry breaking: The insulating gap is governed by the competition between the spin disorder that induces a distribution of different magnitudes of local magnetic moments and the polymorphous distribution of off-center atomic displacements. NaFeO3, on the other hand, has large positional displacement with small spin-disorder-induced moments distribution, leading to insulating PM phase, whereas NaOsO3 has a pronounced spin-disorder-induced moments distribution that forces the PM phase to become metallic. Our work identifies this symmetry-breaking competition as a general framework to bridge seemingly disparate metal-insulator behaviors in transition-metal oxides paramagnets without invoking strong correlation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用密度泛函理论（DFT）进行计算分析，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：过渡金属氧化物顺磁相（PM）的金属-绝缘体行为，具体对比了绝缘体NaFeO₃与金属NaOsO₃。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 顺磁氧化物的绝缘或金属行为由磁无序与位置对称性破缺之间的竞争决定：NaFeO₃中大的位置位移与小的自旋无序诱导磁矩分布导致绝缘相，而NaOsO₃中显著的自旋无序诱导磁矩分布迫使顺磁相变为金属。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：顺磁氧化物的绝缘或金属行为由磁无序与位置对称性破缺之间的竞争决定：NaFeO₃中大的位置位移与小的自旋无序诱导磁矩分布导致绝缘相，而NaOsO₃中显著的自旋无序诱导磁矩分布迫使顺磁相变为金属。；创新点：提出磁无序与位置对称性破缺的竞争作为统一框架，解释过渡金属氧化物顺磁相中看似迥异的金属-绝缘体行为，且不涉及强关联效应。
papers.method_zh: 对称性破缺的密度泛函理论（symmetry-broken DFT），用于模拟顺磁相，分析局域磁矩分布与原子位移的相互作用。

papers.title: Wave turbulence theory of odd fluids and solids: kinetic equations and solutions
papers.abstract: The theory of wave turbulence describes the properties of physical systems composed of a set of weak-amplitude random waves interacting nonlinearly. Here, we study odd wave turbulence, which arises in chiral media subjected to non-reciprocal stresses, notably odd viscosity and odd elasticity. In both cases, we consider simple models for which we can derive and solve analytically the kinetic equations describing the long-term statistical behavior of spectral quantities such as energy or wave action. For odd viscosity, we consider a three-dimensional model that exhibits wave turbulence involving three-wave interactions, which gives rise to a direct energy cascade characterized by an anisotropic Kolmogorov-Zakharov (KZ) spectrum. For odd elasticity, we consider a quasi-one-dimensional overdamped model that exhibits much slower dynamics involving six-wave interactions. In that case, the KZ spectrum corresponding to a forward cascade of a conserved quantity we call odd energy, is nonlocal and therefore does not constitute a physical solution. However, the other KZ solution, which describes an inverse cascade of wave action, is only marginally non-local and is therefore valid up to a logarithmic correction. These two analytical theories provide a rigorous interpretation of direct numerical simulations, where the KZ spectrum is observed both in the case of odd viscosity (forward cascade) and of odd elasticity (inverse cascade).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：wave turbulence theory、kinetic equations、analytically solve、direct numerical simulations。；研究对象：奇异物态中的波湍流现象，具体包括具有奇粘滞性（odd viscosity）的三维流体模型和具有奇弹性（odd elasticity）的准一维过阻尼固体模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在奇粘滞性流体中，三波相互作用导致各向异性的Kolmogorov-Zakharov（KZ）直接能级串谱；在奇弹性固体中，六波相互作用导致波作用量的逆级串，其KZ谱仅在对数修正下有效，而直接能级串的KZ谱是非局域的、非物理解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在奇粘滞性流体中，三波相互作用导致各向异性的Kolmogorov-Zakharov（KZ）直接能级串谱；在奇弹性固体中，六波相互作用导致波作用量的逆级串，其KZ谱仅在对数修正下有效，而直接能级串的KZ谱是非局域的、非物理解。；创新点：首次将波湍流理论系统应用于具有非互易应力（奇粘滞性和奇弹性）的手性介质，并给出了两种情形下KZ谱的解析形式及其有效性判据。
papers.method_zh: 基于弱湍流理论，推导并解析求解描述谱量（如能量、波作用量）长期统计行为的动力学方程；结合直接数值模拟验证解析结果。

papers.title: Trap-Quenched Matter-Wave Optics for Dual Species Lensing
papers.abstract: Dual-species atom interferometry in space promises precise tests of the Universality of Free Fall (UFF), with a sensitivity that grows quadratically with the extended interrogation time accessible in weightlessness. These tests demand exquisite control over the expansion energies of both condensed sources as well as over their differential center-of-mass dynamics. We propose a trap-quenched collimation technique featuring in-trap excitations of collective modes compatible with state-of-the-art atom-chip setups. Using NASA's Cold Atom Laboratory aboard the International Space Station, we demonstrate it on a single-species $^{87}$Rb condensate. By controlling the center-of-mass release dynamics we observe free expansion times up to 700 ms and measure a two-dimensional expansion energy of $k_B \cdot 78\pm 9 \;\mathrm{pK}$ in the imaging plane. A detailed model of the magnetically-induced dynamics indicates that this corresponds to a two-dimensional expansion energy of about $k_B \cdot 15^{+12}_{-5}\; \mathrm{pK}$ along two of the condensate's eigenaxes. Finally, we theoretically study this trap-quenched collimation scheme for a $^{41}$K-$^{87}$Rb mixture, predicting a simultaneous collimation that meets the expansion energy requirements for a state-of-the-art UFF test at the $10^{-15}$ accuracy level.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼有理论研究）。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了在NASA冷原子实验室（CAL）上对单一物种\(^{87}\)Rb凝聚体进行的实验演示，并建立了磁致动力学模型，同时对\(^{41}\)K-\(^{87}\)Rb混合物进行了理论研究。；研究对象：双物种原子干涉仪中的超冷原子（玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体）的准直与膨胀动力学，具体涉及\(^{87}\)Rb单物种及\(^{41}\)K-\(^{87}\)Rb混合体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出并实验验证了一种“阱猝灭准直技术”，通过控制中心质心释放动力学，在\(^{87}\)Rb凝聚体中实现了长达700 ms的自由膨胀时间，并测量到成像平面内二维膨胀能量为\(k_B \cdot 78\pm 9\;\mathrm{pK}\)。理论预测该方案可用于\(^{41}\)K-\(^{87}\)Rb混合物，实现满足\(10^{-15}\)精度水平自由落体普适性检验要求的同步准直。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出并实验验证了一种“阱猝灭准直技术”，通过控制中心质心释放动力学，在\(^{87}\)Rb凝聚体中实现了长达700 ms的自由膨胀时间，并测量到成像平面内二维膨胀能量为\(k_B \cdot 78\pm 9\;\mathrm{pK}\)。理论预测该方案可用于\(^{41}\)K-\(^{87}\)Rb混合物，实现满足\(10^{-15}\)精度水平自由落体普适性检验要求的同步准直。；创新点：提出一种与现有原子芯片装置兼容的阱猝灭准直方案，通过激发阱内集体模式实现双物种同步准直，并首次在空间微重力环境下（国际空间站）演示了该技术对单物种凝聚体的长时自由膨胀控制，为未来空间双物种原子干涉仪的高精度自由落体普适性检验提供了可行路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用阱猝灭技术激发集体模式，结合原子芯片装置，在NASA国际空间站冷原子实验室上进行单物种\(^{87}\)Rb凝聚体的准直实验。理论上建立了磁致动力学详细模型，并数值研究了该方案在\(^{41}\)K-\(^{87}\)Rb双物种混合物中的应用。

papers.title: Dissipation-induced superradiance in matter coupled to a self-interacting cavity
papers.abstract: Light-matter interactions are often modeled via the Dicke model, namely, by two-level systems coupled to a cavity mode. Alas, the threshold for superradiance is often experimentally inaccessible or hindered by light's diamagnetic term. Here, within the Dicke setting, we consider self-interacting light in a cavity, modeled by a photonic Kerr nonlinearity. We show that negative Kerr nonlinearity gives rise to a low-threshold superradiant phase with spin inversion. While unstable in a closed system, cavity dissipation stabilizes this lit phase, opening avenues for lasing and bath-engineered phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：modeled、show、consider（理论建模与分析）。；研究对象：光与物质相互作用体系，具体为Dicke模型框架下耦合到自相互作用腔（含光子Kerr非线性）的二能级系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 负Kerr非线性可在低阈值下诱导出自旋反转的超辐射相；该相在封闭系统中不稳定，但腔耗散可稳定该发光相，为激光和浴工程相开辟新途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：负Kerr非线性可在低阈值下诱导出自旋反转的超辐射相；该相在封闭系统中不稳定，但腔耗散可稳定该发光相，为激光和浴工程相开辟新途径。；创新点：揭示了负Kerr非线性可降低超辐射相阈值，并指出腔耗散对不稳定超辐射相的稳定化作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于Dicke模型，引入光子Kerr非线性项进行理论分析，考虑封闭系统与开放系统（腔耗散）的对比。

papers.title: Detecting Historical Turning Points in Italian Media: A Complex Systems Approach to a Diachronic News Corpus
papers.abstract: The increasing availability of large-scale textual corpora has opened new possibilities for data-driven, quantitative approaches to historical analysis using Natural Language Processing (NLP). However, diachronic corpora with historical relevance from the pre-digital era remain scarce and often incomplete. We present a quantitative approach to historical analysis based on the reconstruction and exploration of a diachronic corpus of around 600,000 articles from the Italian newspaper "La Repubblica", covering all the articles published from the 1st of January 1985 to the 31st of December 2000 - a period of major political, social, and geopolitical change in Italy and globally. Using NLP techniques, we analyze the text at both lexical and semantic levels; we then apply tools from complex systems and statistical physics to trace shifts in media discourse over time. This allows us to detect key transition periods, such as the transition from the First Republic to the Second Republic in Italy, or major international conflicts like the Gulf War or the Kosovo War, without relying on prior labeling. The results show how combining computational linguistics with ideas from complex systems can offer new quantitative insight into historical changes, opening up new paths for studying the dynamics of media and society through large-scale textual data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据分析文章。判断依据：使用了自然语言处理（NLP）技术、复杂系统与统计物理工具进行数据分析，而非实验或纯理论推导。；研究对象：论文研究的对象是意大利报纸《La Repubblica》在1985年1月1日至2000年12月31日期间出版的大约60万篇文章所构成的历时性新闻语料库。该语料库反映了意大利及全球在政治、社会、地缘政治方面的重大变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合自然语言处理与复杂系统方法，可以在无需预先标注的情况下，从大规模历时性新闻文本中自动检测出关键的历史转折时期，例如意大利从“第一共和国”向“第二共和国”的过渡，以及海湾战争、科索沃战争等重大国际冲突。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合自然语言处理与复杂系统方法，可以在无需预先标注的情况下，从大规模历时性新闻文本中自动检测出关键的历史转折时期，例如意大利从“第一共和国”向“第二共和国”的过渡，以及海湾战争、科索沃战争等重大国际冲突。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于将计算语言学与复杂系统/统计物理的思想相结合，为基于大规模文本数据的媒体与社会动态研究提供了新的定量分析路径。
papers.method_zh: 具体使用了自然语言处理（NLP）技术对文本进行词汇和语义层面的分析；随后应用了复杂系统与统计物理的工具来追踪媒体话语随时间的变化轨迹。

papers.title: Wealth Inequality and Planetary Boundaries in a Stylized Agent-Based Model
papers.abstract: At the intersection of rising wealth inequality and intensifying environmental pressures, we investigate a reverse causal relationship that has received comparatively little attention: wealth inequality may not only be a consequence of environmental crises, but also act as a structural obstacle to the ecological transition itself. We develop a stylized agent-based model in which heterogeneous agents, whose initial wealth follows a Pareto distribution, allocate their income between either a Brown or a Green sector through a utility function. The function is designed to capture the trade-off between short-term returns and exposure to long-term systemic risks. A central ingredient is that wealthier agents perceive themselves as less vulnerable to environmental shocks, thereby reducing the amount of resources available for the transition. We show that, beyond inequality thresholds compatible with those observed in most developed countries, the economy remains locked in a Brown regime, even when a substantial share of agents is sensitive to externalities. We then assess a set of stylized fiscal policies (basic income, carbon taxation, Green incentives, and a combined scheme) and find that their effectiveness depends strongly on the inequality regime and on the regressivity embedded in the fiscal mechanism, revealing multidimensional trade-offs between transition speed, cumulative environmental destruction, growth, and fiscal pressure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：agent-based model（基于主体的模型）、stylized model（风格化模型）、utility function（效用函数）。；研究对象：论文研究的是财富不平等与生态转型之间的反向因果关系，具体为：财富不平等如何作为结构性障碍阻碍经济从“棕色”（高污染）部门向“绿色”（可持续）部门转型。这是一个社会经济-环境耦合系统，而非传统凝聚态物理中的具体材料或体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当财富不平等程度超过与大多数发达国家相当的门槛时，即使大部分主体对环境外部性敏感，经济仍会锁定在“棕色”发展模式中。此外，不同财政政策（如基本收入、碳税、绿色激励等）的有效性强烈依赖于不平等程度及财政机制本身的累退性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当财富不平等程度超过与大多数发达国家相当的门槛时，即使大部分主体对环境外部性敏感，经济仍会锁定在“棕色”发展模式中。此外，不同财政政策（如基本收入、碳税、绿色激励等）的有效性强烈依赖于不平等程度及财政机制本身的累退性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，创新点在于：1）将财富不平等本身视为生态转型的结构性障碍（而非仅作为环境危机的后果）；2）在主体模型中引入“财富感知脆弱性”这一机制；3）系统评估了不同财政政策在多种不平等制度下的多维权衡（转型速度、环境破坏累积、经济增长与财政压力）。
papers.method_zh: 采用风格化的基于主体（agent-based）计算模型。模型中异质性主体的初始财富服从帕累托分布，通过一个包含短期回报与长期系统性风险权衡的效用函数，将收入分配至“棕色”或“绿色”部门。核心机制是：更富裕的主体感知自身受环境冲击的脆弱性更低，从而减少可用于绿色转型的资源。

papers.title: Real-time pseudo entropy and modular-Hamiltonian correlations
papers.abstract: Pseudo entropy is a complex-valued generalization of entanglement entropy defined from a reduced transition matrix. We study the pseudo entropy associated with a real-time transition matrix between an initial pure state and its unitary time evolution. For a subsystem $A$, we show that the short-time behavior of real-time pseudo entropy is governed by the correlation between the physical Hamiltonian $H$ and the modular Hamiltonian $K_A=-\logρ_A$ of the initial reduced state, $ S_A(t,0)=S_A(0)-it \langle K_A(H-\langle H\rangle)\rangle + \mathcal{O}(t^2)$. For Hermitian dynamics, the initial imaginary response is controlled by the symmetrized covariance of $H$ and $K_A$ with an overall minus sign, while the initial real response is governed by their commutator. Thus the imaginary part of real-time pseudo entropy is not merely a branch artifact: it is a time-oriented modular response generated by the correlation between microscopic time evolution and subsystem coarse graining. We clarify the relation of this result to the known first law of pseudo entropy, derive an all-order expression in a Schmidt-diagonal model, recover thermal pseudo entropy as a special case, illustrate the covariance/commutator decomposition in a two-qubit model, and confirm the covariance response in transverse-field Ising-chain quenches, including a finite-size study of a modular susceptibility near the Ising critical region. We discuss how this amplitude-level oriented response can be related to ordinary entropy production, and also give a concrete $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric toy-model illustration of the non-Hermitian extension.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及理论推导（如“show that”“derive”“illustrate”），无实验或计算模拟关键词。；研究对象：实时伪熵（real-time pseudo entropy）及其与模哈密顿量（modular Hamiltonian）之间的关联，具体研究初始纯态经幺正时间演化后的子系统伪熵行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实时伪熵的短时行为由物理哈密顿量 \(H\) 与初始约化态的模哈密顿量 \(K_A\) 之间的关联决定：虚部响应由 \(H\) 与 \(K_A\) 的对称化协方差控制，实部响应由它们的对易子控制。伪熵的虚部并非分支切割的人为产物，而是由微观时间演化与子系统粗粒化之间的关联产生的时间定向模响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实时伪熵的短时行为由物理哈密顿量 \(H\) 与初始约化态的模哈密顿量 \(K_A\) 之间的关联决定：虚部响应由 \(H\) 与 \(K_A\) 的对称化协方差控制，实部响应由它们的对易子控制。伪熵的虚部并非分支切割的人为产物，而是由微观时间演化与子系统粗粒化之间的关联产生的时间定向模响应。；创新点：揭示了实时伪熵的虚部具有明确的物理意义——它反映了微观动力学与子系统粗粒化之间的关联，而非仅数学分支选择；建立了伪熵与模哈密顿量-物理哈密顿量关联之间的直接联系，并推广到非厄米情形。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用约化转移矩阵定义伪熵，通过短时展开分析实时伪熵的线性项；在Schmidt对角模型中给出全阶表达式；在二量子比特模型和横场伊辛链淬火中验证协方差/对易子分解；通过有限尺寸研究伊辛临界区附近的模磁化率；并给出非厄米推广的\(\mathcal{PT}\)对称玩具模型示例。

papers.title: Dynamically frozen long-distance entanglement via non-Hermitian PT-symmetric systems
papers.abstract: In distributed quantum networks, interacting spin systems can mediate the generation of highly entangled links between distant nodes. We investigate the role of effective parity-time (PT)-symmetric non-Hermitian spin-1/2 bulks weakly coupled to two quantum links, obtained due to the environmental interactions affecting both the bulk and the links. Focusing on effective non-Hermitian nearest-neighbor (NN) Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) models, we analyze how non-Hermiticity influences the dynamical formation of long-distance entanglement (LDE). For a paradigmatic model consisting of a quantum XX bulk subjected to imaginary staggered magnetic fields, we analytically determine the exceptional points arising from the resulting bulk-mediated interactions between the links. Combining analytical and numerical methods, we demonstrate that an initially fully separable state can dynamically evolve into highly entangled link states near these exceptional points in the broken regime. Further, after optimizing over time and system parameters, near-unit time-averaged entanglement between the links emerges under weak imaginary magnetic fields and bulk-link couplings, which cannot be attained in the corresponding Hermitian systems. Moreover, the non-Hermitian dynamics exhibit a freezing of high entanglement in the vicinity of exceptional points, a feature absent in Hermitian counterparts. We also identify regimes of long-range interaction strengths that yield a higher time-averaged entanglement than the corresponding NN models. Furthermore, we establish that LDE persists in the stationary regime, highlighting the promise of engineered non-Hermitian dynamics for realizing robust and frozen entangled links in quantum networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、analytically determine、analytical and numerical methods、demonstrate。；研究对象：非厄米PT对称自旋-1/2体系统（具体为量子XX体加虚交错磁场）与两个弱耦合量子链路构成的分布式量子网络，以及其中长距离纠缠（LDE）的动态形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非厄米PT对称系统中，初始完全可分离态可在破缺区间的例外点附近动态演化出高度纠缠的链路态，且纠缠在例外点附近出现“冻结”现象，时间平均纠缠可接近单位值，这在对应厄米系统中无法实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非厄米PT对称系统中，初始完全可分离态可在破缺区间的例外点附近动态演化出高度纠缠的链路态，且纠缠在例外点附近出现“冻结”现象，时间平均纠缠可接近单位值，这在对应厄米系统中无法实现。；创新点：揭示了非厄米PT对称性在分布式量子网络中诱导动态冻结长距离纠缠的新机制，特别是例外点附近纠缠的“冻结”行为及弱虚磁场下近单位时间平均纠缠的实现，这些在厄米系统中无法达到。
papers.method_zh: 解析分析（确定例外点及体-链路相互作用）结合数值方法（优化时间与系统参数，计算时间平均纠缠），基于有效非厄米最近邻Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型，并考虑长程相互作用模型与最近邻模型的对比。

papers.title: Universal Construction of Generalized Lyapunov Functions for Nonlinear Dynamical Systems Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract: A scalar potential landscape is one of the most useful ways to understand the stability and transition of a dynamical system. For non-gradient dynamics, however, the construction of a global Lyapunov-type scalar for nonlinear flows with recurrent structures remains a major obstacle. We introduce the generalized Lyapunov function, a scalar function that is non-increasing along deterministic trajectories, as a unifying notion of nonequilibrium potential. Ordinary Lyapunov functions, Freidlin--Wentzell quasi-potentials, and Ao-type potentials are recovered as special representatives. We then propose a data-free physics-informed neural-network framework in which the Lyapunov inequality and a weak divergence-scale compatibility condition are directly embedded into the loss function. The method is tested on linear systems, the Hopf normal form, the van der Pol oscillator, and a three-dimensional Hopf-link flow with two linked limit cycles. The learned landscapes agree with available analytical benchmarks and reveal the invariant sets as low-potential or constant-potential structures, providing a practical route to potential-landscape construction for nonlinear non-gradient systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：physics-informed neural networks（物理信息神经网络）、data-free（无数据）、Lyapunov inequality（Lyapunov不等式）嵌入损失函数。；研究对象：非线性动力系统的势能景观（potential landscape）构建，具体测试体系包括线性系统、Hopf标准型、van der Pol振荡器以及具有两个链接极限环的三维Hopf-link流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出广义Lyapunov函数作为非平衡势的统一概念，并通过物理信息神经网络成功构建了非线性非梯度系统的全局势能景观，揭示了不变集为低势或等势结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出广义Lyapunov函数作为非平衡势的统一概念，并通过物理信息神经网络成功构建了非线性非梯度系统的全局势能景观，揭示了不变集为低势或等势结构。；创新点：首次将广义Lyapunov函数（统一了普通Lyapunov函数、Freidlin-Wentzell拟势和Ao型势）与物理信息神经网络结合，实现了无需训练数据的全局势能景观构建，适用于具有循环结构的非梯度动力学系统。
papers.method_zh: 采用无数据的物理信息神经网络框架，将Lyapunov不等式和弱散度-尺度相容性条件直接嵌入损失函数，通过优化网络参数学习标量势函数。

papers.title: Quantum Entanglement of Bethe States
papers.abstract: We investigate the quantum entanglement of Bethe states across a family of integrable spin chains, including the XXX$_{\frac{1}{2}}$ model, its higher-spin generalizations (XXX$_s$), and the non-compact $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ chain. For on-shell eigenstates, we perform a comprehensive scan of the bipartite entanglement entropy across the entire spectrum of finite chains with periodic boundary conditions, and identify the Bethe solutions that minimize and maximize the entanglement. These extremal solutions follow systematic, spin-dependent patterns in the Bethe quantum numbers. In the XXX$_{\frac{1}{2}}$ spin chain, for the antiferromagnetic chain, the state with minimal entropy always coincides with the lowest-energy state (the ground state) within a given fixed-magnon sector. For the higher-spin XXX$_s$ model, however, the lowest-entropy state is not always identical to the ground state, and can even be the state of highest energy. By contrast, the Bethe roots that maximize entropy exhibit considerably more intricate structure. Our analysis further reveals how special Bethe root configurations, such as singular and strange solutions, affect entanglement, and it uncovers characteristic entanglement features in the non-compact $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ chain that are absent from compact spin chains. For off-shell Bethe states, we develop an optimization algorithm that extremizes the entanglement entropy over rapidity distributions, enabling us to explore the maximum entanglement achievable by a Bethe state without imposing the Bethe ansatz equations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、analysis、develop an optimization algorithm，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：可积自旋链中的Bethe态（Bethe states）的量子纠缠，具体包括XXX₁/₂模型、高自旋推广XXXₛ模型以及非紧致SL(2,ℝ)链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在XXX₁/₂反铁磁链中，给定磁振子数扇区内最小纠缠态总是基态；但在高自旋XXXₛ模型中，最小纠缠态不一定对应基态，甚至可能是最高能态。最大纠缠态对应的Bethe根结构则更为复杂。此外，非紧致SL(2,ℝ)链展现出紧致自旋链所没有的特征纠缠行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在XXX₁/₂反铁磁链中，给定磁振子数扇区内最小纠缠态总是基态；但在高自旋XXXₛ模型中，最小纠缠态不一定对应基态，甚至可能是最高能态。最大纠缠态对应的Bethe根结构则更为复杂。此外，非紧致SL(2,ℝ)链展现出紧致自旋链所没有的特征纠缠行为。；创新点：首次系统扫描了可积自旋链全谱中Bethe态的纠缠熵极值，揭示了自旋依赖的极值模式；发现了高自旋模型中最小纠缠态与基态的非对应关系；并针对离壳Bethe态提出了无需满足Bethe ansatz方程的纠缠优化方法。
papers.method_zh: 对有限周期链的全谱进行二分纠缠熵的全面扫描，识别极值Bethe解；对离壳Bethe态，开发了优化算法在快度分布上极值化纠缠熵，而不施加Bethe ansatz方程约束。

papers.title: Extreme-Scale Atomistic Simulation of Real-Temperature Magnetic Skyrmion Dynamics by Coupled Spin-Lattice Modeling
papers.abstract: Real-temperature topological magnetic dynamics in functional materials is governed by coupled lattice and spin evolution, yet remains inaccessible to predictive simulation at device-relevant scales. As a flagship example, thermally driven helix-to-skyrmion transformation in FeGe requires atomistic resolution, explicit lattice motion, and micrometer-scale domains to resolve device-scale topological texture formation. We combine a spin-constrained density-functional-theory-trained neuro-evolution potential with a structure-preserving spin-lattice integrator within one machine-learned framework. Architecture-specific optimizations, kernel fusion, SVE2 vectorization, and NUMA-aware data layout deliver a seven orders-of-magnitude speedup over prior spin-aware methods. Deployed on LineShine exascale supercomputer, the full application scales to 12.45 million CPU cores with 89.7% weak-scaling efficiency, enabling simulations of 1.34 trillion atoms and an equal number of spins while reaching 48.5 PFLOPS in double precision. The simulations directly resolve real-temperature skyrmion nucleation and reorganization at previously inaccessible scales, establishing a new regime for predictive simulation of coupled spin-lattice topological magnetic dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“atomistic simulation”（原子模拟）、“machine-learned framework”（机器学习框架）、“exascale supercomputer”（百亿亿次超级计算机）等关键词，核心工作为大规模计算模拟。；研究对象：FeGe材料中，在真实温度下由热驱动从螺旋磁结构到斯格明子的拓扑磁性动力学过程，特别是耦合的自旋-晶格演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合机器学习势与结构保持积分器，实现了对1.34万亿原子及等量自旋的极端规模模拟，直接解析了此前无法触及的真实温度下斯格明子的成核与重组过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合机器学习势与结构保持积分器，实现了对1.34万亿原子及等量自旋的极端规模模拟，直接解析了此前无法触及的真实温度下斯格明子的成核与重组过程。；创新点：实现了对耦合自旋-晶格拓扑磁动力学在器件相关尺度（微米级）和真实温度下的预测性模拟，相比之前的自旋感知方法获得了七个数量级的加速，将模拟能力推进到前所未有的规模。
papers.method_zh: 采用自旋约束的密度泛函理论训练的神经进化势（neuro-evolution potential），并结合结构保持的自旋-晶格积分器，构建统一的机器学习框架。通过架构特定优化（如内核融合、SVE2向量化、NUMA感知数据布局）实现加速，并在“LineShine”百亿亿次超级计算机上部署，使用1245万CPU核心，达到48.5 PFLOPS双精度性能。

papers.title: All about quantum error correction: distillation, mitigation, self-correction and beyond
papers.abstract: In this work, it is shown that many quantum error-manipulating techniques, such as distillation, error mitigation, and dynamical decoupling, are special cases of the most general framework for quantum error correction. This unifying perspective is achieved by extending quantum error correction to include state-adaptive and channel-adaptive settings, as well as multi-stage coding scenarios. Based on this insight, a model of self-correcting quantum memory is also proposed. This work clarifies the relationship among these techniques and illustrates, through explicit constructions, how the unified perspective can guide the design of reliable quantum information systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“framework”“model”“unifying perspective”等理论构建关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：量子纠错与量子信息处理技术，具体包括蒸馏（distillation）、错误缓解（error mitigation）、动态解耦（dynamical decoupling）以及自纠正量子存储器（self-correcting quantum memory）等量子错误操控技术。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了蒸馏、错误缓解、动态解耦等多种量子错误操控技术，均可视为最一般量子纠错框架的特例；并基于此统一视角，提出了自纠正量子存储器的模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了蒸馏、错误缓解、动态解耦等多种量子错误操控技术，均可视为最一般量子纠错框架的特例；并基于此统一视角，提出了自纠正量子存储器的模型。；创新点：通过将量子纠错框架扩展到自适应与多级编码场景，首次统一了多种看似独立的量子错误操控技术，并据此提出自纠正量子存储器的模型，为设计可靠量子信息系统提供了指导性视角。
papers.method_zh: 采用理论框架扩展的方法，将量子纠错推广至包含状态自适应（state-adaptive）和信道自适应（channel-adaptive）设置，以及多级编码（multi-stage coding）场景。

papers.title: An integrated ultrahigh vacuum cluster tool for diamond surface science and single nitrogen-vacancy center measurements
papers.abstract: We present a custom-designed ultrahigh vacuum (UHV) cluster tool developed for studying shallow nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond, enabling in situ diamond surface preparation, characterization, and single NV center dynamics measurements within a single connected platform. The system combines a surface science chamber for controlled surface modification and analysis with a cryogenic confocal microscope chamber dedicated to NV spin and optical measurements. This integrated approach enables a direct correlation between diamond surface chemistry and the resulting NV spin and charge properties. The instrument provides a versatile platform for systematic studies of surface-induced decoherence mechanisms and charge dynamics for shallow NV centers, and establishes a pathway toward reproducible surface engineering for quantum sensing applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述了“custom-designed ultrahigh vacuum cluster tool”的设计与搭建，以及“in situ diamond surface preparation, characterization, and single NV center dynamics measurements”等实验操作。；研究对象：金刚石中的浅层氮-空位（NV）色心，具体研究其表面化学与自旋、电荷性质之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，但指出该平台能够直接关联金刚石表面化学与NV色心的自旋和电荷性质，为研究表面诱导退相干机制和电荷动力学提供了系统工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，但指出该平台能够直接关联金刚石表面化学与NV色心的自旋和电荷性质，为研究表面诱导退相干机制和电荷动力学提供了系统工具。；创新点：将金刚石表面科学腔室与单NV色心低温共聚焦测量腔室集成在同一超高真空平台中，实现了原位、直接关联表面化学与NV色心性质的研究，避免了样品暴露大气带来的污染和不确定性。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：自主设计的超高真空（UHV）组合系统，包含表面科学腔室（用于可控表面修饰与分析）和低温共聚焦显微镜腔室（用于NV自旋与光学测量）。实现了原位表面制备、表征与单NV色心动力学测量的一体化。

papers.title: Mean First Passage Time for Persistent Random Walks in Annular Search Domains
papers.abstract: We study the mean first-passage time of a random walker to a small absorbing target at the center of a two-dimensional annulus with a specularly reflecting outer boundary. The problem is motivated by natural killer cell migration toward a target cancer cell, where the goal is to quantify how long it takes immune cells to reach the target and how search efficiency depends on directional persistence and chemotactic bias. Cell motion is modeled as a velocity-jump process. We first consider a correlated random walk with a von Mises turning kernel, with a concentration parameter controlling directional persistence. We then extend the model to a biased correlated random walk using a phase-shifted turning kernel that represents preferential motion, for example following a concentration gradient. Our analysis combines closed-form benchmarks for simple and biased random walks, Fourier-mode reductions of the transport equations for the correlated and biased correlated models, and a fast-turning perturbation expansion that gives an analytical correction to the diffusion-limit mean first-passage time for the random walker. Our analytical results are supported by numerical methods that include a semi-Lagrangian solver in radial and angular coordinates, a stationary discretisation designed to handle biased transport, and an event-driven Monte Carlo simulator for cross-validation. Together, our results provide a framework relating persistent and biased immune-cell motion to target-search times in confined two-dimensional domains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含计算模拟）。判断依据：关键词包括“closed-form benchmarks”、“Fourier-mode reductions”、“perturbation expansion”、“numerical methods”、“semi-Lagrangian solver”、“Monte Carlo simulator”。；研究对象：二维环形搜索域中具有持续性和趋化性偏向的随机游走（persistent and biased random walks）的平均首次通过时间（Mean First Passage Time, MFPT）。具体物理现象为自然杀伤细胞（NK细胞）向目标癌细胞迁移的搜索效率问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过解析与数值结合的方法，建立了描述持续性和偏向性免疫细胞运动与二维受限域中目标搜索时间之间关系的理论框架。研究量化了方向持续性和趋化偏向如何影响随机游走者到达中心小吸收靶点的平均时间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过解析与数值结合的方法，建立了描述持续性和偏向性免疫细胞运动与二维受限域中目标搜索时间之间关系的理论框架。研究量化了方向持续性和趋化偏向如何影响随机游走者到达中心小吸收靶点的平均时间。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 1. 将细胞运动建模为速度跳跃过程（velocity-jump process）。2. 使用冯·米塞斯转向核（von Mises turning kernel）描述相关随机游走，用相移转向核（phase-shifted turning kernel）描述偏向相关随机游走。3. 采用闭式基准解（closed-form benchmarks）、输运方程的傅里叶模式约化（Fourier-mode reductions）以及快速转向微扰展开（fast-turning perturbation expansion）进行解析分析。4. 数值方法包括：径向和角坐标下的半拉格朗日求解器（semi-Lagrangian solver）、处理偏向输运的静态离散化（stationary discretisation）以及事件驱动蒙特卡洛模拟器（event-driven Monte Carlo simulator）进行交叉验证。

papers.title: Local correlations in long-range dual-unitary kicked Hamiltonian chains
papers.abstract: Many-body Floquet models with exact space--time symmetry, such as the kicked Ising spin chain (KIC), provide natural examples of systems with dual-unitary dynamics. The requirement of exact space--time symmetry is, however, highly restrictive, as it permits only nearest-neighbor interactions. Based on a pair of Hadamard matrices, we construct a wide family of dual-unitary kicked spin chains with long-range interactions. We show that local two-point correlations in such models propagate along the light-cone edges \( |n| = r|t| \), where \(r\) is the interaction range, and can be derived analytically for operators with local support. This approach is illustrated using the example of a kicked Ising spin chain with next-to-next-neighbor interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct、analytically、derived。；研究对象：具有长程相互作用的双幺正 kicked 自旋链体系，具体以次近邻相互作用的 kicked Ising 自旋链为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有长程相互作用的双幺正 kicked 自旋链中，局域两点关联函数沿光锥边界 |n| = r|t| 传播（r 为相互作用范围），且对于局域支持的算符可解析求解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有长程相互作用的双幺正 kicked 自旋链中，局域两点关联函数沿光锥边界 |n| = r|t| 传播（r 为相互作用范围），且对于局域支持的算符可解析求解。；创新点：突破了此前双幺正动力学仅允许最近邻相互作用的限制，首次构造了具有精确时空对称性的长程相互作用双幺正 kicked 自旋链族。
papers.method_zh: 基于一对 Hadamard 矩阵构造具有长程相互作用的双幺正 kicked 自旋链族，并通过解析推导分析局域两点关联函数的传播行为。

papers.title: Universal Crossovers of Stabilizer Entropy Beyond Criticality
papers.abstract: Stabilizer Rényi entropy has emerged as a probe of nonstabilizerness in quantum many-body systems, but its scaling structure beyond critical points remains poorly understood compared with entanglement entropy. Recent field-theory approaches indicate that stabilizer entropy contains universal critical data and boundary-sensitive terms, raising the question of how these structures extend into massive and crossover regimes. We address this problem for a broad class of finite-range spin chains at Rényi index one-half. We derive exact finite-size formulas for both full periodic chains and finite intervals of the infinite chain, making the universal crossover from critical to noncritical behavior analytically accessible. In periodic geometry, the entropy obeys a volume law away from criticality and exhibits a universal finite-size crossover controlled by the competition between system size and correlation length. We also show that the large-scale SRE density develops a cusp across the field-tuned critical line, while the XX endpoint is governed by a distinct scaling regime associated with the saturation point. In the subsystem geometry, the interval entropy separates bulk critical behavior from boundary contributions generated by the way the finite region cuts the infinite chain. The crossover from critical to massive behavior is then encoded in boundary constants and universal functions controlled by the correlation length. Through exact stabilizer-entropy correspondences, the scaling theory extends to internal XY reductions, Finite-range spin chains, and Cluster--Ising representatives. Our results provide an exact lattice benchmark for the emerging QFT description of stabilizer entropy beyond isolated conformal points.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“field-theory approaches”“exact finite-size formulas”“scaling theory”等理论推导与分析方法。；研究对象：量子多体系统中稳定子Rényi熵（Stabilizer Rényi entropy）在临界点之外的标度行为与普适交叉现象，具体针对有限范围自旋链（finite-range spin chains）及Rényi指数为1/2的情形。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 稳定子熵在远离临界点时服从体积律，并在有限尺寸下表现出由系统尺寸与关联长度竞争控制的普适交叉行为；子系统几何中，区间熵将体临界行为与边界贡献分离，交叉行为由边界常数和关联长度控制的普适函数描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：稳定子熵在远离临界点时服从体积律，并在有限尺寸下表现出由系统尺寸与关联长度竞争控制的普适交叉行为；子系统几何中，区间熵将体临界行为与边界贡献分离，交叉行为由边界常数和关联长度控制的普适函数描述。；创新点：首次在临界点之外系统解析了稳定子熵的普适交叉行为，揭示了其与纠缠熵不同的标度结构，并为量子场论描述提供了精确晶格基准。
papers.method_zh: 通过解析推导，对完整周期链和无限链中的有限区间分别给出精确有限尺寸公式；利用稳定子熵与XY约化、有限范围自旋链、Cluster-Ising模型之间的精确对应关系，将标度理论推广至更多体系。

papers.title: RG Dynamics of Irrelevant Fermion Operators and the Drag Coupling Mechanism
papers.abstract: We study the renormalization-group flow of higher-dimensional fermionic interactions $(ψ^\dagger ψ)^{2n}$ in the presence of a Fermi surface. We show that the growth of the BCS four-fermion coupling induces a drag mechanism whereby higher-order fermionic couplings are driven to strong coupling in the infrared. We derive the corresponding beta functions and show that the drag effect applies generically to the whole tower of fermionic operators. Remarkably, although all couplings are driven toward the same strong-coupling scale, the renormalization-group flow preserves a hierarchy in which higher-dimensional operators remain parametrically suppressed relative to the BCS interaction. We then investigate this mechanism in a $2+1$-dimensional non-Fermi liquid coupled to a critical boson. While higher-order fermionic interactions are similarly enhanced along the flow, we show that they do not destabilize the IR stable non-Fermi-liquid fixed point, present for sufficiently large $N$. We briefly discuss possible implications for multicomponent superconductors and other strongly correlated metallic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：renormalization-group flow（重整化群流）、beta functions（贝塔函数）、fixed point（不动点）。；研究对象：存在费米面的费米液体及2+1维非费米液体中，高阶费米子相互作用（(ψ†ψ)^{2n}）的重整化群动力学，以及“拖拽耦合机制”（drag coupling mechanism）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BCS四费米子耦合在红外区域的增长会通过拖拽机制驱动所有高阶费米子耦合也趋于强耦合，但重整化群流仍保持参数化的层级压制；在非费米液体中，该机制不会破坏足够大N下的红外稳定非费米液体不动点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BCS四费米子耦合在红外区域的增长会通过拖拽机制驱动所有高阶费米子耦合也趋于强耦合，但重整化群流仍保持参数化的层级压制；在非费米液体中，该机制不会破坏足够大N下的红外稳定非费米液体不动点。；创新点：揭示了高阶不可约费米子算符（(ψ†ψ)^{2n}）在费米面存在时被BCS耦合拖拽至强耦合的普遍机制，并证明该机制在非费米液体中不破坏已有的红外稳定不动点。摘要未突出说明与具体多分量超导体或强关联金属系统的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用重整化群（RG）分析方法，推导了费米子算符塔中各级耦合的贝塔函数，并研究了在临界玻色子耦合的非费米液体背景下的RG流行为。

papers.title: Resurgence of the Thermal Transition between Bounce and Sphaleron
papers.abstract: We study the thermal transition between the bounce and the sphaleron in quantum mechanics with a metastable vacuum from the viewpoint of Borel resurgence. For two models representing a second-order and a first-order transition, we compute the perturbative expansion of the thermal free energy to high orders and extract the leading Borel singularity data $(A,b,S)$ as functions of temperature. The Borel singularity location $A$ reproduces the on-shell action of the dominant saddle on both sides of the transition, joining smoothly in the second-order case and developing a kink in the first-order case. The characteristic exponent $b$ jumps between $0$ and $1/2$ across the transition, counting the zero modes of the corresponding saddle. The Stokes constant $S$ matches the one-loop determinant around the saddle. The perturbative expansion around the false vacuum thus determines the transition temperature, the order of the transition, and the decay rate including the one-loop prefactor without relying on semiclassical inputs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Borel resurgence、微扰展开、半经典分析。；研究对象：量子力学中具有亚稳态真空的体系，具体研究“反弹解（bounce）”与“斯法勒隆（sphaleron）”之间的热转变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Borel重求和分析，发现微扰自由能的Borel奇点位置A在转变点两侧分别对应主导鞍点的在壳作用量，特征指数b在转变点处从0跳变到1/2，斯托克斯常数S与鞍点周围的一圈行列式一致。因此，仅通过假真空周围的微扰展开即可确定转变温度、转变阶数以及包含一圈预因子的衰变率，无需依赖半经典输入。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Borel重求和分析，发现微扰自由能的Borel奇点位置A在转变点两侧分别对应主导鞍点的在壳作用量，特征指数b在转变点处从0跳变到1/2，斯托克斯常数S与鞍点周围的一圈行列式一致。因此，仅通过假真空周围的微扰展开即可确定转变温度、转变阶数以及包含一圈预因子的衰变率，无需依赖半经典输入。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Borel重求和（Borel resurgence）理论框架，对两个分别代表二级和一级转变的模型，计算热自由能的高阶微扰展开，并提取主导Borel奇点数据（A, b, S）作为温度的函数。

papers.title: Tantalum as a base material for superconducting integrated circuits
papers.abstract: The performance of superconducting integrated circuits for quantum applications is fundamentally limited by material-related losses. Tantalum, as an emerging material for next-generation quantum circuits, has attracted considerable attention in recent years after demonstrating breakthrough performance in both superconducting microwave resonators and qubits. Concurrently, a growing body of work is devoted to the operation of tantalum-based circuits and related fabrication techniques. This interest is further stimulated by tantalum thin films polymorphism resulting in a variety of its crystalline structure, superconducting properties, coherence, etc. Furthermore, tantalum circuits exhibit distinctive features in cryogenic experiments, which have not been observed in aluminum- or niobium-based ones. In this review, we summarize the recent research of tantalum thin films growth and phase selection mechanisms on various substrates, key aspects of fabrication and performance of superconducting circuit, including a material first-principles theoretical study. In conclusion, we address a number of open issues, including the role of \b{eta}-phase impurities, the effect of hydrofluoric acid solutions on chain characteristics, and the anomalous behavior of α-tantalum chains at cryogenic temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章。关键词：review, summarize。；研究对象：钽（Tantalum）作为超导集成电路的基底材料，涵盖其薄膜生长、相选择机制、超导电路制备与性能，以及相关低温异常行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 钽薄膜因其多晶型结构（如α相与β相）导致超导性质与相干性差异，且在低温实验中展现出铝基或铌基电路未见的独特特征，有望突破当前超导量子电路的性能极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：钽薄膜因其多晶型结构（如α相与β相）导致超导性质与相干性差异，且在低温实验中展现出铝基或铌基电路未见的独特特征，有望突破当前超导量子电路的性能极限。；创新点：系统总结了钽作为新兴超导电路基底材料的最新研究进展，特别指出了β相杂质、氢氟酸溶液对链特性的影响以及α-钽链在低温下的反常行为等尚未解决的问题。
papers.method_zh: 综述了钽薄膜在不同衬底上的生长与相选择机制、超导电路制备与性能的关键工艺，并包含基于第一性原理的理论研究（first-principles theoretical study）。

papers.title: Morphology control and low-temperature magnetotransport in chiral 2D perovskite R-(MBA)$_2$PbI$_4$
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional chiral hybrid perovskites, such as R/S-(MBA)\textsubscript{2}PbI\textsubscript{4}, are leading candidates for realizing and studying chirality-dependent charge and spin transport. However, their prohibitive in-plane resistance has precluded the electrical characterization. Here, we overcome this bottleneck by engineering the thin-film morphology of the chiral perovskite $R\text{-(MBA)}_2\text{PbI}_4$, enabling the first robust lateral device integration. In Hall-bar geometries, we demonstrate Hall measurements under dark conditions, unambiguously identifying p-type conduction with a Hall mobility of $\sim 0.2 \text{cm}^2 \text{V}^{-1} \text{s}^{-1}$ and a carrier density of $\sim 3\times10^{14} \text{ cm}^{-2}$, parameters previously inaccessible in this class of materials. Furthermore, we observe enhanced magnetoresistance along transport paths crossing grain boundaries, highlighting the strong influence of morphology on in-plane transport. This work demonstrates in-plane magnetotransport, enabling future investigations of the fundamental mechanisms of chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) and accelerating the integration of chiral materials into functional spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：Hall-bar geometries, Hall measurements, magnetotransport。；研究对象：手性二维钙钛矿R-(MBA)₂PbI₄的薄膜形貌控制及其低温磁输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过工程化手性钙钛矿R-(MBA)₂PbI₄的薄膜形貌，首次实现了该材料的稳健横向器件集成，并在暗条件下测量到p型导电，霍尔迁移率约0.2 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹，载流子密度约3×10¹⁴ cm⁻²。此外，沿穿越晶界的输运路径观察到增强的磁电阻，表明形貌对平面内输运有显著影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过工程化手性钙钛矿R-(MBA)₂PbI₄的薄膜形貌，首次实现了该材料的稳健横向器件集成，并在暗条件下测量到p型导电，霍尔迁移率约0.2 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹，载流子密度约3×10¹⁴ cm⁻²。此外，沿穿越晶界的输运路径观察到增强的磁电阻，表明形貌对平面内输运有显著影响。；创新点：首次克服了手性二维钙钛矿R-(MBA)₂PbI₄平面内电阻过大的瓶颈，实现了横向器件集成和平面内磁输运测量，获得了此前无法获取的霍尔迁移率和载流子密度等关键参数。
papers.method_zh: 采用薄膜形貌工程（具体方法摘要未明确说明），制备Hall-bar几何结构器件，进行暗条件下的霍尔测量和磁输运测量。

papers.title: Engineering electrically-switchable quantum anomalous Hall states by spin-orbit coupling
papers.abstract: Nonvolatile gate-driven switching of quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) states in graphene moiré systems provides a promising route toward topological electronics based on chiral edge states. However, deliberate use of this switching mechanism requires control over both the magnetic properties and metastability of QAH states. While previous demonstrations mostly relied on the intrinsic magnetic energy landscape of moiré devices, here we show that this landscape can be engineered through proximity coupling to WSe2. We find that proximitizing twisted monolayer-bilayer graphene by WSe2 reshapes the magnetization reversals responsible for nonvolatile electrical switching of QAH states. We attribute this effect to the proximity-induced spin-orbit coupling (SOC), which can lock spin and valley and modify the magnetization of the competing states involved in switching compared with non-proximitized graphene systems. Our findings establish proximity-induced SOC as a new way to engineer magnetic properties and switchable magnetic states in graphene-based systems. We further demonstrate that strong magnetic metastability in tMBG allows the magnetic states to be gate-tuned between QAH and metallic regimes, and between QAH states with Chern numbers |C| = 2 and 1 without resetting the magnetic state. This functionality points toward new device architectures based on QAH chiral edge states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we find”、“we attribute”、“we further demonstrate”等描述实验发现和归因的表述，并提及了具体的器件结构（twisted monolayer-bilayer graphene）和调控手段（proximity coupling to WSe2）。；研究对象：基于石墨烯莫尔体系的量子反常霍尔（QAH）态，具体为扭曲单层-双层石墨烯（tMBG）与WSe2的邻近耦合异质结。研究聚焦于通过自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）工程化调控QAH态的电学开关特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将扭曲单层-双层石墨烯与WSe2邻近耦合，可以引入自旋-轨道耦合，从而重塑磁化反转过程，实现对QAH态非易失性电学开关的工程化调控。此外，在tMBG中，强磁亚稳态允许在不重置磁态的情况下，通过栅极电压在QAH态与金属态之间，以及陈数|C|=2和1的QAH态之间进行切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将扭曲单层-双层石墨烯与WSe2邻近耦合，可以引入自旋-轨道耦合，从而重塑磁化反转过程，实现对QAH态非易失性电学开关的工程化调控。此外，在tMBG中，强磁亚稳态允许在不重置磁态的情况下，通过栅极电压在QAH态与金属态之间，以及陈数|C|=2和1的QAH态之间进行切换。；创新点：提出并实验证明了邻近诱导的自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）是一种新的、可工程化调控石墨烯基体系中磁性和可开关磁态的方法。与以往依赖莫尔器件本征磁性能量景观不同，本工作展示了通过外部材料（WSe2）的邻近效应来主动设计这一能量景观。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法。具体为：构建扭曲单层-双层石墨烯（tMBG）/WSe2异质结，通过邻近耦合引入自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）。通过测量磁化反转和电学输运性质，研究SOC对QAH态非易失性电学开关行为的影响。

papers.title: Driven dynamics of an attractive Bose polaron
papers.abstract: We study the out-of-equilibrium dynamics of an impurity driven by a constant external force through a system of homogeneous weakly-interacting bosons in one spatial dimension. The impurity-boson interaction is assumed to be attractive. We show that the impurity exhibits drifted Bloch oscillations in a wide range of forces in the absence of a lattice. We characterize the dynamical response of the host bosons and explain the mechanism underlying the Bloch oscillations. We analyse the behavior of the drift velocity, the Bloch amplitude and the time period of oscillations in a wide range of forces and other system parameters. In contrast to the case of repulsive impurity-boson interaction, the drift velocity exhibits a sub-linear dependence on a weak applied force, $V_d\sim {F}^α$ with a positive exponent $α$ smaller than unity. The drift velocity monotonically increases with force, though the scaling behavior varies considerably across different regimes of $F$. Moreover, the amplitude of the velocity oscillations displays rich behavior: it first undergoes a decay with force, reaches a minimum, and then presents a revival, increasing with force.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We study、show、characterize、analyze（理论分析与数值计算）。；研究对象：一维均匀弱相互作用玻色子系统中，受恒定外力驱动的杂质（吸引型玻色极化子）的非平衡动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在没有晶格的情况下，杂质在较宽的外力范围内表现出漂移的布洛赫振荡；与排斥型杂质-玻色子相互作用不同，吸引型情况下漂移速度对弱外力呈亚线性依赖（V_d ~ F^α，α<1），且振荡幅度随外力先衰减后复苏。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在没有晶格的情况下，杂质在较宽的外力范围内表现出漂移的布洛赫振荡；与排斥型杂质-玻色子相互作用不同，吸引型情况下漂移速度对弱外力呈亚线性依赖（V_d ~ F^α，α<1），且振荡幅度随外力先衰减后复苏。；创新点：揭示了吸引型杂质-玻色子相互作用下，无晶格体系中杂质仍可呈现布洛赫振荡，并发现了漂移速度的亚线性标度行为以及振荡振幅的非单调变化（衰减-最小值-复苏）。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于一维均匀弱相互作用玻色子系统的模型，研究杂质在恒定外力驱动下的动力学，通过解析或半解析方法分析漂移速度、布洛赫振幅和振荡周期等物理量随外力的标度行为。

papers.title: Geometric formulation of state-dependent Langevin dynamics using scalar free energy
papers.abstract: Stochastic dynamics with state-dependent diffusion are widely used for Brownian motion in confined, anisotropic, and hydrodynamically coupled systems. The conventional Langevin formulation includes a spurious drift associated with multiplicative noise, but its free energy generally does not transform as a scalar, meaning that the covariance is not explicit. Here, we formulate a geometrically consistent Langevin equation by introducing a scalar free energy and using the diffusion tensor as a metric on configuration space. The spurious drift is then expressed as a Christoffel contribution of the diffusion metric. While our formulation is equivalent to the conventional one through the relation between the non-scalar and scalar free energies, it makes the coordinate covariance explicit. We demonstrate its consistency in representative examples of state-dependent diffusion arising from coordinate transformations, geometrical confinement, and projection from curved to flat spaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：formulation（理论构建）、geometric formulation（几何表述）、Langevin equation（朗之万方程）。；研究对象：状态依赖扩散的随机动力学，具体涉及布朗运动在受限、各向异性及流体动力学耦合系统中的行为，以及由坐标变换、几何约束和从弯曲空间到平坦空间投影引起的状态依赖扩散。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入标量自由能并将扩散张量作为构型空间上的度规，可以构建一个几何上一致的朗之万方程，其中虚假漂移自然表达为扩散度规的克里斯托费尔贡献，从而使坐标协变性变得显式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入标量自由能并将扩散张量作为构型空间上的度规，可以构建一个几何上一致的朗之万方程，其中虚假漂移自然表达为扩散度规的克里斯托费尔贡献，从而使坐标协变性变得显式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与几何表述。具体采用微分几何框架，将扩散张量视为度规，利用克里斯托费尔符号表达虚假漂移，并通过与非标量自由能的传统表述建立等价关系来验证一致性。

papers.title: Cepstral Analysis to accelerate Green-Kubo thermal conductivity calculations of Metal-Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) are promising porous materials for applications such as gas storage and separation, where heat transport can critically affect device performance. However, reliable computational prediction of their thermal conductivities remains challenging. In particular, equilibrium molecular-dynamics-based Green-Kubo (GK) simulations, as the most widely used approach, are severely affected by statistical noise. Moreover, they rely on multiple ambiguous, user-defined parameters, which hinder transferability and automation. Here, we demonstrate for metal-organic frameworks that cepstral analysis in combination with GK simulations provides a robust route to massively mitigate these problems, while simultaneously reducing the required sampling times. This is shown for three prototypical frameworks, MOF-5, HKUST-1, and ZIF-8, employing machine-learned moment tensor potentials trained on DFT reference data. In contrast to conventional, direct GK analysis, which shows erratic convergence and strong sensitivity to ad hoc choices of parameters, the cepstral approach yields stable results across a wide range of correlation lengths and achieves convergence within about 1-2 ns of total sampling time. This establishes cepstral analysis base Green-Kubo simulations combined with machine-learned potentials as an efficient, reproducible and automation-ready framework for near ab initio accuracy prediction of thermal transport in MOFs and other complex low-thermal-conductivity materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：equilibrium molecular-dynamics-based Green-Kubo simulations、machine-learned moment tensor potentials、DFT reference data。；研究对象：金属有机框架（MOFs）的热导率计算，具体材料为MOF-5、HKUST-1和ZIF-8。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 倒谱分析（cepstral analysis）结合Green-Kubo模拟，能够显著抑制统计噪声，减少所需采样时间，并在1-2纳秒内实现收敛，从而为MOFs等低热导率材料提供接近从头算精度的热输运预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：倒谱分析（cepstral analysis）结合Green-Kubo模拟，能够显著抑制统计噪声，减少所需采样时间，并在1-2纳秒内实现收敛，从而为MOFs等低热导率材料提供接近从头算精度的热输运预测。；创新点：首次在MOFs中证明倒谱分析能够有效解决传统GK模拟中参数选择主观、收敛不稳定和可迁移性差的问题，并实现自动化、可重复的高效热导率计算。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于机器学习力矩张量势（moment tensor potentials）的平衡分子动力学Green-Kubo（GK）模拟，并结合倒谱分析（cepstral analysis）处理热流自相关函数，以替代传统的直接GK分析方法。

papers.title: Exploratory digital alchemy for colloidal crystal discovery
papers.abstract: Digital Alchemy (DA), introduced by Van Anders et al., is a statistical mechanics-based generalized thermodynamic ensemble method that employs computer simulations to optimize colloidal particle design. This approach applies the principles of statistical mechanics to predict and tailor particle attributes that lead to desired self-assembled structures or material properties. However, as an inverse design method, its main limitation is that the target structure must be known \textit{a priori}. Therefore, the optimal design from DA does not guarantee the targeted structure is the most or the only stable one. This highlights the importance of forward design with an exploratory scheme for optimizing novel colloid designs, which becomes more suitable in such cases. In this paper, we introduce Exploratory Digital Alchemy (EDA), an enhanced forward design scheme that begins by releasing the constraint of the target crystal from DA, followed by an exploration-oriented bias that has been extensively used in enhanced sampling methods such as metadynamics (MetaD). We demonstrate the utility of EDA through examples involving particles interacting via a two-dimensional Lennard-Jones Gauss potential (LJGP) and a three-dimensional oscillating pair potential (OPP). We applied EDA to study the free energy landscapes given different potential parameters of LJGP at different temperatures. With the exploratory scheme, we've also successfully identified a wide range of OPP potential parameters that stabilize metastable Frank-Kasper phases. Our approach fuses the standard DA framework with metadynamics, which could potentially be useful for studying alchemical reactions in a generalized ensemble.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“computer simulations”、“statistical mechanics-based generalized thermodynamic ensemble method”、“free energy landscapes”。；研究对象：胶体晶体（colloidal crystal）的发现与设计，具体涉及二维Lennard-Jones Gauss势（LJGP）和三维振荡对势（OPP）粒子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为“探索性数字炼金术”（Exploratory Digital Alchemy, EDA）的正向设计方案，能够在不预先指定目标晶体结构的情况下，通过自由能景观分析和增强采样，发现稳定亚稳态Frank-Kasper相的新型胶体粒子设计参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为“探索性数字炼金术”（Exploratory Digital Alchemy, EDA）的正向设计方案，能够在不预先指定目标晶体结构的情况下，通过自由能景观分析和增强采样，发现稳定亚稳态Frank-Kasper相的新型胶体粒子设计参数。；创新点：将标准数字炼金术框架与元动力学相结合，实现了从“逆向设计”（需已知目标结构）到“正向探索”（无需预设目标）的转变，并展示了该方法在发现新型亚稳态胶体晶体相方面的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 融合了数字炼金术（Digital Alchemy, DA）的统计力学广义系综方法与元动力学（metadynamics, MetaD）增强采样技术，通过释放DA中对目标晶体的约束并引入探索性偏置，研究不同势参数下的自由能景观。

papers.title: Limits of constant-parameter constitutive models for hydrogels under inertial cavitation
papers.abstract: Mechanical characterization of soft materials at high strain rates is challenging due to their high compliance, nonlinear viscoelastic behavior, and potentially history-dependent responses. Inertial microcavitation rheometry (IMR) addresses this challenge by coupling laser-induced cavitation (LIC) experiments with numerical simulations of bubble dynamics models to infer constitutive models and material parameters. Both IMR and its variants infer parameters that depend on the chosen fitting window, which suggests that a constant-parameter constitutive model is insufficient to describe the full cavitation event. We use this window dependence to identify when the constant-parameter assumption fails, rather than to report a single effective parameter set. The constitutive parameters are estimated over moving, overlapping windows using a modified iterative ensemble Kalman smoother with multiple data assimilation (MIEnKS-MDA). Within the neo-Hookean Kelvin--Voigt (NHKV) constitutive model, we obtain time-resolved estimates of the constitutive response in polyacrylamide (PAAm) hydrogels with different crosslinker concentrations. The inferred shear modulus and viscosity generally decrease and then plateau during cavitation, while exhibiting relatively weak temperature sensitivity. For gelatin gels, by contrast, the inferred property evolution shows a pronounced temperature dependence, with distinct trends at low and high temperatures. Moreover, both the apparent shear modulus and viscosity exhibit significant variations during the first two bubble collapses. These results show that time-resolved parameter estimation within the prescribed NHKV constitutive structure can diagnose where the constant-parameter model assumption falls short during cavitation, thereby guiding the development of improved physics-based models of complex bubble--material interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据关键词：inertial microcavitation rheometry (IMR) experiments, numerical simulations, bubble dynamics models。；研究对象：聚丙烯酰胺（PAAm）水凝胶和明胶凝胶在惯性空化条件下的力学响应，特别是高应变率下的非线性粘弹性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在neo-Hookean Kelvin–Voigt（NHKV）本构模型框架下，水凝胶的剪切模量和粘度在空化过程中先下降后趋于平稳，且对温度敏感性较弱；而明胶凝胶的性质演化则表现出显著的温度依赖性，且在前两次气泡塌缩期间表观模量和粘度均有明显变化。这表明恒定参数本构模型不足以完整描述空化事件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在neo-Hookean Kelvin–Voigt（NHKV）本构模型框架下，水凝胶的剪切模量和粘度在空化过程中先下降后趋于平稳，且对温度敏感性较弱；而明胶凝胶的性质演化则表现出显著的温度依赖性，且在前两次气泡塌缩期间表观模量和粘度均有明显变化。这表明恒定参数本构模型不足以完整描述空化事件。；创新点：利用参数估计的窗口依赖性来诊断恒定参数假设失效的时刻，而非仅报告单一有效参数集；实现了对空化过程中材料本构响应的时间分辨估计。
papers.method_zh: 采用惯性微空化流变学（IMR），结合激光诱导空化（LIC）实验与气泡动力学数值模拟；使用改进的迭代集合卡尔曼平滑器与多重数据同化（MIEnKS-MDA）在移动重叠窗口上估计本构参数。

papers.title: Tuning perpendicular magnetic anisotropy in ultra-low damping Li$_{0.5}$Al$_{x}$Fe$_{(2.5-x)}$O$_4$ thin films for efficient spin-orbit torque switching
papers.abstract: Ultra-thin magnetic insulator films that simultaneously exhibit ultra-low magnon damping, perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (PMA), and low spin-orbit torque (SOT) switching current densities are highly desirable, albeit challenging, for next-generation spintronic technologies that exploit spin waves to transport information without dissipative charge currents. Here, we demonstrate this combination of properties in ferrimagnetic spinel Li$_{0.5}$Al$_{x}$Fe$_{(2.5-x)}$O$_4$ (LAFO) thin films. Through this model system, we find that PMA can be tuned by epitaxial strain in the form of chemical composition and substrate choice and that low SOT switching current densities correlate with small but finite PMA. Ultra-low damping is stabilized primarily by having only Fe$^{3+}$ as magnetically active cations with secondary effects due to increased disorder from Al substitution distribution. SOT efficiency is governed by interface quality and independent of chemical composition. By varying the Al concentration, we systematically tune the saturation magnetization and magnetic anisotropy while maintaining ultra-low Gilbert damping parameters as low as $2\times10^{-4}$ and composition-independent damping-like SOT efficiencies. We identify an optimal composition LAFO x=0.7 (Li$_{0.5}$Al$_{0.7}$Fe$_{1.8}$O$_4$), which combines ultra-low damping, stable PMA with small anisotropy fields, and low critical current densities for SOT switching, establishing it as a promising material platform for energy-efficient spin-wave and spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate this combination of properties in ferrimagnetic spinel Li₀.₅AlₓFe₂.₅₋ₓO₄ (LAFO) thin films”，并涉及薄膜生长、组分调控、性能测量等实验内容。；研究对象：超薄铁磁绝缘体薄膜 Li₀.₅AlₓFe₂.₅₋ₓO₄（LAFO），具体研究其垂直磁各向异性（PMA）、超低阻尼、自旋轨道转矩（SOT）开关等物理性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节化学组分和衬底选择，可以在LAFO薄膜中同时实现超低吉尔伯特阻尼（低至2×10⁻⁴）、可调的垂直磁各向异性以及低临界电流密度的自旋轨道转矩开关，其中最优组分为x=0.7。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节化学组分和衬底选择，可以在LAFO薄膜中同时实现超低吉尔伯特阻尼（低至2×10⁻⁴）、可调的垂直磁各向异性以及低临界电流密度的自旋轨道转矩开关，其中最优组分为x=0.7。；创新点：首次在单一超薄铁磁绝缘体薄膜中同时实现超低阻尼、垂直磁各向异性和高效自旋轨道转矩开关，并系统揭示了组分、应变、界面质量与这些性能之间的关联。
papers.method_zh: 采用外延薄膜生长（如分子束外延或脉冲激光沉积，摘要未明确说明具体技术），通过改变Al浓度和衬底类型调控外延应变，测量磁化强度、磁各向异性、吉尔伯特阻尼参数、自旋轨道转矩效率及开关电流密度。

papers.title: Lone-Pair-Induced Lattice Softness Enables Ultralow Thermal Conductivity in Hybrid Organic-Inorganic Perovskite GuaPbI$_3$
papers.abstract: Thermal conductivity ($κ$) minimization of inorganic thermoelectrics can only be achieved to a certain extent via nanostructural engineering. Here, we introduce a lone-pair-driven materials design strategy based on chemically induced lattice softness to develop hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites with ultra-low $κ$. A physics-guided symbolic-regression machine-learning framework identifies a lone-pair-dominated compositional regime statistically associated with suppressed lattice $κ$ and selects $\text{GuaPbI}_3$ as a candidate material. Mechanochemical synthesis yields $\text{GuaPbI}_3$ with an ultra-low room-temperature $κ\approx 0.088\text{ W m}^{-1}\text{ K}^{-1}$. Electrical measurements reveal electronically active, bias-dependent bulk conduction pathways despite strong phonon suppression, while impedance spectroscopy confirms predominantly bulk-dominated transport. Density functional theory calculations indicate weakly dispersive valence bands, pronounced valence-conduction asymmetry, and localized electrostatic microenvironments arising from lattice charge redistribution. Calculated transport coefficients suggest strong sensitivity of carrier transport to chemical potential, while Lorenz-number analysis reveals deviations from conventional Wiedemann-Franz behavior near band edges. These observations indicate that lone-pair-rich hybrid frameworks generate intrinsically soft and electronically heterogeneous lattice environments capable of strongly suppressing phonon transport while preserving electronically accessible states. This work establishes chemically induced lattice softness as a viable design principle for identifying ultralow-thermal-conductivity hybrid materials without relying on nanostructuring or extrinsic disorder engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。判断依据：摘要中提及了机械化学合成、电学测量、阻抗谱等实验手段，以及符号回归机器学习框架、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算、洛伦兹数分析等计算与理论方法。；研究对象：混合有机-无机钙钛矿材料 GuaPbI₃（胍基碘化铅），具体研究其由孤对电子诱导的晶格软化所导致的超低热导率现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 孤对电子丰富的混合有机-无机钙钛矿 GuaPbI₃ 具有极低的室温热导率（约 0.088 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹），其晶格软化和电子异质性环境能强烈抑制声子输运，同时保留电子可访问的态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：孤对电子丰富的混合有机-无机钙钛矿 GuaPbI₃ 具有极低的室温热导率（约 0.088 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹），其晶格软化和电子异质性环境能强烈抑制声子输运，同时保留电子可访问的态。；创新点：提出并验证了基于化学诱导晶格软化的孤对电子驱动材料设计策略，无需依赖纳米结构工程或外在无序工程即可实现超低热导率。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用物理引导的符号回归机器学习框架筛选候选材料；通过机械化学合成制备 GuaPbI₃；使用电学测量（揭示偏压依赖的体传导路径）和阻抗谱（确认体主导输运）进行表征；结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算分析能带结构、静电微环境及输运系数；通过洛伦兹数分析检验维德曼-弗兰兹定律的偏离。

papers.title: Symmetry-electronic fingerprints reveal competing magnetic phases in two-dimensional materials
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional magnets offer compelling platforms for spintronics and quantum technologies, yet predicting their magnetic ground states, moments, and anisotropy remains challenging. This limitation primarily arises because existing machine-learning representations encode chemical environments without capturing the symmetry or exchange physics that govern magnetism. In this work, we introduce the symmetry-electronic fingerprint (SEF), a physically interpretable representation that encodes crystallographic symmetry operations, Wyckoff-site geometry, together with site-resolved electronic structure. Combined with ensemble learning with random forests, the SEF accurately classifies magnetic ordering while regressing moments alongside anisotropy energies while simultaneously resolving the distinct regimes of itinerant Stoner ferromagnetism from localized superexchange. What sets the SEF-trained models apart is that regions of elevated model uncertainty are not a failure but a diagnostic, identifying materials where these mechanisms compete. First-principles calculations on Co- and Ni-based halides and oxides confirm that these regions correspond to genuine near-degenerate FM and AFM phases with magnetic frustration, suppressed anisotropy, and emergent non-collinear ordering. By encoding symmetry together with exchange physics directly into the representation unlike conventional descriptors, the SEF transforms model uncertainty into a compass pointing toward two-dimensional materials where small perturbations drive transitions between collinear, frustrated, or non-collinear magnetic phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“machine-learning representations”、“ensemble learning with random forests”、“First-principles calculations”等关键词，主要采用机器学习方法和第一性原理计算。；研究对象：二维磁性材料（如Co基和Ni基卤化物和氧化物）中的磁性基态、磁矩、磁各向异性，以及巡游Stoner铁磁性与局域超交换机制之间的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入的对称性-电子指纹（SEF）表示法能够准确分类二维材料的磁有序类型，并回归磁矩和各向异性能量，同时区分巡游铁磁性与局域超交换机制；模型不确定性高的区域并非失败，而是诊断出材料中存在竞争性磁性相（如近简并的铁磁与反铁磁相、磁阻挫、非共线磁序）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入的对称性-电子指纹（SEF）表示法能够准确分类二维材料的磁有序类型，并回归磁矩和各向异性能量，同时区分巡游铁磁性与局域超交换机制；模型不确定性高的区域并非失败，而是诊断出材料中存在竞争性磁性相（如近简并的铁磁与反铁磁相、磁阻挫、非共线磁序）。；创新点：与仅编码化学环境的传统机器学习描述符不同，SEF将对称性和交换物理直接编码到表示中，从而将模型不确定性转化为指向二维材料中竞争磁性相（如共线、阻挫或非共线磁序）的指南针。
papers.method_zh: 提出了对称性-电子指纹（SEF）表示法，编码晶体学对称操作、Wyckoff位点几何以及位点分辨的电子结构；结合随机森林集成学习进行分类和回归；并通过第一性原理计算（对Co基和Ni基卤化物和氧化物）验证预测结果。

papers.title: Overview of the Theory of Extremely Correlated Fermi Liquids
papers.abstract: The Extremely Correlated Fermi Liquids (ECFL) theory is reviewed as a framework for understanding the $t$-$J$ model in metallic systems close to the Mott insulating limit. This overview presents the underlying ideas and the resulting equations in a form accessible to nonexperts. We compare theoretical results with all available resistivity data for single-layer High-T$_{c}$ systems, and with some spectral data. The highlighted results include a density dependent quasilinear T-dependence in resistivity, an unusually small quasiparticle weight, and distinct low-temperature emergent scales that dominate transport, thermodynamics and spectral properties of single-layer High T$_c$ systems. Suggestions are made for further experiments to probe the physics of these challenging quantum many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“reviewed”、“framework”、“theoretical results”、“equations”。；研究对象：极端关联费米液体（ECFL）理论，以及该理论框架下描述的t-J模型在接近莫特绝缘体极限的金属体系中的行为，具体应用于单层高温超导体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: ECFL理论预测了密度依赖的准线性电阻-温度关系、异常小的准粒子权重，以及主导单层高温超导体输运、热力学和谱学性质的多个低温涌现能标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：ECFL理论预测了密度依赖的准线性电阻-温度关系、异常小的准粒子权重，以及主导单层高温超导体输运、热力学和谱学性质的多个低温涌现能标。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：极端关联费米液体（ECFL）理论，用于分析t-J模型。通过与单层高温超导体系的电阻率数据和部分谱学数据进行比较来验证理论。

papers.title: Micron-sized magnonic 3-port rectilinear circulator
papers.abstract: The development of miniaturized non-reciprocal microwave technologies compatible with integrated circuit architectures remains a critical challenge for modern information technology. Here, we present the first experimental characterization of a micron-sized prototypical magnon circulator. Taking advantage of the chiral excitation of spin-waves via nanowire gratings, we propose an original design of a circulator involving three channels of rectilinear and unidirectional spin-wave beams. We demonstrate via a full 3-port spin-wave spectroscopy a genuine spin-wave circulation between the three ports. The narrow frequency band of operation can be tuned over a broad range of frequencies ($2$-$8$ GHz) with both an external field of up to $100$ mT, and the dimensions of the grating specifying the wavevectors. This proposed scheme opens up possibilities for new architectures of integrated and miniaturized non-reciprocal microwave devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“experimental characterization”、“full 3-port spin-wave spectroscopy”。；研究对象：微米级磁振子三端口环形器（micron-sized magnonic 3-port rectilinear circulator），基于纳米线光栅实现自旋波的手性激发与单向传播。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次实验验证了微米级磁振子环形器的工作，通过三端口自旋波光谱测量证明了三个端口之间的自旋波循环，且工作频率可通过外磁场（最高100 mT）和光栅尺寸在2-8 GHz范围内调谐。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次实验验证了微米级磁振子环形器的工作，通过三端口自旋波光谱测量证明了三个端口之间的自旋波循环，且工作频率可通过外磁场（最高100 mT）和光栅尺寸在2-8 GHz范围内调谐。；创新点：提出了基于纳米线光栅手性激发自旋波的原创环形器设计，实现了微米尺度下直线型三端口自旋波循环，为集成化、小型化非互易微波器件提供了新架构。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：利用纳米线光栅实现自旋波的手性激发，设计三通道直线型单向自旋波束结构，并通过全三端口自旋波光谱学（full 3-port spin-wave spectroscopy）进行表征。

papers.title: Band-Selective Tunneling and Anisotropic Multiband Superconductivity in V$_2$Ga$_5$
papers.abstract: Multiband superconductors with structural anisotropy offer a fertile ground for exploring unconventional quantum states, yet disentangling their directional pairing characteristics remains a formidable challenge. Here, we present a comprehensive thermodynamic and spectroscopic study of the tetragonal intermetallic superconductor $\text{V}_2\text{Ga}_5$ ($T_{\rm c} \approx 3.5$~K), combining first-principles electronic structure calculations with highly sensitive AC calorimetry and directional low-temperature scanning tunneling spectroscopy. By constructing a self-consistent, anisotropic multiband singlet $s$-wave pairing model within the fully symmetric $A_{1g}$ representation, we successfully reconcile the experimental specific heat and upper critical field anomalies. Crucially, we reveal that the apparent reversal of bulk gap hierarchies in directional tunneling experiments is a direct consequence of band-selective tunneling. This effect is governed by an elegant interplay between localized Fermi velocity 'hot spots' and specific Fermi surface topologies, rather than raw thermodynamic gap magnitudes alone. Our findings provide a clear microscopic picture of direction-dependent, band-selective tunneling in a highly uniaxial anisotropic superconductor, demonstrating how orientation-dependent transport constraints shape the observable signatures of multiband quantum condensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：AC calorimetry, scanning tunneling spectroscopy, first-principles electronic structure calculations。；研究对象：四方晶系金属间化合物超导体 V₂Ga₅（临界温度 T_c ≈ 3.5 K）及其多带超导配对特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了 V₂Ga₅ 中方向依赖的能带选择性隧穿效应，该效应由费米速度“热点”与费米面拓扑结构共同决定，而非单纯由热力学能隙大小主导，从而解释了定向隧穿实验中观测到的体态能隙层级反转现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了 V₂Ga₅ 中方向依赖的能带选择性隧穿效应，该效应由费米速度“热点”与费米面拓扑结构共同决定，而非单纯由热力学能隙大小主导，从而解释了定向隧穿实验中观测到的体态能隙层级反转现象。；创新点：首次在高度单轴各向异性超导体中建立了方向依赖的能带选择性隧穿的微观图像，阐明了输运约束如何塑造多带量子凝聚体的可观测特征。
papers.method_zh: 结合第一性原理电子结构计算、高灵敏度交流量热法（AC calorimetry）以及定向低温扫描隧道谱学（directional low-temperature scanning tunneling spectroscopy），并构建了全对称 A₁g 表示下的自洽各向异性多带单重态 s 波配对模型。

papers.title: Quantum geometric anomalous Hall response in orbitally nonunitary superconductors
papers.abstract: We investigate the anomalous Hall response (AHR) in a multiband superconductor at optical frequencies, a phenomenon intimately related to the polar Kerr effect, a key probe of time-reversal symmetry breaking in superconductors. In translationally invariant multiband systems with purely intraband pairing, Galilean invariance decouples center-of-mass and relative motion of Cooper pairs, leading to the widespread expectation that a finite AHR requires either disorder or finite interband pairing amplitudes. However, this restriction can be lifted by the quantum geometric effects inherent to multiband Bloch states. Using a honeycomb lattice tight-binding model with Kane-Mele spin-orbit coupling, we analyze the AHR for the time-reversal symmetry broken chiral $d$-wave spin-singlet and chiral $p$-wave equal-spin-triplet pairing states with intraband pairing only. We demonstrate, through both analytical and numerical calculations, that the spin-singlet state yields a vanishing AHR, even with its broken time-reversal symmetry, whereas the equal-spin triplet state exhibits a finite AHR, even when it is spin-unitary. We attribute the latter to orbital nonunitarity, which, in the presence of spin-orbit coupling, generates the spin-polarized Bogoliubov quasiparticle states required for a finite AHR. The response is mediated by interband velocity matrix elements governed by the quantum geometry. This finding establishes that spin-unitary, but orbitally nonunitary pairing, can generate a finite AHR even without interband pairing and thereby revises the criteria for Kerr signals in superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“investigate”“analytical and numerical calculations”“tight-binding model”等关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：多带超导体在光频下的反常霍尔响应（AHR），具体以具有Kane-Mele自旋轨道耦合的蜂窝晶格紧束缚模型中的手性d波自旋单态和手性p波等自旋三重态配对态为研究对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在仅含带内配对的多带超导体中，自旋单态配对即使破坏时间反演对称性，反常霍尔响应仍为零；而等自旋三重态配对即使自旋幺正，只要轨道非幺正，就能产生有限的反常霍尔响应，且该响应由量子几何调控的带间速度矩阵元介导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在仅含带内配对的多带超导体中，自旋单态配对即使破坏时间反演对称性，反常霍尔响应仍为零；而等自旋三重态配对即使自旋幺正，只要轨道非幺正，就能产生有限的反常霍尔响应，且该响应由量子几何调控的带间速度矩阵元介导。；创新点：揭示了轨道非幺正性（而非自旋非幺正性）是产生有限反常霍尔响应的关键，修正了以往认为需要无序或带间配对才能产生Kerr信号的判据，并指出量子几何效应可解除伽利略不变性对反常霍尔响应的限制。
papers.method_zh: 采用蜂窝晶格紧束缚模型，结合Kane-Mele自旋轨道耦合，通过解析计算和数值计算分析反常霍尔响应。

papers.title: Current patterns and loss contributions in CORT cables carrying AC current
papers.abstract: Conductor-on-round-tube (CORT) cables are a potential solution for carrying AC power in a small cross-section. Due to the geometry of the cable and the helical arrangement of the coated conductors (CC), the current follows a non-trivial pattern inside each CC. For instance, for the case of a single-layer cable, the current flow is mostly axial along the outer face of the CCs and mostly azimuthal along their inner face. Such a current distribution, known as the Garber current pattern, affects the transport AC losses. In numerical models, commonly adopted simplifications are either based on straight conductors or infinitely thin CCs. Such approaches neglect the Garber current pattern and thus misrepresent both the detailed current flow within the CC and the resulting 3D distribution of the fields.
