In this work, the detailed 3D current distribution in the CCs is investigated in a one-layer CORT cable, as a function of the cable geometrical parameters such as the conductor thickness, the pitch angle, and the gap between adjacent CCs. In particular, the impact of the Garber current pattern is studied on the two largest contributions to the AC losses, namely the surface losses (associated with the penetration of the component of the magnetic field parallel to the wide faces of the superconducting layer) and the edge losses (associated with the penetration of the perpendicular component of the magnetic field occurring in the vicinity of the gaps between the CCs). The detailed distribution of the currents in the CCs is examined and its relationship with the different AC loss mechanisms is established. This study is carried out by means of an effective 2D model that uses a system of coordinates conforming with the helical structure of the cable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：numerical models, effective 2D model, system of coordinates conforming with the helical structure）；研究对象：单层CORT（Conductor-on-round-tube）电缆中，涂覆导体（CC）内的三维电流分布模式（Garber电流模式）及其对交流损耗（AC losses）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了在单层CORT电缆中，由于电缆几何结构和CC的螺旋排列，CC内部存在非平凡的电流分布（Garber电流模式），该模式显著影响交流损耗中的表面损耗和边缘损耗，且其影响程度与电缆的几何参数（如导体厚度、螺旋角、CC间间隙）密切相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了在单层CORT电缆中，由于电缆几何结构和CC的螺旋排列，CC内部存在非平凡的电流分布（Garber电流模式），该模式显著影响交流损耗中的表面损耗和边缘损耗，且其影响程度与电缆的几何参数（如导体厚度、螺旋角、CC间间隙）密切相关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但相对于摘要中提到的“基于直导体或无限薄CC的简化模型”，本工作的创新点在于通过更精确的模型，首次系统地研究了Garber电流模式对单层CORT电缆交流损耗中表面损耗和边缘损耗这两大主要贡献的具体影响，并建立了电流分布与不同损耗机制之间的关联。
papers.method_zh: 采用一种与电缆螺旋结构共形的有效二维模型（effective 2D model）进行数值模拟研究。

papers.title: Quasi-2D trapped tilted dipoles at zero and finite temperatures in the strongly dipolar regime
papers.abstract: Motivated by the recent experimental observation of dipolar supersolid stripes in a quasi two-dimensional geometry [arXiv:2512.13280 (2025)], we study a trapped system of fully polarized dipoles in a strongly axially confined geometry, both at zero and finite temperatures, by means of Bogoliubov theory. The dipoles are strongly harmonically trapped along the z axis and subjected to a box trap in the x-y plane. We characterize the physics of the trapped system at zero and finite temperatures as a function of the tilting angle of the dipoles, the number of particles and the scattering length, restricting ourselves to the experimentally relevant regime of large condensate fractions. We also illustrate the influence of the aspect ratio of the box trap in the liquid character of the system and its structure. We observe a remarkable promotion of spatial modulations when temperature is increased while keeping the total particle number constant for specific configurations, in qualitative agreement with previous Monte Carlo results in a 3D geometry. Our results are useful to understand the zero temperature physics of the trapped dipolar system in the quasi-2D limit and in the strongly dipolar regime. In addition, they allow to assess the effect of temperature in its equilibrium properties in experimentally relevant conditions, which may be useful for thermometry applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“Bogoliubov theory”、“characterize the physics”、“Monte Carlo results”。；研究对象：准二维强轴向约束几何结构中的全极化偶极子（倾斜偶极子）系统，具体研究其在零温和有限温度下的物理性质，受近期准二维偶极超固体条纹实验观测的启发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在特定构型下，保持总粒子数不变时升高温度会显著促进空间调制（条纹）的形成；系统在准二维极限和强偶极区间的零温物理行为，以及温度对平衡性质的影响，可用于测温应用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在特定构型下，保持总粒子数不变时升高温度会显著促进空间调制（条纹）的形成；系统在准二维极限和强偶极区间的零温物理行为，以及温度对平衡性质的影响，可用于测温应用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Bogoliubov理论进行理论分析，系统研究了偶极子倾斜角、粒子数和散射长度对系统性质的影响，并分析了盒状陷阱纵横比对液体特性及结构的影响。

papers.title: Thermoelectric information engine driven by an autonomous Maxwell demon across quantum-to-classical transitions
papers.abstract: We study a three-terminal thermoelectric engine, focusing on the role of quantum coherence and information flow. A double-dot connects two reservoirs at different chemical potentials, while a third dot monitors their occupation via Coulomb interaction and can be interpreted as an autonomous Maxwell demon. Within the parameter range where the device operates as an engine, we identify conditions under which this interpretation holds. The system dynamics is described within a Redfield master equation that allows us to identify two distinct dynamical regimes with steady states well captured by suitable Lindblad approximations. These two regimes define a first quantum-to-classical transition controlled by the interdot tunneling strength. We further consider the effect of a phonon bath coupled to the double-dot, which induces a second quantum-to-classical transition by generating incoherent transport and decoherence in the small interdot tunneling regime. We identify a parameter region where phonon-induced decoherence suppresses both the coherent transport contribution and the information flow toward the monitoring dot, suggesting that coherence can enhance the demon mechanism in this regime. By tracking information and transport properties across these crossovers, our model shows how coherent tunneling, decoherence, and incoherent phonon-assisted transport compete in an autonomous information engine, while clarifying which thermodynamic Lindblad description is appropriate in each regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Redfield master equation”“Lindblad approximations”等理论框架，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：三端热电发动机，由三个量子点构成，其中两个量子点连接不同化学势的库，第三个量子点通过库仑相互作用监测前两个量子点的占据状态，可视为自主麦克斯韦妖。研究聚焦于量子相干性、信息流以及量子-经典转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 识别出由量子点间隧穿强度控制的第一个量子-经典转变，以及由声子浴诱导的第二个量子-经典转变。在弱隧穿区域，声子导致的退相干抑制了相干输运和信息流向监测点的流动，表明相干性可增强麦克斯韦妖机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：识别出由量子点间隧穿强度控制的第一个量子-经典转变，以及由声子浴诱导的第二个量子-经典转变。在弱隧穿区域，声子导致的退相干抑制了相干输运和信息流向监测点的流动，表明相干性可增强麦克斯韦妖机制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Redfield主方程描述系统动力学，并通过合适的Lindblad近似捕捉两个不同动力学区域的稳态行为。进一步引入与双量子点耦合的声子浴，以研究非相干输运和退相干效应。

papers.title: Population dynamics of surface-mediated autocatalytic processes
papers.abstract: We investigate the population dynamics of surface-mediated autocatalytic processes, in which particles diffuse in a complex environment towards surface regions where they can be either killed or replicated. These opposite mechanisms compete with each other and lead to a sophisticated stochastic evolution of the population size. We provide a systematic analysis of the generating function of the population size. We also deduce its distribution, mean, variance and higher-order moments. For this purpose, we employ several equivalent descriptions of these quantities in terms of nonlinear integral equations and partial differential equations with nonlinear boundary conditions. We inspect the long-time behavior of the population dynamics in three regimes when the mean population size vanishes, reaches a steady-state level, or grows exponentially. A numerical solution of the underlying integral equations and independent Monte Carlo simulations support our theoretical predictions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：investigate, systematic analysis, generating function, nonlinear integral equations, partial differential equations, Monte Carlo simulations）；研究对象：表面介导的自催化过程（surface-mediated autocatalytic processes）中粒子群体的随机演化动力学，具体涉及粒子在复杂环境中扩散至表面区域后被杀死或复制的竞争机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了表面介导自催化过程中群体大小在三种长期行为（平均群体消失、达到稳态、指数增长）下的演化规律，并通过生成函数、分布、均值、方差及高阶矩给出了系统描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了表面介导自催化过程中群体大小在三种长期行为（平均群体消失、达到稳态、指数增长）下的演化规律，并通过生成函数、分布、均值、方差及高阶矩给出了系统描述。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用生成函数方法进行系统分析，推导了群体大小分布、均值、方差及高阶矩；利用非线性积分方程和带非线性边界条件的偏微分方程进行等价描述；通过数值求解积分方程和独立蒙特卡洛模拟验证理论预测。

papers.title: Tracking microscopic irreversibility during yielding of a colloidal fractal gel with Rheo-Echo-XPCS
papers.abstract: Understanding how microscopic structural dynamics relate to macroscopic mechanical response during yielding remains a central challenge in soft matter physics. Here, we introduce rheo-echo X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (rheo-echo-XPCS) with nonlinear acquisition synchronized to oscillatory shear, enabling direct measurement of irreversible nanoscale dynamics under strain amplitude control. Applying this to a carbon black colloidal fractal gel, we resolve time-periodic echoes in the vorticity-direction intensity autocorrelation function whose decay encodes non-affine structural rearrangements. We find: (i)~ballistic-like decorrelation with $τ\propto q^{-1}$ at all strains, where the decorrelation velocity $v_τ= 1/\langle qτ\rangle$ scales linearly with the loss tangent $\tanδ= G''/G'$, establishing $\tanδ$ as a direct macroscopic signature of the rate of irreversible structural decorrelation; (ii)~functional form continuous evolution from compressed exponential ($α\simeq 1.5$) at low strain, consistent with three-dimensional dipolar strain fields in the intact network-to stretched exponential ($α\simeq 0.5$) at high strain, reflecting a dimensional reduction from $d_f = 3$ to $d_f = 1$ as stress transmission shifts from bulk to quasi-one-dimensional filamentary backbones during network fragmentation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：rheo-echo X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (rheo-echo-XPCS)、非线性采集、同步振荡剪切。；研究对象：碳黑胶体分形凝胶在屈服过程中的微观结构动力学与宏观力学响应的关联，具体关注不可逆纳米尺度结构重排。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了不可逆结构去相关的速率（由去相关速度 \(v_\tau\) 表征）与宏观损耗正切 \(\tan\delta = G''/G'\) 呈线性标度关系，从而将 \(\tan\delta\) 确立为微观结构不可逆去相关速率的直接宏观标志；同时观察到去相关函数形式从低应变下的压缩指数（\(\alpha\simeq 1.5\)）连续演变为高应变下的拉伸指数（\(\alpha\simeq 0.5\)），反映了网络碎片化过程中应力传递从三维体相向准一维丝状骨架的维度降低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了不可逆结构去相关的速率（由去相关速度 \(v_\tau\) 表征）与宏观损耗正切 \(\tan\delta = G''/G'\) 呈线性标度关系，从而将 \(\tan\delta\) 确立为微观结构不可逆去相关速率的直接宏观标志；同时观察到去相关函数形式从低应变下的压缩指数（\(\alpha\simeq 1.5\)）连续演变为高应变下的拉伸指数（\(\alpha\simeq 0.5\)），反映了网络碎片化过程中应力传递从三维体相向准一维丝状骨架的维度降低。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用流变-回波X射线光子相关光谱（rheo-echo-XPCS），该方法结合非线性采集与振荡剪切同步，在应变振幅控制下直接测量纳米尺度的不可逆动力学。具体通过分析涡度方向强度自相关函数中的时间周期回波衰减来提取非仿射结构重排信息。

papers.title: Phonon polariton confinement in isotopically pure MOVPE-grown BN triangles
papers.abstract: Phonon polaritons, quasiparticles formed by the resonant hybridization of light and lattice vibrations, exhibit unique properties like the possibility of hyperbolic dispersions. In this context, exfoliated hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) has emerged as a promising material for phonon polariton-based research. However, to advance toward practical applications, it is essential to demonstrate efficient phonon-polariton propagation and confinement in large-area epitaxial BN. To address this topic, we use metalorganic vapor phase epitaxy (MOVPE)-grown BN and investigate the phonon polariton properties using scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM) and nanoscale Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (nano-FTIR). We report remarkably long phonon polariton propagation lengths, indicating the high crystalline quality of the BN layer. By using epitaxially grown isotopically pure triangular islands, we further demonstrate efficient phonon-polariton confinement with mode patterns tunable by the incident light wavelength. Our results pave the way for implementing all-epitaxial, microscale, high-quality polariton resonators for nanophotonics and quantum optics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：MOVPE生长、s-SNOM、nano-FTIR。；研究对象：利用金属有机气相外延（MOVPE）生长的六方氮化硼（hBN）三角形岛中的声子极化激元（phonon polariton）及其传播与局域特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在MOVPE生长的hBN中观测到极长的声子极化激元传播长度，表明该外延层具有高晶体质量；通过同位素纯化的三角形岛，实现了高效的声子极化激元局域化，且模式图案可通过入射光波长调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在MOVPE生长的hBN中观测到极长的声子极化激元传播长度，表明该外延层具有高晶体质量；通过同位素纯化的三角形岛，实现了高效的声子极化激元局域化，且模式图案可通过入射光波长调控。；创新点：首次在大面积外延生长的hBN（而非传统机械剥离的hBN）中实现高效的声子极化激元传播与局域化，并利用同位素纯化的三角形岛结构实现可调谐的局域模式，为全外延微纳极化激元谐振器奠定基础。
papers.method_zh: 采用金属有机气相外延（MOVPE）生长hBN样品；使用散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（s-SNOM）和纳米级傅里叶变换红外光谱（nano-FTIR）表征声子极化激元的传播与局域特性。

papers.title: Dopant-induced modifications of the optical properties of GaSe
papers.abstract: Doping plays a crucial role in tailoring the electronic, optical, and magnetic properties of semiconductors, enabling control of carrier dynamics and the formation of functional states for optoelectronic applications. We investigate the influence of Fe dopants on the optical properties of GaSe crystals using photoluminescence (PL) spectroscopy under varying excitation power, temperature, and magnetic field. Fe incorporation introduces multiple sharp emission lines in addition to intrinsic excitonic transitions, including free and localised excitons. Power- and temperature-dependent measurements indicate that these emission features are associated with Fe-related dopant centres (Fe-bound excitons). Magneto-PL measurements reveal two distinct families of $g$-factors, enabling the identification of intrinsic excitonic transitions and Fe-induced defect states. These results demonstrate that Fe doping creates optically and magnetically active centres in GaSe, providing insight into defect-related excitonic processes and their potential relevance for magneto-optoelectronic and quantum photonic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：photoluminescence (PL) spectroscopy、magneto-PL measurements、excitation power、temperature、magnetic field。；研究对象：Fe掺杂的GaSe晶体（GaSe:Fe）的光学性质，特别是Fe掺杂引入的缺陷态及其对激子发射的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Fe掺杂在GaSe中引入了与Fe相关的束缚激子发射线，并通过磁光PL测量区分了本征激子跃迁与Fe诱导缺陷态的两类不同g因子，表明Fe掺杂创造了光学和磁学活性中心。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Fe掺杂在GaSe中引入了与Fe相关的束缚激子发射线，并通过磁光PL测量区分了本征激子跃迁与Fe诱导缺陷态的两类不同g因子，表明Fe掺杂创造了光学和磁学活性中心。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 变激发功率、变温、变磁场的光致发光（PL）光谱，以及磁光PL（Magneto-PL）测量。

papers.title: The phase composition and physical properties of melt-quenched multicomponent alloy FeCoNiB0.7Si0.3Be
papers.abstract: The structure and physical properties of the high-entropy multicomponent alloy FeCoNiB0.7Si0.3Be in the as-cast and melt-quenched states were studied. The cooling rate of the melt-quenched films was estimated to be approximately 10^6 K/s based on the film thickness. X-ray analysis revealed a multiphase structure, including a BCC-type ordered phase (structural type B2) and intermetallic compounds (Fe, Ni, Co)2B. In melt-quenched samples, the fraction of the B2 phase increased, leading to a decrease in microhardness from 10400 MPa in the as-cast state to 8900 MPa in the melt-quenched state. Magnetic studies confirmed the ferromagnetic nature of the FeCoNiB0.7Si0.3Be alloy. The coercive field of melt-quenched samples (17500 A/m) was significantly higher than that of the as-cast ones (5200 A/m), which is attributed to structure refinement and an increased level of microstresses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：melt-quenched（熔淬）、X-ray analysis（X射线分析）、magnetic studies（磁性研究）。；研究对象：高熵多组元合金 FeCoNiB0.7Si0.3Be 在铸态和熔淬态下的相组成与物理性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 熔淬处理使合金中B2型有序相比例增加，导致显微硬度从10400 MPa降至8900 MPa；同时熔淬样品的矫顽力（17500 A/m）显著高于铸态样品（5200 A/m），归因于结构细化和微应力增加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：熔淬处理使合金中B2型有序相比例增加，导致显微硬度从10400 MPa降至8900 MPa；同时熔淬样品的矫顽力（17500 A/m）显著高于铸态样品（5200 A/m），归因于结构细化和微应力增加。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过熔淬法制备薄膜（冷却速率约10^6 K/s），采用X射线衍射分析相组成，显微硬度测试，以及磁性测量（矫顽力、铁磁性确认）。

papers.title: Physics-informed time-series forecasting of perovskite photoluminescence stability
papers.abstract: Accelerated ageing using elevated temperatures and illumination is one of the most common methods to rapidly study the stability of novel semiconductor materials. However, as the pace of materials discovery continues to accelerate, even faster stability evaluations are needed. A physics-informed time-series forecasting algorithm designed to predict the long-term photoluminescence stability of metal halide perovskites is presented. A diverse experimental dataset of 167 metal halide perovskites is collected, including different crystallinities and compositions. These are stressed using heat and light, while the photoluminescence (PL) is monitored. The >86k collected PL spectra are featurized using a physics-informed model, and a hybrid CNN-LSTM model is trained to forecast the PL intensity during degradation of samples unseen during model training. Notably, the approach generalizes across the material groups and outperforms baseline benchmarks. Furthermore, the physics-based featurization ensures explainability, enabling analysis to identify critical stability descriptors for given predictions. It is expected that this approach will be adapted to other types of time-series data and enables a pathway to significantly reduce experimental testing times.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算/机器学习）。判断依据关键词：experimental dataset（实验数据集）、physics-informed model（物理信息模型）、hybrid CNN-LSTM model（混合卷积-长短期记忆网络模型）、time-series forecasting（时间序列预测）。；研究对象：金属卤化物钙钛矿（metal halide perovskites）的光致发光（photoluminescence, PL）稳定性，涵盖167种不同结晶度和成分的样品。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于物理信息的时间序列预测算法，能够有效预测未参与训练的钙钛矿样品在热和光老化过程中的光致发光强度衰减趋势，且泛化能力优于基线基准。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于物理信息的时间序列预测算法，能够有效预测未参与训练的钙钛矿样品在热和光老化过程中的光致发光强度衰减趋势，且泛化能力优于基线基准。；创新点：将物理信息嵌入特征化过程（physics-based featurization），使模型兼具预测准确性和可解释性（explainability），能够识别关键稳定性描述符，并显著缩短实验测试时间。摘要未突出说明与纯数据驱动方法的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 1）实验手段：对167种金属卤化物钙钛矿样品施加高温和光照加速老化，同时监测其光致发光光谱（共采集超过86,000个PL光谱）。2）计算方法：利用物理信息模型对PL光谱进行特征化（featurization），然后训练一个混合CNN-LSTM（卷积神经网络-长短期记忆网络）模型，用于预测样品降解过程中的PL强度时间序列。

papers.title: Enhanced Photocurrent Response in Epitaxial 0.5PZT-0.5PFN Multiferroic Thin Films
papers.abstract: The exploration of novel multiferroic materials with strong coupling between ferroelectric polarization and photovoltaic effects is crucial for next-generation optoelectronic devices. In this study, we characterized highly oriented 0.5Pb(Zr0.52Ti0.48)O3-0.5Pb(Fe0.5Nb0.5)O3 multiferroic thin films grown by pulsed laser deposition on SrTiO3 (001) substrates with a SrRuO3 bottom electrode. The films exhibited excellent crystalline quality, with a single perovskite phase and (001) orientation. They displayed good ferroelectric properties (remanent polarization $\sim$17 $μ$C/cm$^2$, PUND; coercive field $\sim$150 kV/cm), alongside weak ferromagnetic behavior at room temperature (remanence 1.30 emu/cm$^3$; coercive field 90 Oe). Photovoltaic measurements demonstrated a robust, polarization-dependent photoresponse under 403 nm monochromatic laser illumination, achieving Jsc values between $\pm$20 $μ$A/cm$^2$. This compelling observation confirms the intrinsic coupling between ferroelectric polarization and photovoltaic effects, highlighting the considerable promise of these single-phase multiferroic thin films for advanced photovoltaic and optoelectronic memory applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了薄膜的生长（脉冲激光沉积）、结构表征（X射线衍射）、铁电/铁磁性能测量以及光伏效应测试等实验过程。；研究对象：0.5Pb(Zr0.52Ti0.48)O3-0.5Pb(Fe0.5Nb0.5)O3 (0.5PZT-0.5PFN) 多铁性薄膜。具体体系为在 SrTiO3 (001) 衬底上外延生长、以 SrRuO3 为底电极的薄膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单相 0.5PZT-0.5PFN 多铁性薄膜中，观测到了稳健的、依赖于铁电极化方向的光伏响应，证实了铁电极化与光伏效应之间存在内在耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单相 0.5PZT-0.5PFN 多铁性薄膜中，观测到了稳健的、依赖于铁电极化方向的光伏响应，证实了铁电极化与光伏效应之间存在内在耦合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作的核心新意在于，在一种特定的单相多铁材料（0.5PZT-0.5PFN）中，同时实现了良好的铁电性、弱铁磁性以及可被极化翻转调控的光伏效应，为开发基于单相多铁材料的光电和光电子存储器件提供了实验依据。
papers.method_zh: 脉冲激光沉积（PLD）用于薄膜生长；X射线衍射（XRD）用于结构表征；PUND（正-负-正-负脉冲）方法测量铁电性能；振动样品磁强计（VSM）或类似手段测量磁性能；在403 nm单色激光照射下测量光伏响应（短路电流 Jsc）。

papers.title: Polarizing ultrathin ferroelectric BaTiO3 films through interfacial layer polarization
papers.abstract: An important requirement for the integration of ferroelectric thin films into devices is deterministic control of the polarization state in films of only a few unit cells in thickness. Here, we utilize the charged atomic planes of (001)-oriented SmNiO$_3$ (SNO) buffer layers as a polarizing template to stabilize the polarization in ferroelectric BaTiO$_3$ (BTO) model system thin films. We show that an upwards (downwards) oriented polarization is achieved by selection of the [SmO]$^+$ ([NiO$_2$]$^-$) buffer termination. Most importantly, the charged atomic planes of SNO suppress the depolarizing-field-induced critical thickness in BTO, and we record the emergence of a net polarization in our BTO films from the first unit cell deposited. Our experiments, guided by density-functional-theory (DFT) calculations, further highlight the impact of charged defects on the polarizing effectiveness of the SNO buffer. Specifically, oxygen vacancies counteract the polarizing field of the negatively charged, [NiO$_2$]$^-$-terminated surface of the SNO buffer. Our findings provide important insights into the interplay of defect chemistry and polarizing interfaces to stabilize ferroelectric polarization down to the single-unit-cell limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验为主，辅以DFT计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Our experiments, guided by density-functional-theory (DFT) calculations”。；研究对象：铁电超薄薄膜中的极化态调控，具体为BaTiO₃（BTO）薄膜与SmNiO₃（SNO）缓冲层构成的异质结体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过选择SNO缓冲层的带电原子面终止层（[SmO]⁺或[NiO₂]⁻），可以确定性控制BTO薄膜的极化方向（向上或向下），并且从第一个单胞开始即可获得净极化，抑制了退极化场导致的临界厚度效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过选择SNO缓冲层的带电原子面终止层（[SmO]⁺或[NiO₂]⁻），可以确定性控制BTO薄膜的极化方向（向上或向下），并且从第一个单胞开始即可获得净极化，抑制了退极化场导致的临界厚度效应。；创新点：利用SNO缓冲层的带电原子面作为极化模板，实现了从第一个单胞起即稳定铁电极化，突破了传统铁电薄膜中退极化场导致的临界厚度限制；同时揭示了氧空位等带电缺陷会抵消SNO缓冲层的极化场效应。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用（001）取向的SNO缓冲层作为极化模板，通过分子束外延（推测，摘要未明确说明具体生长方法）制备BTO薄膜；理论上采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算指导实验，并分析带电缺陷（如氧空位）对极化效果的影响。

papers.title: Andreev Reflection to Probe Momentum-Dependent Spin Polarization in Altermagnet CrSb
papers.abstract: Altermagnetic materials have recently emerged as promising candidates for next-generation spintronic applications, characterized by the k-dependent spin-splitted band structure and a simultaneous zero-net-magnetization. Among them, altermagnetic candidate CrSb has attracted considerable attention, owing to its g-wave spin splitting and high Néel temperature. In this article, we employed mechanical point-contact spectroscopy (MPCS) with superconducting Nb tips to probe the Andreev reflection on CrSb single crystals along three principal crystallographic orientations. The extracted momentum-dependent spin polarizations are approximately 73.4% for the (0001) plane, 67.9% for the (-1-120) plane, and 61.9% for the (10-10) plane, respectively, distinct from conventional antiferromagnets. Furthermore, conductance spectra from spatial line-scans on the sample surface support the existence of altermagnetic domains with a characteristic size of 250-500 nm separated by domain-walls with width about 250 nm. These results strongly support the momentum-dependent spin polarization in altermagnetic CrSb and establish Andreev reflection as a new paradigm to probe k-dependent spin textures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：mechanical point-contact spectroscopy (MPCS)、conductance spectra、spatial line-scans。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是交变磁体候选材料 CrSb 单晶，以及其动量依赖的自旋极化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过超导 Nb 针尖的安德烈夫反射测量，发现 CrSb 沿三个主要晶面的自旋极化率显著不同（73.4%、67.9%、61.9%），且存在特征尺寸为 250-500 nm 的交变磁畴，有力支持了其动量依赖的自旋极化特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过超导 Nb 针尖的安德烈夫反射测量，发现 CrSb 沿三个主要晶面的自旋极化率显著不同（73.4%、67.9%、61.9%），且存在特征尺寸为 250-500 nm 的交变磁畴，有力支持了其动量依赖的自旋极化特性。；创新点：首次利用安德烈夫反射实验手段直接探测交变磁体 CrSb 中动量依赖的自旋极化，并建立了安德烈夫反射作为探测 k 依赖自旋织构的新范式。
papers.method_zh: 采用机械点接触谱学（MPCS）技术，使用超导 Nb 针尖在 CrSb 单晶的 (0001)、(-1-120) 和 (10-10) 三个晶向上进行安德烈夫反射测量，并结合样品表面的空间线扫描电导谱分析。

papers.title: Variational Monte Carlo study of a two-orbital Hubbard model for the iron pnictides
papers.abstract: We study a two-orbital Hubbard-Kanamori model, which has been originally proposed for iron-based superconductors, using variational Monte Carlo. We span the nonmagnetic sector at both hole-doping and electron-doping, with respect to the half-filled case $n=2$. We report the presence of a superconductive region with a $s^{\pm}$ symmetry only when the half-filled system is in a Mott state, while orbital selectivity is absent. These results are qualitatively different from what was reported in the three-orbital Hubbard-Kanamori model, where a more extended superconductive region was observed with a concomitant development of orbital selectivity, and they are to some extent more reminiscent of the single-band Hubbard model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：variational Monte Carlo（变分蒙特卡洛）、model study（模型研究）。；研究对象：铁基超导体的两轨道Hubbard-Kanamori模型，具体研究空穴掺杂和电子掺杂下的非磁性区域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅在半满体系处于Mott态时，才存在具有s±对称性的超导区域，且未观察到轨道选择性行为。这一结果与三轨道模型（超导区域更广且伴随轨道选择性）定性不同，反而更接近单带Hubbard模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅在半满体系处于Mott态时，才存在具有s±对称性的超导区域，且未观察到轨道选择性行为。这一结果与三轨道模型（超导区域更广且伴随轨道选择性）定性不同，反而更接近单带Hubbard模型。；创新点：揭示了铁基超导体两轨道模型与三轨道模型在超导区域和轨道选择性行为上的定性差异，指出两轨道模型的行为更类似于单带Hubbard模型。摘要未突出说明与实验结果的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 变分蒙特卡洛（Variational Monte Carlo, VMC）方法。

papers.title: Modeling strained Cd$_3$As$_2$ thin films and their behavior in magnetic fields
papers.abstract: We present a systematic analysis of the behavior of thin films of Cd$_3$As$_2$ under different strain profiles and in magnetic fields. In each case, we construct effective $k \cdot p$ models by considering the reduction of symmetry and all constraints imposed by the remaining symmetries. Our analysis naturally describes both in-plane biaxial and uniaxial strain. Biaxial strain is expected to preserve in-plane $C_4$ rotational symmetry while breaking inversion, allowing for a description in terms of the $4mm$ point group. Uniaxial strain, on the other hand, breaks $C_4$ symmetry. For this case, we consider two scenarios: one preserving inversion, described by the $mmm$ group, and one breaking it, leading to $2mm$ symmetry. After deriving the models, we examine the effects of out-of-plane magnetic fields, identifying two possible microscopic mechanisms that can account for the experimental results reported in Ahadi et al. (2025). Importantly, our analysis proposes a new method for differentiating between them. By incorporating the effects of multiple subbands along the confinement direction, we show that the opening of a gap in the lowest Landau level requires either reducing the symmetry down to $2mm$, breaking both inversion and $C_4$ rotations, or a topological transition of the band structure due to strain-induced band renormalization. Furthermore, we demonstrate that a two-dimensional Dirac semimetal phase can be induced by sufficiently large in-plane magnetic fields. This phase is highly sensitive to different strain profiles, with band touchings occurring when the field is applied perpendicular to preserved mirror planes, serving as a powerful probe of the material's strain profile.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct effective \(k \cdot p\) models、symmetry analysis、deriving models。；研究对象：Cd₃As₂薄膜在不同应变（双轴应变、单轴应变）及磁场（面外磁场、面内磁场）下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了区分两种微观机制的新方法，并发现足够大的面内磁场可诱导出二维狄拉克半金属相，该相对应变剖面高度敏感，可作为探测材料应变的有力工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了区分两种微观机制的新方法，并发现足够大的面内磁场可诱导出二维狄拉克半金属相，该相对应变剖面高度敏感，可作为探测材料应变的有力工具。；创新点：提出了一种区分两种微观机制的新方法，并揭示了面内磁场可诱导二维狄拉克半金属相，且该相对应变剖面高度敏感，可用于探测应变类型。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性分析构建有效 \(k \cdot p\) 模型，考虑不同应变下对称性降低（点群从 \(4mm\) 到 \(mmm\) 或 \(2mm\)）及剩余对称性约束；分析面外磁场下最低朗道能级打开带隙的条件；考虑沿约束方向的多子带效应；研究面内磁场下能带接触行为。

papers.title: Understanding quantum behaviors of an electron in a uniform magnetic field alternatively
papers.abstract: Quantum mechanically, an electron moving in a uniform magnetic field forms Landau levels. A curious feature is that for states with a negative angular quantum number, the total probability current vanishes, which appears to contradict the classical picture of cyclotron motion. While a geometric interpretation based on classical orbits exists, alternative interpretations remain of interest. In this paper, we examine the probability current density and identify a critical radius that naturally partitions the plane into an inner clockwise-flow region and an outer counterclockwise-flow region. We show that the vanishing total current results from an exact cancellation between these two regions. Furthermore, by defining a partitioned kinetic angular momentum with respect to the critical radius, we reveal an intrinsic competitive structure: the electron simultaneously carries two opposing rotational components. The negative quantum number manifests in the strength of the inner counter-rotation, while the net kinetic angular momentum remains positive. This bidirectional flow picture also provides a dynamical interpretation of the infinite degeneracy of Landau levels.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum mechanically, examine, define, reveal, provide interpretation。；研究对象：均匀磁场中单个电子的量子行为，特别是朗道能级中概率电流的分布与角动量结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子在均匀磁场中的概率电流并非单一方向，而是存在一个临界半径，将平面分为内部顺时针流动区和外部逆时针流动区；总电流为零源于这两个区域的精确抵消。负角动量量子数对应内部反向旋转的强度，而净动能角动量仍为正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子在均匀磁场中的概率电流并非单一方向，而是存在一个临界半径，将平面分为内部顺时针流动区和外部逆时针流动区；总电流为零源于这两个区域的精确抵消。负角动量量子数对应内部反向旋转的强度，而净动能角动量仍为正。；创新点：提出了电子在朗道能级中具有双向流动（顺时针与逆时针）的竞争结构，并以此解释了负角动量量子数下总概率电流为零的经典-量子矛盾，同时为朗道能级的无限简并性提供了新的动力学图像。
papers.method_zh: 通过解析计算概率电流密度，定义临界半径，并引入基于临界半径的分区动能角动量概念，对朗道能级的无限简并性给出动力学解释。

papers.title: Frustration effects on the magnetization plateau physics in a trimerized quantum spin-1/2 chain
papers.abstract: We investigate frustration-induced instabilities in a trimerized quantum spin chain motivated by recent experimental findings for the compound Na$_2$Cu$_3$Ge$_4$O$_{12}$. Employing a cluster mean-field approach combined with Lanczos exact diagonalization, we analyze the ground-state and quantum-information properties of a Heisenberg model with competing interactions in a magnetic field. In the weakly frustrated regime, the system exhibits a robust $1/3$ magnetization plateau associated with a collective ferrimagnetic-like trimer state. Increasing the next-nearest-neighbor intratrimer coupling drives a pronounced reorganization of spin correlations, leading to a crossover toward a doublon-like correlation regime and providing a static ground-state picture consistent with the composite excitations observed dynamically in trimerized chains. The resulting low-energy behavior can be interpreted in terms of weakly interacting emergent spins, offering a microscopic explanation for the extended stability of the magnetization plateau. Furthermore, through finite-size scaling analyses of the energy gap, von Neumann entanglement entropy, and fidelity susceptibility, we characterize the zero-field criticality of the model. Ultimately, our results suggest that frustration gives rise to qualitatively distinct quantum states and provide a microscopic framework for understanding the emergence of fractionalized excitations in trimerized quantum spin systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“cluster mean-field approach combined with Lanczos exact diagonalization”（团簇平均场结合Lanczos精确对角化）、“finite-size scaling analyses”（有限尺寸标度分析）等理论计算方法。；研究对象：论文研究了一种三聚化量子自旋-1/2链（trimerized quantum spin-1/2 chain）中的磁化平台物理，具体以化合物Na₂Cu₃Ge₄O₁₂为动机，研究阻挫效应对该体系的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱阻挫区域，体系表现出稳健的1/3磁化平台，对应集体亚铁磁三聚体态；增加次近邻三聚体内耦合会引发自旋关联的重组，导致向双子（doublon-like）关联态的交叉，并可用弱相互作用的涌现自旋解释磁化平台的扩展稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱阻挫区域，体系表现出稳健的1/3磁化平台，对应集体亚铁磁三聚体态；增加次近邻三聚体内耦合会引发自旋关联的重组，导致向双子（doublon-like）关联态的交叉，并可用弱相互作用的涌现自旋解释磁化平台的扩展稳定性。；创新点：揭示了阻挫在三聚化自旋链中诱导出性质不同的量子态，并为理解该体系中分数化激发的涌现提供了一个微观框架。摘要未突出说明与具体实验结果的定量对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用了团簇平均场方法（cluster mean-field approach）结合Lanczos精确对角化（Lanczos exact diagonalization）来分析基态和量子信息性质；通过有限尺寸标度分析（finite-size scaling analyses）能隙、冯·诺依曼纠缠熵（von Neumann entanglement entropy）和保真度磁化率（fidelity susceptibility）来表征零场临界性。

papers.title: Phase diagram of the Kitaev-Heisenberg-$Γ$ model: Classical and quantum magnetism, frustration, and subdominant interactions
papers.abstract: The Kitaev spin liquid provides a rare example of exactly solvable quantum spin liquid states. Intensive research over the past two decades has identified a variety of its candidate materials. In real materials, however, the Kitaev interaction is inevitably accompanied by additional magnetic interactions such as the Heisenberg and $Γ$ interactions. These interactions often induce magnetic ordering at low temperatures, making it essential to clarify their effects in the search for and design of Kitaev spin liquid candidate materials. In this study, we revisit the ground-state phase diagram of the Kitaev-Heisenberg-$Γ$ model from both classical and quantum perspectives, using state-of-the-art numerical techniques. In the classical case, we reveal a $zoo$ $of$ $noncollinear$ $orders$, where a variety of noncollinear multiple-$Q$ magnetic orders with and without incommensurate modulations emerge. In the quantum case, we unravel that quantum fluctuations suppress many of the competing orders found in the classical case, resulting in a reduced number of dominant incommensurate orders. We further identify $highly$ $frustrated$ regions, where spiral spin liquid states as well as new magnetically ordered states are potentially stabilized by other additional magnetic interactions. Our results provide a comprehensive perspective on the Kitaev-Heisenberg-$Γ$ model for both classical and quantum spins and offer a valuable guide not only for interpreting experimental results on candidate materials, but also for searching and designing new materials to realize the Kitaev spin liquid.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：classical and quantum perspectives, state-of-the-art numerical techniques, ground-state phase diagram）；研究对象：Kitaev-Heisenberg-Γ模型，即包含Kitaev相互作用、海森堡相互作用和Γ相互作用的自旋模型，以及该模型中的经典与量子磁性、阻挫效应和亚主导相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典情形下存在多种非共线多Q磁有序（包括公度与非公度调制）；量子涨落抑制了经典情形中的许多竞争序，仅保留少数主导的非公度序，并识别出高度阻挫区域，其中螺旋自旋液体态和新的磁有序态可能由其他附加相互作用稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典情形下存在多种非共线多Q磁有序（包括公度与非公度调制）；量子涨落抑制了经典情形中的许多竞争序，仅保留少数主导的非公度序，并识别出高度阻挫区域，其中螺旋自旋液体态和新的磁有序态可能由其他附加相互作用稳定。；创新点：首次系统对比经典与量子情形下Kitaev-Heisenberg-Γ模型的完整相图，揭示了量子涨落对竞争序的筛选作用，并指出高度阻挫区域中螺旋自旋液体态的存在可能性。
papers.method_zh: 采用最先进的数值技术（摘要未明确具体方法名称，如精确对角化、张量网络方法等），分别从经典自旋和量子自旋角度重新计算基态相图。

papers.title: Selective stabilization of antiferromagnetic orders in FeTe films via local strain engineering
papers.abstract: The parent compound FeTe hosts a complex magnetic landscape that is highly susceptible to lattice distortions. Although theoretical models have predicted a bicollinear to dimer antiferromagnetic (AFM) phase transition under tensile strain, its experimental realization and deterministic control has remained elusive owing to severe magnetic frustration. Here, combining high-resolution scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) and density functional theory (DFT) calculations, we demonstrate the selective stabilization of bicollinear and dimer AFM orders in few-layer FeTe films via local uniaxial strain engineering. By mapping the strain fields near dislocation areas in FeTe films and FeTe/FeSe heterostructures, we establish a direct correspondence between specific strain components and the resulting magnetic ground states. We find that uniaxial compression along the Fe-Fe next-nearest-neighbor direction stabilizes the bicollinear AFM order, with the stripe orientation aligning parallel to the compression axis. Crucially, we report the experimental realization of the long-range dimer AFM order, which emerges under anisotropic strain along the Fe-Fe nearest-neighbor direction. This phase manifests as a distinct $\sqrt{2} \times \sqrt{2}$ electronic reconstruction and shares a common Neel temperature with the bicollinear phase. Our findings reveal that anisotropic strain effectively lifts the magnetic degeneracy among competing states. This work provides a robust strategy for the manipulation of elusive magnetic orders and offers insights into the interplay between lattice, spin, and electronic degrees of freedom in iron-based superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：结合高分辨率扫描隧道显微镜（STM）实验与密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。；研究对象：FeTe薄膜及FeTe/FeSe异质结中的反铁磁序（双共线反铁磁序与二聚体反铁磁序），以及通过局域单轴应变工程对其进行的选择性稳定化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过局域单轴应变工程，在FeTe薄膜中实现了双共线反铁磁序和二聚体反铁磁序的选择性稳定化，并首次实验实现了长程二聚体反铁磁序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过局域单轴应变工程，在FeTe薄膜中实现了双共线反铁磁序和二聚体反铁磁序的选择性稳定化，并首次实验实现了长程二聚体反铁磁序。；创新点：首次通过实验实现了理论预测的、在拉伸应变下从双共线到二聚体反铁磁序的相变，并建立了特定应变分量与磁基态之间的直接对应关系，为操控铁基超导体中难以捉摸的磁序提供了新策略。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨率扫描隧道显微镜（STM）用于实空间成像和应变场映射；密度泛函理论（DFT）计算用于理论预测和解释。

papers.title: Thickness-Independent Quantum Geometric Responses Driven by Interlayer Antiferroic Coupling
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional ferroic materials exhibit rich and intriguing physical phenomena, but their response properties generally depend sensitively on thickness, requiring precise layer-number control and thereby limiting practical applications. Here, we propose a general strategy for realizing thickness-independent quantum geometric responses through symmetry engineering induced by interlayer antiferroic coupling. Using spatial-dependent symmetry analysis, we show that thickness-independent behavior emerges when the symmetry breaking required for a given response is generated by interlayer antiferromagnetic (AFM) or antiferroelectric (AFE) coupling, without invoking topological mechanisms. Our first-principles calculations predict that multilayer MnS in the G-type AFM configuration exhibits a surface-dominated anomalous Hall effect, whose thickness-independent behavior can be significantly influenced by the stacking order. We further propose design principles for achieving thickness-independent anomalous and nonlinear Hall effects driven by interlayer AFE coupling, and suggest potential applications in distinguishing magnetic structures. Our findings open a new route towards robust functional devices based on antiferroic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“propose a general strategy”、“spatial-dependent symmetry analysis”、“first-principles calculations”以及“design principles”。；研究对象：二维铁性材料（two-dimensional ferroic materials）中，由层间反铁性耦合（interlayer antiferroic coupling）驱动的、与厚度无关的量子几何响应（quantum geometric responses），具体包括反常霍尔效应（anomalous Hall effect）和非线性霍尔效应（nonlinear Hall effect）。以多层MnS的G型反铁磁构型为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过层间反铁磁（AFM）或反铁电（AFE）耦合引入对称性破缺，可以实现与厚度无关的量子几何响应，例如表面主导的反常霍尔效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过层间反铁磁（AFM）或反铁电（AFE）耦合引入对称性破缺，可以实现与厚度无关的量子几何响应，例如表面主导的反常霍尔效应。；创新点：提出了一种不依赖拓扑机制，而是通过层间反铁性耦合进行对称性工程（symmetry engineering）来实现厚度无关量子几何响应的通用策略。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 空间依赖的对称性分析（spatial-dependent symmetry analysis）和第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）。

papers.title: Real-time quantification of fluid flows around bubbles during directional solidification
papers.abstract: Directional solidification of bubbly liquids plays a critical role in shaping the microstructure and properties of many materials, yet the fluid dynamics governing bubble behavior during solidification remain poorly understood. Using cryo-confocal microscopy and particle image velocimetry, we quantify fluid flows around bubbles during solidification of water containing surfactants and tracers. Our results reveal that volumetric expansion dominates fluid motion, with velocities scaling linearly with the solidification rate (1-20$~μm/s$), while Marangoni flows-hypothesized to play a key role-are negligible ($< 5~μm/s$) under our experimental conditions. Diffusiophoresis and thermophoresis also contribute minimally. These findings challenge existing theoretical models and provide a framework for controlling bubble distribution in solidified materials
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用cryo-confocal microscopy和particle image velocimetry等实验手段进行定量测量。；研究对象：气泡在定向凝固过程中的流体动力学行为，具体为含表面活性剂和示踪剂的水在凝固时气泡周围的流体流动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 体积膨胀主导了气泡周围的流体运动，其速度与凝固速率呈线性关系（1-20 μm/s）；而此前被认为关键的Marangoni流在实验条件下可忽略（<5 μm/s），扩散泳和热泳贡献也很小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：体积膨胀主导了气泡周围的流体运动，其速度与凝固速率呈线性关系（1-20 μm/s）；而此前被认为关键的Marangoni流在实验条件下可忽略（<5 μm/s），扩散泳和热泳贡献也很小。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 低温共聚焦显微镜（cryo-confocal microscopy）结合粒子图像测速（particle image velocimetry），对含表面活性剂和示踪剂的水在定向凝固过程中气泡周围的流体流动进行实时定量测量。

papers.title: Manipulation of the gyrotropic mode frequency and band structure in an FM / AFM disk via vortex imprinting
papers.abstract: We experimentally investigate the magnetic gyrotropic mode in a system of vortex ferromagnetic (FM) nanooscillator exchange coupled to an antiferromagnetic (AFM) layer. The micron-sized disks formed from the Ni80Fe20(12 nm) / Ir80Mn20 (5 nm) FM/AFM heterostructure are prepared so that the vortex magnetic state is imprinted into the AFM layer. We apply a magnetic resonance force microscopy (MRFM) method to locally study magnetic oscillations in single FM/AFM disks. We show that the gyrotropic mode frequency is significantly (approximately 4 times) shifted to the high frequency compared to similar structure consisting of a single ferromagnetic disk. Upon applying an in-plane magnetic field, we observe a strong peak at a double frequency which was previously predicted in theory. This is governed by the fact that vortex dynamics is strongly nonlinear in a noncentrosymmetric system under investigation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：experimentally investigate、MRFM method、observe。；研究对象：FM/AFM异质结微米圆盘中的涡旋磁态，具体材料为Ni80Fe20(12 nm)/Ir80Mn20(5 nm)铁磁/反铁磁双层结构，研究其磁旋模式（gyrotropic mode）的频率与能带结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将涡旋磁态印入反铁磁层，旋磁模式频率相比单一铁磁圆盘显著蓝移约4倍；在施加面内磁场时，观察到理论预言的倍频强峰，源于非中心对称体系中涡旋动力学的强非线性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将涡旋磁态印入反铁磁层，旋磁模式频率相比单一铁磁圆盘显著蓝移约4倍；在施加面内磁场时，观察到理论预言的倍频强峰，源于非中心对称体系中涡旋动力学的强非线性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 磁共振力显微镜（MRFM）方法，用于局域研究单个FM/AFM圆盘中的磁振荡。

papers.title: Decoding Crystallographic Surface Chirality with Machine Learning: From Atomic Geometry to Fermi Surface Projections
papers.abstract: Intrinsically chiral metal surfaces, where handedness arises from the asymmetric step-kink-terrace topology of high-Miller-index planes, are model systems for enantiospecific catalysis, sensing, and spintronics. Yet, no consistent method exists to classify their handedness directly from experimental observables. We report a dual-domain machine learning framework that decodes crystallographic surface chirality from two independent image representations: atomic structure models in real space and simulated momentum-resolved photoemission maps of the Fermi surface projections in reciprocal space. ResNet18, a deep convolutional neural network, fine-tuned on a database of labeled images achieves ~73% classification accuracy on atomic models and ~99% on Fermi surface projections. We show that the latter transfers directly to synchrotron-acquired experimental images after fine-tuning on just two labeled frames. We identify a working correspondence between the two representations: just as the kink site geometry fixes the orientation of crystallographic planes in real space, the surface normal position in a momentum-resolved photoemission map anchors the orientation of the Fermi surface polygons in reciprocal space. It is precisely this relative orientation that encodes handedness into the map topology with high accuracy. The pronounced difference in accuracy shows that handedness is more readily recovered from the momentum-space electronic pattern than from the local atomic geometry of the kinked surface. This finding has direct implications for the disorder resilience of geometric chiral-induced spin selectivity (CISS) at realistic metal surfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。判断依据：使用了机器学习（计算）对原子结构模型和模拟光电子能谱（计算）进行分析，并直接应用于同步辐射实验图像（实验）。；研究对象：intrinsically chiral metal surfaces（本征手性金属表面），具体为高米勒指数晶面中由不对称台阶-扭结-平台拓扑结构产生的手性表面，以及其费米面投影的动量分辨光电子能谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 机器学习可以从费米面投影的动量空间电子图案中以极高准确率（~99%）解码晶体表面手性，而直接从实空间原子几何结构分类的准确率较低（~73%），表明手性信息在动量空间电子图案中更易恢复。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：机器学习可以从费米面投影的动量空间电子图案中以极高准确率（~99%）解码晶体表面手性，而直接从实空间原子几何结构分类的准确率较低（~73%），表明手性信息在动量空间电子图案中更易恢复。；创新点：首次建立了一个从实验可观测物理量（动量分辨光电子能谱）直接分类晶体表面手性的一致方法，并揭示了实空间扭结几何与倒易空间费米面多边形相对取向之间的对应关系，指出手性编码于该相对取向中。
papers.method_zh: 双域机器学习框架：使用ResNet18深度卷积神经网络，在两类标注图像数据库上进行微调——实空间的原子结构模型图像，以及倒易空间中模拟的动量分辨光电子能谱（费米面投影）图像。实验验证部分：仅用两张标注的同步辐射实验图像进行微调后，模型直接迁移至实验数据。

papers.title: A first-principles approach for predicting infrared optical properties of solids
papers.abstract: We present a simplified formalism for predicting infrared optical constants from first-principles calculations. Addressing limitations of the widely used four-parameter semi-quantum Lorentz model, the proposed approach bridges the gap between the harmonic three-parameter model and full self-energy-based methods. By incorporating essential anharmonic effects including four-phonon scattering and phonon renormalisation, the model provides an efficient and accurate alternative while maintaining low computational cost. The frequency-dependent refractive indices of MgO and rutile TiO$_2$ are computed and compared with experimental data, demonstrating good quantitative agreement. The framework offers a practical approach for predicting optical properties of materials across a wide range of materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles calculations、computational cost、predicting optical constants）；研究对象：固体材料（以MgO和金红石TiO₂为例）的红外光学性质（频率依赖折射率）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种简化第一性原理方法，通过纳入四声子散射和声子重整化等非谐效应，在保持低计算成本的同时，实现了与实验数据良好定量一致的红外光学常数预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种简化第一性原理方法，通过纳入四声子散射和声子重整化等非谐效应，在保持低计算成本的同时，实现了与实验数据良好定量一致的红外光学常数预测。；创新点：克服了广泛使用的四参数半量子Lorentz模型的局限性，在计算效率与精度之间取得平衡，提供了一种可广泛适用于多种材料的实用预测框架。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理的简化形式论，介于简谐三参数模型与完整自能方法之间，包含四声子散射和声子重整化等非谐效应。

papers.title: Disentangling the origin of degradation in perovskite solar cells via optical imaging and Bayesian inference
papers.abstract: Machine learning and computational inference, coupled with experimental data, promise to significantly accelerate our rate of learning in most scientific disciplines. In this study, we develop tools that connect microscopic observations to macroscopic device behaviour, a capability that is essential for accelerating the design of durable energy materials. To this end, we introduce a novel approach that integrates photoluminescence imaging with drift diffusion simulations to understand operation and degradation in fully fabricated perovskite solar cells. By employing Bayesian inference, we generate "inferred maps" of parameters that govern recombination processes present in devices. We track these parameter maps while the devices are aged (70 °C, full spectrum sunlight) to analyse their temporal evolution during degradation. Notably, our approach allows us to distinguish between degradation occurring at the hole or electron transporting layer interface, or within the bulk. Our analysis reveals pronounced spatially non-uniform degradation, with significant macroscopic heterogeneity observed in the optoelectronic parameter maps. We pinpoint the greatest degradation observed in specific regions to stem from the perovskite/transport layer interfaces. Finally, we demonstrate that an amino-silane molecular passivation treatment suppresses this degradation, highlighting its specific role in enhancing device stability. Our approach offers valuable insights for future device fabrication and is a clear exemplification of how advanced Bayesian inference can significantly increase the value of experimental data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据关键词：photoluminescence imaging（实验）、drift diffusion simulations（计算）、Bayesian inference（计算推理）。；研究对象：钙钛矿太阳能电池（perovskite solar cells）在运行过程中的降解机制，特别是空穴/电子传输层界面及体相中的降解行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 钙钛矿太阳能电池的降解在空间上高度不均匀，主要降解源来自钙钛矿/传输层界面；氨基硅烷分子钝化处理可抑制该界面降解，提升器件稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：钙钛矿太阳能电池的降解在空间上高度不均匀，主要降解源来自钙钛矿/传输层界面；氨基硅烷分子钝化处理可抑制该界面降解，提升器件稳定性。；创新点：通过贝叶斯推断将微观光学成像与宏观器件行为定量关联，首次实现了对钙钛矿太阳能电池中不同位置（体相、空穴/电子传输层界面）降解贡献的空间分辨区分。
papers.method_zh: 光致发光成像（photoluminescence imaging）结合漂移-扩散模拟（drift diffusion simulations），并采用贝叶斯推断（Bayesian inference）生成器件中复合过程参数的空间分布图（inferred maps），追踪这些参数在老化（70°C、全光谱太阳光）过程中的时间演化。

papers.title: Holonomy Analysis of Optical-polarization Temperature Trajectories in Stress-induced Ferroelectric SrTiO$_3$
papers.abstract: We develop a data-induced geometric framework for temperature trajectories in optical-polarization data and apply it to temperature-dependent birefringence imaging of stress-induced ferroelectric SrTiO$_3$. By treating the measured response as an observable projection of local material states, the optical-polarization response at each pixel is cast as a trajectory along the temperature axis. Singular value decomposition separates trajectory-induced geometric objects associated with optical-polarization-direction structure and temperature-evolution modes. Holonomies are then defined by transporting these objects around closed loops in real space. The resulting maps reveal spatially localized connection mismatches correlated with an enhanced ferroelectric transition temperature and stress-related optical anisotropy. Local order parameters and angular-gradient analyses confirm that these loop-level signals are distinct from orientational disorder and simple spatial variation. The signed holonomy of the temperature-evolution modes further resolves positive and negative connection structures under a fixed frame convention. These results demonstrate that the data-induced connection geometry of temperature trajectories provides an experimentally accessible diagnostic of electromechanical inhomogeneity in SrTiO$_3$ under stress, without explicitly reconstructing hidden strain or electric-polarization fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要提及“birefringence imaging”（双折射成像）实验手段，以及“optical-polarization data”（光学偏振数据）的测量。；研究对象：应力诱导铁电体 SrTiO₃（钛酸锶）在温度变化下的光学偏振响应，具体关注其电-力不均匀性（electromechanical inhomogeneity）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过分析光学偏振温度轨迹的几何结构（holonomy，和乐），发现空间局域的连接失配与增强的铁电转变温度及应力相关光学各向异性相关，且该信号不同于取向无序或简单空间变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过分析光学偏振温度轨迹的几何结构（holonomy，和乐），发现空间局域的连接失配与增强的铁电转变温度及应力相关光学各向异性相关，且该信号不同于取向无序或简单空间变化。；创新点：提出一种数据诱导的几何框架，通过温度轨迹的和乐分析直接诊断应力下 SrTiO₃ 中的电-力不均匀性，无需显式重构隐藏的应变或电极化场。
papers.method_zh: 采用温度依赖的双折射成像（temperature-dependent birefringence imaging）获取每个像素的光学偏振响应，将其视为沿温度轴的轨迹；利用奇异值分解（SVD）分离轨迹相关的几何对象（偏振方向结构和温度演化模式），并在实空间闭合回路中定义和计算和乐（holonomy）。

papers.title: Collective alignment controls rotation frustration in granular flows of elongated particles
papers.abstract: Dense granular flows made of elongated particles exhibit a strong inhibition of particle rotation compared to spherical grains, but the mechanisms responsible for this effect remain unclear. Using three-dimensional discrete element simulations, we investigate the angular dynamics of elongated particles in dense, confined shear flows. We systematically vary particle aspect ratio, interparticle friction, and boundary conditions to elucidate their respective roles. We show that the reduction of the average angular velocity cannot be attributed to particle shape, friction, or solid fraction alone. Instead, it is controlled by the degree of collective alignment developed under shear, quantified by a nematic order parameter. Based on this observation, we propose a simple scaling law linking the average angular velocity to the local shear rate through a hampering parameter that depends solely on the orientational order via the nematic order parameter. This scaling successfully collapses data obtained for different particle properties (shape, friction), different flow patterns, and, remarkably, remains valid for two additional flow configurations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：three-dimensional discrete element simulations，三维离散元模拟）；研究对象：由细长颗粒组成的密集颗粒流中颗粒旋转受抑制的物理现象，具体涉及颗粒长径比、颗粒间摩擦及边界条件对旋转动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 细长颗粒在密集剪切流中平均角速度的降低并非由颗粒形状、摩擦或固体分数单独决定，而是受剪切下颗粒集体排列程度（由向列序参数量化）的控制。基于此，提出了一个将平均角速度与局部剪切率关联的标度律，该标度律对不同颗粒属性、流动模式及额外两种流动构型均有效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：细长颗粒在密集剪切流中平均角速度的降低并非由颗粒形状、摩擦或固体分数单独决定，而是受剪切下颗粒集体排列程度（由向列序参数量化）的控制。基于此，提出了一个将平均角速度与局部剪切率关联的标度律，该标度律对不同颗粒属性、流动模式及额外两种流动构型均有效。；创新点：揭示了集体排列（向列序）而非单一颗粒属性是控制旋转抑制的关键机制，并提出了仅依赖于向列序参量的阻碍参数（hampering parameter）的标度律，该标度律具有跨构型的普适性。
papers.method_zh: 三维离散元模拟（3D discrete element simulations），系统变化颗粒长径比、颗粒间摩擦系数及边界条件。

papers.title: A solvable model for unsupervised federated learning
papers.abstract: We introduce a theoretical framework for analyzing federated learning in a generative setting through a teacher-multiple interacting students scenario, in which each student receives a distinct realization of the data, either through a different noise corruption or by accessing a different subset, possibly of varying size. Using theoretical tools in equilibrium disordered system, we analytically show that interactions among students systematically enhance learning performance: highly noisy students require fewer samples to recover the underlying pattern, while low-noise students achieve a larger overlap with the ground-truth signal. We derive the optimal Bayesian conditions for teacher recovery as functions of the sample complexity, noise level, and interaction strength, and validate these predictions through numerical simulations. The resulting dynamics can be mapped onto equilibrium sampling in a Restricted Boltzmann Machine with a structured hidden layer, providing a principled theoretical understanding of how interactions improve distributed generative modeling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical framework、analytically show、theoretical tools、equilibrium disordered system、mapped onto equilibrium sampling。；研究对象：无监督联邦学习中的生成模型，具体为教师-多学生交互场景下的分布式生成建模问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 学生之间的相互作用能系统性提升学习性能：高噪声学生需要更少样本恢复底层模式，低噪声学生能获得与真实信号更大的重叠。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：学生之间的相互作用能系统性提升学习性能：高噪声学生需要更少样本恢复底层模式，低噪声学生能获得与真实信号更大的重叠。；创新点：将联邦学习中的学生交互动力学映射为具有结构化隐藏层的受限玻尔兹曼机的平衡采样，为理解交互如何改善分布式生成建模提供了原理性理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 使用平衡无序系统的理论工具（如统计物理中的自旋玻璃理论、受限玻尔兹曼机映射）进行解析分析，并通过数值模拟验证理论预测。

papers.title: A Geometric Design Principle for $\mathbb{Z}_2$ Topological Phases in Twisted Triangular-Lattice Bilayers
papers.abstract: Twisted van der Waals bilayers provide a versatile platform for engineering moiré electronic states, yet a general design principle for time-reversal-invariant topological moiré bands remains elusive. Here, we establish a geometry-driven principle for triangular-lattice bilayers: symmetry-related minima of the stacking-energy landscape are promoted by twist and relaxation into the two sublattices of an emergent honeycomb moiré lattice. First-principles calculations for BiTeBr reveal robust $Γ$-valley moiré valence bands with a nontrivial $\mathbb{Z}_2$ index over a range of twist angles. A four-band Wannier Hamiltonian in the emergent honeycomb basis quantitatively maps these bands onto an extended Kane--Mele model. An out-of-plane electric field drives a transition to a trivial phase by enhancing the Rashba coupling $λ_R$ relative to the intrinsic Kane--Mele coupling $λ_{\rm SO}$. The same honeycomb reconstruction and Kane--Mele mechanism are verified in representative additional triangular-lattice bilayers, establishing stacking reconstruction as a general, geometry-controlled route to electrically tunable moiré quantum spin Hall materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“First-principles calculations”、“Wannier Hamiltonian”、“Kane–Mele model”。；研究对象：扭曲三角晶格双层体系中的拓扑莫尔能带，具体以BiTeBr双层为代表，并推广至其他三角晶格双层材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于几何结构的设计原理：通过扭曲和弛豫，堆叠能量景观中对称性相关的极小点会演化为一个蜂巢状莫尔晶格的两个子晶格，从而在三角晶格双层中实现具有非平庸$\mathbb{Z}_2$拓扑指数的莫尔能带。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于几何结构的设计原理：通过扭曲和弛豫，堆叠能量景观中对称性相关的极小点会演化为一个蜂巢状莫尔晶格的两个子晶格，从而在三角晶格双层中实现具有非平庸$\mathbb{Z}_2$拓扑指数的莫尔能带。；创新点：揭示了“堆叠重构”（stacking reconstruction）作为一种普适的、由几何结构控制的途径，用于实现电学可调的莫尔量子自旋霍尔材料。摘要未突出说明与具体实验结果的对比。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（First-principles calculations）用于计算BiTeBr的电子结构；构建了基于涌现蜂巢基组的四带Wannier哈密顿量，并将其定量映射到扩展的Kane-Mele模型上。

papers.title: Observation of orbital-angular-momentum-driven temperature modulation via the spin Peltier effect
papers.abstract: Angular-momentum transport provides a pathway for controlling energy flow in solids beyond conventional charge-based mechanisms. While spin currents are known to mediate spin-caloritronic phenomena such as the spin Peltier effect (SPE), the role of orbital angular momentum in heat transport remains largely unexplored. Here we demonstrate orbital-angular-momentum-driven temperature modulation via the SPE in yttrium iron garnet/Pt/CuOx heterostructures. Using wedge-shaped CuOx layers combined with spatially resolved active thermal measurement techniques, we map the continuous thickness dependence and quantitatively disentangle the spin- and orbital-current-mediated contributions within a single device. The orbital-mediated component exhibits a pronounced maximum at an intermediate thickness, revealing a characteristic length scale for interfacial orbital-angular-momentum generation and propagation at the Cu/CuOx interface. These results provide direct experimental evidence that charge-current-driven orbital angular momentum can drive SPE-induced temperature modulation, establishing interfacial orbital processes as an additional channel for heat transport and providing a pathway toward spin-orbit caloritronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验观测、样品制备（wedge-shaped CuOx layers）和测量技术（spatially resolved active thermal measurement techniques）。；研究对象：钇铁石榴石（YIG）/Pt/CuOx异质结中的轨道角动量驱动温度调制现象，具体涉及自旋Peltier效应（SPE）和轨道Peltier效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验证明电荷电流驱动的轨道角动量可以通过自旋Peltier效应引起温度调制，并在Cu/CuOx界面处发现轨道角动量的产生与传播具有特征长度尺度，在中间厚度处出现轨道介导分量的显著最大值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验证明电荷电流驱动的轨道角动量可以通过自旋Peltier效应引起温度调制，并在Cu/CuOx界面处发现轨道角动量的产生与传播具有特征长度尺度，在中间厚度处出现轨道介导分量的显著最大值。；创新点：首次直接实验证实轨道角动量可以驱动自旋Peltier效应引起的温度调制，将界面轨道过程确立为热输运的额外通道，为自旋-轨道热电子学（spin-orbit caloritronics）提供了实验基础。
papers.method_zh: 采用楔形CuOx层结合空间分辨主动热测量技术，在同一器件中连续映射厚度依赖关系，并定量分离出自旋流和轨道流介导的贡献。

papers.title: A micromagnetic model with bidirectional magneto-thermal coupling
papers.abstract: Most conventional micromagnetic frameworks in spin caloritronics rely on a unidirectional coupling approximation, wherein thermal fluctuations drive magnetization dynamics while the feedback of magnetic dissipation onto the thermal reservoir is neglected. Here, we establish a rigorously self-consistent bidirectional magneto-thermal coupling model by integrating the stochastic Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (sLLG) equation with a generalized heat transfer equation. In this closed-loop framework, the local temperature acts as a dynamical variable, and the damping-induced dissipation alongside stochastic work dynamically feeds back into the thermal bath as localized heat sources. Utilizing Ito stochastic calculus, we analytically prove that this coupled system strictly obeys the first law of thermodynamics and spontaneously recovers the correct Boltzmann statistics at equilibrium. Spatially resolved micromagnetic simulations further validate the energy exchange mechanism, capturing the finite-bath temperature reduction induced by spatial variation of magnetic moments and the modified density of states under exchange interactions. This bidirectional framework provides a robust microscopic foundation for investigating complex nonequilibrium magneto-thermal dynamics, such as the unidirectional spin-wave heat conveyer effect, paving the way for advanced spin-caloritronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：micromagnetic model, stochastic Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation, generalized heat transfer equation, Ito stochastic calculus）；研究对象：自旋热电子学中的磁热耦合动力学，具体为磁化动力学与热库之间的双向能量交换过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了严格自洽的双向磁热耦合模型，证明该模型严格遵循热力学第一定律并在平衡态自发恢复正确的玻尔兹曼统计；模拟揭示了磁矩空间变化导致的有限热库温度降低以及交换相互作用下态密度的修正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了严格自洽的双向磁热耦合模型，证明该模型严格遵循热力学第一定律并在平衡态自发恢复正确的玻尔兹曼统计；模拟揭示了磁矩空间变化导致的有限热库温度降低以及交换相互作用下态密度的修正。；创新点：突破了传统自旋热电子学框架中单向耦合（仅考虑热涨落驱动磁化动力学，忽略磁耗散对热库的反馈）的近似，首次实现了磁化动力学与热库温度作为动态变量的闭环双向耦合。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导结合数值模拟：将随机Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert（sLLG）方程与广义热传导方程耦合，利用Ito随机微积分进行解析证明，并开展空间分辨的微磁学模拟。

papers.title: Conditional spinodal decomposition in Li-Mg anodes for lithium metal batteries
papers.abstract: The development of batteries with high energy density, short charging times and use of sustainable materials is critical for decarbonization. Magnesium (Mg)-based anodes for lithium (Li) metal batteries promote homogeneous Li plating, thereby avoiding the formation of Li dendrites that cause short circuits and battery failure. However, microstructural modifications induced by Li-alloying and their influence on battery operation remain elusive. Here, we unveil the previously unknown formation of an ordered B2 phase, which creates a conditional spinodal decomposition with the \b{eta}-body-centered cubic phase. Chemical fluctuations characteristic of spinodal decomposition give rise to uniformly dispersed Li-rich \b{eta}-BCC and Li-poor B2 continuous interconnected phases, with the former providing a fast diffusion pathway for Li diffusion towards the anode, hence decreasing the propensity for dendrite formation at elevated current density. This is achieved using Earth-abundant and inexpensive Mg.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“unveil the previously unknown formation”（揭示未知形成）、“microstructural modifications”（微观结构变化）等实验发现性表述，且未提及计算或理论方法关键词。；研究对象：锂金属电池中锂-镁（Li-Mg）合金负极的微观结构，特别是由Li合金化诱导的调幅分解（spinodal decomposition）现象及其对电池性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现Li-Mg负极中形成有序B2相，该相与β-体心立方（β-BCC）相发生条件性调幅分解，产生均匀分散的富锂β-BCC相和贫锂B2相连续互穿结构，其中富锂相为锂扩散提供快速通道，从而在高电流密度下抑制枝晶形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现Li-Mg负极中形成有序B2相，该相与β-体心立方（β-BCC）相发生条件性调幅分解，产生均匀分散的富锂β-BCC相和贫锂B2相连续互穿结构，其中富锂相为锂扩散提供快速通道，从而在高电流密度下抑制枝晶形成。；创新点：首次揭示Li-Mg负极中B2相与β-BCC相之间的条件性调幅分解现象，并阐明其通过形成均匀互穿结构促进锂扩散、抑制枝晶的机制，且所用材料为地球储量丰富且廉价的镁。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如X射线衍射、透射电镜、电化学测试等），仅提及对微观结构变化的观察与分析。

papers.title: Continuum Neural Momentum Eigenstate for Variationally Solving Quasiparticles
papers.abstract: We design the first neural quantum state for continuum particles that, for any chosen allowed momentum $\mathbf{k}$, is by construction an exact eigenstate of total momentum with eigenvalue $\mathbf{k}$. Our architecture, EVE, enables off-the-shelf VMC to solve for momentum-sector ground states. We test EVE on 2D bosons with mutual $1/r$ interactions, finding that a single unified ansatz is capable of describing four qualitatively different states: superfluid, roton, crystal, and phonon. At different densities, we extract the underlying phase of matter from the dispersion's shape. At $r_s = 20.0$, we see the roton minimum at finite $k$ expected of a superfluid. At $r_s = 100.0$, we see striking zone folding indicative of crystalline order, with periodically spaced minima representing floating crystals connected by phonon arcs in between. Using density-density correlation functions, we confirm the phase diagnoses and probe the excitations' correlation structures. Finally, we analyze the roton's phase texture and find unexpected multi-particle phase strings, formed when several vortex dipoles merge, leaving two vortices connected by a phase slip.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：neural quantum state、VMC（变分蒙特卡洛）、architecture、ansatz。；研究对象：连续空间中的多粒子量子系统，具体测试体系为二维玻色子体系，粒子间具有1/r相互作用（库仑相互作用），研究其在不同密度下的基态和激发态（超流、旋子、晶体、声子）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 设计了一种名为EVE的连续体神经量子态架构，能够通过构造精确满足任意给定总动量本征值，并利用变分蒙特卡洛方法求解动量空间基态。在二维玻色子体系中，单一统一变分形式成功描述了超流、旋子、晶体和声子四种截然不同的物态，并揭示了旋子激发中的多粒子相位弦结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：设计了一种名为EVE的连续体神经量子态架构，能够通过构造精确满足任意给定总动量本征值，并利用变分蒙特卡洛方法求解动量空间基态。在二维玻色子体系中，单一统一变分形式成功描述了超流、旋子、晶体和声子四种截然不同的物态，并揭示了旋子激发中的多粒子相位弦结构。；创新点：首次设计了针对连续粒子、且能精确满足任意给定总动量本征值的神经量子态架构，使得VMC可以直接求解动量空间基态。摘要未突出说明与已有连续体神经量子态方法的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用神经网络量子态（neural quantum state）架构EVE，结合变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）方法。通过构造使波函数自动成为总动量算符的本征态，从而直接求解特定动量扇区的基态。利用色散关系形状和密度-密度关联函数分析物相及激发关联结构。

papers.title: Quantum charge pumping in helical systems: A comparative study of short- and long-range hopping
papers.abstract: Using the Keldysh non-equilibrium Green's function approach, we investigate charge pumping through a single-stranded helical structure described by a tight-binding model that includes either short-range hopping (SRH) or long-range hopping (LRH). While quantum pumping has been studied in various low-dimensional systems, the detailed behavior of the spectral current and the pumped dc current in helical geometries in the presence of higher-order electron hopping (beyond nearest neighbors) has not yet been systematically explored. Here, we focus on the interplay between helicity and extended hopping ranges, analyzing how they jointly control the energy-resolved and dc pumped currents under time-periodic end potentials. For LRH, the pumped dc current exhibits pronounced plateau-like regions as a function of chemical potential when energy levels are sparsely spaced -- consistent with adiabatic transport -- whereas SRH yields more parameter-sensitive currents without clear plateaus. The plateau stability is controlled by the drive frequency: at higher frequencies, Floquet side-band mixing destroys the plateaus, leading to oscillatory currents. The phase dependence remains nearly sinusoidal, and the current vanishes at zero phase lag, confirming the necessity of out-of-phase potentials. Crucially, in helical systems, the decay exponent $(\ell_c)$ acts as an effective structural parameter that can tune both the magnitude and sign of the pumped current, offering a geometric knob for controlling quantum pumping. Our findings not only fill a gap in the understanding of spectral and pumped currents in helical systems with extended hopping but also provide tools that can be applied to analyze similar phenomena in other chiral or quasi-one-dimensional systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：使用Keldysh非平衡格林函数方法进行理论计算，未涉及实验数据。；研究对象：单链螺旋结构中的量子电荷泵浦现象，具体研究短程跳跃（SRH）与长程跳跃（LRH）两种紧束缚模型下的输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 长程跳跃（LRH）下，泵浦直流电流在化学势变化时呈现明显的平台状区域（与绝热输运一致），而短程跳跃（SRH）则产生参数敏感的无平台电流。螺旋结构的衰减指数（ℓ_c）可作为有效结构参数，调控泵浦电流的大小和符号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：长程跳跃（LRH）下，泵浦直流电流在化学势变化时呈现明显的平台状区域（与绝热输运一致），而短程跳跃（SRH）则产生参数敏感的无平台电流。螺旋结构的衰减指数（ℓ_c）可作为有效结构参数，调控泵浦电流的大小和符号。；创新点：首次系统探索了螺旋几何结构中高阶电子跳跃（超越最近邻）对谱电流和泵浦直流电流的详细行为，揭示了螺旋性、扩展跳跃范围与驱动频率对泵浦电流的联合调控机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用Keldysh非平衡格林函数方法，对包含短程或长程跳跃的紧束缚模型进行理论分析，研究时间周期端势驱动下的能量分辨谱电流和直流泵浦电流。

papers.title: Leveraging rapid sintering to retain metastable zirconia in copper
papers.abstract: Cermets combining metastable ceramics and ductile metals promise superior toughness and strength. However, retaining metastability often requires high-temperature sintering that coarsens microstructures and relaxes matrix constraint. Here we introduce an ultrafast high-temperature sintering (UHS) strategy to overcome this trade-off in zirconia-copper cermets. By applying Joule heating at around 100 degrees C per second to 900 degrees C with only a 20 second hold, we obtained cermets containing up to 50 weight percent of metastable austenite in zirconia at room temperature within a fine-grained and homogeneous microstructure. The rapid sintering kinetically favors semi-thermal austenite formation while suppressing copper grain growth and matrix relaxation, thereby stabilizing the high-temperature phase and simultaneously preserving microstructural refinement. This approach offers significant potential for copper-based composites in applications such as transformation toughening, self-healing, and crack detection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“引入超快高温烧结（UHS）策略”、“施加焦耳加热”等具体实验手段。；研究对象：陶瓷-金属复合材料（cermets），具体为氧化锆-铜（zirconia-copper）复合材料，重点研究其中亚稳态氧化锆的保留与微观结构控制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过超快高温烧结（UHS）策略，在铜基复合材料中成功保留了高达50重量%的亚稳态氧化锆（室温下为奥氏体相），同时获得了细晶、均匀的微观结构，克服了传统高温烧结中微观结构粗化和基体约束松弛的权衡问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过超快高温烧结（UHS）策略，在铜基复合材料中成功保留了高达50重量%的亚稳态氧化锆（室温下为奥氏体相），同时获得了细晶、均匀的微观结构，克服了传统高温烧结中微观结构粗化和基体约束松弛的权衡问题。；创新点：提出并验证了利用超快高温烧结（UHS）在动力学上促进半热奥氏体形成、同时抑制铜晶粒长大和基体松弛的策略，从而在保持微观结构细化的前提下稳定高温亚稳相。摘要未突出说明与传统烧结方法的具体性能对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 超快高温烧结（UHS）技术：以约100°C/秒的升温速率加热至900°C，仅保温20秒，利用焦耳加热实现快速烧结。

papers.title: A wrong ground-state structure of HfO$_2$ predicted by machine-learning interatomic potentials based on the PBE functional
papers.abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have become powerful tools for material simulations. Many MLIPs are trained based on density functional theory (DFT) datasets generated with the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) exchange-correlation functional. Using a PBE-based MLIP for HfO2, we identify a previously unreported low-energy I41/amd structure, which is predicted to be more stable than the well-known ground-state structure, the monoclinic P21/c structure. Since experiments show clearly that HfO2 takes the P21/c structure as the ground state, this is obviously a wrong prediction. Unfortunately, the same prediction is also made by widely used PBE-based foundation models such as NequIP-OAM-L and MatterSim-v1-5M. Comparisons among different DFT functionals show that this error originates from the PBE functional, which overstabilizes low-density structures containing sixfold Hf-O octahedral units, such as the I41/amd and Pbcn phases. The error also affects the calculated energy landscapes and barrier heights along ferroelectric HfO2 polarization switching paths when there are large lattice relaxations. Fortunately, the error can be largely suppressed by other functionals such as PBEsol and local density approximation. Our study serves as a warning about the impact of errors in exchange-correlation functional approximations on the reliability of MLIP simulations of crystal structures and phase transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：基于密度泛函理论（DFT）数据集训练的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）进行结构预测，并对比不同泛函的计算结果。；研究对象：二氧化铪（HfO₂）的晶体结构，特别是其基态结构（单斜P21/c结构）与一个被错误预测为更稳定的四方I41/amd结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于PBE泛函训练的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）错误地预测HfO₂的基态为I41/amd结构，而非实验上公认的单斜P21/c结构。该错误源于PBE泛函本身过度稳定了含有六配位Hf-O八面体单元的低密度结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于PBE泛函训练的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）错误地预测HfO₂的基态为I41/amd结构，而非实验上公认的单斜P21/c结构。该错误源于PBE泛函本身过度稳定了含有六配位Hf-O八面体单元的低密度结构。；创新点：首次明确指出并系统分析了基于PBE泛函的机器学习原子间势在预测HfO₂基态结构时产生的系统性错误，揭示了该错误源于PBE泛函本身而非机器学习模型，并警告了交换关联泛函近似误差对MLIP模拟晶体结构和相变可靠性的影响。
papers.method_zh: 使用基于PBE泛函训练的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）进行结构预测，并与广泛使用的PBE基础模型（如NequIP-OAM-L和MatterSim-v1-5M）的结果进行对比。通过比较不同DFT泛函（PBE、PBEsol、局域密度近似LDA）的计算结果来追溯误差来源。

papers.title: When proofreading improves both speed and accuracy
papers.abstract: Proofreading is generally thought to improve accuracy at the expense of speed. We show that this trade-off can be reversed in stochastic processes with long-lived stalled states. Using a non-Markovian renewal framework, we derive exact expressions for the error rate and completion time under proofreading for arbitrary stall-time distributions. Our analysis reveals that fluctuations in stall durations, rather than their mean alone, determine whether proofreading can simultaneously increase speed and accuracy. In the limit of strong stalling, this regime emerges when the coefficient of variation of the stall time exceeds a threshold set by the intrinsic error rate. These results provide a general criterion for proofreading in systems ranging from self-assembly and polymer replication to immune recognition and other nonequilibrium information-processing systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：non-Markovian renewal framework、exact expressions、theoretical analysis。；研究对象：校对机制（proofreading）在随机过程中的动力学行为，具体涉及自组装、聚合物复制、免疫识别等非平衡信息处理系统中的校对过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有长寿命停滞态的随机过程中，校对机制可以同时提高速度和准确性，打破传统认为的“准确性以速度为代价”的权衡关系。停滞时间波动的变异系数超过由内在错误率设定的阈值时，这一新机制就会出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有长寿命停滞态的随机过程中，校对机制可以同时提高速度和准确性，打破传统认为的“准确性以速度为代价”的权衡关系。停滞时间波动的变异系数超过由内在错误率设定的阈值时，这一新机制就会出现。；创新点：揭示了停滞时间的统计涨落（而非仅平均时长）是决定校对能否同时提升速度与准确性的关键因素，并给出了强停滞极限下实现该效应的通用判据（变异系数阈值）。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用非马尔可夫更新框架（non-Markovian renewal framework），推导了任意停滞时间分布下校对过程的错误率和完成时间的精确表达式，并分析了停滞时间波动（而非仅平均值）对性能的影响。

papers.title: Molecular reference corrections for quantum Monte Carlo adsorption energies
papers.abstract: Accurate surface thermochemistry requires balanced error cancellation between extended slabs and molecular reference states. This balance can fail whenever the electronic-structure error is not transferable across the chemically distinct species entering a thermodynamic cycle. Here we examine this problem in single-determinant fixed-node diffusion Monte Carlo (SD-FNDMC) for oxygenated ORR intermediates on Pt(111). Gas-phase thermochemistry is used to diagnose the reference-state imbalance, and a hybrid cycle is introduced to separate slab-adsorbate binding from molecular formation. The hybrid cycle keeps the surface binding term at the SD-FNDMC level, where cancellation is expected to be most favorable, and replaces the molecular formation contribution with a benchmark coupled cluster reference. For Pt(111), the resulting correction is small for O and OH but larger for OOH, while the geometry-matched refinement gives only a secondary correction. Applying the same cycle to HCO and COH on Cu(111) gives corrections of opposite sign, showing that the bias is controlled primarily by the electronic structure of the molecular reference rather than by adsorbate geometry alone. This decomposition identifies molecular reference imbalance as a separable source of error in SD-FNDMC surface thermochemistry and reduces the corresponding bias without modifying the SD-FNDMC slab-binding contribution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：量子蒙特卡洛、耦合簇、热化学循环。；研究对象：凝聚态表面热化学，具体为氧还原反应（ORR）中间体（O, OH, OOH）在Pt(111)表面，以及HCO和COH在Cu(111)表面的吸附能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单行列式固定节点扩散蒙特卡洛（SD-FNDMC）计算中，分子参考态的不平衡是表面热化学误差的一个可分离来源。通过引入混合热化学循环，用高精度耦合簇基准替换分子形成能部分，可以有效修正该偏差，且修正符号主要由分子参考态的电子结构决定，而非吸附质几何结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单行列式固定节点扩散蒙特卡洛（SD-FNDMC）计算中，分子参考态的不平衡是表面热化学误差的一个可分离来源。通过引入混合热化学循环，用高精度耦合簇基准替换分子形成能部分，可以有效修正该偏差，且修正符号主要由分子参考态的电子结构决定，而非吸附质几何结构。；创新点：提出了一种诊断和修正SD-FNDMC表面热化学中分子参考态不平衡误差的混合循环方法，将误差来源（分子参考态）与表面结合能计算（SD-FNDMC）分离开来，从而在不修改SD-FNDMC slab结合能贡献的前提下减少偏差。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用单行列式固定节点扩散蒙特卡洛（SD-FNDMC）方法计算表面结合能，并结合气相热化学诊断参考态不平衡。引入了一个混合热化学循环，将表面吸附项保留在SD-FNDMC水平，而将分子形成能贡献替换为基准耦合簇（Coupled Cluster）参考值。

papers.title: Revealing nonvolatile behaviors in magneto-thermal switching using microstructure-controlled superconducting composites
papers.abstract: Thermal conductivity in a conductor changes by the application of an external magnetic field, which functions as a magneto-thermal switch. For superconductors, a large magneto-thermal switching can occur through a superconducting-to-normal conducting phase transition due to the change in the electron contribution in thermal conductivity. Arima et al. recently reported a nonvolatile nature of the magneto-thermal switching for superconducting solders, which consist of phase-separated Sn and Pb domains. Although they clarified that magnetic flux trapping is required to induce the nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching, a rule for such material design is still unclear. Here, we investigate the microstructure dependence of magneto-thermal switching in superconducting Sn/Pb multilayered composites, which are created by an accumulative roll bonding method. The thickness of each layer, that is the scale of microstructure, can be systematically controlled by the repetition number of roll bonding while the whole sample size and average composition are unchanged. We find that, as the formation of micro-scaled Sn domains proceeds by increasing the repetition number, a nonvolatility in the magneto-thermal conductivity gradually appears in correlation with the remanent magnetization. This study directly confirms that the inclusions with a size comparable to or less than the magnetic vortex in superconducting matrix is essential for magnetic flux trapping, enabling the nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching in superconducting composites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验制备方法（accumulative roll bonding method）和测量手段（磁热导率、剩磁测量）。；研究对象：超导Sn/Pb多层复合材料的微观结构对磁热开关非易失性的影响。具体体系为通过累积轧制法制备的Sn/Pb多层膜，其中Sn和Pb形成相分离的层状结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当超导基体中形成尺寸与磁通涡旋相当或更小的Sn畴区时，能够有效捕获磁通，从而在超导复合材料中实现非易失性磁热开关效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当超导基体中形成尺寸与磁通涡旋相当或更小的Sn畴区时，能够有效捕获磁通，从而在超导复合材料中实现非易失性磁热开关效应。；创新点：直接证实了超导基体中尺寸与磁通涡旋相当或更小的夹杂物是捕获磁通、实现非易失性磁热开关的关键微观结构条件，为这类材料的设计提供了明确规则。
papers.method_zh: 采用累积轧制法制备Sn/Pb多层复合材料，通过改变轧制重复次数系统调控各层厚度（即微观结构尺度），同时保持样品整体尺寸和平均成分不变。测量了磁热导率与剩磁的关联性。

papers.title: Intrinsic Ductility from Shear Amorphization: From Pure Metals to Multi-Principal-Element Alloys
papers.abstract: Direct links between electronic structure and intrinsic ductility remain elusive for metals. A framework is proposed that reduces the complexities of valence charge distribution, band filling, and shear strain effects into structure-property relationships describing the intrinsic ductility of metals and alloys. Rather than relying on crystal cleavage and dislocation nucleation at preexisting crack tips, we show that a lower energy fracture criterion, i.e., the activation energy density for amorphization, enables accurate predictions of both intrinsic ductility and ductile-to-brittle transition temperatures. From analytical expressions and tabulated ab-initio stiffness constants, lattice parameters, and binary interaction energies, we present a unified theory that reconciles ductile flow in pure metals and solid-solution alloys. Phase diagrams generated for the Nb-Ta-V-Ti system simultaneously explain its high strength and room-temperature tensile ductility, validating this framework as a practical one for rapid design of structural multi-principal-element alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：framework proposed、analytical expressions、ab-initio stiffness constants、phase diagrams generated）；研究对象：金属及多主元合金的本征延展性，具体包括纯金属和固溶体合金的剪切非晶化机制，以及Nb-Ta-V-Ti体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出以剪切非晶化的激活能密度作为更低能量的断裂判据，能够准确预测金属和合金的本征延展性及韧脆转变温度，并统一解释了纯金属和固溶体合金的延性流动行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出以剪切非晶化的激活能密度作为更低能量的断裂判据，能够准确预测金属和合金的本征延展性及韧脆转变温度，并统一解释了纯金属和固溶体合金的延性流动行为。；创新点：摒弃传统依赖预存裂纹尖端解理和位错成核的判据，首次将剪切非晶化的激活能密度作为本征延展性的统一判据，并建立了从纯金属到多主元合金的普适理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 基于电子结构分析，将价电荷分布、能带填充和剪切应变效应简化为结构-性能关系；利用第一性原理（ab-initio）计算的刚度常数、晶格参数和二元相互作用能，构建解析表达式和相图。

papers.title: Water Flow Through Polar and Non-Polar Nanopores: Insights from Multiscale Simulations
papers.abstract: Global water stress has emerged as a critical challenge, driving the search for advanced membrane materials that enable efficient, selective water filtration and transport. In this context, two-dimensional nanoporous membranes provide an ideal platform to elucidate how atomic-scale structure and electronic polarization govern water flow under extreme confinement. In this study, we employ multiscale simulations to investigate the effect of water flow through nanopores in graphene and hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) membranes. Our results reveal significantly higher water flow in hBN membranes than in graphene. This enhanced flow is attributed to the asymmetry of the hBN pores, which induces an electric dipole moment, as confirmed by quantum-mechanical (QM) calculations. Classical molecular dynamics simulations further demonstrate that water molecules exhibit a random distribution with no preferential orientation near the graphene pores, whereas hBN induces strong structuring. Furthermore, hybrid quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) simulations indicate that the dipole moment of the hBN pore increases in the presence of water, as evidenced by the average charge distribution. Conversely, the symmetric nature of graphene pores results in non-polar characteristics, as verified by both QM/MM and QM calculations. These findings provide valuable insights into the distinct water-transport properties when flowing through graphene and hBN nanopores, with potential implications for designing advanced nanofiltration membranes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：multiscale simulations、classical molecular dynamics、hybrid quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) simulations、quantum-mechanical (QM) calculations）；研究对象：水在石墨烯和六方氮化硼（hBN）纳米孔中的流动行为，以及原子尺度结构和电子极化对极端受限条件下水输运的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: hBN膜中的水流量显著高于石墨烯膜，这是由于hBN孔的不对称性诱导出电偶极矩，而石墨烯孔具有对称的非极性特征，导致水分子在孔附近无择优取向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：hBN膜中的水流量显著高于石墨烯膜，这是由于hBN孔的不对称性诱导出电偶极矩，而石墨烯孔具有对称的非极性特征，导致水分子在孔附近无择优取向。；创新点：通过多尺度模拟揭示了hBN纳米孔因结构不对称性产生的电偶极矩是增强水流动的关键机制，并对比了石墨烯孔的非极性特性，为设计先进纳滤膜提供了原子尺度的物理图像。
