papers.method_zh: 多尺度模拟，包括：量子力学（QM）计算、经典分子动力学（MD）模拟、以及混合量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）模拟。

papers.title: How alignment controls heat transport in polymer chains with kinks?
papers.abstract: Thermal transport in long polymer molecules is commonly attributed to ballistic propagation of long-wavelength acoustic phonons, which act as Goldstone modes arising from translational symmetry, while the transport of other phonons is suppressed by Anderson localization. This mechanism leads to thermal conductivity that increases with molecular length. Consistent with this picture, strongly aligned polymers exhibit exceptionally high thermal conductivity, whereas poorly aligned polymers are orders of magnitude less conductive and function as thermal insulators. Here we show that this strong sensitivity to molecular alignment originates from phonon scattering by molecular kinks. Even in the long-wavelength limit, the kink scattering remains strong because kinks break translational symmetry both for longitudinal and transverse phonons. As a result, randomly oriented kinks cause a rapid decrease in thermal conductivity with increasing molecular length. These findings identify alignment control by means of kink engineering as a route for tuning thermal transport in polymers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we show that”“originates from”“identify...as a route”等理论推导与机制分析表述，未提及具体实验或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：聚合物分子链中的热输运现象，特别是分子链中“扭结”（kinks）对热导率的影响机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 聚合物分子链中热导率对分子取向的强烈敏感性源于扭结对声子的散射：即使在长波极限下，扭结仍能破坏纵向和横向声子的平移对称性，导致随机取向的扭结使热导率随分子链长度增加而快速下降。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：聚合物分子链中热导率对分子取向的强烈敏感性源于扭结对声子的散射：即使在长波极限下，扭结仍能破坏纵向和横向声子的平移对称性，导致随机取向的扭结使热导率随分子链长度增加而快速下降。；创新点：揭示了扭结作为破坏平移对称性的关键缺陷，在长波极限下仍能强烈散射声子，从而解释了为何弱取向聚合物热导率比强取向聚合物低数个数量级，并提出“扭结工程”作为调控聚合物热输运的新途径。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架或计算手段，仅基于声子输运的物理图像（弹道输运、安德森局域化、对称性破缺散射）进行机制分析。

papers.title: Nonmonotonic temperature dependence of the thermopower of atomic-size gold contacts
papers.abstract: We report measurements of the thermopower of atomic-size gold contacts realized by the mechanically controllable break junction (MCBJ) technique over a temperature range from 18 K to 295 K. A thermometer included in the lithographic structure close to the constriction provides a direct measurement of the temperature increase generated by heating one side of the contact with a focused laser beam. While the conductance histograms confirm the quantum nature of the transport, we observe a nonmonotonic temperature dependence of the ensemble-averaged thermopower with a minimum of $-2\,μ$VK$^{-1}$ at about 150 K. The values for the thermopower obtained at the lowest and the high temperature are compatible with values reported in the literature, but the nonmonotonic behavior in between disagrees with the expected linear dependence for quantum coherent conductors described by the Landauer formula. We develop a theoretical model based on an energy dependent transmission function that qualitatively reproduces the nonmonotonic behavior, but fails quantitatively. We therefore interpret our data as a result of phonon contributions to the thermopower beyond the Landauer model and with opposite sign than the classical phonon drag known from bulk systems. Our findings show that, firstly, the thermopower gives important insight into the transport properties of atomic-size structures and second that the linear approximation of the Landauer model has to be used with caution when studying more complex transport properties even for atomic contacts from free-electron metals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：measurements、MCBJ technique、measurements of the thermopower）；研究对象：原子尺寸金接触（atomic-size gold contacts）的热电势（thermopower）随温度的变化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 原子尺寸金接触的系综平均热电势随温度呈非单调变化，在约150 K处出现最小值（-2 μV/K），这与Landauer公式预期的线性温度依赖关系不符，表明声子对热电势有贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：原子尺寸金接触的系综平均热电势随温度呈非单调变化，在约150 K处出现最小值（-2 μV/K），这与Landauer公式预期的线性温度依赖关系不符，表明声子对热电势有贡献。；创新点：首次在原子尺寸金接触中观察到热电势的非单调温度依赖行为，并指出该行为无法由Landauer模型定量描述，需引入与经典声子拖曳效应符号相反的声子贡献来解释。
papers.method_zh: 采用机械可控断裂结（MCBJ）技术制备原子尺寸金接触，在18 K至295 K温度范围内测量热电势；利用集成在微结构中的温度计直接测量聚焦激光加热一侧接触引起的温升；通过电导直方图确认输运的量子特性；并构建基于能量依赖透射函数的理论模型进行定性分析。

papers.title: Extending the La Solubility Limit in Sr$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$ through High-Pressure High-Temperature Synthesis
papers.abstract: La-doped bilayer iridates provide an important platform for studying the evolution of the spin-orbit-assisted Mott state under electron doping, but the La solubility achieved by conventional ambient-pressure synthesis is limited. Here, we report the synthesis and physical properties of nominally La-doped (Sr$_{1-x}$La$_x$)$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$ (x = 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, and 0.20) prepared using high-pressure high-temperature techniques. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction refinements, supported by scanning electron microscopy-energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (SEM-EDX), reveal significantly enhanced La incorporation, with nominal x = 0.05 and 0.15 corresponding to actual compositions of approximately (Sr$_{0.89}$La$_{0.11}$)$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$ and (Sr$_{0.77}$La$_{0.23}$)$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$, respectively. At nominal x = 0.20, the bilayer phase is no longer stabilized and instead transforms into cubic perovskite Sr$_{1-x}$La$_x$IrO$_3$. (Sr$_{0.89}$La$_{0.11}$)$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$ exhibits a ferromagnetic-like transition near 186 K accompanied by magnetic hysteresis and subtle lattice anomalies indicative of spin-lattice coupling. Despite its high electron-doping level, the compound remains strongly insulating, consistent with a heavily doped localized magnetic insulating state distinct from both parent Sr$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$ and ambient-pressure La-doped samples. In contrast, (Sr$_{0.77}$La$_{0.23}$)$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$ displays metal-like electronic behavior, weakened magnetic order, and enhanced carrier delocalization, although disorder-driven localization persists at low temperatures. These results demonstrate that high-pressure synthesis substantially extends the accessible doping range of bilayer iridates and reveals electronic and magnetic states inaccessible through conventional synthesis routes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“合成”、“物理性质”、“单晶X射线衍射”、“扫描电子显微镜-能量色散X射线光谱”等实验手段。；研究对象：La掺杂的双层铱氧化物 (Sr$_{1-x}$La$_x$)$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$。具体研究在高压高温合成条件下，La掺杂对该体系电子掺杂、磁性和输运性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高压高温合成，成功将La在Sr$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$中的固溶度显著提升至约23%（实际组分），并发现了两种截然不同的电子态：在中等掺杂（~11% La）时，体系呈现强绝缘性和铁磁-like转变；在高掺杂（~23% La）时，体系呈现类金属行为但低温下仍存在局域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高压高温合成，成功将La在Sr$_3$Ir$_2$O$_7$中的固溶度显著提升至约23%（实际组分），并发现了两种截然不同的电子态：在中等掺杂（~11% La）时，体系呈现强绝缘性和铁磁-like转变；在高掺杂（~23% La）时，体系呈现类金属行为但低温下仍存在局域化。；创新点：利用高压高温合成方法突破了传统常压合成对La掺杂浓度的限制，首次在双层铱氧化物中实现了更高电子掺杂水平，并揭示了常压合成无法获得的电子和磁学新相（如高掺杂下的类金属态）。
papers.method_zh: 高压高温合成技术；单晶X射线衍射（SC-XRD）进行结构精修；扫描电子显微镜-能量色散X射线光谱（SEM-EDX）进行成分分析；磁性和电输运性质测量。

papers.title: Role of quantum confinement in semiconductor-superconductor core-shell nanowires
papers.abstract: This work is motivated by the experimentally observed coherence of the supercurrent in semiconductor nanowires covered by a half-shell metallic superconductor, which leads to flux dependent supercurrent oscillations with period h/2e, as expected for a tubular superconductor, i.e. Little-Parks oscillations. We perform microscopic model calculations and compare the results for full and half metallic shells. We use an effective Hamiltonian derived from the Green's function of the proximitized semiconductor nanowire, where the presence of the superconductor is represented by a self energy. Furthermore, we incorporate the electrostatic band-bending at the metal-semiconductor interface as a rectangular narrow quantum well on the semiconductor side. The properties of the eigenstates of the effective Hamiltonian are determined by the spatial profile of the corresponding transverse modes in the normal state. For half-shell wires, transverse modes with high-enough energy expand outside the interface quantum well and generate eigenstates with mixed electron-hole character that surround the entire circumference of the nanowire, similar to eigenstates of the full-shell system. We identify these states as being responsible for the observed Little-Parks effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：关键词“microscopic model calculations”、“effective Hamiltonian”、“Green's function”。；研究对象：半导体-超导体核壳纳米线（semiconductor-superconductor core-shell nanowires），具体研究全壳（full shell）与半壳（half shell）金属超导覆盖层对体系超流相干性的影响，以及由此产生的Little-Parks振荡现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在半壳纳米线中，能量足够高的横向模式会扩展到界面量子阱之外，产生环绕整个纳米线圆周的、具有混合电子-空穴特性的本征态，这些态是导致实验观测到的Little-Parks效应的关键。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在半壳纳米线中，能量足够高的横向模式会扩展到界面量子阱之外，产生环绕整个纳米线圆周的、具有混合电子-空穴特性的本征态，这些态是导致实验观测到的Little-Parks效应的关键。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于近邻化半导体纳米线的格林函数推导有效哈密顿量，将超导体的存在通过自能项表示；同时，在金属-半导体界面处引入一个矩形窄量子阱来模拟静电能带弯曲效应。通过分析正常态下横向模式的空间分布，确定有效哈密顿量本征态的性质。

papers.title: Site Preferences and "Coloring Problem" in Cu-doped BiMn$_7$O$_{12}$ Quadruple Perovskite
papers.abstract: Lightly Cu-doped BiMn$_7$O$_{12}$ (x = 0.05, 0.10, and 0.15) was investigated using high-pressure synthesis, single-crystal X-ray diffraction, pair distribution function (PDF) analysis, STEM, magnetic measurements, and first-principles calculations. All compositions retain an average monoclinic $I$2/$m$ structure, while Cu substitution progressively suppresses the monoclinic distortion and drives the lattice toward a pseudo-cubic metric symmetry. PDF analysis reveals increasing local structural disorder and reduced medium-range coherence with increasing Cu concentration, despite preservation of the overall quadruple-perovskite framework. Single-crystal refinements indicate enhanced electron density at the octahedral Mn B sites, suggesting preferential Cu occupation within the MnO$_6$ network rather than the conventional square-planar sites expected for Cu$^{2+}$. Magnetic measurements reveal two characteristic anomalies near $T_1$ ~ 100-120 K and $T_2$ ~ 50-60 K, together with pronounced magnetic irreversibility, field-dependent hysteresis, and unsaturated magnetization. Increasing Cu concentration progressively suppresses the low-temperature magnetic state and weakens the field-induced moment. First-principles calculations favor Cu occupation at the square-planar sites, contrasting with the experimental refinements and highlighting strong competitions among local bonding, short-range disorder, and metastability in this highly frustrated quadruple perovskite system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：高压合成、单晶X射线衍射、PDF分析、STEM、磁性测量、第一性原理计算。；研究对象：Cu掺杂的BiMn₇O₁₂四重钙钛矿材料（Cu浓度x=0.05, 0.10, 0.15），重点关注Cu的占位偏好及“着色问题”。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cu掺杂倾向于占据八面体Mn B位（而非预期的平面四方Cu²⁺位），但第一性原理计算却支持平面四方占位，表明该高度阻挫四重钙钛矿体系中存在局域成键、短程无序与亚稳态之间的强烈竞争。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cu掺杂倾向于占据八面体Mn B位（而非预期的平面四方Cu²⁺位），但第一性原理计算却支持平面四方占位，表明该高度阻挫四重钙钛矿体系中存在局域成键、短程无序与亚稳态之间的强烈竞争。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 高压合成、单晶X射线衍射、对分布函数（PDF）分析、扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）、磁性测量、第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Optical pulse-induced quantum geometric waves in graphene
papers.abstract: We show that, under a short optical pulse, the quantum metric of Bloch states in the momentum-time (kx, ky , t) of graphene becomes dynamic and exhibits a wave-like behavior near Dirac points. This quantum metric wave reflects the Floquet-band structure caused by the pulse, as revealed by solving the time-dependent Schrödinger equation assuming that correlations and out-of-equilibrium effects can be ignored. The momentum and temporal components of the metric have very distinct time dependence that persists even after the pulse has passed. In addition, the pulse also generates a Berry curvature wave that is otherwise absent in static graphene. The time-dependent electron densities in conduction and valence bands also give arise to a Fisher information wave that constitutes part of the quantum metric wave, and is readily measurable by pump-probe experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“通过求解含时薛定谔方程”“假设关联和非平衡效应可忽略”，未涉及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：石墨烯中由短光脉冲激发的量子几何波，具体包括动量-时间空间中的量子度量波、贝里曲率波以及Fisher信息波。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在短光脉冲作用下，石墨烯狄拉克点附近的布洛赫态量子度量呈现波动行为，并产生原本静态石墨烯中不存在的贝里曲率波；这些量子几何波在脉冲结束后仍持续存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在短光脉冲作用下，石墨烯狄拉克点附近的布洛赫态量子度量呈现波动行为，并产生原本静态石墨烯中不存在的贝里曲率波；这些量子几何波在脉冲结束后仍持续存在。；创新点：首次揭示光脉冲可在石墨烯中激发量子度量波和贝里曲率波，并指出Fisher信息波作为量子度量波的一部分可通过泵浦-探测实验直接测量。
papers.method_zh: 通过求解含时薛定谔方程（忽略关联和非平衡效应）分析脉冲诱导的Floquet能带结构，并计算量子度量、贝里曲率及Fisher信息的时间演化。

papers.title: Hall conductivity reveals the nature of quantum coherence in strongly correlated metals
papers.abstract: Linear-in-temperature resistivity is a hallmark for strange metallic transport, and appears universally in many strongly correlated electron systems. However, the focus on the longitudinal channel often overshadows the profound microscopic insights contained within the transverse response. Here, we utilize numerically exact determinantal quantum Monte Carlo simulations of the doped Hubbard model in a magnetic field to calculate longitudinal and transverse transport. We demonstrate that while the resistivity is robustly $T$-linear across parameter sets, the Hall response is highly sensitive to particle-hole asymmetry, Fermi surface topology, and many-body correlation effects. Specifically, the combination of these effects determine a crossover scale in which the system becomes quantum-coherent, and is reflected in the Hall conductivity. Our results demonstrate that while the $T$-linearity in resistivity appears universal, the Hall response reveals a crossover from semi-classical to quantum-coherent transport otherwise masked in the longitudinal channel.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：numerically exact determinantal quantum Monte Carlo simulations（数值精确的行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟）。；研究对象：强关联金属中的奇异金属输运现象，具体为掺杂哈伯德模型（doped Hubbard model）在磁场下的纵向和横向输运行为，聚焦于霍尔电导率所揭示的量子相干性本质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电阻率的线性温度依赖（T-linear resistivity）在不同参数下表现普适，但霍尔响应高度敏感于粒子-空穴不对称性、费米面拓扑和多体关联效应；这些效应共同决定了一个量子相干交叉尺度，该尺度在霍尔电导率中得以体现，而在纵向输运通道中被掩盖。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电阻率的线性温度依赖（T-linear resistivity）在不同参数下表现普适，但霍尔响应高度敏感于粒子-空穴不对称性、费米面拓扑和多体关联效应；这些效应共同决定了一个量子相干交叉尺度，该尺度在霍尔电导率中得以体现，而在纵向输运通道中被掩盖。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用数值精确的行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟（determinantal quantum Monte Carlo simulations），对磁场下的掺杂哈伯德模型进行纵向和横向输运计算。

papers.title: Lock-In Infrared Thermography: Phase Analysis for Rapid, Wide-Range Thermal Conductivity Measurements
papers.abstract: We report on a phase-based lock-in thermography approach, combined with a multilayered thermal model (often employed in thermoreflectance analysis), to measure the thermal conductivity of bulk materials and layered structures. The spatial distribution of the material's thermal phase is monitored with an infrared camera, which is locked into the frequency of a modulated laser used to heat the material. This phase distribution is then fit with a thermal model, in which properties such as thermal conductivity are extracted as fit parameters. This approach enables non-contact, front-side measurements, which are insensitive to surface roughness. The technique does not strictly require the application of a transducer layer, but we highlight the practical benefits of applying a removable adhesive layer to serve as a near-surface absorber. We demonstrate the efficacy of the method by measuring materials with thermal conductivities that span over three orders of magnitude (approximately 1 W/m/K to > 2000 W/m/K).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“lock-in thermography approach”、“infrared camera”、“measured”、“demonstrate the efficacy”。；研究对象：块体材料和层状结构的热导率测量。具体涵盖热导率范围约1 W/m/K至>2000 W/m/K的材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于锁相红外热成像的相位分析方法，结合多层热模型，能够非接触、正面测量热导率，且对表面粗糙度不敏感，可测量热导率跨越三个数量级的材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于锁相红外热成像的相位分析方法，结合多层热模型，能够非接触、正面测量热导率，且对表面粗糙度不敏感，可测量热导率跨越三个数量级的材料。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：锁相红外热成像（lock-in thermography），使用红外相机监测材料的热相位空间分布，并与调制激光频率锁定；热模型：采用常用于热反射分析的多层热模型（multilayered thermal model），将热导率作为拟合参数从相位分布中提取。技术细节：不严格要求使用换能层，但建议使用可移除的粘附层作为近表面吸收体。

papers.title: Resolving Finite-Size Errors in EOM-CCSD Band Gaps of Solids with Interacting-Bath Dynamical Embedding Theory
papers.abstract: Periodic equation-of-motion coupled-cluster theory with single and double excitations (EOM-CCSD) has shown promise for quantitative calculations of band structures in solids. However, its steep computational scaling has limited calculations to relatively coarse $k$-point meshes, leading to sizable finite-size errors and discrepant estimates of thermodynamic-limit band gaps in recent benchmarks. In this work, we revisit EOM-CCSD band gaps for ten semiconductors and insulators using interacting-bath dynamical embedding theory (ibDET), a systematically improvable Green's function embedding framework that enables dense Brillouin-zone sampling at modest computational cost. By pushing the $k$-point sampling up to $10\times10\times10$, well beyond the system sizes accessible in canonical periodic EOM-CCSD calculations, we significantly reduce finite-size errors and obtain stable thermodynamic-limit extrapolations. We further compare $G_0W_0$@PBE, $G_0W_0$@HF, and EOM-CCSD on an equal footing using the same numerical settings in PySCF. We find that EOM-CCSD yields a mean absolute error of 0.32 eV relative to experimental band gaps for a test set of ten semiconductors and insulators, lower than that of $G_0W_0$@PBE. For ZnO, EOM-CCSD also accurately describes the Zn $3d$-band binding energy, despite overestimating the band gap. These results demonstrate that ibDET offers a practical route to high-accuracy many-body electronic structure calculations in periodic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：EOM-CCSD、ibDET、Green's function embedding、PySCF。；研究对象：十种半导体和绝缘体（包括ZnO）的能带结构，具体关注带隙和Zn 3d带结合能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过ibDET方法实现密集布里渊区采样（10×10×10 k点网格），显著降低了EOM-CCSD计算中的有限尺寸误差，得到稳定的热力学极限外推；EOM-CCSD对十种半导体和绝缘体的实验带隙平均绝对误差为0.32 eV，优于G₀W₀@PBE，且能准确描述ZnO的Zn 3d带结合能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过ibDET方法实现密集布里渊区采样（10×10×10 k点网格），显著降低了EOM-CCSD计算中的有限尺寸误差，得到稳定的热力学极限外推；EOM-CCSD对十种半导体和绝缘体的实验带隙平均绝对误差为0.32 eV，优于G₀W₀@PBE，且能准确描述ZnO的Zn 3d带结合能。；创新点：将ibDET应用于周期性EOM-CCSD计算，首次实现了远超传统周期EOM-CCSD所能达到的系统尺寸（10×10×10 k点网格），从而有效解决了有限尺寸误差问题，并提供了与G₀W₀方法在相同数值条件下的公平比较。
papers.method_zh: 采用相互作用浴动力学嵌入理论（ibDET），这是一种可系统改进的格林函数嵌入框架，用于在较低计算成本下实现密集k点采样；在PySCF中统一数值设置下，对比了G₀W₀@PBE、G₀W₀@HF和EOM-CCSD的计算结果。

papers.title: Spontaneous symmetry breaking under Bose--Einstein condensation
papers.abstract: Due to high current interest to Bose-Einstein condensation, the related topics, such as spontaneous gauge symmetry breaking, ergodic decomposition, and particle fluctuations, are intensively discussed in literature. These discussions, unfortunately, involve quite a number of controversies and confusions. The goal of the present brief survey is to clarify some of these confusions, concentrating on the principal points, such as the relationship between the conditions of Bose-Einstein condensation, the Bogolubov method of quasiaverages, spontaneous gauge symmetry breaking, ergodic decomposition, the presumed existence of nonthermodynamic particle fluctuations leading to the so-called ``grand canonical catastrophe", and the requirements for system stability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“brief survey”（简要综述），并讨论“Bogolubov method of quasiaverages”、“ergodic decomposition”等理论概念，未涉及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（Bose-Einstein condensation）中的自发规范对称性破缺、遍历分解、粒子数涨落及系统稳定性等基础理论问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 澄清了玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚条件、自发规范对称性破缺、遍历分解、非热力学粒子数涨落（所谓“巨正则灾难”）以及系统稳定性要求之间的逻辑关系，并试图消除当前文献中存在的争议与混淆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：澄清了玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚条件、自发规范对称性破缺、遍历分解、非热力学粒子数涨落（所谓“巨正则灾难”）以及系统稳定性要求之间的逻辑关系，并试图消除当前文献中存在的争议与混淆。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体包括：Bogolubov准平均方法、遍历分解理论、对粒子数涨落与巨正则系综稳定性的讨论。

papers.title: Multiband Superconductivity and Charge Density Wave in HfxZr1-xTe3 single crystals
papers.abstract: We report on the bulk multiband superconductivity and charge density wave (CDW) in HfxZr1-xTe3 single crystals. The parent compound ZrTe3 is a layered van der Waals material that undergoes a CDW transition near 63 K and exhibits only filamentary superconductivity below 2.0 K. Upon the introduction of a small amount of Hf (x = 0.02), the CDW transition temperature is reduced to TCDW ~ 53 K, while a robust bulk superconducting state emerges at Tc ~ 3.3 K, underscoring a subtle competition between CDW order and superconductivity in this quasi-one-dimensional system. Electrical resistivity, magnetic susceptibility, Hall effect, Seebeck coefficient, and specific heat measurements consistently confirm the bulk nature of the superconducting phase. The temperature dependence of the upper critical field Hc2(T) deviates markedly from single-band behavior, and it is well described by a two-band model, consistent with multiband superconductivity. Analysis of the Hall effect, and thermoelectric behavior reveal pronounced electronic anisotropy, with enhanced effective carrier masses, indicating that the subtle structural modification introduced by Hf substitutions affects the Fermi surface topology, as well as electronic correlations. Measurements of electrical resistivity in hydrostatic pressures up to ~ 2 GPa reveal that pressure drives TCDW to higher temperatures while suppressing Tc. These findings show that Hf doping can be used to fine-tune the balance between the CDW instability and superconductivity, possibly by means of chemical pressure effects, stabilizing a multiband superconducting state in Hf-doped ZrTe3.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：单晶生长、电输运、磁化率、比热、霍尔效应、Seebeck系数、静水压测量。；研究对象：HfxZr1-xTe3单晶中的多带超导电性与电荷密度波（CDW）。具体为Hf掺杂对ZrTe3这一准一维层状范德瓦尔斯材料中CDW与超导竞争关系的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 少量Hf掺杂（x=0.02）将CDW转变温度从~63 K降至~53 K，同时诱导出体超导电性（Tc~3.3 K），且该超导态具有多带特性；静水压则使CDW增强、超导被抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：少量Hf掺杂（x=0.02）将CDW转变温度从~63 K降至~53 K，同时诱导出体超导电性（Tc~3.3 K），且该超导态具有多带特性；静水压则使CDW增强、超导被抑制。；创新点：首次在Hf掺杂ZrTe3中实现从丝状超导到体超导电性的转变，并明确揭示多带超导特征，通过化学压力（Hf替代）精细调控CDW与超导的竞争平衡。
papers.method_zh: 单晶生长；电输运测量（电阻率、上临界场Hc2(T)）；磁化率；霍尔效应；Seebeck系数；比热；静水压（~2 GPa）下的电阻率测量；两带模型拟合Hc2(T)。

papers.title: Computationally efficient method for determining limiting velocities of edge dislocations in anisotropic crystals
papers.abstract: The continuum-limit theory of dislocations in crystals predicts divergences in the elastic energy at crystal-geometry dependent limiting velocities $v_L$, which separate subsonic, transsonic, and supersonic dislocation glide regimes and are therefore import for material strength models at high strain rates. Although it is known how to calculate those limiting velocities, there is one special case - edge dislocations with reflection symmetry, but non-vanishing elastic constants $c'_{16}$ or $c'_{26}$ - where previous methods have been notoriously slow. In this letter, we address this deficiency by deriving a computationally efficient method for determining the limiting velocities of edge dislocations with reflection symmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：continuum-limit theory（连续极限理论）、deriving a computationally efficient method（推导计算方法）。；研究对象：各向异性晶体中刃型位错的极限速度（limiting velocities），特别是具有反射对称性但弹性常数 \(c'_{16}\) 或 \(c'_{26}\) 非零的特殊情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 针对反射对称性刃型位错中因非零 \(c'_{16}\) 或 \(c'_{26}\) 导致传统计算方法极慢的问题，提出了一种计算效率更高的新方法，用于确定其极限速度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：针对反射对称性刃型位错中因非零 \(c'_{16}\) 或 \(c'_{26}\) 导致传统计算方法极慢的问题，提出了一种计算效率更高的新方法，用于确定其极限速度。；创新点：解决了以往在特定对称性条件下（反射对称性且 \(c'_{16}\) 或 \(c'_{26}\) 非零）计算极限速度时计算速度极慢的缺陷，首次提出了针对该特殊情况的快速计算方法。
papers.method_zh: 基于连续极限位错理论，通过数学推导得到一种计算效率更高的方法，用于确定反射对称性刃型位错的极限速度。摘要未明确说明具体推导细节或数值算法。

papers.title: The formation of magnetic reentrancy in the Ising model on a decorated square lattice
papers.abstract: In our work, based on an exact solution of the Ising model on a decorated square lattice with an arbitrary number of decorating spins, we have demonstrated the fundamental possibility of describing the phenomenon of multiple magnetic phase transitions (magnetic reentrancy) in the regime of competing exchange interactions. We analyzed the magnetic behavior of the system and established the conditions for the occurrence of magnetic reentrancy. We have determined the relationships of the model parameter under which the formation of one, three, and even five magnetic phase transitions is possible, which is confirmed by a complicated magnetic phase diagram. We have also proposed a unique method for finding critical temperatures that allows for the precise determination of their number and values, including those at extremely low temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact solution（精确解）、Ising model（伊辛模型）、theoretical analysis（理论分析）。；研究对象：在具有竞争交换相互作用的装饰方格晶格上的伊辛模型，具体研究该体系中出现的多重磁相变现象（磁回滞）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确求解装饰方格晶格上的伊辛模型，证明了在竞争交换相互作用条件下，系统可以出现一个、三个甚至五个磁相变，并给出了这些多重相变形成的参数条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确求解装饰方格晶格上的伊辛模型，证明了在竞争交换相互作用条件下，系统可以出现一个、三个甚至五个磁相变，并给出了这些多重相变形成的参数条件。；创新点：首次在装饰方格晶格伊辛模型的精确解框架下，系统证明了多重磁相变（磁回滞）现象存在的可能性，并给出了多达五个相变的具体参数关系，同时提出了精确确定极低温临界温度的新方法。
papers.method_zh: 基于装饰方格晶格上任意数量装饰自旋的伊辛模型的精确解，通过分析系统的磁行为，建立了磁回滞发生的条件，并提出了一种独特的临界温度求解方法，可精确确定临界温度的数量和数值（包括极低温下的临界温度）。

papers.title: Compositional gradient engineering for enhanced ferroelectricity in ultrathin AlScN
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric AlScN is promising for CMOS-compatible non-volatile memory, but thickness scaling is limited by leakage, premature breakdown, and defect-mediated failure. Here we show that compositional grading within a continuous wurtzite AlN-AlScN lattice mitigates these limitations by distributing structural and polarization discontinuities across the film thickness, reducing defect formation and local field concentration. In a 20 nm graded heterostructure, monotonic Sc incorporation and AlN-rich boundaries produce reversible ferroelectric switching, an as-grown metal-polar state, a 21% higher breakdown field, 10% enhanced remanent polarization, and 40x higher resistivity relative to homogeneous AlScN. Time-domain PUND measurements reveal strongly suppressed post-switching leakage, consistent with reduced defect-assisted and polarization-coupled conduction. This improved dielectric robustness enables ferroelectric functionality in 5 nm graded stacks containing only a 2 nm $\mathrm{Al}_{0.64}\mathrm{Sc}_{0.36}\mathrm{N}$ region, with measurable switching near 1 V. These results establish compositional grading as a defect- and field-management strategy for scalable ultrathin wurtzite ferroelectrics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Time-domain PUND measurements”等具体实验测量手段，以及“20 nm graded heterostructure”“5 nm graded stacks”等样品制备与表征结果。；研究对象：铁电AlScN薄膜，具体为通过组分梯度工程（compositional grading）构建的连续纤锌矿AlN-AlScN异质结构，研究其超薄尺度下的铁电性增强与漏电抑制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在连续纤锌矿AlN-AlScN晶格中引入组分梯度（从AlN-rich到Sc逐渐增加），可有效分散结构不连续性和极化突变，减少缺陷形成与局部电场集中，从而在20 nm梯度异质结构中实现可逆铁电翻转、击穿场强提高21%、剩余极化增强10%、电阻率提升40倍，并在仅含2 nm Al₀.₆₄Sc₀.₃₆N区域的5 nm超薄堆叠中仍保持可测量的铁电开关行为（~1 V）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在连续纤锌矿AlN-AlScN晶格中引入组分梯度（从AlN-rich到Sc逐渐增加），可有效分散结构不连续性和极化突变，减少缺陷形成与局部电场集中，从而在20 nm梯度异质结构中实现可逆铁电翻转、击穿场强提高21%、剩余极化增强10%、电阻率提升40倍，并在仅含2 nm Al₀.₆₄Sc₀.₃₆N区域的5 nm超薄堆叠中仍保持可测量的铁电开关行为（~1 V）。；创新点：首次提出将组分梯度工程作为缺陷与电场管理策略，用于实现可扩展的超薄纤锌矿铁电体，克服了传统均匀AlScN在厚度缩小时因漏电、过早击穿和缺陷介导失效导致的性能瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 采用组分梯度外延生长（连续纤锌矿AlN-AlScN晶格），结合时域PUND（正-负-正-负脉冲）测量表征开关后漏电，以及击穿场强、剩余极化、电阻率等电学性能测试。

papers.title: Hierarchical Interdiffusion Kinetics in Nanoscale Ni/Al Multilayers
papers.abstract: Nanoscale mass transport governs the onset of intermetallic formation in reactive metallic multilayers, yet the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Here, we combine fast differential scanning calorimetry (FDSC) of free-standing Ni/Al multilayers (20 nm bilayer thickness) with correlative STEM to resolve the early interdiffusion regime. Varying the heating rate over five orders of magnitude (0.1 to 10,000 K/s) enables isoconversional Kissinger-Akahira-Sunose (KAS) analysis, linking heat-flow signatures to microstructural evolution. The as-deposited multilayers are nanocrystalline and exhibit pronounced premixing, with significant Ni enrichment throughout the Al layers. Upon annealing, mass transport proceeds hierarchically: at low temperatures, Ni diffusion is confined to Al grain boundaries (~81 kJ/mol), while at higher temperatures lattice diffusion from grain boundaries into the grain interiors becomes active (~168 kJ/mol), leading to increased mass transport and heat release. These findings identify grain boundaries as the dominant transport pathways controlling reaction onset and as key microstructural design parameters in reactive multilayers. By providing access to transient kinetic regimes and intermediate states, the combined FDSC-microscopy approach opens new opportunities for studying defect-mediated transport and non-equilibrium phase transformations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：fast differential scanning calorimetry (FDSC)、correlative STEM、Kissinger-Akahira-Sunose (KAS) analysis。；研究对象：纳米尺度Ni/Al多层膜（双层厚度20 nm）中的早期互扩散动力学，以及由此引发的金属间化合物形成过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在纳米Ni/Al多层膜中，质量输运呈现层级性：低温下Ni扩散局限于Al晶界（活化能约81 kJ/mol），高温下晶界向晶粒内部的晶格扩散被激活（活化能约168 kJ/mol），导致质量输运和放热增加。晶界是控制反应起始的主导输运通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在纳米Ni/Al多层膜中，质量输运呈现层级性：低温下Ni扩散局限于Al晶界（活化能约81 kJ/mol），高温下晶界向晶粒内部的晶格扩散被激活（活化能约168 kJ/mol），导致质量输运和放热增加。晶界是控制反应起始的主导输运通道。；创新点：通过跨越五个数量级的加热速率，首次在实验上解析了纳米Ni/Al多层膜早期互扩散的瞬态动力学过程，并直接揭示了晶界作为主导输运路径的层级扩散机制，为将晶界作为反应性多层膜的关键微结构设计参数提供了依据。
papers.method_zh: 结合快速差示扫描量热法（FDSC，加热速率跨越五个数量级：0.1至10,000 K/s）与关联扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM），并采用等转化率Kissinger-Akahira-Sunose (KAS) 分析方法将热流信号与微观结构演化关联。

papers.title: Dynamical Control of Superconductivity in Superconductor-Ferromagnet Bilayers
papers.abstract: We study a simplified model of a ferromagnetic metal proximitized by a fully-gapped $s-$wave superconductor and integrated with a microwave resonator. The low-energy excitations in the combined system consist of ferromagnetic magnons, Bogoliubov excitations of the superconductor, and cavity photons. We show here that when the magnons and photons have comparable frequencies and are subject to an external drive, the hybridized driven magnon-polaritons induce a non-equilibrium crossover from the expected proximitized nodal $p-$wave superconductor to a fully gapped $(p_x+ip_y)-$superconductor. Moreover, the characteristic crossover temperature is inversely related to the magnon-photon detuning. We compute the temperature-dependent renormalization of the cavity photon frequencies across this nodal to nodeless evolution, which modifies the kinetic inductance of the resonator, and find a number of non-trivial features tied to the non-equilibrium (i.e., driven) nature of the problem. We compare and contrast these results with a recent circuit quantum electrodynamics (cQED) based experiment studying a permalloy-niobium bilayer, where a non-trivial dependence of the low-temperature cavity response on the magnon-photon detuning was observed. Our results pave the way for a principled exploration of engineering novel states of matter by coupling cavity photons to electronic collective modes in correlated two-dimensional materials and interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：study a simplified model, show, compute, compare and contrast with experiment）；研究对象：超导体-铁磁体双层膜（具体为全能隙s波超导体近邻化铁磁金属，并与微波谐振腔集成）中的超导态动力学调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当铁磁磁子与腔光子频率相近并受外部驱动时，混合驱动的磁子-极化激元会诱导系统从预期的近邻化节线p波超导体转变为全能隙(p_x+ip_y)超导体，且该转变的特征温度与磁子-光子失谐成反比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当铁磁磁子与腔光子频率相近并受外部驱动时，混合驱动的磁子-极化激元会诱导系统从预期的近邻化节线p波超导体转变为全能隙(p_x+ip_y)超导体，且该转变的特征温度与磁子-光子失谐成反比。；创新点：揭示了通过驱动磁子-光子耦合系统实现超导态从节线到无能隙的动力学交叉，并指出该交叉温度可由磁子-光子失谐调控；结果与近期基于电路量子电动力学（cQED）的坡莫合金-铌双层膜实验进行了对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于简化模型的理论分析，包括计算磁子、Bogoliubov激发和腔光子的低能激发谱，分析非平衡驱动下的磁子-极化激元杂化，并计算温度依赖的腔光子频率重整化（即动力学电感修正）。

papers.title: Influence-solvability: a systematic theory of $(1+1)D$ solvability and its application to brickwork circuits
papers.abstract: `Solvable' circuits, such as dual unitaries and its generalisations, have arisen as paradigmatic examples of tractable chaotic non-equilibrium dynamics, both in classical and quantum systems. However, while increasingly more complicated sufficient conditions have been proposed, a systematic theory classifying and understanding general features of solvable circuits is missing. We develop such a theory by introducing influence-solvable circuits, a class of $(1+1)D$ circuits whose influence matrix, which represents the `bath' generated by its own evolution, is given by a uniform MPS with finite bond-dimension $χ$. This property allows for efficient computation of subsystem dynamics and essentially contains all known examples of solvable circuits. We derive a set of necessary and sufficient local conditions by using a version of the fundamental theorem of MPS for open boundary conditions. Next we apply our theory to brickwork circuits with $χ=1$ influence-solvability and perform a systematic classification of classical brickwork circuits with local dimension up to $d=3$ and quantum brickwork circuits with $d=2$. Our search reveals new solvable circuits that are not captured by known solvability conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“develop such a theory”、“derive a set of necessary and sufficient local conditions”、“perform a systematic classification”，属于理论框架构建与分类研究。；研究对象：可解电路（solvable circuits），特别是(1+1)维砖墙电路（brickwork circuits），包括经典和量子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了“影响可解电路”（influence-solvable circuits）这一系统性理论框架，该框架通过影响矩阵的均匀MPS表示（有限键维数χ）统一了所有已知可解电路，并发现了未被已有可解性条件捕捉的新可解电路。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了“影响可解电路”（influence-solvable circuits）这一系统性理论框架，该框架通过影响矩阵的均匀MPS表示（有限键维数χ）统一了所有已知可解电路，并发现了未被已有可解性条件捕捉的新可解电路。；创新点：首次建立了可解电路的系统性分类理论，而非仅提出更复杂的充分条件；通过影响矩阵的MPS表示给出了可解性的统一刻画，并发现了超越已知可解性条件的新电路实例。
papers.method_zh: 利用开放边界条件下MPS基本定理的变体，推导影响可解性的必要充分局部条件；对χ=1的影响可解砖墙电路进行系统分类，包括局域维度d≤3的经典砖墙电路和d=2的量子砖墙电路。

papers.title: Hidden antiferromagnetism, persistent valley fluctuations, and $U(6)$ crossovers in triangular-lattice M-point moiré materials via determinantal quantum Monte Carlo
papers.abstract: A new moiré material platform was recently proposed based on twisting two-dimensional atomic monolayers whose low-energy states lie at the three M-points of the Brillouin Zone. Continuum and ab initio modeling suggest that electrons in the conduction bands of these materials realize three-valley Hubbard models with valley-selective, quasi-one-dimensional hopping. Remarkably, the onsite Hubbard repulsion is almost $U(6)$-symmetric without fine-tuning. Here, we show that this class of systems naturally admits sign-free determinantal Quantum Monte Carlo simulations at a filling of three electrons per moiré unit cell. We use these to explore the phase diagram for interactions of various strengths and $U(6)$-breaking anisotropies. We show that for near-isotropic interactions as relevant to, e.g., AA-stacked twisted SnSe$_2$, the system exhibits an extended intermediate-coupling regime in which local-moment formation and itinerancy compete, and the crossover to a putative low-temperature ordered state can be understood in terms of fluctuating $U(6)$ local moments. We argue that many of these features persist beyond the idealized sign-problem-free limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：determinantal Quantum Monte Carlo（行列式量子蒙特卡洛）、continuum and ab initio modeling（连续模型与第一性原理建模）、phase diagram（相图）。；研究对象：三角晶格M点莫尔材料（triangular-lattice M-point moiré materials），具体如AA堆叠的扭曲SnSe₂。该体系低能电子态位于布里渊区的三个M点，形成具有谷选择性和准一维跳迁的三谷Hubbard模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在每莫尔原胞填充三个电子的条件下，该体系在近各向同性相互作用（如AA堆叠扭曲SnSe₂）时，存在一个扩展的中等耦合区间，其中局域磁矩形成与巡游性相互竞争，且向低温有序态的交叉可由涨落的U(6)局域矩来理解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在每莫尔原胞填充三个电子的条件下，该体系在近各向同性相互作用（如AA堆叠扭曲SnSe₂）时，存在一个扩展的中等耦合区间，其中局域磁矩形成与巡游性相互竞争，且向低温有序态的交叉可由涨落的U(6)局域矩来理解。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：1）首次指出该类M点莫尔材料天然适合进行无符号问题的DQMC模拟；2）揭示了在近U(6)对称性下，系统存在一个由局域矩涨落主导的扩展中间耦合区间，并阐明了其与低温有序态的关联。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用无符号问题的行列式量子蒙特卡洛（sign-free determinantal Quantum Monte Carlo）模拟，并结合连续模型与第一性原理建模（continuum and ab initio modeling）进行描述。

papers.title: Composite Quantum Geometry and Semiclassical Dynamics
papers.abstract: We derive semiclassical equations of motion for general composite bound states in insulators and semiconductors, covering excitations such as excitons and trions. For neutral composites we find that a uniform external electric field does not couple to a Berry curvature term, contrary to the naive expectation from single-electron dynamics. Instead, a distinct quantum geometric quantity appears generically in the equations of motion. This quantity is the difference between inequivalent Berry connections that can be defined for the composite, generalising the concept of the quantum geometric dipole previously studied for excitons. In the case of charged composites such as trions, we find an additional Berry curvature contribution to the equations of motion. As we demonstrate, however, there is an infinite family of inequivalent composite Berry curvatures, and so care must be taken to make the correct choice that describes the physical dynamics. We explain how this choice should be made dependent on the definition of a spatial centre for the composite. We end by discussing composite dynamics that have no single-electron counterpart. We find that trions in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene undergo a transverse drift under an applied electric field and that this is driven not only by the Berry curvature contribution but also by the quantum geometric dipole. The interplay of these two geometric contributions further imprints itself on the trion's internal dynamics, causing its dipole moment to oscillate in time.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：推导半经典运动方程、讨论量子几何量、无实验或计算模拟描述。；研究对象：绝缘体和半导体中的复合束缚态（如激子、三激子）的量子几何与半经典动力学，特别关注魔角扭曲双层石墨烯中的三激子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 中性复合粒子（如激子）在均匀外电场中不产生贝里曲率项，而是出现一种新的量子几何量——不等价贝里联络之差（推广了量子几何偶极子概念）；带电复合粒子（如三激子）则存在贝里曲率贡献，但需根据复合粒子的空间中心定义正确选择贝里曲率。在魔角扭曲双层石墨烯中，三激子在外电场下发生横向漂移，该漂移由贝里曲率和量子几何偶极子共同驱动，且两者相互作用导致三激子偶极矩随时间振荡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：中性复合粒子（如激子）在均匀外电场中不产生贝里曲率项，而是出现一种新的量子几何量——不等价贝里联络之差（推广了量子几何偶极子概念）；带电复合粒子（如三激子）则存在贝里曲率贡献，但需根据复合粒子的空间中心定义正确选择贝里曲率。在魔角扭曲双层石墨烯中，三激子在外电场下发生横向漂移，该漂移由贝里曲率和量子几何偶极子共同驱动，且两者相互作用导致三激子偶极矩随时间振荡。；创新点：揭示了中性复合粒子与单电子动力学在电场响应上的本质差异（无贝里曲率项），提出了复合粒子不等价贝里联络差这一新几何量，并指出带电复合粒子贝里曲率的选择依赖于空间中心定义；首次发现三激子动力学中贝里曲率与量子几何偶极子的耦合导致偶极矩振荡。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：从一般复合束缚态的量子几何出发，推导半经典运动方程，并应用于激子和三激子体系。

papers.title: Charting the emergent low-dimensional manifold of quantum materials
papers.abstract: The periodic table of elements transformed chemistry by revealing simple organizing principles underlying atomic behavior. Despite decades of effort, no analogous framework has emerged for crystalline materials -- their microscopic complexity and vast configurational space have defied reduction to fundamental organizing principles. Current databases catalog thousands of synthesized materials, but extracting predictive, interpretable models from this wealth of data remains a formidable challenge. Here we demonstrate that the materials landscape possesses a hidden geometric organization that can be unveiled through unsupervised nonlinear dimensionality reduction. Applying differential geometry techniques to the Inorganic Crystal Structure Database (ICSD), we reveal that just a few combinations of microscopic descriptors capture the vast majority of variance in material properties. This low-dimensional embedding autonomously segregates superconductors from ordinary materials and further distinguishes superconducting families in ways that transcend chemical similarity alone. Remarkably, the discovered geometric organization directly governs critical temperatures ($T_c$) across diverse superconducting families, enabling accurate $T_c$ predictions without any knowledge of the pairing mechanism. Our approach uncovers emergent organizing principles that control macroscopic quantum behavior, offering a new paradigm in how we build models of complex quantum materials directly from experimental data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据关键词：unsupervised nonlinear dimensionality reduction、differential geometry techniques、low-dimensional embedding。；研究对象：晶体材料（基于无机晶体结构数据库ICSD）的几何组织规律，以及超导体的临界温度（\(T_c\)）预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 材料性质空间存在一个低维几何结构，仅需少数微观描述符即可解释大部分性质差异；该结构能自动区分超导体与普通材料，并直接决定不同超导家族的临界温度，无需依赖配对机制知识即可准确预测\(T_c\)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：材料性质空间存在一个低维几何结构，仅需少数微观描述符即可解释大部分性质差异；该结构能自动区分超导体与普通材料，并直接决定不同超导家族的临界温度，无需依赖配对机制知识即可准确预测\(T_c\)。；创新点：首次揭示材料景观中隐藏的几何组织，将微分几何方法引入材料数据库分析，实现了不依赖物理机制的\(T_c\)预测，为从实验数据中构建复杂量子材料模型提供了新范式。
papers.method_zh: 无监督非线性降维（微分几何技术），应用于无机晶体结构数据库（ICSD）中的材料数据，通过低维嵌入分析材料性质与微观描述符的关系。

papers.title: Cyclotron mass-selective de Haas-van Alphen measurements using temperature modulation
papers.abstract: We present a temperature-modulated de Haas-van Alphen measurement technique that allows selective addressing of quantum oscillations with different effective masses $m^{\ast}$ using a non-monotonic amplitude evolution with temperature and magnetic field, governed by the temperature derivative of the Lifshitz-Kosevich factor. The technique relies on harmonic modulation of the sample temperature and phase-sensitive detection of quantum oscillations in the voltage induced in a pick-up coil. We use a set of frequencies with strong Zeeman-driven harmonic content in the compensated topological semimetal MoSi$_{2}$ as a natural linear mass comb ranging from 1$m^{\ast}$ to 13$m^{\ast}$ to demonstrate the tunability of the mass-dependent quantum oscillation amplitudes experimentally. The technique allows to reliably isolate weak contributions of heavy orbits that are inaccessible in conventional de Haas-van Alphen frequency spectra because their frequency peaks overlap with much stronger frequency peaks of lighter orbits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“temperature-modulated de Haas-van Alphen measurement technique”的实验实现，并进行了“experimentally”的演示。；研究对象：补偿型拓扑半金属 MoSi₂ 中的量子振荡现象，特别是不同有效质量（m*）的德哈斯-范阿尔芬（dHvA）振荡。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种温度调制dHvA测量技术，通过非单调的振幅随温度和磁场的变化，能够选择性地探测不同有效质量的量子振荡，从而可靠地分离出传统频谱中因与轻轨道强峰重叠而无法分辨的重轨道弱信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种温度调制dHvA测量技术，通过非单调的振幅随温度和磁场的变化，能够选择性地探测不同有效质量的量子振荡，从而可靠地分离出传统频谱中因与轻轨道强峰重叠而无法分辨的重轨道弱信号。；创新点：利用温度调制实现有效质量选择性探测，能够隔离传统dHvA频谱中因频率峰重叠而无法分辨的重轨道弱贡献。
papers.method_zh: 温度调制dHvA测量技术。具体包括：对样品温度进行谐波调制，结合锁相检测拾取线圈中感应的电压信号，利用Lifshitz-Kosevich因子的温度导数来控制振幅演化。

papers.title: Spin correlations, low-energy scales, and anisotropy scaling in kagome frustrated magnets
papers.abstract: Neutron scattering is central to identifying quantum states of magnetic materials. In the search for quantum spin liquids, broad spectral features of inelastic spectra have been cited as evidence for spinon excitations, but can also arise from magnon excitations excitations in the presence of quenched disorder and strong magnon interactions. We develop a new approach to this problem, based on the adiabatic continuity in the $XXZ$ Heisenberg model on geometrically frustrating (GF) lattices as a function of the model's anisotropy. Using this approach, we identify universal features and energies of finite-temperature spin correlators. Focusing on the kagome lattice, we show that the low-energy spin spectral function contains robust, momentum-independent peaks with frequencies: $ω_1 \approx 3.4 T^*$ and $ω_2 \approx 6.3 T^*$, where the ``hidden energy scale'' $T^*$ is the characteristic scale of a low-temperature peak in the heat capacity, at which many GF magnets also display spin-glass freezing. We show that the spectral features at low energies $ω\lesssim T^*$ arise from single-magnon scattering and identify the magnetizations of the respective excitations. We explore the evolution of the spectral features with temperature and discuss extensions to other GF lattices. Our results provide a sharp spectroscopic criterion for interpreting neutron scattering in kagome and other GF quantum magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a new approach”“identify universal features”“show that”等理论推导和模型分析关键词，未涉及具体实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：几何阻挫（GF）晶格上的XXZ海森堡模型，重点聚焦于kagome（笼目）晶格上的阻挫磁体及其自旋关联、低能标度和各向异性标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在kagome晶格上，低能自旋谱函数中存在两个与动量无关的稳健峰，频率分别为ω₁≈3.4T*和ω₂≈6.3T*，其中T*是热容低温峰的特征能标，也是许多几何阻挫磁体出现自旋玻璃冻结的温度标度。低能（ω≲T*）谱特征源于单磁子散射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在kagome晶格上，低能自旋谱函数中存在两个与动量无关的稳健峰，频率分别为ω₁≈3.4T*和ω₂≈6.3T*，其中T*是热容低温峰的特征能标，也是许多几何阻挫磁体出现自旋玻璃冻结的温度标度。低能（ω≲T*）谱特征源于单磁子散射。；创新点：提出了基于绝热连续性和各向异性标度的新分析框架，将热容中的“隐藏能标”T*与中子散射谱中的特征频率直接关联，为区分量子自旋液体与阻挫磁体中磁子激发提供了明确的谱学判据。
papers.method_zh: 基于XXZ海森堡模型在几何阻挫晶格上的绝热连续性，通过分析模型各向异性参数的变化，识别有限温度自旋关联函数的普适特征和能量标度。

papers.title: Mixed-dimensional quantum Monte Carlo studies of M-point moiré materials
papers.abstract: A new moiré-material platform has recently been proposed based on twisting two-dimensional triangular-lattice monolayers whose low-energy states lie at the three M points of the Brillouin zone. Continuum models derived from extensive ab initio simulations suggest that electrons in the conduction bands of one such M-point moiré material, twisted AA-stacked SnSe$_2$, realize a three-orbital Hubbard model with orbitally-selective, quasi-one-dimensional (quasi-1D) hopping, protected by a projective mirror symmetry. Here, we show that the resulting "mixed-dimensional" limit -- in which the hopping is exactly quasi-1D in each valley, while the valleys are coupled by interactions into a fully two-dimensional network -- can be sampled with Stochastic Series Expansion (SSE) quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) without a sign problem at any filling. We develop an efficient new SSE QMC algorithm that combines custom global updates with parallel tempering to overcome the equilibration challenges posed by the mixed-dimensional setting. We then use this algorithm to explore the phase diagram of M-point twisted AA-stacked SnSe$_2$. Over extended and realistic ranges of twist angles and interaction strengths, we find that at integer fillings the system supports correlated insulators whose nature and strength depend strongly on angle. At certain commensurate fractional fillings, we further find evidence for Wigner-Mott insulators. We analytically account for the main features observed numerically using a strong-coupling description. Finally, we discuss perturbations away from the mixed-dimensional limit and the possibility of applying our method to other realizations of mixed-dimensional Hubbard models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）、连续模型、强耦合描述。；研究对象：M点莫尔材料，具体为扭曲AA堆叠SnSe₂中的电子体系，以及其实现的三轨道哈伯德模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在混合维度极限下，扭曲AA堆叠SnSe₂在整数填充时支持关联绝缘体，其性质强烈依赖于扭转角；在特定分数填充时存在维格纳-莫特绝缘体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在混合维度极限下，扭曲AA堆叠SnSe₂在整数填充时支持关联绝缘体，其性质强烈依赖于扭转角；在特定分数填充时存在维格纳-莫特绝缘体。；创新点：首次针对M点莫尔材料（扭曲AA堆叠SnSe₂）提出的混合维度极限，开发了高效的SSE QMC算法，克服了混合维度设置下的平衡化挑战，并系统绘制了其相图。
papers.method_zh: 使用随机级数展开（SSE）量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）方法，结合自定义全局更新与并行回火算法，对混合维度哈伯德模型进行无符号问题的数值模拟，并辅以强耦合解析描述。

papers.title: Electric-Field Mapping of Optically Perturbed CdTe Radiation Detectors
papers.abstract: In radiation detectors, the spatial distribution of the electric field plays a fundamental role in their operation. Access to this field distribution is of strategic importance, especially when investigating the perturbing effects induced by incident radiation. For example, one dangerous effect that prevents their proper operation is the accumulation of internal space charge. Here, we probe the two-dimensional electric field in a Schottky CdTe detector using the Pockels effect and report on its local perturbation after exposure to an optical beam at the anode electrode. Our electro-optical imaging setup, together with a custom processing routine, allows the extraction of the electric-field vector maps and their dynamics during a voltage bias-optical exposure sequence. The results are in agreement with numerical simulations, allowing us to confirm a two-level model based on a dominant deep level. Such a simple model is indeed able to fully account for both the temporal and spatial dynamics of the perturbed electric field. This approach thus allows a deeper understanding of the main mechanisms affecting the non-equilibrium electric-field distribution in CdTe Schottky detectors, such as those leading to polarization. In the future, it could also be used to predict and improve the performance of planar or electrode-segmented detectors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用Pockels效应探测”、“电光成像装置”、“提取电场矢量图”等实验手段，并结合数值模拟进行验证。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是Schottky型CdTe辐射探测器，物理现象是入射光（光学束）在阳极电极处对探测器内部电场分布的局部扰动，以及由此导致的空间电荷积累和极化效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Pockels效应实现了对CdTe探测器二维电场分布及其动态变化的直接成像，并确认一个基于单一深能级的双能级模型能够完全解释受扰动电场的时空动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Pockels效应实现了对CdTe探测器二维电场分布及其动态变化的直接成像，并确认一个基于单一深能级的双能级模型能够完全解释受扰动电场的时空动力学。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用基于Pockels效应的电光成像装置，结合自定义处理程序，在施加偏压和光学曝光序列过程中提取电场矢量图。理论上通过数值模拟验证了实验结果，并建立了一个基于主导深能级的双能级模型。

papers.title: Temporal glide symmetry enforces a parity sideband selection rule in scalar bulk media
papers.abstract: Symmetry is a powerful way to control coupling between photonic mode families. In spatially periodic structures, glide symmetry can protect band contacts and suppress stop bands. Here we show a different role for temporal glide, a spatiotemporal counterpart combining reflection with a half-period time translation. In a scalar time-modulated trilayer waveguide, temporal glide imposes an exact selection rule linking frequency conversion to transverse-mode symmetry: the parity content of every Floquet eigenstate alternates with sideband index, up to a state-dependent sign. In scattering, this means that a mode of definite parity can emit only into the opposite transverse parity at odd sidebands and into the same parity at even sidebands. We verify the rule directly in bulk Floquet eigenstates and in finite-section time-domain simulations. An incident odd waveguide mode is converted into an even frequency sideband, while all symmetry-forbidden output channels at the analysed sidebands are suppressed to numerically negligible values. Rather than acting as a temporal copy of spatial-glide band sticking, temporal glide provides a distinct symmetry principle for converting electromagnetic energy between selected modes and frequencies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要提及“Floquet eigenstates”“time-domain simulations”，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：时间调制的三层波导（scalar time-modulated trilayer waveguide）中，由时间滑移对称性（temporal glide symmetry）导致的频率转换与横模对称性之间的选择定则。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 时间滑移对称性强制一个严格的奇偶边带选择定则：在标量体介质中，每个Floquet本征态的奇偶性随边带索引交替变化（取决于态相关的符号），导致入射的确定奇偶性模式只能在奇数边带转换为相反横模奇偶性，在偶数边带转换为相同横模奇偶性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：时间滑移对称性强制一个严格的奇偶边带选择定则：在标量体介质中，每个Floquet本征态的奇偶性随边带索引交替变化（取决于态相关的符号），导致入射的确定奇偶性模式只能在奇数边带转换为相反横模奇偶性，在偶数边带转换为相同横模奇偶性。；创新点：揭示了时间滑移对称性不同于空间滑移对称性的新物理角色——它不是空间滑移能带粘附（band sticking）的时间副本，而是提供了一种在选定模式与频率之间转换电磁能量的独特对称性原理。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析（基于Floquet本征态对称性）结合有限截面时域数值模拟（finite-section time-domain simulations），验证了选择定则并确认对称性禁止的输出通道数值上可忽略。

papers.title: Diffusive Dynamics of Nonstabilizerness
papers.abstract: Symmetries shape the quantum-information dynamics of many-body systems, but their effect on nonstabilizerness, the resource complementary to entanglement, is less understood. We compute the stabilizer Rényi entropy, a measure of nonstabilizerness, in $\mathrm{U}(1)$-symmetric one-dimensional random circuits. The disorder-averaged dynamics is captured by a four-replica tensor network, which we evaluate by $S_4$-adapted infinite time-evolving block decimation (iTEBD) directly in the thermodynamic limit. Together with a hydrodynamic argument, our results identify a diffusive universality class for the late-time approach of nonstabilizerness to its random-state value, with the stabilizer Rényi entropy gap closing as $1/t$. The same scaling is verified in an energy-conserving nonintegrable Ising chain. More broadly, our framework provides a hydrodynamic perspective on nonstabilizerness generation and offers insight into the design of approximate Haar-random states in Hamiltonian dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：计算、hydrodynamic argument、tensor network、iTEBD。；研究对象：U(1)对称一维随机电路中的非稳定化子（nonstabilizerness）的扩散动力学，以及能量守恒非可积伊辛链中的非稳定化子行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非稳定化子（以稳定化子Rényi熵度量）在晚期趋近随机态值时，其间隙按1/t的标度律闭合，属于扩散普适类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非稳定化子（以稳定化子Rényi熵度量）在晚期趋近随机态值时，其间隙按1/t的标度律闭合，属于扩散普适类。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用四副本张量网络描述无序平均动力学，采用S4适应的无限时间演化块消减（iTEBD）直接在热力学极限下计算；结合流体力学论证；并在能量守恒的非可积伊辛链中进行数值验证。

papers.title: A ribbon ZX calculus for gauge theory
papers.abstract: ZX calculus provides a graphical formalism for reasoning about quantum processes, built from two interacting Frobenius algebras associated with the Z and X bases of a qubit. While it has found widespread application in quantum information and computing, its relationship to quantum field theory has only recently begun to be explored. In this work, we further develop this connection by providing a generalization of ZX calculus to two-dimensional Yang Mills theory with a compact gauge group. The key observation is that both frameworks can be organized around the Hopf Frobenius algebraic structure associated with a group algebra, which can in turn be described by the diagrammatics of two dimensional topological quantum field theory. Given the well known relationship between gauge theory and gravity in two and three dimensions, our work paves the way for applications of ZX to low dimensional gravity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：ZX calculus、graphical formalism、generalization、Yang Mills theory、topological quantum field theory。；研究对象：二维杨-米尔斯理论（two-dimensional Yang Mills theory）及其与ZX演算的关联，涉及紧致规范群（compact gauge group）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: ZX演算可以推广到具有紧致规范群的二维杨-米尔斯理论中，两者均基于群代数上的Hopf Frobenius代数结构，该结构可由二维拓扑量子场论的图解描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：ZX演算可以推广到具有紧致规范群的二维杨-米尔斯理论中，两者均基于群代数上的Hopf Frobenius代数结构，该结构可由二维拓扑量子场论的图解描述。；创新点：首次将ZX演算与二维杨-米尔斯理论建立系统联系，揭示了二者在代数结构上的统一性，并为ZX演算在低维引力中的应用铺平道路。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于ZX演算的图形化形式体系，结合Hopf Frobenius代数结构，利用二维拓扑量子场论的图解方法进行推广。

papers.title: A refined thermodynamic analysis of nonsecular master equations
papers.abstract: We present a systematic thermodynamic analysis of nonsecular master equations. We consider master equations resulting either from the partial secular and the geometric-arithmetic approximations, two approximations ensuring the positivity of the system's dynamics when some of its transition frequencies are too small to enable the full secular approximation. Both cause the system to relax towards a steady state which is not the Gibbs state of its bare Hamiltonian. Nonetheless, we build a unified, consistent thermodynamic framework for those dynamics. Starting from a microscopic expression of the second law based on system-environment correlations, we employ a systematic perturbation theory to preserve the positivity of the second law despite the approximations done on the dynamics. We show that, in spite of the weak system-bath coupling, the system-bath interaction energy participates to the energy balance, as well as the Lamb-shift. Those extra contributions give rise to work performed by the system on the bath when the former is out of equilibrium. We compare this microscopic entropy production with the definition based on the contractivity of the reduced system dynamics (Spohn inequality). We show that, unlike for secular master equations, the two entropy production rates differ because of the presence of non-vanishing stationary coherences in the energy eigenbasis. However, in the case of a single thermal bath, the difference is purely transient, and no work can be cyclically extracted from the steady-state despite its non-Gibbs form. Finally, we illustrate our results with a simple example, clarifying and completing the thermodynamic picture of Markovian dynamics in the quantum regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamic analysis、master equations、approximations、perturbation theory。；研究对象：非世俗主方程（nonsecular master equations）描述的开量子系统热力学，具体涉及部分世俗近似（partial secular approximation）和几何-算术近似（geometric-arithmetic approximation）下的马尔可夫动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱系统-浴耦合下，系统-浴相互作用能及兰姆移位（Lamb-shift）必须参与能量平衡，导致非平衡系统对浴做功；与世俗主方程不同，非世俗主方程的熵产生率因稳态相干性（stationary coherences）的存在而与Spohn不等式定义不同，但单热浴情况下差异仅为瞬态，无法从非吉布斯稳态中循环提取功。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱系统-浴耦合下，系统-浴相互作用能及兰姆移位（Lamb-shift）必须参与能量平衡，导致非平衡系统对浴做功；与世俗主方程不同，非世俗主方程的熵产生率因稳态相干性（stationary coherences）的存在而与Spohn不等式定义不同，但单热浴情况下差异仅为瞬态，无法从非吉布斯稳态中循环提取功。；创新点：首次对非世俗主方程（包括部分世俗近似和几何-算术近似）建立统一且自洽的热力学框架，明确指出了稳态相干性导致熵产生率差异的瞬态性质，并澄清了非吉布斯稳态下无法循环提取功的结论。
papers.method_zh: 基于系统-浴关联的微观第二定律表达式，采用系统微扰理论（systematic perturbation theory）保持第二定律的正定性；对比基于约化动力学压缩性（contractivity）的Spohn不等式定义。

papers.title: Optical Implementation of Equilibrium Propagation Using Spatial Photonic Ising Machines
papers.abstract: Equilibrium Propagation offers a compelling alternative to traditional machine learning for training energy-based networks. Here we demonstrate a hybrid optical-digital implementation of EP using a Spatial Photonic Ising Machine (SPIM). The SPIM exploits the gauge transformation method to optically encode both continuous neuron states and rank-1 binary trainable patterns as phase modulations via a spatial light modulator, with inference realized using a finite difference scheme. The experimental system is evaluated on the Wine classification dataset. The potential of this approach, including the use of continuous couplings and structured coupling matrices, is evaluated numerically on the more complex MNIST dataset. Our work provides a concrete pathway toward energy-efficient physical implementations of Equilibrium Propagation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+数值计算）。关键词：hybrid optical-digital implementation、experimental system is evaluated、evaluated numerically。；研究对象：基于空间光子伊辛机（Spatial Photonic Ising Machine, SPIM）的光学-数字混合系统，用于实现平衡传播（Equilibrium Propagation）算法，训练基于能量的神经网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用空间光子伊辛机成功实现了平衡传播算法的光学-数字混合实验，在Wine分类数据集上进行了实验验证，并在MNIST数据集上通过数值模拟展示了连续耦合和结构化耦合矩阵的潜力，为节能的物理实现平衡传播提供了具体路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用空间光子伊辛机成功实现了平衡传播算法的光学-数字混合实验，在Wine分类数据集上进行了实验验证，并在MNIST数据集上通过数值模拟展示了连续耦合和结构化耦合矩阵的潜力，为节能的物理实现平衡传播提供了具体路径。；创新点：首次将平衡传播算法在空间光子伊辛机上进行光学-数字混合实现，利用光学手段高效编码神经元状态和可训练模式，并展示了该方案在真实数据集上的可行性。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用空间光调制器（SLM）通过规范变换方法（gauge transformation method）光学编码连续神经元状态和秩1二元可训练模式作为相位调制，利用有限差分方案（finite difference scheme）实现推理；数值上评估了连续耦合和结构化耦合矩阵在MNIST数据集上的性能。

papers.title: Momentum Space Algorithm for Electronic Structure of Double-Incommensurate Trilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: Numerical algorithms for computing electronic structure of incommensurate 2D materials using ab initio models is critical for predicting material properties and guiding experiment. For bilayers, momentum space and continuum models have been introduced to approximate observables of ab initio tight-binding models using a momenta description despite the lack of periodicity in the tight-binding model required for Bloch theory. A similar structure has been introduced for double-incommensurate trilayers using a continuum model, where the three lattices are all mutually incommensurate. However, this description leads to a four-dimensional lattice space, and numerical convergence of the density of states was observed to have poor convergence. In this work, we introduce a momentum space framework for double incommensurate trilayer graphene, and introduce an efficient truncation scheme of the four-dimensional lattice to drastically improve convergence of the density of states and momentum local density of states (a parallel object to classical band structure). We implement this algorithm on an ab initio model of twisted trilayer graphene and validate convergence estimates. We further verify numerically that the momentum space algorithm, inherently higher order than the continuum model as it is an exact transformation of the tight-binding model, captures altered band behavior near the flat bands at magic angles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：numerical algorithms、ab initio models、momentum space framework、algorithm。；研究对象：双非公度三层石墨烯（double-incommensurate trilayer graphene）的电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种动量空间算法，通过高效的截断方案显著改善了双非公度三层石墨烯态密度和动量局域态密度的数值收敛性，并验证了该算法能捕捉魔角附近平带的能带行为变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种动量空间算法，通过高效的截断方案显著改善了双非公度三层石墨烯态密度和动量局域态密度的数值收敛性，并验证了该算法能捕捉魔角附近平带的能带行为变化。；创新点：针对双非公度三层石墨烯，提出了一种比连续模型更高阶的动量空间算法（是紧束缚模型的精确变换），并设计了有效的截断方案以解决此前态密度收敛性差的问题。
papers.method_zh: 基于紧束缚模型的动量空间框架，引入四维晶格的高效截断方案，并在扭曲三层石墨烯的从头算模型上实现该算法，通过收敛性估计进行数值验证。

papers.title: Numerical Hints for Dyon Condensation at $θ=2π$ via Wilson-'t Hooft Loops in $SU(2)$ Yang-Mills Theory
papers.abstract: Yang-Mills theories at $θ$ and $θ+2π$ are unitarily equivalent, but their $2π$ periodicity has a nontrivial realization. Recent developments in generalized global symmetries show that confinement vacua at $θ=0$ and $2π$ should belong to different symmetry-protected topological (SPT) states with the $1$-form center symmetry. For its examination, we measure the Wilson-'t Hooft loop operators at $θ=2π$ for the $SU(2)$ Wilson lattice gauge action and discuss their long-distance behaviors. This requires us to identify the gauge topological charge in the presence of defects, and we employ the $1$-form covariant DBW2 gradient flow to smear lattice gauge fields. We then obtain numerical evidence consistent with dyon condensation at $θ=2π$, rather than monopole condensation, as theoretically predicted.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：数值证据、测量、Wilson格点规范作用量、梯度流）；研究对象：SU(2)杨-米尔斯理论在θ=2π时的真空态性质，具体为dyon凝聚与monopole凝聚的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Wilson-’t Hooft圈算符的数值测量，获得了与dyon凝聚（而非monopole凝聚）一致的数值证据，支持了θ=0和θ=2π的禁闭真空属于不同对称性保护拓扑（SPT）态的理论预言。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Wilson-’t Hooft圈算符的数值测量，获得了与dyon凝聚（而非monopole凝聚）一致的数值证据，支持了θ=0和θ=2π的禁闭真空属于不同对称性保护拓扑（SPT）态的理论预言。；创新点：首次通过数值手段直接检验了θ=2π处dyon凝聚与monopole凝聚的竞争，为广义全局对称性框架下关于SPT态的理论预测提供了数值支持。
papers.method_zh: 采用SU(2) Wilson格点规范作用量，在θ=2π下测量Wilson-’t Hooft圈算符的长程行为；使用1-形式协变DBW2梯度流对格点规范场进行平滑处理，以在存在缺陷的情况下识别规范拓扑荷。

papers.title: Steady-State Noise Signatures of Lindbladian Exceptional Points
papers.abstract: Exceptional points (EPs) are non-Hermitian degeneracies at which two or more eigenvalues and their corresponding eigenvectors coalesce. In open quantum systems, exceptional points can arise in the Lindbladian governing the dissipative dynamics. Their signatures have so far been mainly identified in finite-time observables, such as transient currents, while steady-state average currents generally provide no direct evidence of the underlying exceptional-point structure. In this work, we demonstrate that signatures of Lindbladian EPs can nevertheless be accessed in the steady-state regime through current noise. We derive general expressions for current correlation functions within a Lindblad master-equation framework and show, in particular, how exceptional points affect their behaviour as a function of the time delay. We illustrate these results with the paradigmatic example of two interacting qubits coupled to two reservoirs, where the steady-state noise clearly distinguishes overdamped, underdamped, and critical regimes. Our results establish current correlation functions as a steady-state probe of Lindbladian EPs in open quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Lindblad master-equation framework、derive general expressions、theoretical demonstration。；研究对象：开放量子系统中Lindbladian奇异点（Lindbladian exceptional points）的稳态噪声特征，具体以两个相互作用的量子比特耦合到两个热库的体系为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过电流噪声（current noise）可以在稳态下探测到Lindbladian奇异点的特征，特别是电流关联函数随延迟时间的变化能清晰区分过阻尼、欠阻尼和临界三种动力学区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过电流噪声（current noise）可以在稳态下探测到Lindbladian奇异点的特征，特别是电流关联函数随延迟时间的变化能清晰区分过阻尼、欠阻尼和临界三种动力学区域。；创新点：此前Lindbladian奇异点的信号主要在有限时间观测量（如瞬态电流）中被识别，而稳态平均电流通常无法直接反映奇异点结构。本工作首次证明，通过稳态下的电流噪声（而非平均电流）可以获取Lindbladian奇异点的特征信息。
papers.method_zh: 基于Lindblad主方程框架，推导了电流关联函数的一般表达式，并通过两个相互作用量子比特与两个热库耦合的范例模型进行理论分析。

papers.title: Interference of critical dynamics associated with zero modes
papers.abstract: We study the interference of critical dynamics associated with zero modes (ICDZM) in the generalized Creutz ladders using closed quench paths that pass through two critical points successively. By reading out the final zero-mode transfer probability, we find rich ICDZM interference patterns dependent on the quench path. In particular, when the closed path links two topologically nontrivial phases, the ICDZM pattern may either vanish or exhibit period doubling. Within the framework of WKB analysis, this phenomenon is well clarified by the interference phase accumulated in the quench procedure. We also demonstrate that the zero-mode transfer probability can be detected by the deviation of the boundary particle number from its initial fractional value, which arises from the blending of bulk modes in the critical dynamics. As an edge defect, the zero-mode transfer probability captures both the ICDZM oscillation and the known anomalous defect production in a non-closed quench path. These results identify ICDZM and the corresponding edge defect as probes for critical dynamics associated with topological zero modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“WKB分析”、“quench paths”、“零模转移概率”等理论分析框架，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：广义Creutz梯子模型中的零模临界动力学干涉现象（ICDZM），具体研究通过闭合淬火路径穿过两个临界点时零模的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当闭合淬火路径连接两个拓扑非平庸相时，ICDZM干涉图案可能消失或出现周期倍增现象；零模转移概率可通过边界粒子数相对于初始分数值的偏离来探测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当闭合淬火路径连接两个拓扑非平庸相时，ICDZM干涉图案可能消失或出现周期倍增现象；零模转移概率可通过边界粒子数相对于初始分数值的偏离来探测。；创新点：首次揭示了闭合淬火路径下零模临界动力学的干涉图案与拓扑相结构之间的关联，并指出零模转移概率可作为探测拓扑零模临界动力学的边缘缺陷探针。
papers.method_zh: 采用闭合淬火路径（依次穿过两个临界点）驱动系统，通过读取最终零模转移概率分析干涉图案；运用WKB（Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin）近似分析淬火过程中积累的干涉相位。

papers.title: Chiral Long-Range Order in three Euclidean Lattice Gross-Neveu Models
papers.abstract: We prove the existence of Long-Range Order in a class of two-dimensional Euclidean lattice Gross-Neveu models with an even number of fermion flavors, covering three standard lattice discretizations, including naive and staggered fermions widely used in numerical studies. By performing a Hubbard-Stratonovich transformation, we map the fermionic systems to bosonic ones and establish Reflection Positivity for the resulting measures. Exploiting this structure, we combine Chessboard Estimates with a Peierls-type contour argument to prove Long-Range Order for the chirally charged fermion-mass bilinear $\overlineψψ$ at sufficiently small coupling and sufficiently large flavor number. Our analysis is robust with respect to the choice of lattice discretization and applies uniformly across different realizations of the same underlying continuum model. Moreover, we obtain uniform pointwise bounds on the bosonic two-point function, equivalently on the fermionic mass-mass correlator, showing that it is quantitatively controlled by the minimizers of the effective potential. This provides a fully rigorous and non-perturbative demonstration of Long-Range Order in lattice Gross-Neveu models and establishes a direct connection between the rigorous theory and its large-$N$ (mean-field) predictions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“prove”、“rigorous”、“non-perturbative”、“Chessboard Estimates”、“Peierls-type contour argument”。；研究对象：二维欧几里得格点Gross-Neveu模型，具体涵盖三种标准格点离散化方案（包括naive费米子和staggered费米子），研究其手性长程序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在足够小的耦合常数和足够大的费米子味道数下，证明了手性荷费米子质量双线性项⟨ψ̅ψ⟩存在长程序，并获得了玻色子两点函数（等价于费米子质量-质量关联函数）的一致逐点界，表明其受有效势极小值的定量控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在足够小的耦合常数和足够大的费米子味道数下，证明了手性荷费米子质量双线性项⟨ψ̅ψ⟩存在长程序，并获得了玻色子两点函数（等价于费米子质量-质量关联函数）的一致逐点界，表明其受有效势极小值的定量控制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过Hubbard-Stratonovich变换将费米子系统映射为玻色子系统，建立反射正性；结合棋盘估计（Chessboard Estimates）与Peierls型轮廓论证（Peierls-type contour argument）进行严格非微扰证明。

papers.title: Fibonacci Steady-States and Persistent Oscillations in an Ordered Multimode Dicke Model
papers.abstract: Ultracold atoms in multimode optical cavities provide a rich testbed for many-body phenomena enabled by light-mediated interactions. Recent experiments include realizations of spin glasses and associative memories, as described by multimode Dicke models with disordered couplings. However, the properties of multimode Dicke models with ordered coupling geometries remain largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate the stable steady-states of the multimode Dicke model with an ordered nearest-neighbor coupling geometry, where $n_c$ atomic clusters are coupled via $n_c-1$ cavity modes. We show that the number of mean-field stable steady-states in the superradiant phase exhibits Fibonacci scaling with the number of atomic clusters, and that a subset of these steady-states exhibit persistent oscillations. Using both the truncated Wigner approximation and the numerically-exact hierarchy of pure states, we further demonstrate that these features of the stable steady-state solutions persist for finite cluster sizes. Ordered multimode Dicke models, such as the nearest-neighbor coupling geometry considered here, are accessible with current experimental technologies and point toward a broader class of strongly interacting dissipative systems with similarly rich behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：investigate、mean-field stable steady-states、truncated Wigner approximation、numerically-exact hierarchy of pure states）；研究对象：有序多模Dicke模型中的多体系统，具体为具有最近邻耦合几何结构的原子团簇与腔模耦合体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超辐射相中，平均场稳定稳态的数量随原子团簇数呈斐波那契标度，且部分稳态表现出持续振荡行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超辐射相中，平均场稳定稳态的数量随原子团簇数呈斐波那契标度，且部分稳态表现出持续振荡行为。；创新点：首次系统研究了具有有序耦合几何（最近邻耦合）的多模Dicke模型的稳定稳态性质，揭示了斐波那契标度律和持续振荡现象，并证明这些特征在有限团簇尺寸下依然存在。
papers.method_zh: 平均场理论分析、截断维格纳近似（truncated Wigner approximation）以及数值精确的纯态层次方法（hierarchy of pure states）。

papers.title: Experiment-compatible measurement--feedback quantum state preparation with reinforcement learning
papers.abstract: Ground-state preparation is a critical task in quantum simulation and quantum computing, as it enables the study of correlated phases and the generation of entangled resource states. While measurement--feedback control has emerged as a promising route to state preparation, existing schemes either rely on handcrafted, task-specific policies or are designed using full quantum-state information that is unavailable in real experiments and becomes impractical for large many-body systems. Here we develop an adaptive measurement--feedback protocol based on reinforcement learning under partial observability. The controller uses only the history of experimentally accessible measurement outcomes to choose both the measurement operator and the feedback action in real time. To make training compatible with experiments, we introduce a stochastic terminal reward built from one-shot measurements of randomly sampled Hamiltonian components, avoiding unphysical full-state reconstruction while remaining an unbiased estimator of the target energy. We demonstrate the method by preparing ground states of the Bose--Hubbard model and by generating GHZ states, establishing a scalable and hardware-compatible route to quantum state preparation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“reinforcement learning”、“protocol”、“training”、“unbiased estimator”，主要涉及算法设计与数值演示。；研究对象：量子多体系统的基态制备，具体演示了Bose-Hubbard模型的基态和GHZ纠缠态的生成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于部分可观测性的强化学习测量-反馈协议，该协议仅利用实验可访问的测量结果历史来实时选择测量算符和反馈动作，并通过随机终端奖励避免了非物理的全态重构，实现了与实验兼容的量子态制备。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于部分可观测性的强化学习测量-反馈协议，该协议仅利用实验可访问的测量结果历史来实时选择测量算符和反馈动作，并通过随机终端奖励避免了非物理的全态重构，实现了与实验兼容的量子态制备。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程的强化学习框架。控制器仅使用实验可得的测量结果序列进行决策；训练中使用从随机采样的哈密顿量分量的一次性测量构建的随机终端奖励作为目标能量的无偏估计量。

papers.title: Global Control with the Tavis-Cummings Interaction
papers.abstract: We study the controllability of a system of qubits under global control, where control pulses act identically on all qubits. Specifically, we consider a collection of qubits identically coupled to a single bosonic mode, or harmonic oscillator, via the Jaynes-Cummings interaction. This collective coupling, known as the Tavis-Cummings (TC) interaction, has been realized in several quantum computing platforms, including superconducting and atomic qubit systems. Although the qubits do not interact directly with one another, they can become entangled through their common coupling to the bosonic mode. We characterize the group of unitaries that can be implemented on the joint Hilbert space of the qubits and bosonic mode using the TC interaction together with a global $z$ field $J_z$, corresponding to identical z rotations on all qubits. We show that for n>2 qubits the set of realizable unitaries is restricted by an "accidental" symmetry of the TC Hamiltonian, distinct from its "standard" U(1) and permutational symmetries. On the other hand, we find that the Hamiltonian $J_z^2$ breaks this accidental symmetry and, together with the TC interaction and $J_z$, achieves semi-universality: it allows the implementation of arbitrary unitaries that respect permutational and U(1) symmetry, up to certain constraints on the center of the group. In a companion paper, we further analyze this remarkable accidental symmetry and show that it can be understood through Schwinger's bosonic model of angular momentum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要讨论可控性分析、对称性分析、哈密顿量性质等理论内容，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：量子比特系统与单个玻色子模式（谐振子）通过Tavis-Cummings（TC）相互作用耦合的体系，具体为多个量子比特与同一玻色模的集体耦合系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于n>2个量子比特，TC哈密顿量存在一种“偶然”对称性（区别于标准的U(1)和置换对称性），限制了可实现酉变换的集合；而引入J_z^2哈密顿量可打破该偶然对称性，结合TC相互作用和J_z实现“半普适性”——允许实现满足置换对称性和U(1)对称性的任意酉变换（受群中心约束）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于n>2个量子比特，TC哈密顿量存在一种“偶然”对称性（区别于标准的U(1)和置换对称性），限制了可实现酉变换的集合；而引入J_z^2哈密顿量可打破该偶然对称性，结合TC相互作用和J_z实现“半普适性”——允许实现满足置换对称性和U(1)对称性的任意酉变换（受群中心约束）。；创新点：揭示了TC哈密顿量中一个此前未被认识的“偶然”对称性，并证明该对称性限制了全局控制下的量子比特系统可控性；提出通过J_z^2哈密顿量打破该对称性以实现半普适性控制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过群论和对称性分析，研究TC相互作用与全局z场J_z联合作用下可实现的酉变换集合；利用Schwinger玻色子角动量模型（在姊妹论文中进一步分析偶然对称性）。

papers.title: Accidental Symmetry in the Tavis-Cummings Model via the Schwinger Boson Representation
papers.abstract: The Jaynes-Cummings (JC) Hamiltonian is a paradigmatic model of light-matter interaction and, more generally, qubit-boson interactions, widely used across atomic, optical, and superconducting qubit platforms. In the multi-qubit setting, where n qubits are identically coupled to a single boson mode, this interaction is known as the Tavis-Cummings (TC) Hamiltonian. The structure of the TC model is usually understood in terms of two standard symmetries: permutation invariance of the qubits and a U(1) symmetry associated with conservation of the total excitation number. Here we identify an additional, independent "accidental" symmetry of the TC Hamiltonian and construct the corresponding conserved observable. We show that, for n>2 qubits, this symmetry imposes strong constraints on the realizable unitary transformations. These constraints persist in the presence of the global $J_z$ Hamiltonian, but are removed by adding $J_z^2$, even though $J_z^2$ preserves both permutation invariance and the U(1) symmetry. Finally, we explain the origin of this previously unnoticed symmetry using Schwinger's boson representation of angular momentum. These restrictions have important implications for controllability of the TC system and for its applications to quantum computing, which are investigated further in a companion paper.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要讨论哈密顿量结构、对称性分析、可实现的幺正变换约束等理论推导，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：Tavis-Cummings（TC）模型，即多个量子比特（qubit）与单个玻色子模式耦合的量子光学系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在n>2个量子比特的TC模型中，除了已知的置换对称性和U(1)对称性外，还存在一个额外的“偶然”对称性，该对称性对系统可实现的幺正变换施加了强约束，且该约束在加入全局J_z哈密顿量后依然存在，但可通过添加J_z^2项消除。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在n>2个量子比特的TC模型中，除了已知的置换对称性和U(1)对称性外，还存在一个额外的“偶然”对称性，该对称性对系统可实现的幺正变换施加了强约束，且该约束在加入全局J_z哈密顿量后依然存在，但可通过添加J_z^2项消除。；创新点：首次识别并构造了TC哈密顿量中一个此前未被注意到的“偶然”对称性及其对应的守恒可观测量，并阐明了该对称性对量子计算可控性的重要限制。
papers.method_zh: 利用Schwinger玻色子表示（Schwinger boson representation）对TC哈密顿量的角动量结构进行重新表述，从而揭示并解释该偶然对称性的起源。

papers.title: Fine-tuning MLIP foundation models: strategies for accuracy and transferability
papers.abstract: Adapting machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP) foundation models to specialised tasks through fine-tuning is an increasingly important practice, yet systematic guidance on when and how to fine-tune is currently limited. We evaluate seven fine-tuning strategies -- naive full-parameter updates, two layer-freezing variants, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), multihead replay, pseudolabelled replay, and replay combined with LoRA -- across five chemically diverse benchmarks (aqueous NaCl, ice polymorphs, S$_\mathrm{N}$2 reactions, SPICE biomolecules, and lithium electrolytes), three generations of foundation models, and training sets spanning five orders of magnitude. To support this evaluation we implement three capabilities in the MACE codebase: LoRA adapted for equivariant message-passing architectures, including both scalar and equivariant linear layers; pseudolabelled replay, which decouples the replay data source from the original pretraining corpus; and model-aware atomic reference energy (E0) reestimation for fine-tuning workflows. We find that foundation model quality, correct E0 initialisation, and well-chosen hyperparameters are prerequisites whose impact routinely exceeds that of the fine-tuning strategy itself. Once these prerequisites are met, most strategies achieve strong target-task accuracy, consistently surpassing models trained from scratch. The practical distinction depends on deployment scope: naive fine-tuning offers the best convergence for single-system applications, while multihead replay -- with either original or pseudolabelled data -- is the only approach tested that consistently preserves out-of-distribution robustness, maintaining both pretraining-distribution accuracy for broader deployment and many-body short-range repulsion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP) foundation models, fine-tuning strategies, MACE codebase。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是多种化学体系，包括：水溶液NaCl、冰多晶型、S_N2反应、SPICE生物分子和锂电解质。核心物理现象是原子间相互作用的机器学习势能模型的微调策略。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在满足基础模型质量、正确的原子参考能量（E0）初始化和良好超参数的前提下，大多数微调策略都能达到强目标任务精度，且一致优于从头训练的模型。其中，朴素全参数微调在单系统应用中收敛最佳，而多头回放（使用原始或伪标签数据）是唯一能保持分布外鲁棒性的方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在满足基础模型质量、正确的原子参考能量（E0）初始化和良好超参数的前提下，大多数微调策略都能达到强目标任务精度，且一致优于从头训练的模型。其中，朴素全参数微调在单系统应用中收敛最佳，而多头回放（使用原始或伪标签数据）是唯一能保持分布外鲁棒性的方法。；创新点：首次对MLIP基础模型的微调策略进行了系统性的跨基准、跨模型代际、跨训练集规模的对比评估，并提出了针对等变消息传递架构的LoRA适配、伪标签回放以及E0重估计等具体实现方法。
papers.method_zh: 系统评估了七种微调策略：朴素全参数更新、两种层冻结变体、低秩适应（LoRA）、多头回放、伪标签回放、以及回放结合LoRA。在MACE代码库中实现了三项新功能：适用于等变消息传递架构的LoRA（包括标量和等变线性层）、伪标签回放（解耦回放数据源与原始预训练语料）、以及模型感知的原子参考能量（E0）重估计。

papers.title: Multiple Topological Haldane Phases for Symmetry-Protected Quantum Information Processing
papers.abstract: Symmetry-protected topological phases have attracted significant interest at the fundamental level and as a potential platform for quantum information processing, owing to their protected edge states and resilience to perturbations. Applying these features for practical and efficient quantum computation is highly desirable, but remains an open challenge. Here, we demonstrate the partitioning into multiple independent Haldane phase subsystems of a single spin-1/2 ladder system and propose this as a scalable architecture for gate-based quantum computation, which takes advantage of the symmetry-protected topological order. We encode qubits in the two topological states of the $S^{z}=0$ sector of each subsystem. Finite-size effects, typically viewed as detrimental, instead provide a controllable energy splitting that enables single-qubit rotations using only local magnetic fields. An Ising-type interaction between neighboring subsystem edges generates entangling gates, enabling universal quantum computation driven by two control parameters that are easily accessible experimentally. Our results demonstrate how symmetry-protected topological phases can be directly harnessed for circuit-model quantum computation in realistic systems.
